function local_class:scene_manager()
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.qte_event

	self.is_prev_section = self.controller.starting_inner_progress <= 10

	if self.is_prev_section then
		self:tanker_qte_event()
	else
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })
			self:tanker_qte_event()
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:tanker_qte_event()
	local fallen_queen = self.get_fallen_queen_phase_1()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
	local desert_slave = self.get_desert_slave()
	local tanker = self.get_tanker()
	local leader = self.get_knight()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(fallen_queen)

	if fallen_queen.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		-- 죽은 상태이면 부활도 같이 시켜줌
		self:character_heal(fallen_queen)
	end

	self:character_heal(leader)
	self:character_heal(desert_slave)
	self:character_heal(teatan_hero)

	character_util.set_direction(fallen_queen, 'down')

	--카메라 중심은 (-52.5, 0, 30.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0)
	local camera_start_pos = leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	camera_util.move(camera_start_pos, 0)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--페이드 인 후
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라 1초간 (-52.5, 0, 36.5) 으로 이동
	local camera_pos = fallen_queen.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--아래 4개 동시에 시작
	--화면 3에서 2.5로 줌 인 (시간 1초)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 1)

	--카밀라 cleave_cast -> cleave_loop
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qc_07')
	local slow_key = 'slow_key'
	time_util.mod(slow_key)
	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, { name = 'cleave_cast', scale = 0.8, loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_ball_01')
	local missile_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_missile_loop_01', loop = true })
	local blast_cast_pos = fallen_queen.Position + vector(0, 1.8, 0)
	local boss_blast_cast = self.get_fx_boss_radiant_blast_cast():Instantiate(blast_cast_pos)

	wait_for_sec(0.067)
	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, { name = 'cleave_cast_loop', loop = false })

	--카밀라 로봇 손 모이는 지점(위 이미지 초록점)에 fx_boss_fallen_queen_radiant_blast_cast

	--카메라 shake 세기 0.1 (시간 2초)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 2)

	--카메라 shake 끝난 후 1 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	time_util.unmod(slow_key)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--크레이그(-52.5, 0, 31.5)  (up, dualsword_idle) 미리 배치
	local tanker_defence_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s13_qte_scene_tanker_pos_2')
	scene_util.set_anim(tanker, self, 'dualsword_idle')
	character_util.set_position(tanker, tanker_defence_pos)

	--아래 연출 동시에 시작
	--카밀라(down, idle attack, cleave loop X)
	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, { name = 'cleave', loop = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(fallen_queen, self, 'attack')

	--0.2초간 카메라 shake 0.4
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.2)

	--0.2초간 카메라 화면 2.5에서 3.5로 줌 아웃
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 0.2)

	wait_for_sec(0.095)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:boss_meteor_shoot(self.get_fx_boss_meteor(), meteor_start_pos, meteor_end_pos[2], meteor_speed_2, base_rotate)

	self:boss_meteor_shoot(self.get_fx_boss_meteor(), meteor_start_pos, meteor_end_pos[1], meteor_speed_2, base_rotate)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	self:boss_meteor_shoot(self.get_fx_boss_meteor(), meteor_start_pos, meteor_end_pos[2], meteor_speed_2, base_rotate)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	self:boss_meteor_shoot(self.get_fx_boss_meteor(), meteor_start_pos, meteor_end_pos[1], meteor_speed_2, base_rotate)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	self:boss_meteor_shoot(self.get_fx_boss_meteor(), meteor_start_pos, meteor_end_pos[2], meteor_speed_2, base_rotate)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	self:boss_meteor_shoot(self.get_fx_boss_meteor(), meteor_start_pos, meteor_end_pos[3], meteor_speed_2, base_rotate)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	self:boss_meteor_shoot(self.get_fx_boss_meteor(), meteor_start_pos, meteor_end_pos[1], meteor_speed_2, base_rotate)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	self:boss_meteor_shoot(self.get_fx_boss_meteor(), meteor_start_pos, meteor_end_pos[1], meteor_speed_2, base_rotate)

	--1초 대기

		local qte_meteor = self.get_fx_boss_meteor():Instantiate(meteor_start_pos)
		local qte_meteor_contrail = self.get_fx_boss_meteor_contrail():Instantiate(meteor_start_pos)

		--이펙트 스케일을 0.7배

		qte_meteor.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)

		qte_meteor_contrail.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)

function local_class:desert_slave_qte_event()
	local fallen_queen = self.get_fallen_queen_phase_1()
	local desert_slave = self.get_desert_slave()
	local tanker = self.get_tanker()
	local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	character_util.set_active_state(teatan_hero, 'disabled')

	--QTE 드래그 ↑ 출력(실패없음)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	qte_util.swipe('up', nil, 0.2, false, false)

	wp_util.move_async(desert_slave, {
		desert_slave.Position + vector(0, 0, 3),
	}, nil, 0.2, { run = true })

	--QTE 입력 시 마빈 (-53, 0, 34) 에서 (-52.5, 0, 36.5) 로 전무 스킬 사용하며 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rise_01')
	local desert_slave_skill_end_pos = vector(-52.5, -1, 44.5)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(desert_slave, 'CwpDesertSlaveEarthquake', desert_slave_skill_end_pos)
	--local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(desert_slave, 'CwpDesertSlaveEarthquake', fallen_queen.Position)
	--local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(desert_slave, 'CwpDesertSlaveEarthquake', fallen_queen)
	command_util.publish_cmd(desert_slave.Owner, cmd)
	self.desert_slave_camera_pos = desert_slave_skill_end_pos + vector(0, 0, 2.5)

	local camera_dur_1 = 1
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, camera_dur_1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')
	self.get_fx_smoke_dash():Instantiate(desert_slave.Position)
	--local camera_dur_2 = (desert_slave_skill_end_pos - desert_slave.Position).magnitude / move_speed
	camera_util.move(self.desert_slave_camera_pos, camera_dur_1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카밀라 피격 시
	--카밀라 down, attack, groggy
	scene_util.set_emotion(fallen_queen, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, { name = 'groggy', loop = false })

	--0.5초간 카메라 shake 0.3
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	--카밀라 레드 펄스 + squish
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(fallen_queen)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(fallen_queen)

	local innuit_wp = vector(-59, 0, 45.5)
	character_util.set_position(innuit, innuit_wp)
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(innuit, self, 'staff_idle')
	character_util.set_direction(innuit, 'right')

	local teatan_hero_wp = vector(-46, 0, 45.5)
	character_util.set_position(teatan_hero, teatan_hero_wp)
	scene_util.set_emotion(teatan_hero, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(teatan_hero, self, 'rifle_idle')
	character_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, 'left')

	--연타 시작 시 마빈 샤우트 말풍선(좌상단) 출력, 스킵 불가능, 말풍선 출력과 동시에 연출은 계속 진행
	--마빈: 뒈져라!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(desert_slave,
			{ key = 'qc_desert_slave_qte_scene_1', skip = false, bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	--마빈 카밀라에게 up, gauntlet_boong_attack로 카밀라 연타 반복
	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack', sfx_name = function()
		--연타 시 아래 연출 적용
		--카메라 shake 시간:0.3, 세기:0.1
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(fallen_queen)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(fallen_queen)
		--fx_hit
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_01')
		local fx_hit_pos = fallen_queen.Position + vector(unity_class.random.Range(-0.4, 0.4), 0.5, unity_class.random.Range(-0.4, 0.4))
		local hit = self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(fx_hit_pos)
		local lasthit = self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(fx_hit_pos)
		hit.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
		lasthit.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
		--fx_m_gauntlet_shockwave_lv0
		local shockwave = self.get_fx_gauntlet_shockwave_lv0():Instantiate(fallen_queen.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5))
		shockwave.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, -90, 0))
		shockwave.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
	end })

	--연출 중 QTE 연타 출력
	--12회 연타 시 다음 연출 진행
	qte_util.tap(12, nil, false)

	--카밀라 cleave 1회 아래 포즈될 때 동시 진행
	--카밀라 cleave 애니메이션 시작과 동시에 (0.5초간 타임 스케일 0.1)
	do
		local slow_key = 'slow_key'
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
		time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.1)

		scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, { name = 'cleave', loop = false })
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		--0.3초간 카메라 2에서 2.5으로 줌 아웃
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 0.3)
		--0.3초간 카메라 shake 세기 0.4
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.4)

		time_util.unmod(slow_key)
	end

	--fx_hit, fx_lasthit 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_robot_01')
	local fx_hit_pos = fallen_queen.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, -0.8)
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(fx_hit_pos)
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(fx_hit_pos)

	--마빈 up, gauntlet_damaged 로 화면 아래로 빠르게 밀려남
	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'gauntlet_damaged', loop = false })

	local desert_slave_knock_back_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', desert_slave.Position, -2)

	wp_util.move_async(desert_slave, {
		desert_slave_knock_back_pos
	}, nil, 0.25, { run = true, locked_dir = 'up', last_direction = 'up' })

	character_util.set_active_state(desert_slave, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(tanker, 'disabled')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카밀라 cleave_cast -> cleave_loop
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qc_07')

function local_class:knight_qte_event()
	local fallen_queen = self.get_fallen_queen_phase_1()
	local leader = self.get_knight()

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bow_attack_ready_loop')

	--0.5초동안 카메라 (-52.5, 0, 31)로 이동]
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 0.8)
	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.8)

	local guardian_center = leader.Position + leader.SpineController.SpineTotalOffset
	local target_pos = fallen_queen.Position + vector(0, 0.6, -0.3)
	local bow_dir = (target_pos - leader.Bounds.center).normalized
	local bow_pos = guardian_center + bow_dir
	leader.SpineController.AimPoint = CS.Oak.IKSupportUtil.GetAimPointInSpineSpace(bow_pos, guardian_center)

	--가디언 up, bow_attack_ready_loop
	--QTE 드래그 ↑ 출력
	qte_util.swipe('up', nil, nil, false, false)

	--입력 시 입력 시 0.2초간 타임 스케일 0.2
	--가디언에 fx_knight2_4th_cast
	local slow_key = 'slow_key'
	time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bow_shot_06')
	--self.get_knight_projectile_fire():Instantiate(leader.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, 0.5))
	self.get_knight_projectile_cast():Instantiate(leader.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, 0.7))

	--0.2초 동안 화면 4에서 2로 줌 인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, 0.2)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	time_util.unmod(slow_key)

	--타임 스케일 풀리면서 화살 발사
	--fx_knight2_4th_fire (+ fx_knight2_4th_arrow_proj)
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'bow_attack', loop = false })
		leader.SpineController.AimPoint = nil
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.03)

	local arrow = self.get_knight_projectile():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, 0.6, 1))
	local trail = self.get_knight_projectile_trail():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, 0.6, 1))
	arrow.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
	trail.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
	trail.transform.localScale = vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

	local fallen_queen_pos = fallen_queen.Position

	local duration = 0.4
	--화살 따라 카메라 같이 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bow_shot_13')
	camera_util.move(fallen_queen_pos, duration)
	self.get_knight_projectile_fire():Instantiate(leader.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, 0.7))

	start_coroutine(function()
		--카밀라에게 피격하기 직전 0.1초간 타임 스케일 0.1
		wait_for_sec(duration - 0.1)
		time_util.mod('slow_key', 0.07)
		--(타임 스케일 풀리고 아래 진행)
	end)

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = arrow.transform.position
	local end_pos = fallen_queen_pos + vector(0, 0.6, -1)
	local progress = 0
	while progress < 1 do
		progress = time_passed / duration

		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		trail.transform.position = pos
		arrow.transform.position = pos

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	time_util.unmod(slow_key)

	--카밀라에게 피격하는 순간 fx_smokebomb 생성 + 1초간 화이트 아웃
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_dark_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 1)
	local smoke = self.get_fx_smokebomb():Instantiate(fallen_queen_pos)

	arrow:Dispose()
	arrow = nil

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(teatan_hero)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(leader, param, true)
	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'enabled')
	scene_util.show_weapon(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	coroutine.yield()
	smoke:Dispose()
	smoke = nil

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	self:pre_setting()
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.fallen_queen_phase_1_end
	self:fallen_queen_phase_1_end_scene()
end

		{ 'qc_main_s13_choose_1_3', 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--가디언 up, release 2회
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

		--1초간 카메라 카밀라 이동
		camera_util.move_async(fallen_queen.Position, 1)

		--카밀라(down, sleep_deep, idle): 모든 것이 한 줌의 재로 사라진 세상…
		scene_util.set_emotion(fallen_queen, self, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_5')
		character_util.remove_emotion(fallen_queen)

		--카밀라(down, idle, idle): 그걸 원하는 게 아니라면 당신과 함께할 일은 없어요.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_6')

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--가디언 right, smile, victory_get 1회
		scene_util.show_victory_get_async(leader, self, { emotion = 'smile', dir = 'right' })

		--이후 가디언 up, idle
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

		--1초간 카메라 카밀라 이동
		camera_util.move_async(fallen_queen.Position, 1)

		--카밀라(down, attack, idle shake 0.04): 주변에 기대기만 하는 게 당신답네요.
		scene_util.shake(fallen_queen, 0.04, 99999)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fallen_queen, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_7')
		character_util.remove_emotion(fallen_queen)
		character_util.stop_shake(fallen_queen)

	elseif choose_result == 3 then
		--가디언 right, smile, dance3 2.5초 + tease 버블
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.show_emoticon(leader, nil, 'tease')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'dance3')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')

		wait_for_sec(2.5)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--이후 가디언 up, idle
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

		--1초간 카메라 카밀라 이동
		camera_util.move_async(fallen_queen.Position, 1)

		--카밀라(down, attack, idle  shake 0.04): …당신을 증오합니다. 가디언…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
		character_util.shake(fallen_queen, 0.04, 99999)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fallen_queen, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_8')
		character_util.remove_emotion(fallen_queen)
		character_util.stop_shake(fallen_queen)
	end

	--공통 연출
	--크레이그(left, idle, idle): 이 전투는 우리의 승리. 무의미한 언쟁은 그만두게.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(tanker, 'qc_main_s13_9')

	--마리안(down, attack, idle): 새로운 가디언이 되겠다는 헛소리도 하지 말고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self, 'down', nil,
			'attack', { key = 'qc_main_s13_10', skip = true })

	--마빈(down, attack, idle): 졌으면 닥치고 꺼져라.
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'down')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(desert_slave, 'qc_main_s13_11')

	--카밀라 (down, attack, idle) silence 버블
	scene_util.set_emotion(fallen_queen, self, 'attack')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(fallen_queen, nil, 'silence')

	--카밀라 (down, attack, idle): 가디언… 당신이 정말로 강했다면 챔피언들의 도움은 필요 없었겠죠….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_12')

	--1초간 화면 4에서 3.3으로 줌 인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3.3, 1)

	--카밀라 (down, attack, idle): 당신이 정말로 강했다면… 제 동생이 당신을 돕는 상황도 나오지 않았을 거고…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_13')

	--1초간 화면 3.3에서 2.5으로 줌 인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, 1)

	--카밀라(down, attack, idle shake 0.03):  <b>그녀가 제 동생을 노릴 일도 없었을 텐데…!</b>
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	character_util.shake(fallen_queen, 0.03, 99999)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_14')
	character_util.stop_shake(fallen_queen)

	--하단 대사 출력 시 0.4초간 카메라 쉐이크 세기 0.1
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.4)

	--카밀라 (down, attack, idle): [shout] 전부…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_15')

	--하단 샤우트와 동시에 0.4초간 카메라 shake 0.2
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.4)

	--카밀라 (down, mad, idle): [shout] 당신 때문에…!!!
	local heartbeat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_heartbeat_01', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fallen_queen, self, 'mad')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_16')

	--2초간 화면 2.5에서 4로 줌 아웃
	camera_util.resize_to_default(2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카밀라 (down ,mad, idle): 거짓으로 점철된 선조의 예언도.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_17')

	--카밀라 (down, mad, idle): 500년 넘게 이어져온 왕가의 의무도.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_18')

	--하단 샤우트와 동시에 0.5 카메라 쉐이크 0.2
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	--카밀라 (down, idle, idle): [shout] 전부 끝내겠습니다!!!
	heartbeat_sfx:Stop()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(fallen_queen)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s13_19')

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.fallen_queen_awakening_scene
	self:fallen_queen_awakening_scene()
end

function local_class:fallen_queen_awakening_scene()
	local fallen_queen = self.get_fallen_queen()
	local fallen_queen_awakening = self.get_fallen_queen_phase_2()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
	local desert_slave = self.get_desert_slave()
	local tanker = self.get_tanker()
	local leader = self.get_knight()

	--카밀라에 laser_light_big 생성 + 동시에 카메라 shake 세기 0.2
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_dark_04')
	local loop_sfx = music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '02_light_loop_01', loop = true })
	local laser = self.get_fx_boss_awakening_light():Instantiate(fallen_queen.Bounds.center)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 99999)
	character_util.set_position(fallen_queen, fallen_queen.Position + vector(0, 0.5, -0.2))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--코코(right, attack, release): [shout] 허튼 짓 하기 전에 막아야 해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(innuit, 'qc_main_s13_20')

	--포위 중인 가디언 + 챔피언 4인 카밀라를 향해 뛰어듬
	--코코 right, attack, prostrate
	scene_util.set_anim(innuit, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit, self, 'attack')

	--마빈 right, attack, twohand_attack_4
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'right')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(desert_slave, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(desert_slave, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false })

	--마리안 left, attack, twohand_attack_4
	character_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, 'left')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(teatan_hero, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(teatan_hero, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(teatan_hero, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false })

	--크레이그 left, attack, twohand_attack_4
	scene_util.set_emotion(tanker, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(tanker, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false })

	--기사 up, get
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'get', loop = false })

	--기사 일행 점프 후 타임 스케일 0.3 + 화면 4에서 3으로 줌 인
	local jump_mod_key = 'jump_mod_key'
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	time_util.mod(jump_mod_key, 0.3)

	do
		local jump_to = fallen_queen.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0)
		local jump_speed = 3
		local jump_dur = (leader.Position - jump_to).magnitude / jump_speed
		local jump_height = 1.5
		camera_util.move(jump_to, jump_dur)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, jump_dur)

		character_util.jump_move(leader, jump_to, jump_speed, jump_height, false)
		character_util.jump_move(innuit, jump_to, jump_speed, jump_height, false)
		character_util.jump_move(desert_slave, jump_to, jump_speed, jump_height, false)
		character_util.jump_move(teatan_hero, jump_to, jump_speed, jump_height, false)
		character_util.jump_move(tanker, jump_to, jump_speed, jump_height, true)
	end

	--위 이미지에서 초록 표시처럼 기사 일행이 카밀라 거의 덮었을 때 아래 실행
	--깔려있던 카메라 shake 0.2 제거 후 0.5초간 카메라 shake 0.3
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	--타임 스케일 0.3 -> 1
	time_util.unmod(jump_mod_key)

	--카밀라가 있던 위치에 fx_common_smokescreen 생성하며 laser_light_big 제거
	loop_sfx:Stop()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_dark_03')
	self.get_fx_boss_awakening_light_shockwave():Instantiate(fallen_queen.Bounds.center)
	laser:Dispose()
	laser = nil

	--카밀라 화면 위로 빠르게 날아감(수직 상승)
	local flying_duration_1 = 0.5
	local fallen_queen_fly_pos_1 = fallen_queen.Position + vector(0, 6, 0)

	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, 'idle')
	wp_util.move(fallen_queen, {
		fallen_queen_fly_pos_1,
	}, nil, flying_duration_1, { y_mode = 'flying' })

	start_coroutine(self.air_spin_screen_out, self, innuit, true)
	start_coroutine(self.air_spin_screen_out, self, tanker, false)

	character_util.reset_locked_dir(desert_slave)
	character_util.reset_locked_dir(teatan_hero)

	character_util.air_spin(desert_slave,
			{ offset = vector(-3, 0, 5), explode = false, play_deathsfx = false })
	character_util.air_spin(teatan_hero,
			{ offset = vector(3, 0, 5), explode = false, play_deathsfx = false })

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(leader, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false })

	--기사가 밀려 떨어지는 곳은 아래 화살표시한 지점
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
	local jump_to = field_util.get_marker_pos('boss_phase_2_party_pos_1') + vector(0, 0, -2.5)
	local jump_speed = 4
	local jump_dur = (leader.Position - jump_to).magnitude / jump_speed
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 1440, jump_dur)

	--기사 아래로 날아가는 것에 맞춰 카메라 z축 아래로 이동
	camera_util.move(jump_to, jump_dur)

	--기사 에어스핀하다 위 지점에 left, damaged, prostrate 자세로 떨어짐(떨어질 때 fx_hit)
	character_util.jump_move(leader, jump_to, jump_speed, 1.5, true)
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(jump_to + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	--가디언 left, damaged, prostrate 1초간 shake 0.03
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언 표정 attack으로 바뀌고 1초 대기
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--이후 left, attack, get 자세로 일어나고 0.7초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.reset_locked_dir(leader)

	--가디언 right 0.7초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--가디언 up, idle
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	self:fall_attack_scene()
end

function local_class:fall_attack_scene()
	local leader = self.get_knight()
	local fallen_queen = self.get_fallen_queen()
	local fallen_queen_awakening = self.get_fallen_queen_phase_2()
	local fall_attack_pos = vector(100, 0, 100)

	--5초간 카메라 z축 위로 8 상승(상승 시 화면 중앙에 카밀라가 떠있음)
	--카메라 z위로 3칸 이동 duration 3
	--1초 후 화면 페이드 아웃 duration 2

	camera_util.move(leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 3), 3)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--화면 위로 이동하며 페이드 인 시 카밀라도 함께 위로 이동
	--화면 페이드 인 시 카밀라 첫 위치를 화면 하단으로 조정
	character_util.set_position(fallen_queen, fall_attack_pos + vector(0, 0, -4))
	character_util.set_direction(fallen_queen, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim(fallen_queen)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(fallen_queen, false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(fallen_queen, self, 'sleep_deep')

	--화면 초당 1칸 상승하면 카밀라는 초당 1.5칸 상승하는 식으로 카밀라 상승
	--화면 이동이 끝나고 카밀라는 1초정도 더 위로 이동하여 정렬
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qc_10')
	camera_util.move_async(fall_attack_pos + vector(0, 0, -2), 0)
	screen_util.fade_in(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	camera_util.move(fall_attack_pos, 5)

	local move_dur = 5
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = fallen_queen.Position
	local target_pos = fall_attack_pos
	local lerp_func = interpolations_constants.ease_in_out_sine

	while time_passed < move_dur do
		local progress = lerp_func(time_passed, 0, 1, move_dur)
		local cur_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
		fallen_queen.Position = cur_pos
		camera_util.move(cur_pos, 0)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
	--character_util.move_to_async(fallen_queen, fall_attack_pos, 2.5, nil, false, false)
	local leader_center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s13_qte_scene_tanker_pos_2')
	character_util.set_position(leader, leader_center_pos)

	--가디언은 up, bow_attack_ready_loop 자세

	-- 3초 동안 카밀라 down, idle, idle shake 0.04 (shake는 임시 연출 이후 이펙트로 변경)
	--카밀라에게 빛이 모임 (1.5초간 타임 스케일 0.8)
	--fx_qc_fallen_queen_change (출력위치: 1p 카밀라 센터)
	scene_util.set_emotion(fallen_queen, self, 'idle')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local boss_change_pos = fallen_queen.Bounds.center
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 2.5)
	-- fx_qc_fallen_queen_change (요청된 상태)
	local boss_change = self.get_fx_boss_change():Instantiate(boss_change_pos)

	--character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(fallen_queen, 0, 0.7)
	local color_key = 'white_key'
	character_util.add_fade_color(fallen_queen, color_key, unity_class.color.white, 1, 1.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(fallen_queen, 0, 1.2)
	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	--camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.4)
	--wait_for_sec(0.2)
	screen_util.fade_out(0.2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--위 이펙트 출력 1.5초 후 아래 이펙트 출력

	wait_for_sec(0.08)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	local fallen_queen_awakening_center_pos = fall_attack_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	camera_util.move(fallen_queen_awakening_center_pos, 0)

	boss_change:Dispose()
	boss_change = nil
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 위 shake 끝나는 순간  카밀라 2페이즈 boss_fallen_queen_en 로 교체
	character_util.set_active_shadow(fallen_queen_awakening, false)
	character_util.set_position(fallen_queen_awakening, fallen_queen.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))
	character_util.set_position(fallen_queen, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(fallen_queen, 1, 0)
	character_util.remove_fade_color(fallen_queen, color_key, 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(fallen_queen, 'disabled')

	--shake 끝난 후 transform 애니메이션 재생
	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen_awakening, self, { name = 'transform', loop = false })
	fallen_queen_awakening.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.1)
	fallen_queen_awakening.SpineController.TimeScale = 0

	--1.5초간 화면 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in(1.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	--페이드 인 시작과 동시에 카밀라 1초간 웅크린 자세로 shake 0.03
	character_util.shake(fallen_queen_awakening, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	fallen_queen_awakening.SpineController.TimeScale = 1

	local boss_pos = fallen_queen_awakening.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	--transform 날개 펼친 순간 이펙트 fx_qc_fallen_queen_change_end과 카메라 shake
	self.get_fx_boss_change_end():Instantiate(boss_change_pos + vector(0, 0, 1))

function local_class:air_spin_screen_out(fo, is_left)
	local duration = 1
	local rotation_dir = is_left and -720 or 720
	character_util.spine_rotate(fo, rotation_dir, duration + 0.4)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.one * 6, duration)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(fo, false)

	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local end_add_x = is_left and -10 or 10
	local end_pos = fo.Position + vector(end_add_x, 8, -5)

	fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 1000)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * end_pos.y

		fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, y)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'disabled')
end

function local_class:boss_meteor_shoot(pooled_object, start_pos, end_pos, speed, rotate, scale, wait)
	local fire = pooled_object:Instantiate(start_pos)
	local contrail = self.get_fx_boss_meteor_contrail():Instantiate(start_pos)
	local shoot_dir = (end_pos - start_pos).normalized
	local duration = (end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed

	fire.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
	contrail.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

	-- 이펙트 기본 방향을 아래로 향하도록
	local fx_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * rotate
	fire.transform.localRotation = fx_rotation
	contrail.transform.localRotation = fx_rotation

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_dark_projectile_03')
	start_coroutine(function()
		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
			fire.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			contrail.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		end)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
		character_util.shake(self.get_tanker(), 0.04, 0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_kick_02')
		local explosion = self.get_fx_meteor_explosion():Instantiate(end_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.8))
		explosion.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5

		contrail:Dispose()
		contrail = nil

		fire:Dispose()
		fire = nil
	end)

	return duration
end

function local_class:character_heal(fo)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = fo
	heal_info.target = fo
	heal_info.heal = fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	heal_info.isRevive = true

	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.fallen_queen_boss_phase_1 and
			e.BattleGroupName == self.boss_battle_group_names then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.done

		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

			--배틀 중지 및 디버프 삭제
			stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			-- 보스를 처치 한 후 섹션이 넘어감.
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			local fallen_queen_awakening = self.get_fallen_queen_phase_2()
			character_util.set_active_state(fallen_queen_awakening, 'disabled')
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, 0)
			quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	-- 리더 부활하면 카메라 다시 5로 세팅
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.5)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:underground_scene()
	local fallen_queen_awakening = self.get_fallen_queen_phase_2()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--검은 화면 1초 대기
	--다시 화면 4로 세팅
	--카메라 위치 미리 아래 공간 잡아둠
	local guardian_falling_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('underground_center_pos') + vector(0, 21, 0)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	character_util.set_position(leader, guardian_falling_start_pos, true)
	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'disabled')
	local start_rotate = -90
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, start_rotate, 0)

	local camera_pos_1 = field_util.get_marker_pos('underground_center_pos') + vector(0, 19, 0)
	camera_util.move(camera_pos_1, 0)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qc_11')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--아래 동시 시작
	--1초간 카메라 shake 세기 0.3
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 1)
	local smokescreen_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', camera_pos_1, -3)
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('underground_center_pos')

	--화면 상단에 fx_common_smokescreen 생성 (임시 연출)
	self.get_fx_ceiling_explosion_screen():Instantiate(smokescreen_pos)
	self.get_fx_hidden_underground_light():Instantiate(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 4))

	--천장 폭발 fx_qc_ceiling_explosion_screen (요청된 상태)
	--천장 빛 fx_qc_hidden_underground_light (요청된 상태)
	--가디언 (right, damaged, embarrsed) 천천히 회전(검은 배경에서 회전했던 연출과 동일)
	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'enabled')

	--가디언 위치는 천장에서 바닥까지 약 z 13칸, 1.5초 동안 떨어지도록 지정
	--카메라는 가디언 따라감
	local falling_duration = 1.2
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 360 * 2 + start_rotate, falling_duration)

	camera_util.move(center_pos, falling_duration)
	character_util.move_to(leader, center_pos, falling_duration)

	--위 연출 시작하고 0.2초 뒤 0.25초 동안 타임 스케일 0.1
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local slow_key = 'slow_key'
	time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.06)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	time_util.unmod(slow_key)

	wait_for_sec(0.9)

	--가디언 바닥에 떨어지는 순간 아래 동시 시작

	--가디언 right, damaged, prostrate
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = true })

	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(leader)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)

	--squish
	--fx_office_ground_impact_crack + fx_lasthit
	local ground_fx_pos = leader.Position
	local crack = self.get_fx_ground_impact_crack():Instantiate(ground_fx_pos)
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(ground_fx_pos)

	--0.5초간 카메라 shake 세기 0.2
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	--가디언 떨어진 후 3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.4)

	crack:Dispose()
	crack = nil

	wait_for_sec(1.6)

	--1초간 가디언 shake 0.03
	character_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언 left, attack, get 자세로 일어남
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(leader, 'right')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--가디언 up, idle
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(leader, { dir = 'up', sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	--붉은점에 카밀라(boss_fallen_queen_en) 공중에 뜬 상태

	local start_scale = 0.1
	local end_scale = 1
	local duration = 3
	fallen_queen_awakening.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * start_scale

	character_util.set_active_state(fallen_queen_awakening, 'enabled')

	--카밀라 4초에 걸쳐서 위 표시한 지점으로 하강
	local boss_start_pos = center_pos + vector(0, 0, 3)
	character_util.move_to(fallen_queen_awakening, boss_start_pos, 3)

	--카밀라 하강 시작하면 아래 진행
	--2초에 동안 화면 4에서 5로 줌 아웃
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 2)

	--2초에 동안 카메라 z 2칸 위로 이동
	local camera_pos_2 = center_pos + vector(0, 0, 2)
	camera_util.move(camera_pos_2, 2)

	local shadow_change_time_passed = 0
	while shadow_change_time_passed < duration do
		shadow_change_time_passed = shadow_change_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(shadow_change_time_passed, 0, 1, duration)

		local size = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)
		fallen_queen_awakening.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.fallen_queen_boss_phase_1

	--보스 타이틀 출력
	--용사 카밀라
	--이 전투에 세계의 운명이 걸려있습니다.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/audio:bgm_queencastle_boss_02', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	screen_util.show_boss_title('qc_main_s14_boss_title', 'qc_main_s14_boss_sub_title', 2, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen_awakening, self, { name = 'twohand_attack3', loop = false })
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(fallen_queen_awakening)
	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	-- 몬스터로
	self.controller:custom_convert_to_boss_monster(fallen_queen_awakening, self.boss_battle_group_names,
			'boss_fallen_queen_battle_zone', 'boss_fallen_queen_notice')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_pre_load()

	self.get_fx_last_hit()
	self.get_fx_dead()
	self.get_fx_spotlight()
	self.get_fx_reset()
	self.get_fx_gimmick_char_magnetic()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_door_opened_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent), 'on_tesla_coil_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveByMagnetNoticeEvent), 'on_move_by_magnet_notice_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

	for i = 1, self.worker_count do
		local worker = self.get_worker(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(worker, 'enabled')
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:setting_section()

	for i = 1, self.guide_worker_count do
		local tesla = self.get_worker_tesla(i)
		tesla.Transform:Find('mesh').gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.is_switch_gimmick_talk = { false, false }
	self:set_s3_zone_event()

	local power_source_name = 's3_power_source_'
	local power_source_count = 2
	for i = 1, power_source_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(power_source_name .. i))
	end

	-- 오프닝 이벤트 시작
	sp_util.start_scene(self.opening_event, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveByMagnetNoticeEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	if self.magnetic_effect ~= nil then
		self.magnetic_effect:Dispose()
	end

	if self.android_marker_name_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.android_marker_name_list do
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.android_marker_name_list[i])
		end
		self.android_marker_name_list = nil
	end

	self.switch_gimmick_char_list = nil
	self.worker_info_list = nil
	self.is_show_zone_events = nil
	self.s3_zone_event = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_worker_guiding = false
	self.is_stage_exit = true
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.clear
end

function local_class:on_door_opened_event(e)
	if e.DoorHandleName == self.switch_door_name .. 1
			and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.stay_switch_door then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.stay_tesla_door
		start_coroutine(self.open_worker_door, self)
		return true
	elseif e.DoorHandleName == self.tesla_door_name .. 1
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.stay_tesla_door then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.last_scene
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_by_magnet_notice_event(e)
	for i = 1, self.switch_worker_count do
		local switch_worker = self.get_switch_worker(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, switch_worker) then
			if e.IsStartMoving and not self.is_switch_gimmick_talk[i] then
				self.is_switch_gimmick_talk[i] = true
				quest_marker_util.remove(switch_worker.Name)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
				character_util.set_anim(switch_worker, { name = 'embarrassed' })
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(switch_worker, { key = self.string_key .. 23 })
			elseif not e.IsStartMoving then
				character_util.set_direction(switch_worker, 'left')
				character_util.set_anim(switch_worker, { name = 'prostrate' })
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, self.get_worker_tesla(1)) and e.IsTurningOn == true
			and not self.is_turn_on_worker_tesla then
		self.is_turn_on_worker_tesla = true
		for i = 1, self.guide_worker_count do
			local worker = self.get_worker(i)
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(worker)
			if i == 1 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_worker_01', parent = worker })
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(worker, { key = self.string_key .. 27 })
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_arrive_zone_1') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending
		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.magnet_event_zone_name)
			and not self.is_enter_magnet_door_zone then
		self.is_enter_magnet_door_zone = true
		sp_util.start_scene(self.worker_door_event, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.is_show_zone_events ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.is_show_zone_events do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.auto_event_zone_name .. i)
					and not self.is_show_zone_events[i] then
				self.is_show_zone_events[i] = true
				start_coroutine(self.s3_zone_event[i], self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, self.magnet_event_zone_name) then
		self.is_enter_magnet_door_zone = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'magnet_grid')
			and not self.is_reset_worker then
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
			if hold_target ~= nil then
				command_util.execute_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction),
						leader.Position, 4, false)
			end
		end

		self.is_reset_worker = true
		start_coroutine(self.reset_switch_worker, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:reset_switch_worker()
	local switch_worker_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.switch_worker_count do
		local worker = self.get_switch_worker(i)
		table.insert(switch_worker_list, worker)
	end

	while not self.is_stage_exit do
		local idle_count = 0
		for i = 1, #switch_worker_list do
			local worker = switch_worker_list[i]
			if lua_helper.type_compare(worker.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterIdleState)
					or lua_helper.type_compare(worker.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState) then
				idle_count = idle_count + 1
			end
		end

		if idle_count >= #switch_worker_list then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, #switch_worker_list do
		local worker = switch_worker_list[i]
		self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(worker.Position)
		worker.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_switch_worker_pos_' .. i)
	end

	self.is_reset_worker = false
end

function local_class:setting_section()
	-- 길막 안드로이드들을 WallCrashBehaviour로
	for i = 1, self.wall_worker_count do
		local worker = self.get_horizontal_worker(i)
		worker.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end
end

function local_class:opening_event()
	local knight = get_party_leader()

	screen_util.fade_out(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_start_pos_1')

	local worker_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.worker_count do

		, 1)
	end

	-- 가디언 (right, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')

	-- 공주 (left, tired, question(loop x)) : 안드로이드들이 우릴 보고 이전 마스터들이라고 했지…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, { name = 'question', loop = false }
	, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, self.string_key .. 14)

	-- 공주 (left, tired, bomb_idle) : 모습도 원래보다 조금 달라진 것 같아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, 'bomb_idle'
	, nil, self.string_key .. '14_1')

	-- 공주 (left, tired, cast) : 부유성도 안드로이드들도…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, { name = 'cast', keep = true }
	, nil, self.string_key .. 15)

	-- 공주 (left, tired, idle) : 정말 인베이더의 손에 넘어가 버린 걸까…?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, self.string_key .. 16)

	-- 화면 shake (0.3, 0.5), 공주, 가디언 위 보고 애니메이션 해제, 점프(0.5, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')
	character_util.normal_jump(princess)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'up')
	character_util.normal_jump(knight, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 안드로이드 1, 2 (down, mad, attack)
	character_util.set_direction(worker_list[2], 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(worker_list[2], { name = 'throw', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	-- 안드로이드 1 (down, mad, attack) : 어서 따라오지 않고 뭐하는 겁니까, 휴먼!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_direction(worker_list[1], 'down')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(worker_list[1], self, nil, 'throw'
	, nil, self.string_key .. 17)

	-- 안드로이드 1, 2 (up, mad, idle)
	for i = 1, self.guide_worker_count do
		character_util.remove_anim(worker_list[i])
		character_util.set_direction(worker_list[i], 'up')
		worker_list[i].OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	-- 컨트롤 복구
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 퀘스트 마커 안드로이드 1에 설정
	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, worker_list[1], true)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	-- 안드로이드 이동 시작
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.start_follow_walker
	start_coroutine(self.work_move_routine, self)
end

function local_class:work_move_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local is_show_going_first_event = false
	local custom_string_key = self.string_key .. 'event_'

	-- 걸어다니는 안드로이드 캐싱
	self.worker_info_list = {}
	local moving_work_count = 2
	for i = 1, moving_work_count do
		local worker_info = {}

		worker_info.worker = self.get_worker(i)
		worker_info.start_pos = worker_info.worker.Position
		worker_info.end_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
		worker_info.dir = worker_info.Direction

		table.insert(self.worker_info_list, worker_info)
	end

	-- 이벤트로 인해 멈추는 포지션 인덱스 리스트
	local stop_index_list = { 4, 5, 6 }

	-- 안드로이드가 안내 중인지?
	self.is_worker_guiding = true

	-- 이동 좌표 index
	self.work_index = 0

	-- 이동 시간 체크
	self.time_passed = 0

	-- 움직이는 시간 duration
	self.worker_move_duration = 1

	-- 안드로이드 상태
	local worker_state = { move = 1, stop = 2, speech_bubble = 3 }
	local cur_worker_state = worker_state.move

	--region Local Functions

	-- 좌표에 따라 스피치 버블 뷰포트 좌표 구하기
	local range = vector(10, 0, 8)

	local function get_viewport_pos(pos, target_pos, is_in_screen)
		if is_in_screen then
			return nil
		end

		local progress_x = math.min(math.abs(target_pos.x - pos.x) / range.x, 1) * 0.8
		if pos.x < target_pos.x then
			progress_x = progress_x * -1
		end
		local pos_x = math.max(0.4, math.min(0.5 + progress_x, 0.8))

		local progress_y = math.min(math.abs(target_pos.z - pos.z) / range.y, 1) * 0.8
		if pos.z < target_pos.z then
			progress_y = progress_y * -1
		end
		local pos_y = math.max(0.2, math.min(0.5 + progress_y, 0.8))

		return vector(pos_x, pos_y)
	end

	-- 더 빨리 이동 했을 때 한번 타는 로직 (말풍선)
	local function move_faster_once_talk(center_pos)
		local dist_z = math.abs(leader.Position.z - center_pos.z)
		local worker_1 = self.worker_info_list[1].worker
		if (leader.Position.z >= center_pos.z and dist_z >= 6) then
			is_show_going_first_event = true
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(worker_1, { key = custom_string_key .. 4 })
		end
	end

	-- 안드로이드 이동 루틴
	local function move_worker_routine(dt)
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		if self.time_passed >= self.worker_move_duration then
			for i = 1, #self.worker_info_list do
				character_util.set_position(self.worker_info_list[i].worker, self.worker_info_list[i].end_pos)
			end

			self:set_next_dest()

			if table_util.contain_value(stop_index_list, self.work_index) then
				self.is_working_pause = true
				-- 각 인덱스 별로 이벤트 진행
				start_coroutine(self.walker_event, self, self.work_index, self.worker_info_list)
			end
		else
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.worker_move_duration)
			for i = 1, #self.worker_info_list do
				local worker_info = self.worker_info_list[i]
				local target_pos = vector_util.lerp(worker_info.start_pos, worker_info.end_pos, progress)
				local diff = target_pos - worker_info.worker.Position
				if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) == false then
					CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(worker_info.worker, diff.normalized
					, vector_util.magnitude(diff))
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 가이드를 다시 시작할지 체크 후 스테이트 변경
	local function check_restart_guide(is_in_screen)
		if is_in_screen then
			cur_worker_state = worker_state.move
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.worker_info_list[1].worker)
			for i = 1, moving_work_count do
				character_util.set_direction(self.worker_info_list[i].worker, self.worker_info_list[i].dir)
				character_util.set_anim(self.worker_info_list[i].worker, { name = 'walk' })
			end
		end
	end

	--endregion

	-- 첫 목적지 갱신
	self:set_next_dest()

	local action_wait_time = 3

	-- 안드로이드 안내 루틴 시작
	local cur_wait_time = 0
	while self.is_worker_guiding and self.work_index < 7 do
		if not self.is_working_pause then
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

			-- 현재 안드로이드들의 중심점
			local center_pos = self.worker_info_list[1].worker.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

			-- 스크린 안에 있는지?
			local is_in_screen = screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(center_pos, { bonus_distance = 0.5 })
					or (center_pos.z < leader.Position.z)

			if cur_worker_state == worker_state.move then
				-- 이동 중 더 빨리 갔을 때 한번 나오는 말풍선 로직
				if not is_show_going_first_event then
					move_faster_once_talk(center_pos)
				end

				-- 안드로이드 움직이는 로직
				move_worker_routine(dt)

				if not is_in_screen then
					cur_wait_time = cur_wait_time + dt

					-- action_wait_time 시간 보다 길어지면 말풍선 출력후 멈춤
					if cur_wait_time > action_wait_time then
						cur_worker_state = worker_state.stop
						cur_wait_time = 0

						-- 가디언 방향 바라봄
						for i = 1, moving_work_count do
							local worker = self.worker_info_list[i].worker
							character_util.remove_anim(worker)
							character_util.look_at(worker, leader)
						end

						-- 랜덤 말풍선 출력
						local speech_worker = self.worker_info_list[1].worker
						local is_in_screen_worker = screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(speech_worker.Position)

						music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_worker_01', volume = 0.5 })
						speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(speech_worker, {
							key = custom_string_key .. random_util.get_random_int(1, 3),
							viewport_pos = get_viewport_pos(speech_worker.Position
							, leader.Position, is_in_screen_worker) })
					end
				else
					cur_wait_time = 0
				end
			elseif cur_worker_state == worker_state.stop then
				-- 안드로이드 1, 2가 카메라 바깥으로 벗어나고 3초가 지난 경우, 이벤트 발생 (멈추지 않음)
				check_restart_guide(is_in_screen)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 안내가 정상적으로 끝난 뒤라면 애니메이션 원복
	if self.is_worker_guiding then
		for i = 1, moving_work_count do
			character_util.set_direction(self.worker_info_list[i].worker, 'down')
			character_util.remove_anim(self.worker_info_list[i].worker)
		end
	end
end


-- 다음 목적지 세팅
function local_class:set_next_dest()
	self.time_passed = 0

	local start_point = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.worker_point_name .. self.work_index)
	self.work_index = self.work_index + 1

	if self.work_index >= 7 then
		return
	end

	local end_point = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.worker_point_name .. self.work_index)
	local dest = end_point - start_point
	self.worker_move_duration = dest.magnitude / self.worker_move_speed

	for i = 1, #self.worker_info_list do
		self.worker_info_list[i].start_pos = self.worker_info_list[i].worker.Position
		self.worker_info_list[i].end_pos = self.worker_info_list[i].start_pos + dest
		self.worker_info_list[i].dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.worker_info_list[i].end_pos
				- self.worker_info_list[i].start_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(self.worker_info_list[i].worker, self.worker_info_list[i].dir)
		character_util.set_anim(self.worker_info_list[i].worker, { name = 'walk' })
	end
end

function local_class:walker_event(index, worker_info_list)
	for i = 1, #worker_info_list do
		character_util.remove_anim(worker_info_list[i].worker)
	end

	if index == 4 then
		-- 안드로이드들이 비켜주는 이벤트
		self:open_worker_wall_door(worker_info_list)
	elseif index == 6 then
		-- 테슬라 문 여는 이벤트
		self:tesla_door_event(worker_info_list)
	end
end

function local_class:open_worker_wall_door(worker_info_list)
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.start_follow_walker

	for i = 1, #worker_info_list do
		character_util.set_direction(worker_info_list[i].worker, 'up')
	end

	-- 안내 안드로이드 1 (up, mad, throw) : 마스터에게 손님을 안내하는 중입니다, 비켜주시죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(worker_info_list[1].worker, self, nil, { name = 'throw', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
	, nil, { key = self.string_key .. 18, skip = false })

	-- 경비 안드로이드 1, 2, 3, 4 (down, mad, salute(loop x))
	local wall_worker_list = {}
	local move_worker_count = 4

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', parent = self.get_horizontal_worker(1), volume = 0.5 })
	for i = 1, move_worker_count do
		local worker = self.get_horizontal_worker(i)
		character_util.set_anim(worker, { name = 'salute', loop = false })
		table.insert(wall_worker_list, worker)
	end

	-- 1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 경비 안드로이드 속도 2로 위 그림처럼 이동
	for i = 1, move_worker_count do
		local worker = wall_worker_list[i]
		character_util.remove_anim(worker)
		local is_left = i < (move_worker_count - 1)
		local dir = is_left and 'right' or 'left'

		if i < move_worker_count then
			local move_x = i < (move_worker_count - 1) and -2 or 2
			wp_util.move(worker, {
				worker.Position + unity_class.vector3.back,
				worker.Position + vector(move_x, 0, -1)
			}, 2, nil, { last_direction = dir })
		else
			wp_util.move_async(worker, {
				worker.Position + unity_class.vector3.back,
				worker.Position + vector(2, 0, -1)
			}, 2, nil, { last_direction = dir })
		end
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.stay_switch_door

	-- 거리 체크 이벤트 다시 실행 시작
	self.is_working_pause = false

	for i = 1, #worker_info_list do
		character_util.set_anim(worker_info_list[i].worker, { name = 'walk' })
	end
end

function local_class:worker_door_event()
	self.is_working_pause = true
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_worker_move_point_4')
	if not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(center_pos, self.worker_info_list[1].worker.Position) then
		-- 그리드 밖에 있다면 그리드 바로 아래로 순간 이동 후 이동
		for i = 1, #self.worker_info_list do
			local pos_x = i == 1 and -0.5 or 0.5
			local pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', center_pos, -1)
			character_util.remove_anim(self.worker_info_list[i].worker)
			character_util.set_position(self.worker_info_list[i].worker, pos + vector(pos_x, 0, 0))
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.worker_info_list do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.worker_info_list[i].worker)
	end

	local switch_worker_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.switch_worker_count do
		local worker = self.get_switch_worker(i)
		worker.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 0.75, 1))
		table.insert(switch_worker_list, worker)
	end

	-- 안드로이드 1, 2 이동 경로 끝까지 이동 (대기)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, self.worker_info_list[1].worker
		, center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 1.5
		, nil, { last_direction = 'up' }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, self.worker_info_list[2].worker
		, center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1.5
		, nil, { last_direction = 'up' }),
	})

	-- 카메라 1초 간 안내 안드로이드 1, 2의 중심 위치로 이동
	local camera_pos = self.worker_info_list[1].worker.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

	-- 안내 안드로이드 1 (up, mad, cast2) : 왜 길이 막힌 걸까요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.worker_info_list[1].worker, self, nil, 'cast2'
	, nil, self.string_key .. 19)

	-- 안내 안드로이드 2 (up, mad, throw) : 경비병, 어서 문을 여십시오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.worker_info_list[2].worker, self, nil, { name = 'throw', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
	, nil, self.string_key .. 20)

	-- 카메라 1.5초 간 z축 위로 4칸 이동
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos + vector(0, 0, 4), 1.5)

	-- 경비 안드로이드 1 (down, mad, idle) : 저는 마스터에게 경비 명령을 받았지 문을 열어달라는 명령은 받은 적이 없습니다. 
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(switch_worker_list[1], self.string_key .. 21)

	-- 경비 안드로이드 2 (down, idle, cross_arm) : 안드로이드는 인간과 다르게 명령을 충실하게 수행합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(switch_worker_list[2], self, nil
	, 'cross_arm', nil, self.string_key .. '21_1')

	-- 카메라 1초 간 안내 안드로이드 1, 2의 중심 위치로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 안내 안드로이드 1 (right, idle, bomb_idle) : 할 수 없군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.worker_info_list[1].worker, self, 'right'
	, 'bomb_idle', nil, self.string_key .. '21_2')

	-- 안내 안드로이드 2 (left, idle, nod) : 문이 열릴 때까지는 휴식 시간을 가질 수밖에요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.worker_info_list[2].worker, 'left', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.worker_info_list[2].worker, self, nil
	, 'nod', nil, self.string_key .. 22)

	-- 안내 안드로이드 1, 2 각자 반대 방향 보고 tired, sleep
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	for i = 1, #self.worker_info_list do
		character_util.set_direction(self.worker_info_list[i].worker, i <= 1 and 'left' or 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.worker_info_list[i].worker, { name = 'sleep' }
		, { name = 'tired' })
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.android_marker_name_list = {}
	for i = 1, #switch_worker_list do
		local marker_name = switch_worker_list[i].Name
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, marker_name, switch_worker_list[i], true)
		table.insert(self.android_marker_name_list, marker_name)
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

-- 문이 열린 후
function local_class:open_worker_door()
	self.android_marker_name_list = nil

	local worker_list = {}
	local moving_work_count = 2
	for i = 1, moving_work_count do
		local worker = self.get_worker(i)
		table.insert(worker_list, worker)
	end

	-- 안내 안드로이드 서로 바라봄, 애니메이션, 이모션 해제
	-- 안내 안드로이드 1, 2 속도 2로 위 경로 따라서 계속 이동
	for i = 1, #worker_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(worker_list[i])
		local dir = i <= 1 and 'right' or 'left'
		character_util.set_direction(worker_list[i], dir)
	end

	-- 안내 안드로이드 2 (left, mad, bomb_idle) : 이런, 마스터가 바뀐 뒤로 처음 가지는 휴식시간이었는데.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = worker_list[2] })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(worker_list[2], self, nil,
			'bomb_idle', nil, { key = self.string_key .. 24, skip = false })

	if self.work_index < 5 then
		self:set_next_dest()
	else
		for i = 1, #self.worker_info_list do
			character_util.set_direction(self.worker_info_list[i].worker, 'up')
			character_util.set_anim(self.worker_info_list[i].worker, { name = 'walk' })
		end
	end

	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, worker_list[1], true)
	self.is_working_pause = false
end

function local_class:tesla_door_event(worker_info_list)
	local function pause_end()
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		for i = 1, self.guide_worker_count do
			local tesla = self.get_worker_tesla(i)
			tesla.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			tesla.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		-- 안내 안드로이드 플레이어 바라봄
		for i = 1, #worker_info_list do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(worker_info_list[i].worker)
			character_util.look_at(worker_info_list[i].worker, leader)
		end

		if not self.is_worker_guiding then
			return
		end

		-- 안내 안드로이드 1 (left, idle, cast) : 너무합니다, 휴먼.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(worker_info_list[1].worker, self, nil,
				'cast', nil, { key = self.string_key .. 28, skip = false })

		if not self.is_worker_guiding then
			return
		end

		-- 안내 안드로이드 플레이어 바라봄
		for i = 1, #worker_info_list do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(worker_info_list[i].worker)
			character_util.look_at(worker_info_list[i].worker, leader)
		end

		-- 안내 안드로이드 2 (idle, throw) : 예나 지금이나 눈치 없기는 매한가지군요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(worker_info_list[2].worker, self, nil,
				{ name = 'throw', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
		, nil, { key = self.string_key .. '28_1', skip = false })

		if not self.is_worker_guiding then
			return
		end

		self.is_working_pause = false
		for i = 1, #worker_info_list do
			character_util.set_direction(worker_info_list[i].worker, 'up')
			character_util.set_anim(worker_info_list[i].worker, { name = 'walk' })
		end
	end

	if self.current_section_state > self.section_state.stay_tesla_door then
		pause_end()
		return
	end

	for i = 1, self.guide_worker_count do
		local tesla = self.get_worker_tesla(i)
		tesla.Position = worker_info_list[i].worker.Position
	end

	self:worker_is_in_camera(worker_info_list[1].worker.Position)
	if self.current_section_state > self.section_state.stay_tesla_door then
		pause_end()
		return
	end

	-- 안내 안드로이드 1 (up, mad, idle) : 또 길이 막혔군요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(worker_info_list[1].worker, self.string_key .. 25, false)
	if self.current_section_state > self.section_state.stay_tesla_door then
		pause_end()
		return
	end

	-- 길을 막는 문이 열린 경우 이벤트 중단하고 이동 이어서 진행
	self:worker_is_in_camera(worker_info_list[1].worker.Position)
	if self.current_section_state > self.section_state.stay_tesla_door then
		pause_end()
		return
	end

	-- 안내 안드로이드 2 (up, mad, idle) : 그 말인 즉, 휴식 시간이 다시 돌아왔다는 거죠.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(worker_info_list[2].worker, self.string_key .. 26, false)
	-- 길을 막는 문이 열린 경우 이벤트 중단하고 이동 이어서 진행
	if self.current_section_state > self.section_state.stay_tesla_door then
		pause_end()
		return
	end

	-- 안내 안드로이드 1, 2 각자 반대 방향 보고 tired, sleep
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = worker_info_list[1].worker })
	for i = 1, #worker_info_list do
		character_util.set_direction(worker_info_list[i].worker, i <= 1 and 'left' or 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(worker_info_list[i].worker, { name = 'sleep' }
		, { name = 'tired' })
	end

	-- 길을 막는 문이 열린 경우 이벤트 중단하고 이동 이어서 진행
	while self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.stay_tesla_door
			and self.is_worker_guiding do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	pause_end()
end

function local_class:worker_is_in_camera(pos)
	while self.is_worker_guiding
			and not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(pos, { bonus_distance = 0.5 }) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:ending_scene()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_start')

	-- 캐릭터 중심에 정렬
	wp_util.move(princess, center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil, 0.75
	, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move_async(knight, center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), nil, 0.75
	, { last_direction = 'up' })
	camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.5, 0.5)

	-- 움직이는 로직 멈추고 한프레임 쉼
	self.is_worker_guiding = false
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local worker_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.guide_worker_count do
		local worker = self.get_worker(i)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(worker)
		character_util.remove_anim(worker)
		table.insert(worker_list, worker)
	end

	local function work_end_point()
		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'down')
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down', true)

		wp_util.move(worker_list[1], vector_util.get_xy0(worker_list[1].Position, 115.5)
		, 2, nil)
		wp_util.move_async(worker_list[2], vector_util.get_xy0(worker_list[2].Position, 115.5)
		, 2, nil)

		character_util.set_direction(knight, 'up')
		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')

		wp_util.move(worker_list[1], {
			worker_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.left,
			worker_list[1].Position + vector(-1, 0, 2), center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1)
		}, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
		wp_util.move_async(worker_list[2], {
			worker_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right,
			worker_list[2].Position + vector(1, 0, 2), center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 1)
		}, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
	end

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(center_pos, worker_list[1].Position) then
		-- 같은 그리드 안에 있으면 남은 거리 체크해서 기사 공주를 돌아서 들어갈지 바로 갈지 세팅
		if (center_pos.z - worker_list[1].Position.z) <= 1.05 then
			-- 거리 얼마 안남았으면 그냥 올라감
			wp_util.move(worker_list[1], center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1), 2
			, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
			wp_util.move_async(worker_list[2], center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 1), 2
			, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
		else
			work_end_point()
		end
	else
		-- 그리드 밖에 있다면 그리드 바로 아래로 순간 이동 후 이동
		local teleport_pos = center_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 7
		for i = 1, #worker_list do
			local pos_x = i == 1 and -0.5 or 0.5
			character_util.set_position(worker_list[i], teleport_pos + vector(pos_x, 0, 0))
		end

		work_end_point()
	end

	for i = 1, #worker_list do
		character_util.remove_anim(worker_list[i])
	end

	-- 안내 안드로이드 1 (down, mad, idle) : 저희가 명령받은 이동 경로는 여기까지입니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(worker_list[1], self.string_key .. 29)

	-- 안내 안드로이드 2 (down, mad, idle) : 마스터와 즐거운 시간 보내시길 바랍니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(worker_list[2], self.string_key .. 30)

	-- 안내 안드로이드 1 (down, mad, bomb_idle) : 여기까지 오신 김에 안드로이드 휴식 시간 연장에 관련된 논의도 진행해주시면 감사하겠습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(worker_list[1], self, nil, 'bomb_idle', nil
	, self.string_key .. 31)

	-- 안내 안드로이드 1, 2 속도 3으로 왔던 길 반대로 이동
	wp_util.move(worker_list[1], {
		worker_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.left,
		worker_list[1].Position + vector(-1, 0, -2),
	}, 3, nil)
	wp_util.move_async(worker_list[2], {
		worker_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right,
		worker_list[2].Position + vector(1, 0, -2),
	}, 3, nil)

	-- 안내 안드로이드 1, 2가 가디언과 공주보다 z 좌표값 줄어들 때 가디언과 공주 아래 봄
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'down')

	wp_util.move(worker_list[1], {
		worker_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.right, worker_list[1].Position + vector(1, 0, -7)
	}, 3, nil)
	wp_util.move_async(worker_list[2], {
		worker_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.left, worker_list[2].Position + vector(-1, 0, -7),
	}, 3, nil)

	-- 안내 안드로이드 1, 2 화면 밖으로 이동해 사라질 때까지 대기
	for i = 1, #worker_list do
		character_util.set_active_state(worker_list[i], 'disabled')
	end

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 가디언 (right, idle, idle), 공주 (up, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')

	-- 공주 (up, idle, idle) : 이 앞에 기다리는 것이 인베이더의 군단장…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, self.string_key .. 32)

	-- 공주 …이모티콘
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess, nil, 'silence')

	-- 공주 (left, attack, idle) : (플레이어 이름)!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left', nil
	, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, self.string_key .. 33)

	-- 공주 (left, attack, idle) : 앞으로 무슨 일이 벌어지더라도 용기를 내자!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, self.string_key .. 34)

	-- 공주 (left, attack, release) : 어떤 어려움이라도 함께 이겨내는 거야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, 'left'
	, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, self.string_key .. 35)

	-- 공주 (left, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

	-- 선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { self.string_key .. 36, 'mercy' }, { self.string_key .. 37, 'brutal' } })

	-- 1) 물론이죠, 공주님! / 2) 저는 갑자기 속이 안 좋아서, 이만…
	if choose_result == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		-- 가디언 (right, scared, bomb_idle)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(knight, { name = 'bomb_walk' }, { name = 'scared' })

		-- 가디언 1초 간 1칸 뒷걸음질 (방향 유지)
		wp_util.move_async(knight, knight.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, nil, 1,
				{ locked_dir = 'right' })

		character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
		character_util.set_locked_dir(knight, 'none')

		-- 0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 가디언 (right, idle, idle)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		-- 공주 (left, tired, cast) : (플레이어 이름), 괜찮아?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, 'cast', 'tired'
		, self.string_key .. 38)

		-- 공주 (left, attack, victory_extra) : 걱정 마, 내가 있잖아!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, 'victory_extra', 'attack'
		, self.string_key .. 39)
	end

	-- 가디언 (right, smile, nod x 2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.nod_twice(knight)

	if choose_result == 2 then
		wp_util.move_async(knight, knight.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, nil, 0.5)
	end

	-- 공주 (left, smile, idle) : 그럼 가자!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, nil, 'smile'
	, self.string_key .. 40)

	-- 가디언과 공주 victory_get(loop x) 애니메이션
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princess, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.show_victory_get_async(knight, self, { emotion = 'attack' })

	-- 가디언, 공주 (up, idle, idle)
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.set_direction('up')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:carpenter_hammer_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local carpenter_index_list = { 1, 6, 12, 13, 15 }
	for i = 1, #carpenter_index_list do
		local carpenter = get_character(self.oneline_npc_name .. carpenter_index_list[i])
		character_util.set_anim(carpenter, { name = 'carpenter_hammer', scale = 1.1 })
	end

	-- 0.2초 딜레이
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	local delay_carpenter_index_list = { 2, 16 }
	for i = 1, #delay_carpenter_index_list do
		local carpenter = get_character(self.oneline_npc_name .. delay_carpenter_index_list[i])
		character_util.set_anim(carpenter, { name = 'carpenter_hammer', scale = 1.1 })
	end

	while not self.is_stage_exit do
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		if self.is_stage_exit then
			break
		end

		for i = 1, #carpenter_index_list do
			local carpenter = get_character(self.oneline_npc_name .. carpenter_index_list[i])
			local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(carpenter.Direction)
			local dist = vector_util.distance(leader.Position, carpenter.Position)
			if dist < 10 then
				local effect_pos = carpenter.Position + vector(dir_vector.x * 0.4, 0.3, dir_vector.z * 0.4)
				self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(effect_pos)
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_mining_01', parent = carpenter, volume = 0.1 })
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		if self.is_stage_exit then
			break
		end

		for i = 1, #delay_carpenter_index_list do
			local carpenter = get_character(self.oneline_npc_name .. delay_carpenter_index_list[i])
			local dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(carpenter.Direction)

			local dist = vector_util.distance(leader.Position, carpenter.Position)
			if dist < 10 then
				local effect_pos = carpenter.Position + vector(dir_vector.x * 0.4, 0.3, dir_vector.z * 0.4)
				self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(effect_pos)
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_mining_01', parent = carpenter, volume = 0.1 })
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:worker_sweeper_routine()
	local sweeper_count = 6
	local sweeper_list = {}
	for i = 1, sweeper_count do
		local sweeper = get_character(self.sweeper_name .. i)
		sweeper.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_anim(sweeper, { name = 'walk' })
		table.insert(sweeper_list, sweeper)
	end

	local move_info_list = {}
	local move_pos_list = {
		unity_class.vector3.right * 3, unity_class.vector3.left * 3, unity_class.vector3.back * 3,
		unity_class.vector3.forward * 3, unity_class.vector3.right * 7, unity_class.vector3.left * 7
	}

	local speed = 2
	local sweeper_time = 2

	-- 시작 좌표(1) / 도착 좌표(2)
	for i = 1, #sweeper_list do
		local pos_info = {}
		pos_info.pos_list = { sweeper_list[i].Position, sweeper_list[i].Position + move_pos_list[i] }
		pos_info.duration = (pos_info.pos_list[2] - pos_info.pos_list[1]).magnitude / speed
		pos_info.time_passed = 0

		pos_info.cur_index = 1
		pos_info.target_index = 2

		pos_info.state = 'move'

		table.insert(move_info_list, pos_info)
	end

	while not self.is_stage_exit do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		for i = 1, #sweeper_list do
			move_info_list[i].time_passed = move_info_list[i].time_passed + dt

			if move_info_list[i].state == 'move' then
				if move_info_list[i].time_passed < move_info_list[i].duration then
					-- 이동할 diff 구하기
					local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(move_info_list[i].time_passed / move_info_list[i].duration)
					local start_pos = move_info_list[i].pos_list[move_info_list[i].cur_index]
					local end_pos = move_info_list[i].pos_list[move_info_list[i].target_index]
					local target_pos = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
					local diff = target_pos - sweeper_list[i].Position

					-- 이동
					if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) == false then
						CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(sweeper_list[i], diff.normalized
						, vector_util.magnitude(diff))
					end
				else
					-- 2초간 청소함
					move_info_list[i].cur_index = (move_info_list[i].cur_index > 1) and 1 or 2
					move_info_list[i].target_index = (move_info_list[i].target_index > 1) and 1 or 2

					move_info_list[i].state = 'sweeper'
					move_info_list[i].time_passed = 0
					character_util.set_anim(sweeper_list[i], { name = 'sweeper_cleaning' })
				end
			elseif move_info_list[i].state == 'sweeper' then
				-- 청소 중일 때
				if move_info_list[i].time_passed >= sweeper_time then
					move_info_list[i].time_passed = 0
					move_info_list[i].state = 'move'

					-- 방향 전환
					local start_pos = move_info_list[i].pos_list[move_info_list[i].cur_index]
					local end_pos = move_info_list[i].pos_list[move_info_list[i].target_index]
					local dir = vector_util.to_direction(end_pos - start_pos)
					character_util.set_direction(sweeper_list[i], dir)

					-- 걷는 애니메이션 재생
					character_util.set_anim(sweeper_list[i], { name = 'walk' })
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--endregion

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.entered_meal_zone
