function local_class:reminisce_messiah_scene()
	local scene_key = 'main_s4_reminisce_messiah_'

	--인베이더 1, 6, C - demonwarrior
	--인베이더 2, 8, A - demonarcher
	--인베이더 3, 7, B - demon_hulk
	--인베이더 4, 5 - fat_invader_guard
	--인베이더 9, D - invader_soldier
	local dynamic_npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
		[scene_key .. 'queen'] = 'qc_reminisce_queen',
		[scene_key .. 'messiah'] = 'qc_reminisce_messiah',

		[scene_key .. 'knight_male'] = 'qc_knight_male_bow',
		[scene_key .. 'knight_female'] = 'qc_knight_female_bow',
		[scene_key .. 'princess'] = 'qc_princess',

		[scene_key .. 'harvester'] = 'qc_reminisce_boss_harvester',
		[scene_key .. 'boss_invader'] = 'qc_reminisce_boss_invader',
		[scene_key .. 'minotaur'] = 'qc_reminisce_boss_minotaur',

		[scene_key .. 'fallen_queen'] = 'qc_fallen_queen',
	})

	local queen_before = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'queen']
	local messiah = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'messiah']
	local fallen_queen = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'fallen_queen']

	local knight = user_util.has_knight_male()
			and dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'knight_male'] or dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'knight_female']
	local princess = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'princess']
	scene_util.hide_weapon(knight)

	local harvester = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'harvester']
	local boss_invader = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'boss_invader']
	local minotaur = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'minotaur']

	scene_util.hide_weapon(fallen_queen)

	local center_pos = vector(500, 0, 0)
	local camera_pos = center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1.5)

	--카밀라와 구세주 맵 바깥 사용하지 않는 검은 공간에 생성

	--카메라는 카밀라와 구세주 중앙 좌표에서 z축으로 1.5칸 올라간 지점으로 즉시 이동
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	--카밀라 - queen (right, idle, idle), 구세주 - messiah (left, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_position(queen_before, center_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(queen_before, 'right')

	character_util.set_position(messiah, center_pos + vector(2, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(messiah, 'left')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(messiah, 0, 0)

	-- 기사 카밀라 뒤에
	character_util.set_position(knight, queen_before.Position + vector(-1, 0, -1))
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 0, 0)

	local champion_sword_pos = queen_before.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1)
	local champion_sword = self.qc_util:create_champion_sword_on_floor(champion_sword_pos, false)
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(champion_sword, 0, 0)

	-- 보스들 구세주 뒤에
	character_util.set_position(boss_invader, messiah.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(boss_invader, 'left')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(boss_invader, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_position(harvester, messiah.Position + vector(4, 0, 3))
	character_util.set_direction(harvester, 'left')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(harvester, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_position(minotaur, messiah.Position + vector(4, 0, -1.5))
	character_util.set_direction(minotaur, 'left')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(minotaur, 0, 0)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화면 페이드 인 2초
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 카밀라 : 예언의 진실을 알게 된 나는 리리 님에게 저항하기로 결심했어.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_69', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : <b>구세주</b>, 두 사람의 대화에서도 나왔던 이름이자…
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_70', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 미지의 적, 인베이더의 수장.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_71', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 그라면…예언을 막을 수 있는 방법을 알고 있지 않을까?
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_72', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 그를 만나기 위해, 난 인베이더 모선으로 향했지.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_73', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 인베이더는 우리들의 적이지만, 그것 외에 다른 방법이 없었으니까…
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_74', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카메라 1초 간 카밀라와 구세주 중앙 좌표에서 z축으로 1.5칸 올라간 지점으로 이동
	camera_pos = camera_pos + unity_class.vector3.right
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	-- 구세주 알파 페이드 인 1초 (대기)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_champ_sword_04')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(messiah, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 구세주 … 이모티콘 2.5초
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(messiah, nil, 'silence')

	-- 카밀라 : 구세주는 나에게 거래를 제안했어.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_75', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 위 구도로 챔피언 소드 (champion_sword), 가디언 알파값 0으로 생성 후 1초 간 알파 페이드 인 (대기 x)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_evolve_result_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 1, 1)
	start_coroutine(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async, champion_sword, 1)

	-- 카밀라 : 내가 알고 있는 정보를 전부 알려준다면…
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_76', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 위 구도로 인베이더 사령관 (boss_invader), 하베스터 (boss_harvester), 미노타우르스 (boss_minotaurs) 알파값 0으로 생성 후 1초 간 알파 페이드 인 (대기 x)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_evolve_result_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(boss_invader, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(harvester, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(minotaur, 1, 1)

	-- 카밀라 : 그 대가로 <b>예언에 맞설 힘</b>을 주겠다고 말야.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_77', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	--카밀라 … 이모티콘 2.5초
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(queen_before, nil, 'silence')

	-- 챔피언 소드, 가디언, 인베이더 사령관, 하베스터, 미노타우르스 1초 간 알파 페이드 아웃
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(boss_invader, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(harvester, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(minotaur, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 0, 1)
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(champion_sword, 0, 1)

	-- 카밀라 : 나는 그의 거래를 받았들였고…내가 아는 모든 것을 말했지.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_78', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 그리고 오랜 논의 끝에 우리는 같은 결론을 내렸어.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_79', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 예언이 실현되어 종말이 오는 것을 막기 위해서는…
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_80', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : <b>가디언</b>이 <b>챔피언 소드</b>를 들고 <b>구세주</b>의 앞에 서는 일이 와서는 안 된다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_81', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top, false)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	do
		local duration = 1

		--구세주 1초 간 알파 페이드 아웃
		self:set_reminisce_npcs_disappear({ messiah }, duration)

		--1초 대기
		camera_pos = queen_before.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5)
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

		self:set_reminisce_npcs_disabled({ messiah })
	end

	--카밀라 (down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(queen_before, 'up')

	--1초 대기
	camera_pos = camera_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 6
	-- 스포트라이트 (fx_spotlight) 이펙트 가디언과 공주 사이에 생성
	local fx_spotlight = self.get_fx_spotlight():Instantiate(camera_pos)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(knight, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(knight, 'sword_idle')
	character_util.set_position(knight, camera_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 0, 0)

	-- 가디언 (right, smile, sword_idle), champion_sword 무기 장착
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(knight, '[base]weapon1', 'champion_sword')

	-- 공주 (left, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(princess, 'smile')
	character_util.set_position(princess, camera_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 0, 0)

	-- 카메라 2초 간 가디언과 공주 사이 위치로 이동 (대기)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 2, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	-- 가디언과 공주 1초 간 알파 페이드 인 (대기)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fade_out_01', volume = 0.6
	, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 가디언과 공주 victory_get(loop x) 애니메이션
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(knight, 'victory_get')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(princess, 'victory_get')

	-- 2.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	-- 카밀라 : 예언과는 조금 달랐지만…
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_82', self.reminisce_speech_pos.bottom)

	-- 카밀라 : 가디언과 네 여정은 예정된 흐름을 따라 순조롭게 진행되었어.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_83', self.reminisce_speech_pos.bottom)

	-- 카밀라 : 이대로라면 예언의 결말까지 진행되는 것은, 시간 문제에 불과할 뿐이었지.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_84', self.reminisce_speech_pos.bottom)

	-- 가디언과 공주 1초 간 알파 페이드 아웃
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 0, 1)

	-- 카메라 2초 간 카밀라에게 이동 (대기)
	camera_pos = queen_before.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 2, { ignorecameragrids = true })
	fx_spotlight:Dispose()

	-- 카밀라 : 우리들은 알고 있었어.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_85', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 가디언이 챔피언 소드의 주인이자, 이야기의 주인공인 이상.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_86', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 그를 제거하려는 시도는 무의미하다는 것을.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_87', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 그렇다면 남은 방법은 하나 뿐.
	scene_util.set_direction(queen_before, 'down', '01_walk_04')
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_88', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	do
		local disappear_duration = 1
		local appear_duration = 1
		local appear_delay = 0.5

		--카밀라 1초 간 알파 페이드 아웃
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_communication_error_01')
		self:set_reminisce_npcs_disappear({ queen_before }, disappear_duration)

		--0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(appear_delay)

		self:set_reminisce_npcs_disabled({ fallen_queen })

		--카밀라 위치에 인베이더 군단장 카밀라 - qs_invader_queen 알파값 0으로 생성
		character_util.set_position(fallen_queen, queen_before.Position)
		character_util.set_direction(fallen_queen, 'down')

		--인베이더 군단장 카밀라 1초 간 알파 페이드 인
		self:set_reminisce_npcs_appear({ fallen_queen }, appear_duration)

		--1초 대기
		wait_for_sec(disappear_duration - appear_delay)

		self:set_reminisce_npcs_disabled({ queen_before })

		wait_for_sec(appear_duration - (disappear_duration - appear_delay))
	end

	-- 카밀라 : 챔피언 소드와 헤븐홀드에 대해 누구보다 잘 아는 내가.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_89', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 인베이더의 군단장이 되어서.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_90', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : <b>가디언으로부터 챔피언 소드와 헤븐홀드를 빼앗는 것</b>.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_02')
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_91', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top, false)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화면 2초 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(dynamic_npcs)
end

function local_class:reminisce_last_scene()
	local scene_key = 'main_s4_reminisce_last_'
	local dynamic_npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
		[scene_key .. 'fallen_queen'] = 'qc_fallen_queen',
		[scene_key .. 'teatan_hero'] = 'qc_teatan_hero',
		[scene_key .. 'desert_slave'] = 'qc_desert_slave',
		[scene_key .. 'tanker'] = 'qc_tanker',
		[scene_key .. 'innuit'] = 'qc_innuit',

		[scene_key .. 'helmet_teatan_hero'] = 'qc_teatan_hero_helmet',
		[scene_key .. 'helmet_desert_slave'] = 'qc_desert_slave_helmet',
		[scene_key .. 'helmet_tanker'] = 'qc_tanker_helmet',
		[scene_key .. 'helmet_innuit'] = 'qc_innuit_helmet',
	})

	local npcs = {
		fallen_queen = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'fallen_queen'],
		teatan_hero = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'teatan_hero'],
		desert_slave = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'desert_slave'],
		tanker = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'tanker'],
		innuit = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'innuit'],
	}

	local helmet_npcs = {
		teatan_hero = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'helmet_teatan_hero'],
		desert_slave = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'helmet_desert_slave'],
		tanker = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'helmet_tanker'],
		innuit = dynamic_npcs[scene_key .. 'helmet_innuit']
	}

	--카밀라 - qs_invader_queen (down, idle, idle)
	--말(마리안) - teatan_hero_npc (down, idle, idle),
	--맙(마빈) - desert_slave_2 (down, idle, idle),
	--크(크레이그) - tanker_2 (up, idle, idle),
	--코(코코) - innuit_2 (up, idle, idle)
	for name, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(scene_key .. name)
		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'down')

		-- 캐릭터에 배틀액션같은거 붙어있을수도 있으니 HideWeapon해줌
		scene_util.hide_weapon(npc)
	end

	for name, npc in pairs(helmet_npcs) do
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(scene_key .. name)
		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'down')

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)

		-- 캐릭터에 배틀액션같은거 붙어있을수도 있으니 HideWeapon해줌
		scene_util.hide_weapon(npc)
	end

	-- TODO : 검은 네모 1 ~ 4에 배터리 설치
	local battery_name = 's4_battery_'
	local battery_count = 4
	for i = 1, battery_count do
		local battery = get_field_object(battery_name .. i)
		battery.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('main_s4_reminisce_last_battery_' .. i)
	end

	--탁자 오브젝트 제거
	--챔피언 소드 아이템 champion_sword 위 좌표에 180도 돌려서 바닥에 꽂혀 있음
	local champion_sword_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(scene_key .. 'sword')

	local champion_sword = self.qc_util:create_champion_sword_on_floor(champion_sword_pos, false)
	local champion_sword_fallen = self.qc_util:create_champion_sword_on_floor(champion_sword_pos)

	champion_sword:SetSortingLayer(true)
	champion_sword_fallen:SetSortingLayer(true)

	--카메라는 카밀라에 포커싱
	camera_util.move_async(npcs.fallen_queen.Position, 0, { end_target = npcs.fallen_queen
	, ignorecameragrids = true })

	--1초 대기
	field_util.tint(self.reminisce_tint_key, unity_color({ 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1 }), 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(champion_sword_fallen, 0, 0)

	--화면 페이드 인 2초
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 카밀라 : 부유성을 습격하는 첫 번째 계획은 아쉽게도 실패하고 말았지.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_93', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 좀 더 치밀하게 준비한 두 번째 계획, 마계 습격을 위장한 부유성 탈취는...
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_95', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	-- 카밀라 : 완벽하게 성공했어.
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_96', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

	do
		--카밀라 속도 1로 챔피언 소드 z축으로 0.7칸 위까지 이동 (말풍선은 카메라가 이동해도 움직이지 않도록 처리)
		local target_pos = champion_sword_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.7)
		local move_key = scene_key .. 'queen'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npcs.fallen_queen, target_pos, 1, nil, self, move_key)

		-- 카밀라 : 나는 미리 준비한 <b>네 개의 배터리와 네 명의 챔피언</b>을 이용해서.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_06')
		self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_97', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top)

		--카밀라 이동 완료까지 대기
		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	--카밀라 (down, attack, cast)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npcs.fallen_queen, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(npcs.fallen_queen, self, 'cast')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_02')
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async, champion_sword, 0, 1),
		util.cs_generator(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async, champion_sword_fallen, 1),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--0.5초 대기
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			local duration = 3

			--3초 간 화면 틴트 (1, 0.5, 0.5, 1)
			field_util.tint(self.reminisce_tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0.3, 0.3, 1 }), duration)

			--3초 대기
			wait_for_sec(duration)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			for name, npc in pairs(npcs) do
				if name ~= 'fallen_queen' then
					character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 2)
				end
			end

			for name, npc in pairs(helmet_npcs) do
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 2)
			end
		end)
	})

	--카밀라 (down, smile, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npcs.fallen_queen)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npcs.fallen_queen, self, 'smile')

	-- 카밀라 : <b>챔피언 소드와 부유성을 내 손에 넣었지.</b>
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	self:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech('qc_main_s4_b_98', self.reminisce_speech_pos.top, false)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화면 1초 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 배터리 비활성화
	for i = 1, battery_count do
		local battery = get_field_object(battery_name .. i)
		battery.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	-- 카밀라 NPC가 파괴되기 전에 카메라 타겟을 비워줌
	stage_camera:SetTarget(nil)

	load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(dynamic_npcs)
end

function local_class:show_fallen_queen_reminisce_speech(talk_key, viewport_pos, is_skip)
	--대사는 카메라 위 구역에 꼬리 없는 말풍선으로 표시
	is_skip = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_skip, true)

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.get_fallen_queen(), talk_key, is_skip, {
		--FIXME : 위치 조정 필요
		viewport_pos = viewport_pos,
		force_sfx = (is_skip == false)
	})
end

function local_class:set_reminisce_npcs_disappear(npcs, duration)
	for i = 1, #npcs do
		local npc = npcs[i]

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, duration)
	end
end

function local_class:set_reminisce_npcs_disabled(npcs)
	for i = 1, #npcs do
		local npc = npcs[i]

		character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)
		npc.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
	end
end

function local_class:set_reminisce_npcs_appear(npcs, duration, target_alpha)
	target_alpha = target_alpha or 1

	for i = 1, #npcs do
		local npc = npcs[i]

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, target_alpha, duration)
	end
end

function local_class:before_battle_scene()
	local scene_key = 'main_s4_after_reminisce_'

	local before_fallen_queen = self.get_unmasked_queen()
	character_util.set_active_state(before_fallen_queen, 'disabled')

	local fallen_queen = self.get_unmasked_queen()
	character_util.set_active_state(fallen_queen, 'enabled')

	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local knight = get_party_leader()

	character_util.set_position(fallen_queen, field_util.get_marker_pos(scene_key .. 'fallen_queen'))
	character_util.set_direction(fallen_queen, 'down')

	character_util.set_position(knight, self.get_restart_knight_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'up')

	character_util.set_position(princess, self.get_restart_princess_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')

	--카메라 원래 카밀라와 가디언, 공주 가운데에서 z축으로 1칸 위 위치로 즉시 이동
	local camera_pos = vector(fallen_queen.Position.x, 0, (fallen_queen.Position.z + knight.Position.z) / 2 + 1)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)

	--공주 위치 가디언 옆으로 복귀
	--카밀라 - queen (down, smile, idle)
	character_util.set_direction(fallen_queen, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fallen_queen, self, 'smile')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화면 2초 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, idle) : 나의 하나뿐인 귀염둥이, 지금은 내 이야기가 조금 어렵겠지만…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_b_100')

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, idle) : 멸망을 막기 위해, 이 세상을 구하기 위해서는.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_b_101')

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, idle) : 이 방법 밖에는 없었단다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_b_102')

	-- 공주 (up, idle, idle) : 언니…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'qc_main_s4_b_103')

	local queen_origin_pos = fallen_queen.Position

	--카밀라 속도 0.5로 위로 0.5칸 이동
	--카밀라 이동 완료까지 대기
	local target_pos = self.champion_sword.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local move_key = 'queen_move'
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_03')
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fallen_queen, target_pos, 0.5, nil, self, move_key)

	-- 1초 간 카밀라 이동한 위치로 카메라 이동, 크기 3으로 변경 (대기 x)
	camera_util.move(target_pos, 1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1)
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	--카밀라 (up, nil, idle) : 가디언.
	camera_util.move(fallen_queen.Position, 0, { end_target = fallen_queen })
	character_util.remove_emotion(fallen_queen)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fallen_queen, self, 'up'
	, nil, nil, 'qc_main_s4_b_104')

	-- 카밀라 (up, idle, idle) : 당신에게는 정말 미안한 말입니디만…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_b_105')

	-- 카밀라 (up, idle, idle) : 모두를 위해서, 당신은 이 자리에서 사라져야만 합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_b_106')

	-- 카메라 shake(0.3, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	--카밀라 (up, idle, sword_attack)
	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'sword_idle' })

	--애니메이션과 맞춰서
	wait_for_sec(0.267)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hero_sword_04')

	--챔피언 소드 아이템을 제거하고
	drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.champion_sword)
	self.champion_sword = nil

	--챔피언 소드를 카밀라에게 장비시켜 줌
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(fallen_queen, '[base]weapon1', self.corrupted_champion_sword_sprite_name)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, sword_idle) : 만약 당신이 이 <b>챔피언 소드</b>를 들고.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_b_107')

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, sword_idle) : 인베이더의 수장인 <b>구세주</b> 앞에 서는 날이 온다면…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_b_108')

	do
		local duration = 1.5
		local queen_pos = self.get_restart_fallen_queen_pos()
		local queen_move_diff = queen_pos - fallen_queen.Position
		local move_key = 'after_reminisce_fallen_queen'

		--카밀라 1.5초 간 아래로 1칸 이동
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_03')
		scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, 'sword_walk')
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(fallen_queen, queen_pos, nil, duration, self, move_key)

		--카메라 1.5초 간 아래로 1.5칸 이동
		target_pos = camera_pos + (queen_move_diff * 0.5)
		camera_util.move_async(target_pos, duration)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, sword_idle) : <b>이 세상은 멸망하게 되니까요.</b>
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')
	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, 'sword_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_b_109', false, { force_sfx = true })

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, bomb_idle) : 너무 슬퍼하진 마세요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.hide_weapon(fallen_queen, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fallen_queen, self, nil, 'bomb_idle'
	, nil, 'qc_main_s4_b_110')

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, sword_idle) : 당신이 지키고 싶었던 소중한 <b>공주님</b>도, <b>동료 챔피언들</b>도, 이 <b>헤븐홀드</b>도…
	character_util.hide_weapon(fallen_queen, false)
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(fallen_queen, '[base]weapon1', self.corrupted_champion_sword_sprite_name)
	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, 'sword_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_b_111')

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, sword_idle) : 제가 당신을 대신해 지켜낼 테니까요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_b_112')

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, idle) : 그러니 당신이 할 일은…
	character_util.hide_weapon(fallen_queen, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_b_113')

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local origin_camera_pos = vector(fallen_queen.Position.x, 0, (fallen_queen.Position.z + knight.Position.z) / 2)
	do
		local duration = 0.3

		--0.3초 간 카메라 사이즈 2.5로 축소
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, duration)
		camera_util.move_async(fallen_queen.Position, duration)
	end

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(fallen_queen, '[base]weapon1', self.corrupted_champion_sword_sprite_name)

	-- 카메라 shake (0.2, 0.5)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	-- 카밀라 (down, smile, sword_idle) : 여기서 제 손에 죽음을 맞는 것입니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_06')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fallen_queen, self,
			'down', 'sword_idle', 'smile', 'qc_main_s4_b_114')

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, idle), ! 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(fallen_queen, nil, 'notice')

	-- 공주 (up, idle, hold_loop), 점프 (0.5, 0.3) : 언니! 제발 그만!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			nil, { name = 'hold_loop', keep = true }, nil, 'qc_main_s4_b_115')

	-- 공주 (up, idle, hold_loop) : 우리끼리 싸우는 것은 이제 그만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil, nil, nil, 'qc_main_s4_b_116')

	--카밀라 (down, attack, cast2)
	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, 'cast2')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fallen_queen, self, 'attack')

	do
		local shake_duration = 1.5
		local resize_duration = 1

		--카메라 shake(0.2, 1.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_magic_04')
		camera_util.shake(0.2, shake_duration)

		--1초 간 카메라 사이즈 복구
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, resize_duration)
		camera_util.move_async(origin_camera_pos, resize_duration)

		--1.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(shake_duration - resize_duration)
	end

	-- fx_boss_fallen_queen_blade_cast_portal_open_r 공주 위치에 생성
	-- localRotation (0, -90, 0)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(princess, 'Top Effects', 3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lord_shoot_01')
	local blade_cast_open = self.get_fx_blade_cast_open():Instantiate(princess.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
	blade_cast_open.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)
	blade_cast_open.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

	--화면 shake (0.3, 0.5)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	--공주 위치에 fx_lasthit 생성
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(princess.Bounds.center)

	--가디언 (right, surprise, embarrassed), 점프(0.5, 0.3)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'embarrassed')
	character_util.normal_jump(knight, '01_jump_01')

	--공주 (left, scared, idle), 점프(0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(princess, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'scared')
	character_util.normal_jump(princess)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언 (right, scared, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'scared')

	-- 공주 (left, scared, idle) : 언니!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self,
			nil, nil, nil, 'qc_main_s4_b_117')

	--카밀라 (down, idle, sword_idle) : 걱정 마, 내 귀염둥이.
	character_util.remove_emotion(fallen_queen)
	scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, { name = 'sword_idle' })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fallen_queen, self,
			'down', nil, nil, 'qc_main_s4_b_118')

	--카밀라 (down, smile, sing) : 이번 일만 끝나면…우린 다시 행복해질 수 있을 거야.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fallen_queen, self,
			'down', 'sing', 'smile', 'qc_main_s4_b_119')

	--카밀라 (down, smile, cast2) : 그러니까, 기다려 줄래?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fallen_queen, self,
			'down', 'cast2', 'smile', 'qc_main_s4_b_120')

	-- 카밀라 (down, smile, idle) : 우리 귀염둥이는 착한 아이니까…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fallen_queen, self,
			'down', nil, 'smile', 'qc_main_s4_b_121')

	--공주 머리 위에 shake 말풍선 : 언니이이이!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(princess, {
		key = 'qc_main_s4_b_122', skip = false, bubble_type = 'shout', type_speed = 0,
		keep_display = true, world_pos = princess.Position + vector(0, 1, 0),
		force_sfx = true })

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	do
		-- 카메라 shake(0.3, 0.3)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

		-- fx_boss_fallen_queen_blade_cast_portal_open_r 제거
		blade_cast_open:Dispose()

		-- fx_boss_fallen_queen_blade_cast_portal_end_r 공주 위치에 생성
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hyunckel_shot_01')
		local blade_cast_end = self.get_fx_blade_cast_end():Instantiate(princess.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
		blade_cast_end.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)
		-- localRotation (0, -90, 0)
		blade_cast_end.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

		-- 공주 0.3초 간 알파 페이드 아웃 (대기)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 0, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 공주 비활성화
	character_util.set_active_state(princess, 'disabled')

	--가디언 (up, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'up')

	-- 카밀라 (down, idle, idle) : 아직도 이해하지 못하셨나요?
	character_util.remove_anim(fallen_queen)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fallen_queen, self,
			'down', nil, nil, 'qc_main_s4_b_123')

	--카밀라 (down, smile, idle) : 그렇다면 제가 직접 알려드리도록 하죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fallen_queen, self,
			'down', nil, 'smile', 'qc_main_s4_b_123_1')

	-- 카밀라 (down, attack, sword_idle) : 당신의 죽음만이…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_equip_weapon_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fallen_queen, self,
			'down', 'sword_idle', 'attack', 'qc_main_s4_b_124')

	-- 카밀라 (down, attack, sword_attack(loop x) -> sword_attack_stab (loop x) -> sword_idle) : <b>이 세계를 구할 수 있습니다!!!</b>
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_back_slash_04')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(fallen_queen, self, { name = 'sword_attack', loop = false })
		scene_util.set_anim_async(fallen_queen, self, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', loop = false })
		scene_util.set_anim(fallen_queen, self, 'sword_idle')
	end)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fallen_queen, self, 'down', nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'qc_main_s4_b_125')
end

function local_class:choose_about_authority()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	-- 공주 (left, cry, cast) : (플레이어 이름)...
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'qc_main_s4_a_123')

	--아래 선택지에서 권한을 포기한다를 고른 경우, 재시작 버튼을 누르면 여기서부터 다시 시작
	--Custom_state 등으로 저장해서 재 진입 시 바로 이 상황에서 재시작하도록 설정
	self:save_before_authority_choice()

	--선택지
	--챔피언 소드의 권한을 포기한다.
	--챔피언 소드의 권한을 포기하지 않는다.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_main_s4_a_123_1', 'brutal' },
		{ 'qc_main_s4_a_123_2', 'mercy' },
	})

	return result == 2
end

function local_class:knight_dead_scene()
	--챔피언 소드의 권한을 포기한다. 선택 시

	local fallen_queen = self.get_fallen_queen()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	end

	start_coroutine(self.battle_routine, self)
end

function local_class:battle_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local fallen_queen_monster = self.get_fallen_queen_monster()

	-- 리더 hp에 따른 연출 처리
	local leader_hp_event = function()
		-- 가디언 체력이 0.01퍼센트 남았을 때 종료
		while self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_with_queen do
			local guardian_hp_ratio = leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio
			if guardian_hp_ratio < 0.01 then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 시간에 따른 연출 처리
	local time_pass_speak_event = function()
		local battle_timer = function(start_time, wait_time, stop_condition)

			while unity_class.time.time - start_time < wait_time and
					self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_with_queen do
				if stop_condition ~= nil and stop_condition() then
					break
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			return self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.battle_with_queen
		end

		-- 전투 시작 후 10초 지나거나 가디언의 HP가 85% 이하로 남음
		local target_radio = 0.85
		local stop_condition = function()
			local guardian_hp_ratio = leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio
			return target_radio >= guardian_hp_ratio
		end

		local is_battle_end_while_waiting = battle_timer(unity_class.time.time, 10, stop_condition)
		if is_battle_end_while_waiting then
			return
		else
			-- 카밀라 : 고작 그 정도 힘으로 저를 상대하려던 건가요?
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen_monster, 'qc_main_s4_c_1', false)
		end

		-- 전투 시작 후 20초 지나거나 가디언의 HP가 50% 이하로 남음
		target_radio = 0.5
		is_battle_end_while_waiting = battle_timer(unity_class.time.time, 10, stop_condition)
		if is_battle_end_while_waiting then
			return
		else
			-- 카밀라 : 당신이 낼 수 있는 최강의 힘을 보여주세요!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen_monster, 'qc_main_s4_c_2', false)
		end

		-- 전투 시작 후 30초 지나거나 가디언의 HP가 30% 이하로 남음
		target_radio = 0.3
		is_battle_end_while_waiting = battle_timer(unity_class.time.time, 10, stop_condition)
		if is_battle_end_while_waiting then
			return
		else
			-- 카밀라 : 세상을 구할 영웅이 이렇게 약해도 괜찮다고 생각하시나요?
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen_monster, 'qc_main_s4_c_3', false)
		end
	end

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(time_pass_speak_event),
		util.cs_generator(leader_hp_event)
	})

	leader.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_end_with_queen
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	character_util.convert_to_npc(fallen_queen_monster)
end

		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = target.Position
		local end_pos = target.Position + move_vector
		while true do

			if progress >= 1 then
				break
			end

			target.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local function local_hero_landing(fo, dir, pos, jump_height, fall_duration)
		-- 캐릭터를 히어로 랜딩 할 위치로 배치
		character_util.set_position(fo, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)

		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false })

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local start_pos = fo.Position
		local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, fo.Position.y, 0)
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
			free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

			if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
				character_util.set_position(fo, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
			else
				character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

	character_util.remove_emotion(fallen_queen)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_c_30')

	--카밀라 (down, idle, sword_idle) : 제 계획은 무너지지 않습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_c_31')

	--카밀라 (down, idle, sword_idle) : 조금만 기다려 주세요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(fallen_queen, 'qc_main_s4_c_32')

	--카밀라 (down, smile, sword_idle) : 내 하나 뿐인 귀염둥이.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')

	character_util.hide_weapon(leader, false)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:play_envi_sfx(sfx_name, volume)
	self:stop_envi_sfx(0)

	, volume = volume, type_priority = 'loop' })

	if self.envi_sfx ~= nil then
		self.envi_sfx:FadeOut(fade_out_time)
		self.envi_sfx = nil
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	local invisible_wall = self.get_invisible_wall(1)
	invisible_wall.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	if self.desert_slave_attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.desert_slave_attack_range)
		self.desert_slave_attack_range = nil
	end

	if self.tanker_attack_range_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.tanker_attack_range_list do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.tanker_attack_range_list[i])
		end

		self.tanker_attack_range_list = nil
	end

	if self.attack_range_circle_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.attack_range_circle_list do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range_circle_list[i])
		end
		self.attack_range_circle_list = nil
	end

	if self.teatan_parent ~= nil then
		local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
		self.teatan_parent = teatan_hero.Transform.parent
		self.teatan_parent = nil
	end

	if self.ice_info_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.ice_info_list do
			local ice_info = self.ice_info_list[i]
			ice_info.wall:Dispose()
		end

		self.ice_info_list = nil
	end

	self:stop_explosion_sfx()

	self:dispose_ice_effect()

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.shader_container) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.shader_container)
	end
	self.shader_container = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.chase_zone_name .. 1)
			and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.none then
		-- 마빈 추격 시작
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.chase_start_desert_slave
		start_coroutine(self.chase_start_desert_slave, self)
		return true
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.chase_zone_name .. 2 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader)
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.bomb_attack_teatan_hero then
		-- 마리안 폭탄 이벤트 시작
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.bomb_attack_teatan_hero
		start_coroutine(self.chase_start_teatan_hero, self)
		return true
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.chase_zone_name .. 3 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader)
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.bomb_attack_teatan_hero_part_2 then
		-- 마리안 두번째 폭탄 이벤트 시작
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.bomb_attack_teatan_hero_part_2
		start_coroutine(self.chase_start_teatan_hero_part_2, self)
		return true
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.chase_zone_name .. 4 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader)
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.enter_save_area then
		--TODO: 중간 저장 안전 지대
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_save_area
		self:stop_explosion_sfx()
		-- 배틀 게이트 닫음
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s5_battle_gate_' .. 3, true))
		return true
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.chase_zone_name .. 5 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader)
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.chase_start_tanker then
		-- 크레이그 추격 이벤트 시작
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.chase_start_tanker
		start_coroutine(self.chase_start_tanker, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.chase_zone_name .. 6)
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.chase_tanker_part_2 then
		-- 크레이그 2차 추격 이벤트 시작
		-- 크레이그쪽 invisible_wall 세팅
		local invisible_wall = self.get_invisible_wall(1)
		invisible_wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1, 2))
		invisible_wall.Position = vector(46.5, 0, 193.5)

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.chase_tanker_part_2
		return true
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.chase_zone_name .. 7 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader)
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.ice_attack_innuit then
		-- 코코 얼음 공격 시작
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ice_attack_innuit
		start_coroutine(self.ice_attack_innuit, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.chase_zone_name .. 8)
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.start_money_shot then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.start_money_shot
		start_coroutine(self.last_attack_desert_slave, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.is_stage_end = true
end

--endregion

-- 섹션 시작 연출
function local_class:start_section(is_cur_section_start)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_run', state = 'event' })
	if is_cur_section_start then
		-- 이 섹션에서 시작 했다면 circular로 페이드 인
		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	else
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	end
end

-- 마빈 추적 연출
function local_class:chase_start_desert_slave()
	local desert_slave_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.s5_invisible_wall_marker .. 1)
			+ unity_class.vector3.back

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local desert_slave = self.get_desert_slave()

	-- 마빈 (up, mad, gauntlet_attack(loop x))
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(desert_slave)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(desert_slave, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack', loop = false }
	, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_active_state(desert_slave, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(desert_slave, desert_slave_pos)

	-- 마빈 캐릭터에 fx_flame_rush_loop 이펙트 생성해서 parent에 붙임, 마빈이 이동하는 방향으로 회전
	local flame_loop_effect = self.get_fx_flame_rush_loop():Instantiate(desert_slave.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0), desert_slave.Transform)

	-- 마빈 그리드 밖에서 대기
	character_util.set_position(desert_slave, desert_slave_pos)

	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 카메라 shake(0.2, 2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_vulkan_attack_01')
	local duration = 2
	camera_util.shake(0.2, duration)

	-- 마빈 2초 간 위 경로로 달려감
	wp_util.move(desert_slave, desert_slave_pos + vector(0, 0, 35.5), nil, duration)

function local_class:chase_start_teatan_hero()
	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count - 2 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s5_battle_gate_' .. i, true))
	end

	-- 마리안
	local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()

	local start_pos = vector(-9, 6.5, 0)
	local end_pos = vector(18, -8.5, 0)
	local duration = 1.5

	teatan_hero.Position = start_pos
	character_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(teatan_hero, { name = 'attack', loop = false }
	, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_active_state(teatan_hero, 'enabled')

	character_util.spine_scale(teatan_hero, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5, 0)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	character_util.spine_scale(teatan_hero, unity_class.vector3.one * 3, duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_04')
	local is_throw_bomb = false
	local time_passed = 0
	while not self.is_stage_end and time_passed < duration do
		if not is_throw_bomb and time_passed >= duration * 0.2 then
			self:stop_explosion_sfx()
			self.explosion_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_loop_01'
			, play_pos = vector(18, 0, 193.5), loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

			is_throw_bomb = true
			start_coroutine(self.chasing_bomb_routine, self)
			start_coroutine(self.throw_bomb, self, 's5_bomb_throw_point_1_', 8)
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local target_pos = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		teatan_hero.Position = target_pos
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(teatan_hero, 'disabled')
end

-- 마리안 두번째 폭탄 연출

	character_util.spine_scale(teatan_hero, unity_class.vector3.one * 3, duration)

	local start_pos = vector(12, 6.5, 0)
	local end_pos = vector(-22, -8.5, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_04')

function local_class:stop_explosion_sfx()

		self.explosion_sfx:Stop()
		self.explosion_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:chasing_bomb_routine()
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local bomb_info = {}
	bomb_info.end_pos = unity_class.vector3.one
	bomb_info.start_pos = unity_class.vector3.one
	bomb_info.bomb = nil
	bomb_info.delay = 0.15
	bomb_info.is_explosion = false
	bomb_info.time_passed = 0
	bomb_info.state = 'wait'
	bomb_info.attack_range = nil

	local fall_duration = 1
	local height = 10
	local radius = 1.5

	local is_clear = false
	while not self.is_stage_end and not self.is_game_over and not is_clear do
		bomb_info.time_passed = bomb_info.time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if bomb_info.state == 'wait' then
			if bomb_info.time_passed >= bomb_info.delay then
				bomb_info.end_pos = vector(math.min(31, leader.Position.x)
				, leader.Position.y, leader.Position.z)
				bomb_info.start_pos = bomb_info.end_pos + vector(0, height, 0)
				bomb_info.bomb = self.get_bomb():Instantiate(bomb_info.start_pos)

				self:set_bomb_attack_range(bomb_info)
			end
		elseif bomb_info.state == 'attack' then
			self:bomb_attack(bomb_info, leader, fall_duration, radius)
		elseif bomb_info.state == 'check_bomb_range' then
			self:check_bomb_range(bomb_info, leader, radius, function()
				if self.current_section_state > self.section_state.bomb_attack_teatan_hero_part_2 then
					is_clear = true
				end
			end)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if bomb_info.attack_range ~= nil then
		bomb_info.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	if bomb_info.bomb ~= nil then
		bomb_info.bomb:Dispose()
	end
end

-- 마리안 폭탄 로직
function local_class:throw_bomb(first_name, count)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local bomb_info_list = {}

	local height = 15
	local fall_duration = 1
	local radius = 1.25
	for i = 1, count do
		local bomb_info = {}
		bomb_info.end_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(first_name .. i)
		bomb_info.start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(first_name .. i) + vector(0, height, 0)

		bomb_info.bomb = self.get_bomb():Instantiate(bomb_info.start_pos)
		bomb_info.delay = 0.15 * i
		bomb_info.is_explosion = false
		bomb_info.time_passed = 0
		bomb_info.state = 'wait'
		bomb_info.attack_range = nil

		table.insert(bomb_info_list, bomb_info)
	end

	local explosion_count = 0
	while not self.is_stage_end do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if explosion_count >= count then
			if self.is_game_over
					or self.current_section_state > self.section_state.bomb_attack_teatan_hero_part_2 then
				break
			end

			explosion_count = 0
			for i = 1, count do
				local bomb_info = bomb_info_list[i]
				bomb_info.bomb = self.get_bomb():Instantiate(bomb_info.start_pos)
				bomb_info.is_explosion = false
			end

			-- 끝까지 진행하면 1초 대기 후 처음부터 폭탄 투하 반복
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end

		for i = 1, count do
			local bomb_info = bomb_info_list[i]
			if bomb_info.is_explosion == false then
				bomb_info.time_passed = bomb_info.time_passed + dt
				if bomb_info.state == 'wait' then
					if bomb_info.time_passed >= bomb_info.delay then
						self:set_bomb_attack_range(bomb_info)
					end
				elseif bomb_info.state == 'attack' then
					self:bomb_attack(bomb_info, leader, fall_duration, radius)
				elseif bomb_info.state == 'check_bomb_range' then
					self:check_bomb_range(bomb_info, leader, radius, function()
						explosion_count = explosion_count + 1
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 폭탄 어택레인지 생성
function local_class:set_bomb_attack_range(bomb_info)
	bomb_info.time_passed = 0
	bomb_info.state = 'attack'

	bomb_info.attack_range = self:get_attack_range_circle()

	attack_range_util.setup_by_position(bomb_info.attack_range, bomb_info.end_pos, 0.01)
	attack_range_util.show(bomb_info.attack_range, 0)
end

-- 폭탄 공격 시작
function local_class:bomb_attack(bomb_info, leader, fall_duration, radius, callback)
	if bomb_info.time_passed < fall_duration then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(bomb_info.time_passed / fall_duration)
		local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(bomb_info.start_pos, bomb_info.end_pos, progress)
		bomb_info.bomb.transform.position = lerp_pos
	else
		bomb_info.time_passed = 0
		bomb_info.state = 'check_bomb_range'

		-- 거리 계산
		local magnitude = vector_util.get_x0z(bomb_info.end_pos - leader.Position).magnitude
		if magnitude < radius - 0.01 then
			local is_left = leader.Position.x < bomb_info.end_pos.x
			self:fail_event(is_left)
		end

		-- 폭탄 터짐
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', play_pos = bomb_info.end_pos
		, volume = 0.5, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
		bomb_info.bomb:Dispose()
		bomb_info.bomb = nil
		self.get_fx_explosion():Instantiate(bomb_info.end_pos)

		if callback then
			callback()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_bomb_range(bomb_info, leader, radius, callback)
	if bomb_info.time_passed <= 0.3 then
		-- 거리 계산
		local magnitude = vector_util.get_x0z(bomb_info.end_pos - leader.Position).magnitude
		if magnitude < radius - 0.01 then
			local is_left = leader.Position.x < bomb_info.end_pos.x
			self:fail_event(is_left)
		end
	else
		bomb_info.time_passed = 0

		bomb_info.state = 'wait'
		bomb_info.attack_range:Hide()
		bomb_info.is_explosion = true

		if callback then
			callback()
		end
	end
end

-- 크레이그 추적 연출
function local_class:chase_start_tanker()
	local target_magnitude = 1.25
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local tanker = self.get_tanker()

	-- AttackRange 끝까지 차면 크레이그 속도 12로 돌진 (left, idle, sword_shield_attack(loop x)), 돌진하는 동안 카메라 shake(0.2)
	local tank_pos_marker_name = 's5_tanker_pos_'
	local tanker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(tank_pos_marker_name .. 1)
	character_util.set_direction(tanker, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tanker)
	character_util.set_anim(tanker, { name = 'sword_shield_attack', loop = false })
	character_util.set_active_state(tanker, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(tanker, tanker_pos)

	-- 크레이그에 FX_ChargeImpact_dash 이펙트 생성해서 parent에 붙임
	local charge_impact_effect = self.get_fx_charge_impact_dash():Instantiate(tanker.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0), tanker.Transform)

	-- 1초 간 AttackRange가 차오름
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	local attack_range = self.tanker_attack_range_list[1]
	local attack_range_pos = tanker_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * 8.5

	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, attack_range_pos, unity_class.vector3.left, 0.1)
	attack_range_util.show(attack_range, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local function end_attack()
		attack_range:Hide()
		charge_impact_effect:Dispose()
	end

	-- AttackRange 끝까지 차면 크레이그 속도 12로 돌진 (left, idle, sword_shield_attack(loop x)), 돌진하는 동안 카메라 shake(0.2)
	local tanker_pos_2 = field_util.get_marker_pos(tank_pos_marker_name .. 2)

	-- 첫번째 돌진
	local duration = 0.5
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_oghma_shield_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, duration)
	wp_util.move(tanker, tanker_pos_2, nil, duration)
	local is_tackle_fail = self:tackle_move(tanker, leader, duration, target_magnitude + 0.25, end_attack)
	-- 실패시 return
	if is_tackle_fail then
		character_util.remove_anim(tanker)
		return
	end

	if self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.chase_start_tanker then
		-- 여기까지 내려온 거라면 실패
		duration = 0.88
		local tanker_pos_3 = field_util.get_marker_pos(tank_pos_marker_name .. 3) + unity_class.vector3.left
		wp_util.move(tanker, tanker_pos_3, nil, duration)
		self:tackle_move(tanker, leader, duration, target_magnitude, end_attack)
		character_util.remove_anim(tanker)
		return
	end

	-- 두번째 어택레인지 차오르는 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	attack_range:Hide()
	attack_range = self.tanker_attack_range_list[2]

	local attack_range_pos_2 = tanker.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward

	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, attack_range_pos_2, unity_class.vector3.back, 0.1)
	attack_range_util.show(attack_range, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_direction(tanker, 'down')
	charge_impact_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -180, 0)

	-- 두번째 어택 시작
	duration = 1.15
	local tanker_pos_4 = field_util.get_marker_pos(tank_pos_marker_name .. 4)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_oghma_shield_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, duration)
	wp_util.move(tanker, tanker_pos_4, nil, duration)
	is_tackle_fail = self:tackle_move(tanker, leader, duration, target_magnitude, end_attack)
	if is_tackle_fail then
		character_util.remove_anim(tanker)
		return
	end

	-- 세번째 어택레인지 차오르는 연출
	local invisible_wall = self.get_invisible_wall(1)
	invisible_wall.Position = tanker.Position
	character_util.set_direction(tanker, 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	attack_range:Hide()
	attack_range = self.tanker_attack_range_list[3]

	local attack_range_pos_3 = tanker.Position + unity_class.vector3.left

	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, attack_range_pos_3, unity_class.vector3.right, 0.1)
	attack_range_util.show(attack_range, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	charge_impact_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)

	-- 세번째 어택
	duration = 0.96
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_oghma_shield_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, duration)
	wp_util.move(tanker, field_util.get_marker_pos(tank_pos_marker_name .. 5), nil, duration)
	is_tackle_fail = self:tackle_move(tanker, leader, duration, target_magnitude, end_attack)
	character_util.remove_anim(tanker)

	if is_tackle_fail then
		return
	end

	end_attack()
end

function local_class:ice_attack_innuit()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s5_battle_gate_4', true))

	local attack_count = 1
	self.ice_effect_list = {}
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local target_magnitude = 1.2
	local is_fail = false

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_magic_05')
	local wait_time = 0.3
	wait_for_sec(wait_time)

	while not self.is_stage_end do
		-- 코코가 리더 바라보도록
		character_util.look_at(innuit, leader)

		-- 어택 포인트 정보 세팅
		local attack_point_info = {}
		do
			local marker_name = 's5_ice_attack_point_' .. attack_count
			attack_point_info.pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name)
			attack_point_info.ice_info = self:get_ice_info()

			-- 어택 레인지 세팅
			attack_point_info.attack_range = self:get_ice_attack_range()

			attack_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_point_info.attack_range, attack_point_info.pos, 0.01)
			attack_range_util.show(attack_point_info.attack_range, 0)
		end

		-- 4의 배수 공격(4, 8, 12, 16, 20) 시, 플레이어 위치와 현재 공격 ice 오브젝트의 중심 위치 확인
		-- 플레이어 위치와 AttackRange 위치의 거리가 1.5 이하면 얼음 공격 딜레이를 0.3초에서 0.35초로 변경
		-- 플레이어 위치와 AttackRange 위치의 거리가 1.5 이상이면 얼음 공격 딜레이를 0.3초에서 0.27초로 변경
		local is_multiples_of_four = (attack_count % 4) == 0
		if is_multiples_of_four then
			local diff = (leader.Position - attack_point_info.pos).magnitude
			wait_time = (diff >= 1.5) and 0.27 or 0.35
		end

		-- wait_time 만큼 대기
		wait_for_sec(wait_time)

		-- 카메라 shake(0.2, 0.3)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)

		do
			attack_point_info.attack_range:Hide()
			attack_point_info.ice_info.wall.Position = attack_point_info.pos
			attack_point_info.ice_info.wall.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_break_ice_01', play_pos = attack_point_info.pos
			, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
			self.get_fx_red_ice_hit():Instantiate(attack_point_info.pos)
			local ice_effect = self.get_fx_red_ice():Instantiate(attack_point_info.pos)
			ice_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
			table.insert(self.ice_effect_list, ice_effect)

			-- 거리 체크해서 게임오버 확인
			local target_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(attack_point_info.pos, unity_class.vector3.one * 2)
			if bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(target_bounds, leader.Bounds) and not is_fail
					and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.start_money_shot then
				-- 게임 오버 연출 시작
				local is_left = leader.Position.x < attack_point_info.pos.x
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_ice_01')
				self:fail_event(is_left)
				is_fail = true
			end
		end

		-- 10번 공격 끝나면 FX_reset_object 이펙트 코코 위치에 생성, 0.2초 뒤 코코 위치 즉시 검은 원(코2) 위치로 이동
		if attack_count == 10 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')
				self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(innuit.Position)
				wait_for_sec(0.2)
				character_util.set_position(innuit, field_util.get_marker_pos(self.innuit_point_name .. 2))
				self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(innuit.Position)
			end)
		end

		if self.is_game_over then
			attack_point_info.attack_range:Hide()
			break
		end

		attack_count = attack_count + 1
		if attack_count > self.ice_count then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:get_ice_info()
	for i = 1, #self.ice_info_list do
		local ice_info = self.ice_info_list[i]
		if ice_info.is_active == false then
			ice_info.is_active = true
			return ice_info
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:dispose_ice_effect()
	if self.ice_effect_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.ice_effect_list do
			self.ice_effect_list[i]:Dispose()
		end

		self.ice_effect_list = nil
	end
end

-- 돌진 연출 체크
function local_class:tackle_move(owner, target, duration, target_magnitude, callback)
	local is_fail = false
	local time_passed = 0

	while not self.is_stage_end and time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local magnitude = vector_util.get_x0z(owner.Position - target.Position).magnitude
		if magnitude < target_magnitude and not is_fail then
			-- 게임 오버 연출 시작
			local is_left = target.Position.x < owner.Position.x
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
			self:fail_event(is_left, function()
				if callback then
					callback()
				end
			end)

			is_fail = true
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	return is_fail
end

function local_class:fail_event(is_left, callback)
	if self.is_game_over then
		return
	end

	self.is_game_over = true
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	start_coroutine(self.fail_event_routine, self, is_left, callback)
end

-- 실패 연출
function local_class:fail_event_routine(is_left, callback)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(leader)
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0))
	self.get_extreme_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0))
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })

	local duration = 1
	local rotation_dir = is_left and -720 or 720
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, rotation_dir, duration + 0.2)
	character_util.spine_scale(leader, unity_class.vector3.one * 7, duration)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, false)

	local start_pos = leader.Position
	local end_add_x = is_left and -3 or 3
	local end_pos = leader.Position + vector(end_add_x, 10, -12)
	local is_fade_start = false

	leader.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 1000)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		if not is_fade_start and time_passed >= (duration * 0.5) then
			is_fade_start = true
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
			screen_util.fade_out_circular(1, 'linear')
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * end_pos.y

		leader.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, y)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	leader.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local is_enter_save_point = self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.enter_save_area

	-- 리더 리셋
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, is_enter_save_point and 'right' or 'up')
	local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.reset_point_name .. (is_enter_save_point and 2 or 1))
	character_util.set_position(leader, marker_pos)
	character_util.spine_scale(leader, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, true)

	-- 크레이그 리셋
	local tanker = self.get_tanker()
	character_util.set_active_state(tanker, 'disabled')
	for i = 1, #self.tanker_attack_range_list do
		self.tanker_attack_range_list[i]:Hide()
	end

	-- 얼음 리셋
	self:dispose_ice_effect()
	self:reset_ice_wall()

	-- 코코 리셋
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	character_util.set_direction(innuit, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(innuit, field_util.get_marker_pos(self.innuit_point_name .. 1))

	-- 마빈 리셋
	local desert_slave = self.get_desert_slave()
	local desert_slave_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.s5_invisible_wall_marker .. 1)
			+ unity_class.vector3.back
	character_util.set_position(desert_slave, desert_slave_pos)
	self.desert_slave_attack_range:Hide()

	-- 마리안 리셋
	local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
	character_util.set_active_state(teatan_hero, 'disabled')

	self.current_section_state = is_enter_save_point
			and self.section_state.enter_save_area or self.section_state.chase_start_desert_slave

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	local start_index = is_enter_save_point and self.battle_gate_count or 1
	for i = start_index, self.battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('s5_battle_gate_' .. i, true))
	end

	if callback then
		callback()
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	self.is_game_over = false

	-- 중간 저장 시점이 아니면 마빈 이벤트 시작
	if not is_enter_save_point then
		self:chase_start_desert_slave()
	else
		-- 중간 지점이라면 invisible_wall 리셋
		local invisible_wall = self.get_invisible_wall(1)
		invisible_wall.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end
end

function local_class:last_attack_desert_slave()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local desert_slave = self.get_desert_slave()

	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector(999, 0, 999),
			unity_class.vector2(13.75, 1.5),
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	attack_range:Hide()

	-- 존 1 입장 후 연출 시작 (컨트롤 빼앗음)
	local target_pos = vector(76, 0, 178.5)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, target_pos, nil, 0.15, { run = true })

	-- 가디언 속도 6으로 맵 우측 끝까지 이동
	local move_end_key = 'move_end_key'
	target_pos = target_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * 11
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, target_pos, nil, 1.5, self,
			move_end_key, { run = true })

	-- 가디언 이동 시작하면 현재 방 수직 구간 전체에 AttackRange 생성 (챕터 3 그림자 괴물 참고)
	-- AttackRange는 1초 간 내부 공간이 채워지도록 설정
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_vulkan_jump_01')
	local desert_slave_pos = vector(74, 0, 178.5)

	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, desert_slave_pos, unity_class.vector3.right * 1.1, 0.1)
	attack_range_util.show(attack_range, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- AttackRange가 전부 채워지면 위 위치에 마빈 캐릭터 생성
	-- 마빈 (right, mad, gauntlet_attack(loop x))
	character_util.remove_anim(desert_slave)
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(desert_slave, 'gauntlet_boong_attack')
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(desert_slave, desert_slave_pos)
	character_util.set_active_state(desert_slave, 'enabled')

	-- 마빈 캐릭터에 fx_flame_rush_loop 이펙트 생성해서 parent에 붙임, 마빈이 이동하는 방향으로 회전
	local flame_loop_effect = self.get_fx_flame_rush_loop():Instantiate(desert_slave.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0), desert_slave.Transform)

	-- 카메라 shake(0.2, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_vulkan_attack_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	-- 1초 간 마빈 우측으로 달려옴
	wp_util.move_async(desert_slave, target_pos + unity_class.vector3.left
	, nil, 0.5)

	-- 가디언과 마빈 충돌하는 순간 fx_windowbreak, FX_Common_SmokeScreen 가디언 위치로부터 x축으z로 0.5 우측 좌표에 생성
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.5)
	attack_range:Hide()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_window_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.get_fx_smokescreen():Instantiate(desert_slave.Position + vector(0.5, 0.1, 0))
	self.get_fx_window_break():Instantiate(desert_slave.Position + vector(0.5, 0.1, 0),
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0), nil)

	-- 마빈은 충돌 후에도 계속 앞으로 달려서 카메라 밖으로 사라짐
	wp_util.move(desert_slave, desert_slave.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 24
	, 12, nil)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 카메라 shake(0.4, 0.5)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)

	-- 가디언은 위 선처럼 공중에 떴다가 추락
	-- 가디언 추락하는 동안 (right, damaged, embarrassed), 1440도 회전
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

	-- 추락 4초간 지속
	character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, false)
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 2880, 4.5)

	-- y축으로는 자유낙하에 적당한 힘을 넣어서 좌표 이동
	-- x축은 linear 이동
	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 1.5
		local height = 6
		local cur_angle = 0

		local start_pos = leader.Position
		local end_pos = start_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * 10

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
			local pos = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

			cur_angle = cur_angle + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
			leader.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, y)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	start_coroutine(function()
		local duration = 1.5
		local start_pos = leader.Position

		local end_pos = leader.Position - vector(-6, 0, 23)
		camera_util.move(
				vector_util.get_xy0(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(6, 0, 0),
						stage_camera.LookAtPosition.z - 18), duration)

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
			local pos = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			leader.Position = pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	character_util.set_active_state(desert_slave, 'disabled')
	flame_loop_effect:Dispose()

	self:start_money_shot_scene()
end

function local_class:reset_ice_wall()

		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.ice_info_list do
		local ice_info = self.ice_info_list[i]
		ice_info.is_active = false
		ice_info.wall.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError(time_passed)

	end
end

function local_class:control_money_shot_scene(jump_game_prefab, jump_game_animator, camera_pos)
	local qte_timescale = 0.02
	local qte_delay_duration = 0.05

	-- 캐릭터 설정
	local knight_position_transform = jump_game_prefab.transform:Find('character/position')
	local jump_game_knight_parent = jump_game_prefab.transform:Find('character/position/mesh')
	local unused_jump_game_knight = jump_game_prefab.transform:Find('character/position/mesh/knight_female_1')
	unused_jump_game_knight.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local jump_game_characters = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	local jump_game_knight = get_party_leader()
	jump_game_knight.Transform.parent = jump_game_knight_parent
	jump_game_knight.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero + vector(0, 0.2, 0)
	character_util.hide_weapon(jump_game_knight, true)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(jump_game_knight, false)
	character_util.set_direction(jump_game_knight, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(jump_game_knight, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(jump_game_knight, { name = 'damaged' })

	jump_game_characters:Add(jump_game_knight)

	local jump_game_desert_slave = self.get_desert_slave()
	local jump_game_teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
	local jump_game_tanker = self.get_tanker()
	local jump_game_innuit = self.get_innuit()

	jump_game_characters:Add(jump_game_desert_slave)
	jump_game_characters:Add(jump_game_teatan_hero)
	jump_game_characters:Add(jump_game_tanker)
	jump_game_characters:Add(jump_game_innuit)

	jump_game_teatan_hero.Transform.parent = self.teatan_parent

	local jump_game_android_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local jump_game_android = self.get_jump_game_android(i)
		jump_game_android_list:Add(jump_game_android)
		jump_game_characters:Add(jump_game_android)

		character_util.set_active_state(jump_game_android, 'enabled')
	end

	for i = 0, jump_game_characters.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_active_state(jump_game_characters[i], 'enabled')
		character_util.spine_scale(jump_game_characters[i], unity_class.vector3.one * 0.77, 0)
	end

	-- 캐릭터 Shader 변경
	if is_unity_null(self.shader_container) then
		self.shader_container = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
				'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/theatres/jumpgame', 'jumpgame_shader_container')

		local no_bend_shader = self.shader_container:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShaderContainer)).ShaderList[0]

		for i = 0, jump_game_characters.Count - 1 do
			jump_game_characters[i].SpineController.CustomShader = no_bend_shader
		end
	end

	if jump_game_animator ~= nil then
		local animation_name = 'jumpgame'
		jump_game_animator:Play(animation_name)
	end

	-- 추락
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_terror_02', state = 'event' })

	local delay_for_first_fallen = 2.93

	character_util.spine_rotate(jump_game_knight, 1440, delay_for_first_fallen)
	character_util.shake(jump_game_knight, 0.04, delay_for_first_fallen)

	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local time_passed = 0
	local radius = 2
	local start_pos = jump_game_knight.Position

	while time_passed < delay_for_first_fallen do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_radius = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				time_passed, radius, -radius, delay_for_first_fallen)

		local progress = (delay_for_first_fallen - time_passed) / delay_for_first_fallen
		local cur_x = math.sin(math.pi * progress * 4) * cur_radius
		local cur_y = math.cos(math.pi * (progress * 4)) * cur_radius

		jump_game_knight.Position = start_pos + vector(cur_x, cur_y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	jump_game_knight.Position = start_pos

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')

	self.get_fx_jumpgame_stomp():Instantiate(knight_position_transform.position)

	character_util.set_active_shadow(jump_game_knight, true)
	character_util.set_direction(jump_game_knight, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(jump_game_knight, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(jump_game_knight, { name = 'tired' })

	local delay_for_first_fallen_rotate = 0.45

	for i = 1, 3 do
		wait_for_sec(delay_for_first_fallen_rotate)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

		character_util.jump(jump_game_knight, 0.5, 0.3)
		if i == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(jump_game_knight, 'left')
			character_util.set_anim(jump_game_knight, { name = 'cast' })
		elseif i == 2 then
			character_util.set_direction(jump_game_knight, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(jump_game_knight, { name = 'damaged' })
		else
			character_util.set_direction(jump_game_knight, 'up')
			character_util.set_emotion(jump_game_knight, { name = 'attack' })
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(delay_for_first_fallen_rotate)

	-- 1차 QTE
	local qte_start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local qte_result = self:qte('up', qte_timescale, qte_delay_duration)

	local qte_cur_delay = unity_class.time.time - qte_start_time
	if qte_cur_delay < qte_delay_duration then
		wait_for_sec(qte_delay_duration - qte_cur_delay)
	end

	-- 점프 시간
	local duration_for_jump = 0.787

	if not qte_result then
		wait_for_sec(0.35)

		self:jump_game_game_over(jump_game_prefab, 'left', jump_game_characters)

		return
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

		character_util.set_active_shadow(jump_game_knight, false)
		character_util.jump(jump_game_knight, 1, duration_for_jump)
		character_util.set_anim(jump_game_knight, { name = 'get' })

function local_class:jump_game_game_over(jump_game_prefab, direction, jump_game_characters)
	local jump_game_animator = jump_game_prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	jump_game_animator.speed = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_02')

	local jump_game_knight = get_party_leader()

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(jump_game_knight)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(jump_game_knight)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.set_direction(jump_game_knight, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(
			jump_game_knight, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })

	local duration = 2
	local is_left = direction == 'left'
	local rotation_dir = is_left and -720 or 720
	character_util.spine_rotate(jump_game_knight, rotation_dir, duration)
	character_util.spine_scale(jump_game_knight, unity_class.vector3.one * 4, duration)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(jump_game_knight, false)

	local start_pos = jump_game_knight.Position
	local end_add_x = is_left and -10 or 10
	local end_pos = jump_game_knight.Position + vector(end_add_x, 10, -12)

	jump_game_knight.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 1000)

	start_coroutine(self.jump_game_camera_shake, self, jump_game_prefab, 0.3, duration / 3)

	local time_passed = 0
	local is_fade_start = false

	while time_passed < duration do
		if not is_fade_start and time_passed >= (duration * 0.5) then
			is_fade_start = true
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
			screen_util.fade_out(duration * 0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * end_pos.y

		jump_game_knight.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, y)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 캐릭터 리셋
	jump_game_knight.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)
	jump_game_knight.Transform.parent = self.teatan_parent
	jump_game_knight.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	for i = 0, jump_game_characters.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(jump_game_characters[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.remove_anim(jump_game_characters[i])
		character_util.remove_anim(jump_game_characters[i], true)
		character_util.remove_emotion(jump_game_characters[i])
	end

	if not is_unity_null(jump_game_prefab)  then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(jump_game_prefab)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	start_coroutine(self.start_money_shot_scene, self)
end

function local_class:camera_move(jump_game_prefab, end_pos, duration, interpolation)

	local start_pos = jump_game_camera.localPosition
	local cur_interpolation = interpolations_constants[interpolation]

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local cur_x = cur_interpolation(
				time_passed, start_pos.x, end_pos.x - start_pos.x, duration)
		local cur_y = cur_interpolation(
				time_passed, start_pos.y, end_pos.y - start_pos.y, duration)
		local cur_z = cur_interpolation(
				time_passed, start_pos.z, end_pos.z - start_pos.z, duration)

		jump_game_camera.localPosition = vector(cur_x, cur_y, cur_z)

	end

	jump_game_camera.localPosition = end_pos

function local_class:jump_game_camera_shake(jump_game_prefab, magnitude, duration)

	local camera_start_pos = jump_game_camera.localPosition

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local cur_x = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude / 2, magnitude / 2)
		local cur_z = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude / 2, magnitude / 2)

		jump_game_camera.localPosition = camera_start_pos + vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
