function local_class:move_object(target, end_pos, duration, interpolation)
	local target_transform = target.transform
	local start_pos = target_transform.localPosition
	local cur_interpolation = interpolations_constants[interpolation]

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local cur_x = cur_interpolation(
				time_passed, start_pos.x, end_pos.x - start_pos.x, duration)
		local cur_y = cur_interpolation(
				time_passed, start_pos.y, end_pos.y - start_pos.y, duration)
		local cur_z = cur_interpolation(
				time_passed, start_pos.z, end_pos.z - start_pos.z, duration)

		target_transform.localPosition = vector(cur_x, cur_y, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	target_transform.localPosition = end_pos
end

function local_class:z_sine_move(target, end_pos, height, duration)
	local start_pos = target.Position

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_z = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + lerp_pos.z
		local cur_pos = vector(lerp_pos.x, lerp_pos.y, cur_z)

		target.Position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	target.Position = end_pos

	self.move_finished = self.move_finished + 1
end

function local_class:android_shoot_missile(missile_shoot_list, duration, knight_position_transform)
	local delay = 0.3
	local delay_timer = 0
	local time_passed = 0
	local missile_duration = 0.5

	local shooter_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, missile_shoot_list.Count - 1 do
		shooter_list:Add(missile_shoot_list[i])
	end

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		delay_timer = delay_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if delay_timer >= delay then
			delay_timer = 0

			if shooter_list.Count == 0 then
				shooter_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
				for i = 1, missile_shoot_list.Count - 1 do
					shooter_list:Add(missile_shoot_list[i])
				end
			end

			local cur_shooter_index = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, shooter_list.Count))
			local cur_shooter = shooter_list[cur_shooter_index]

			if not is_unity_null(knight_position_transform) then
				start_coroutine(self.shoot_missile, self, cur_shooter,
						knight_position_transform.position, missile_duration, true)
			else
				break
			end

			shooter_list:Remove(cur_shooter)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_missile(shooter, end_pos, duration, use_harpy_sound)
	character_util.set_anim(shooter, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false })

	local shoot_pos = shooter.Position

	if shooter.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		shoot_pos = shoot_pos + vector(-1.6, 0.45, 0)
	elseif shooter.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		shoot_pos = shoot_pos + vector(1.6, 0.45, 0)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_missile_launch_02')

	self.get_fx_jumpgame_teatan_missile_fire():Instantiate(shoot_pos)

	local cur_missile = self.get_fx_jumpgame_teatan_missile():Instantiate(shoot_pos)

	-- 회전
	if shooter.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		cur_missile.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)
	end

	self:move_object(cur_missile, end_pos, duration, 'linear')

	if use_harpy_sound then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_explosion_02')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_explosion_03')
	end

	self.get_fx_jumpgame_teatan_missile_explosion():Instantiate(cur_missile.transform.localPosition)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	cur_missile:Dispose()
end
--endregion

	self.amb_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	-- object pool 로드
	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			'fx_queencastle_heavenhold_certify_floor_loop',
			'fx_queencastle_heavenhold_certify_floor_end',
			'fx_char_buff_blue')

	-- 자막 로드
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, self.typing_text_asset_bundle_name, self.typing_text_asset_name, function(prefab)
				self.typing_text_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab).gameObject
				self.typing_text = self.typing_text_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))

				self.typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 90, 1, 110)
				self.typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0
				self.typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()
				self.typing_text.Label.fontSize = 32
				self.typing_text.Label.color = unity_class.color.white
			end)

	self.typing_text_obj:SetActive(false)

	-- 이펙트 추가
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_3_futurecastle/effects/futurecastle', 'fx_event_princess_appear_blue', function(prefab)
				self.princess_appear_effect = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.princess_appear_effect:SetActive(false)
			end)
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent), 'on_tesla_coil_on_off_event')

	local monitor = self.get_monitor()
	monitor.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	monitor.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.5, 1, 1))

	self.get_desk().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	get_field_object('dummy_wall_3').Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	get_field_object('dummy_wall_6').Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self:dynamic_npc_setting()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.start_scene(self.start_event, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))

	if self.dynamic_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npcs)
		self.dynamic_npcs = nil
	end

	if self.princess_appear_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.princess_appear_effect)
		self.princess_appear_effect = nil
	end

	if self.typing_text_obj ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text_obj)
		self.typing_text_obj = nil
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.tint_key = nil
	self.tint_color = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_monitor()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			start_coroutine(self.talk_monitor, self)
		else
			start_coroutine(function()
				local leader = get_party_leader()
				local monitor = self.get_monitor()
				--모니터 말풍선 : 헤븐홀드 비상 복구 시스템 준비 완료.
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'qc_main_s6_15', false,
						{ world_pos = monitor.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0) })
			end)
		end

		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_desk()) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.dummy_head_3 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.talk_hero_ai
		sp_util.start_scene(self.request_hero_ai, self)
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('dummy_wall_3')) then
		self:dummy_routine(3)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('dummy_wall_6')) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.dummy_head_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.dummy_head_2
		self:dummy_routine(2)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	-- 가디언 인증 존
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(),'s6_activate_zone') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.activate_end
		sp_util.start_scene(self.authenticate_knight, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 안드로이드 더미 존
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's6_tint_zone') and
		self.current_section_state == self.section_state.activate_end then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.tint_zone
		start_coroutine(self.tint_zone_routine, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's6_worker_head_zone_1') and
				self.current_section_state == self.section_state.tint_zone then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.dummy_head_1
		self:dummy_routine(1)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's6_worker_head_zone_2') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.dummy_head_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.dummy_head_2
		self:dummy_routine(2)
		return true
	end

	if self.amb_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'capsule_tint_zone') then
		self.amb_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.amb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_facility_01', loop = true,
													type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'capsule_tint_zone') then
		self.amb_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.amb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_heavenhold_bunker_02', loop = true,
													type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
		return true
	end

	return false
end


function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.tint_zone_loop = false
	return true
end

function local_class:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, get_field_object('s6_magnet')) and e.IsTurningOn and
			self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.dummy_head_2 then

		-- GDTS-3643 특정 스탭 시 안드로이드 더미 머리와 상호작용 불가 현상 수정
		if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.dummy_head_2 then
			self:dummy_routine(2)
		end

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.dummy_head_3

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

			local tesla_coil = get_field_object('s6_tesla_coil')
			local magnet = get_field_object('s6_magnet')

			tesla_coil.Electrocutable.PowerRadius = 8
			camera_util.move_async(magnet.Position, 1)

			wait_for_sec(4)

			camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_desk(), true)
		end)

		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

	self.dynamic_npcs = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({

--- 최하층에서 깨어나는 가디언
function local_class:start_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('activate_pos')

	-- 가디언 세팅
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'prostrate')

	-- field 틴트 적용
	field:Tint(self.field_tint_key, self.field_tint_color, 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(3, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(2)

	scene_util.shake(leader, 0.025, 2)
	wait_for_sec(3)

	scene_util.shake(leader, 0.04, 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(leader, 'right')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--가디언 위 바라봄
	--1초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언 좌측 바라봄
	--1초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언 우측 바라봄
	--가디언 (left, idle, bomb_idle) ?이모티콘 2.5초
	--이모티콘 사라질 때까지 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	--스테이지 기본 입장 연출
	--퀘스트 마커는 맵 중앙의 케이든 AI 제단에 표시
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			leader.Direction, game_string:GetString(stage.Name)))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, marker_pos, true)
end

--- 가디언 인증 이벤트
function local_class:authenticate_knight()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('activate_pos')

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	wp_util.move_async(leader, marker_pos, nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'down' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--화면 중앙 위쪽(가디언 가리지 않도록) 말풍선 : NOW LOADING…
	self.typing_text_obj:SetActive(true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bunker_ui_01')
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_main_s6_2', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화면 shake (0.1, 2), 가디언 (down, idle, idle)
	--2초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bunker_ui_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--화면 shake (0.3, 0.3), 가디언 (down, surprise, embarrassed), 점프 (1, 0.5),
	--가디언 위치에 이펙트 fx_death_match_capture_zone_blue, fx_death_match_capture_zone_blue_score 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'embarrassed')
	character_util.jump(leader, 1, 0.5)
	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_amb_heavenhold_bunker_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'default' })
	local zone_effect = self.get_fx__certify_floor_loop():Instantiate(leader.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--가디언 (down, surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--화면 2초간 틴트 (0, 0, 0, 1), 카메라 2초간 가디언 위치보다 z값 1 높은 좌표로 이동
	field:Tint(self.field_tint_key .. 1,  unity_color({ 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1 }), 2)
	camera_util.move_async(marker_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 2)

	--아래 자막(typing_text) : 헤븐홀드 비상 복구 시스템에 접속합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_main_s6_3', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

	--가디언 (down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'idle')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--아래 자막 : 사용자의 이름을 입력하십시오.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_main_s6_4', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

	--선택지
	--(플레이어 이름)
	--캔터베리 가디언
	--주인공
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_main_s6_6', 'mercy' }, { 'qc_main_s6_7', 'intellect' }, { 'qc_main_s6_8', 'forced' } })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--아래 자막 : 사용자 인증을 진행합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_main_s6_8_0', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

	--아래 자막 : 당신은 미래의 용사가 맞습니까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_main_s6_8_1', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

	--선택지
	--로봇이 아닙니다. - mercy
	--…… - brutal
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'qc_main_s6_8_2', 'mercy' }, { 'qc_main_s6_8_3', 'brutal' } })

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 2초 간 z축 아래로 2칸 이동

	camera_util.move(marker_pos - vector(0, 0, 1), 2)

	--아래 자막 : 인간이 있는 타일을 모두 선택하세요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText(game_string:GetString('qc_main_s6_8_4'), 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

	--NPC 설정
	--전부 알파값 0
	--안(안드로이드) - worker_a (down, idle, idle)
	--로(로레인) - maiden_2
	--튜(튜링) - demon_android_small_turing
	--NPC 전부 1초 간 알파 0.7로 페이드 인
	local npcs = { self.dynamic_npcs['worker'], self.dynamic_npcs['maiden'], self.dynamic_npcs['demon_android'] }

	local npc_sort = function()
		for i = 1, 10 do
			local rand_x = random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)
			local rand_y = random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)
			local temp = npcs[rand_x]
			npcs[rand_x] = npcs[rand_y]
			npcs[rand_y] = temp
		end
	end

	local npc_out = function()
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npcs[1], 0, 1)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npcs[2], 0, 1)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npcs[3], 0, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.set_position(npcs[1], vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_position(npcs[2], vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_position(npcs[3], vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	local npc_appear = function()
		character_util.set_position(npcs[1], leader.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, -2))
		character_util.set_position(npcs[2], leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -2))
		character_util.set_position(npcs[3], leader.Position + vector(3.5, 0, -2))

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npcs[1], 0.7, 1)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npcs[2], 0.7, 1)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npcs[3], 0.7, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	local wait_time = 3

	while true do
		npc_appear()
		--선택지
		--1
		--2
		--3
		local choose_result = 0
		local wait_for_branch = true

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

		local talk_branch_1 = {
			Text = game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords('qc_main_s6_8_5'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
			end}

		branches:Add(talk_branch_1)

		local talk_branch_2 = {
			Text = game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords('qc_main_s6_8_6'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Forced,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
			end}

		branches:Add(talk_branch_2)

		local talk_branch_3 = {
			Text = game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords('qc_main_s6_8_7'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
			end}

		branches:Add(talk_branch_3)

		local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
		choice_state.Branchs = branches
		choice_state.Talker = leader
		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

		local time_passed = 0
		while wait_for_branch and wait_time > time_passed do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if wait_for_branch then
			if choice_state ~= nil then
				choice_state.CancelCallback = function() end
				CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance:OnClickCirtain()
			end

			-- ui scene pop overlay(0.25초 + alpha) 기다려줌
			wait_for_sec(1)

			choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
				{ 'qc_main_s6_8_8', 'brutal' },
			})
		end

		--1, 2, 3 선택 시
		if choose_result ~= 1 then
			wait_time = 2
			--1초 간 화면 틴트 (1, 0.5, 0.5, 1)
			--1초 대기
			field:Tint(self.field_tint_key .. 2,  unity_color({ 1, 0.3, 0.3, 1 }), 1)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)


			--아래 자막 : 인증 오류.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
			coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_main_s6_8_9', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

			--1초 간 화면 틴트 (0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1)
			field:RemoveTint(self.field_tint_key .. 2, 1)

			--NPC 전부 1초 동안 알파 페이드 아웃 (대기)
			npc_out()

			--아래 자막 : 재시도 - 인간이 있는 타일을 모두 선택하세요.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')

--- tint 밝아지는 루틴
function local_class:tint_zone_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local bottom = field_util.get_marker_pos('tint_bottom').z
	local top = field_util.get_marker_pos('tint_top').z
	local cur_z = bottom
	local start_tint = self.field_tint_color.r

	self.tint_zone_loop = true

	while self.tint_zone_loop do
		cur_z = math.max(leader.Position.z, cur_z)
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_tint, 1, (cur_z - bottom) / (top - bottom))
		field:Tint(self.field_tint_key, unity_color({ progress, progress, progress, 1 }), 0)

		if cur_z > top then
			field:RemoveTint(self.field_tint_key, 0)
			self.tint_zone_loop = false
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_3_futurecastle/effects/futurecastle', 'fx_event_princess_appear_blue', function(prefab)
				self.princess_appear_effect = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.princess_appear_effect:SetActive(false)
			end)

	quest_util.load_pool_resource('MagicCircle_AppearIdle', 'FX_reset_object', 'FX_hit')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	self.get_desk().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self:quest_check()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:quest_marker_active()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_hero_black(), self.controller)

	if self.fx_magic_circle ~= nil then
		self.fx_magic_circle:Dispose()
		self.fx_magic_circle = nil
	end

	if self.princess_appear_effect ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.princess_appear_effect)
		self.princess_appear_effect = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_desk()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_desk, self)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_hero_black()) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.talk_hero_ai
		sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_hero_ai, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's7_stage_end_zone') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.talk_hero_ai then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.stage_clear
		start_coroutine(self.stage_clear_routine, self)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'hero_ai_ready' then
		self:hero_ai_ready()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if e.CameraGrid.name == self.marker_grid_name then
		self:quest_marker_active()
		return true
	else
		self:quest_marker_remove()
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion
function local_class:interact_desk()
	local hero_ai = self.get_constant_hero_ai()
	local desk_pos = self.get_desk().Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	local hero_ai_pos = desk_pos + vector(0, 2, 0)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(hero_ai, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(desk_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_11')
	self.princess_appear_effect.transform.localPosition = hero_ai_pos
	self.princess_appear_effect:SetActive(true)

	character_util.set_position(hero_ai, hero_ai_pos)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(hero_ai, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--모든 시험을 통과하면 관리자 AI가 가동…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_main_s7_0')

	--케이든 AI 0.5초간 알파 페이드 아웃 -> 0.5초간 알파 페이드 인
	--0.5초 대기
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(hero_ai, 0, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--케이든 AI 0.3초간 알파 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_evolve_result_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(hero_ai, 0, 0.3)
	self.princess_appear_effect:SetActive(false)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_position(hero_ai, vector(999, 0, 999))
	--카메라 플레이어에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader()
end

function local_class:quest_check()
	local quest_clear_count = 0

	if get_field_object('power_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		quest_clear_count = quest_clear_count + 1
	end

	if get_field_object('wisdom_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		quest_clear_count = quest_clear_count + 1
	end

	if get_field_object('bravery_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		quest_clear_count = quest_clear_count + 1
	end

	if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_key) == 1 then
		self.fx_magic_circle = self.get_fx_magic_circle():Instantiate(
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_magic_circle_pos'))

		local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
		character_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'right')
		scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, 'idle')
		character_util.set_position(hero_ai, vector(-1.175, 0, 70.5))

		self.get_desk().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.talk_hero_ai
	elseif quest_clear_count == 3 then
		self:hero_ai_ready()
	end
end

function local_class:quest_marker_active()
	if not get_field_object('power_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 1,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('power_magic_circle_pos_1'), true)
	end

	if not get_field_object('wisdom_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 2,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('wisdom_magic_circle_pos_1'), true)
	end

	if not get_field_object('bravery_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 3,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_magic_circle_pos_1'), true)
	end
end

function local_class:quest_marker_remove()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 1)
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 2)
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 3)
end

function local_class:hero_ai_ready()
	local hero_black = self.get_hero_black()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local desk_pos = self.get_desk().Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	local hero_ai_pos = desk_pos - vector(0, 0, 2.5)

	character_util.set_direction(hero_black, 'up')
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_black, self, 'idle')
	character_util.set_anim(hero_black, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_position(hero_black, hero_ai_pos)
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_cleared(hero_black)
	hero_black.SpineController:AddColor(hero_black.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
	character_util.add_listener(hero_black, self.controller)

	self.get_desk().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	character_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up')
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, 'idle')
	character_util.set_anim(hero_ai, { name = 'idle' })
	hero_ai.SpineController:AddColor(hero_ai.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(hero_ai, 0, 0)
	hero_ai.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
end

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	camera_util.move(hero_ai.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 1)
	party_util.align_party(hero_ai, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--케이든 AI (right, smile, idle) : 준비되셨나요, 용사님?

	--가디언 (left, idle, nod x 2 -> idle)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1.5, 'linear')
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.main_s8_first_scene_finished_key, 1)
	end

	--검은 화면 2초 유지
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('default_start')
	character_util.set_position(leader, field_util.get_marker_pos(start_pos))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(2)

	--연출 끝난 후 스테이지 시작 연출
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	if key == 1 then
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	stage_launch_util.directional_stage_entry(leader.Position, leader.Direction, game_string:GetString(stage.Name), false, false)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	self.crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_ship_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_qc_energy_active')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_spotlight_police')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_qc_temple_lift_light')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_qc_wall_mural_scan')

	CS.MessyText.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	--스테이지에서 이미 생성되어있음.
	self.mural = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/QueenCastle/Common/MuralTheatreController')

	self.current_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.main_s9_mural_scene_finished_key)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.after_mural then
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec, true, self.get_gate_focus_pos())
	else
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_mural
	end

	if self.screen_play then
		if self.current_state < self.section_state.after_mural then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.mural_scene, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	CS.MessyText.DisposeAll()
	self.mural = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_elevator()) then
		if self.current_state == self.section_state.after_mural then
			self.current_state = self.section_state.interact_elevator
			sp_util.start_scene(self.elevator_scene, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--벽화 스캐닝 이벤트
function local_class:scan_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero = self.get_hero()
	--페이드 인 완료되고 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카이 up, 점프 2회
	character_util.normal_double_jump(hero, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero)
	camera_util.move_async(hero.Position, 0.5, { end_target = hero })

	--스캔 해야할 횟수 만큼 시행
	for i = 1, #self.scan_data do
		--이동
		local pos = self.scan_data[i].scan_pos
		local on = self.scan_data[i].on_target
		local off = self.scan_data[i].off_target

		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
		wp_util.move_async(hero, pos, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'up', run = true })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		dash_sfx:Stop()

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--스캔 연출
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bunker_ui_03')
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_qc_wall_mural_scan'):Instantiate(self.scan_data[i].target.Position)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		on.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		off.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		wait_for_sec(3)
	end

	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	wp_util.move_async(hero, self.get_mural_pos(2), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'down', run = true })
	dash_sfx:Stop()

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--모든 벽화가 채워진 상태가 아닐 시
	if not self.all_clear then
		--카이 (down, smile, 점프 1회): 확인한 벽화는 복사해뒀습니다, 용사님!
		scene_util.set_emotion(hero, self, 'smile')
		character_util.normal_jump(hero, true)
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero, 'qc_main_s9_pre_1')

		--카이 (down, smile, idle): 복원이 끝나면 어떤 내용이 적혀있었는지도 알 수 있을 겁니다.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero, 'qc_main_s9_pre_2')

		--기사 up, nod 2회
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')

		--기사 right, victory_get 하며 스테이지 명 출력, 컨트롤 풀림, 스캔 이후 벽화는 인터렉트하여 확인 가능.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero)
	end
	for i = 1, #self.scan_data do
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.scan_data[i].finished_key, 1)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleMarioController')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = QueenCastleMario @
		Comment = QueenCastleMario 퀘스트/이벤트 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_substage_mario'

	-- scene_util 버전
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	-- 스테이지 종료 플래그
	self.stage_ended = false

	self.android = {
		get = function(this, number)
			return get_character('caravan_android_' .. number)
		end,
		load_async = function(this)
			this.count = table_util.get_size(this.dict)
		end,
		count = 4,
		foreach = function(this, func)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				func(i, this:get(i))
			end
		end,
		set_idle = function(this)
			this:foreach(function(index, npc)
				if index == 1 or index == 2 then
					character_util.set_anim(npc, { name =  'twohand_idle'})
				else
					character_util.set_anim(npc, { name =  'idle'})
				end
			end)
		end,
		set_walk = function(this)
			this:foreach(function(index, npc)
				character_util.set_anim(npc, { name =  'twohand_walk'})
			end)
		end,
		get_offset = function(this, index)
			return this.offsets_from_caravan[index]
		end,
		offsets_from_caravan = {
			vector(-2, 0, 1),
			vector(-2, 0, 0),
			vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
			vector(0.5, 0, -0.5),
		}
	}
	self.caravan = {
		get = function(this)
			return get_character('caravan')
		end,
		move_async = function(this, distance, speed)
			local caravan = this:get()
			local move_key = 'caravan_group'
			local end_pos = vector(caravan.Position.x + distance, caravan.Position.y, caravan.Position.z)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(caravan, end_pos, speed, nil, this, move_key)

			self.android:set_walk()
			self.android:foreach(function(index, npc)
				end_pos = vector(npc.Position.x + distance, caravan.Position.y, npc.Position.z)
				wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, end_pos, speed, nil, this, move_key)
			end)
			wp_util.wait_move_end(this, move_key)
			self.android:set_idle()
		end,
		move = function(this, distance, speed, last_pos, last_dir)
			local caravan = this:get()
			local move_key = 'caravan_group'
			local end_pos = vector(caravan.Position.x + distance, caravan.Position.y, caravan.Position.z)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(caravan, end_pos, speed, nil, this, move_key)

			self.android:set_walk()
			self.android:foreach(function(index, npc)
				end_pos = vector(npc.Position.x + distance, caravan.Position.y, npc.Position.z)
				wp_util.move(npc, end_pos, speed, nil)
			end)

			start_coroutine(function()
				wp_util.wait_move_end(this, move_key)
				self.android:set_idle()
				if last_pos ~= nil then
					this:set_position_and_dir(last_pos, last_dir)
				end
			end)
		end,
		stop = function(this)
			local caravan = this:get()
			character_util.stop(caravan)
			self.android:foreach(function(index, npc)
				character_util.stop(npc)
			end)
		end,
		set_position_and_dir = function(this, position, dir)
			local caravan = this:get()
			character_util.set_position(caravan, position)
			if dir == 'left' then
				character_util.set_locked_dir(caravan, 'right')
			else
				character_util.set_locked_dir(caravan, 'left')
			end

			self.android:foreach(function(index, npc)
				local off_set = self.android:get_offset(index)
				if dir == 'left' then
					off_set.x = -off_set.x
				end
				local pos = position + off_set
				--안드로이드 1,2,4 right, idle, idle
				character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
				character_util.set_direction(npc, dir)
			end)
		end,
	}

	self.bean_bag = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self:dispose_bean_bag()

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

	return false

local local_class = newclass('MarioPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = Mario @
		Comment = Mario 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_1_6'

	self.unlock_stage_name = 'queencastle_substage_mario'

	-- 섹션 내 스테이트 Enum
	self.section_state = {
		before_appear_sisters = 1,
		before_scuffle = 2,
		before_talk_with_sisters = 3,
		talk_with_sisters = 4,
	}
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_appear_sisters

	self.get_knight = function()
		return get_party_leader()
	end

	self.get_hero_ai = function()
		return user_party[1]
	end

	self.get_maria = function()
		return get_character('maria')
	end

	self.get_lisa = function()
		return get_character('lisa')
	end

	local android_preset_name = 'mario_pre_dynamic_android_'

	self.android = {
		dict = nil,
		get = function(this, index)
			return this.dict[this.preset_name .. index]
		end,
		load_async = function(this)
			this.dict = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(this.specs)
			this.count = table_util.get_size(this.dict)
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.dict == nil then
				return
			end

			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.dict)

			this.dict = nil
			this.count = 0
		end,
		preset_name = android_preset_name,
		specs = {
			[android_preset_name .. 1] = 'qc_worker',
			[android_preset_name .. 2] = 'qc_worker',
			[android_preset_name .. 3] = 'qc_worker',
			[android_preset_name .. 4] = 'qc_worker',
		},
		count = 0,
		foreach = function(this, func)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				func(i, this:get(i))
			end
		end,
		get_offset = function(this, index)
			return this.offsets_from_caravan[index]
		end,
		offsets_from_caravan = {
			vector(-2, 0, 1),
			vector(-2, 0, 0),
			vector(0, 0, -1),
			vector(2, 0, 0),
		}
	}

	local caravan_name = 'mario_pre_dynamic_caravan'

	self.caravan = {
		dict = nil,
		get = function(this)
			return this.dict[this.name]
		end,
		load_async = function(this)
			this.dict = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(this.spec)
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.dict == nil then
				return
			end

			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.dict)

			this.dict = nil
		end,
		name = caravan_name,
		spec = {
			[caravan_name] = 'qc_caravan',
		},
	}

	self.door = {
		name = 'mario_door_',
		count = 2,
		open = function(this)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(this.name .. i, false))
			end
		end,
		close = function(this)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(this.name .. i, false))
			end
		end,
	}

	self.fx = {
		lasthit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.phone = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.android:load_async()
	self.caravan:load_async()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set()
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.phone ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.phone)
	end
	self.phone = nil

	self.android:dispose()
	self.caravan:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.android:dispose()
	self.caravan:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_appear_sisters and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'mario_pre_appear_sisters') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_scuffle

		sp_util.start_scene(self.appear_sister_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_scuffle and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'mario_pre_scuffle') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_talk_with_sisters

		sp_util.start_scene(self.scuffle_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_talk_with_sisters and
			(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_maria()) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_lisa())) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.talk_with_sisters

		sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_with_sisters_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:set()
	local caravan_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('mario_pre_appear_sisters_caravan')

	do
		local caravan = self.caravan:get()

		character_util.set_position(caravan, caravan_pos)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(caravan, 'left')
	end

	self.android:foreach(function(index, npc)
		local pos = caravan_pos + self.android:get_offset(index)

		--안드로이드 1,2,4 right, idle, idle
		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'right')
	end)

	local android = self.android:get(3)
	scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'bow_idle')
	self.phone = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{
				itemid = 20950,
				pos = android.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0.25),
				notforinven = true,
				skip_text = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				showoncharacter = true,
				sprscale = 0.4
			})
	self.phone.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 10)
	self.phone.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 10)
end

function local_class:appear_sister_scene()
	local caravan = self.caravan:get()
	local android_3 = self.android:get(3)
	local maria = self.get_maria()
	local lisa = self.get_lisa()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--초록색 트리거 존 진입시 강제 이벤트 발생.

	--가디언, 카이 down, idle, idle로 가로 정렬 +
	do
		local knight = self.get_knight()
		local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()

		local align_center = field_util.get_marker_pos('mario_pre_appear_sisters_party_center')
		local speed = 2

		wp_util.move(knight, align_center + vector(0.5, 0, 0), speed,
				nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
		wp_util.move(hero_ai, align_center + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), speed,
				nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
	end

	--카메라 캐러밴 있는 곳으로 포커싱.
	camera_util.move_async(caravan.Position, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	--안드로이드3 (right, idle, bow_idle) : 헤븐 홀드 내 미확인 운송 수단 발견.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_3, 'qc_mario_pre_1')

	--안도르이드3 (right, idle, bow_idle) : 이송하겠습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_3, 'qc_mario_pre_2')

	--대사 이후 안드로이드3 idle자세로 변경 + mall_phone 제거
	if self.phone ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.phone)
	end
	self.phone = nil
	character_util.remove_anim(android_3)

	local right_exit_x = field_util.get_marker_pos('mario_pre_appear_sisters_right_exit').x

	local wagon_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_wagon_loop_01', loop = true })
	--안드로이드 3,4는 walk / 안드로이드 1,2는 twohand_walk로 우측 그리드 밖으로 사라진다. (속도4)
	do
		local move_key = 'caravan_group'
		local speed = 4

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_push_wagon_01')

		self.android:foreach(function(index, npc)
			local end_pos = vector(right_exit_x + 1.5, 0, npc.Position.z)

			if index == 1 or index == 2 then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'twohand_walk')
			end

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, end_pos, speed, nil, self, move_key)
		end)

		do
			local end_pos = vector(right_exit_x + 3.5, 0, caravan.Position.z)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(caravan, end_pos, speed, nil, self, move_key)
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
		wagon_sfx:Stop()

		do
			local caravan_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('mario_pre_scuffle_caravan')

			character_util.set_position(caravan, caravan_pos)

			self.android:foreach(function(index, npc)
				local pos = caravan_pos + self.android:get_offset(index)

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
				character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
				character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
			end)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_02')
	--“물자를 잔뜩 들여놨으니 주민들이 좋아하겠지?”
	local sisters_appear_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('mario_pre_appear_sisters_sisters_appear_center')
	local sisters_target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('mario_pre_appear_sisters_sisters_align_center')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(lisa, 'qc_mario_pre_3', nil, {
		world_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', sisters_appear_pos, 0) + vector(-2, 0, 0), type_speed = 0
	})

	--말풍선 출력 종료 후 카메라 ‘하늘색 네모’ 1번으로 1초만에 이동하여
	local sisters_move_key = 'sisters'
	local maria_offset = vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	local lisa_offset = vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	do
		--마리아, 리사 가운데로 포커싱.
		local speed = 4

		local focus_dur = 1
		local focus_start_pos = sisters_appear_pos + focus_dur * speed * unity_class.vector3.forward

		--마리아, 리사 up, idle, walk(속도4)로 하늘색 네모 2번까지 걸어간다.

		character_util.set_position(maria, sisters_appear_pos + maria_offset)
		character_util.set_position(lisa, sisters_appear_pos + lisa_offset)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(maria, sisters_target_pos + maria_offset, speed, nil,
				self, sisters_move_key, { run = true, end_callback = function()
					character_util.set_direction(maria, 'right')
					scene_util.set_emotion(maria, self, 'smile')
				end })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(lisa, sisters_target_pos + lisa_offset, speed, nil,
				self, sisters_move_key, { run = true, end_callback = function()
					character_util.set_direction(lisa, 'right')
					scene_util.set_emotion(lisa, self, 'smile')
				end })

		camera_util.move_async(focus_start_pos, focus_dur)

		local additional_move_dur = (sisters_target_pos - focus_start_pos).magnitude / speed

		camera_util.move(sisters_target_pos, additional_move_dur)
	end

	--마리아 (up, idle, walk) : (걸어가면서 대사) 그러게. 분명 기뻐할…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(maria, { key = 'qc_mario_pre_4', type_speed = 0 })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, sisters_move_key)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(maria)
	--하늘색 네모 2번에서 둘 다 right, smile, idle 상태에서
	--0.3초 후
	--right, surprise, jump1회
	do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maria)
		scene_util.set_emotion(maria, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.normal_jump(maria, true)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lisa)
		scene_util.set_emotion(lisa, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.normal_jump(lisa)

		wait_for_sec(0.8)
	end

	--마리아, 리사 right, surprise, run(속도9)로 우측으로 달려가 붉은원, 초록원 위치에 right, surprise, idle로 정렬한다.
	do
		local move_key = 'sisters_run'
		local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('mario_pre_appear_sisters_sisters_run_center')
		local speed = 7

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(maria, center_pos + maria_offset, speed, nil, self, move_key)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(lisa, center_pos + lisa_offset, speed, nil, self, move_key)

		do
			local duration = (sisters_target_pos - center_pos).magnitude / speed

			camera_util.move_async(center_pos, duration)
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	do
		local delay = 0.6

		--0.3초 후 마리아 left, surprise, idle / 리사 down, surprise, idle
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(maria, 'left')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(lisa, 'down')
		wait_for_sec(delay)

		--0.3초 후 마리아 down, surprise, idle / 리사 up, surprise, idle
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(maria, 'down')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(lisa, 'up')
		wait_for_sec(delay)

		--0.3초 후 마리아 right, surprise, idle / 리사 left, surprise, idle
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(maria, 'right')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(lisa, 'left')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	--마리아 (right, surprise, idle) : 캐러밴이 어디로 갔지?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maria, 'qc_mario_pre_5')

	--마리아 (right, surprise, release) : 분명 여기다가 주차해 뒀는데…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, 'right',
			'release', nil, 'qc_mario_pre_6')

	--리사 (left, surprise, cast) : 잠깐 출장 갔다 온 사이에 이게 무슨 일이야?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lisa, self, 'left',
			'cast', nil, 'qc_mario_pre_7')

	--마리아 right, scared, idle + emoticon_bubble_exclamation
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maria)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(maria, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'scared', keep = true }, 'notice')

	--마리아 (right, scared, shake 0.03 1회 후 idle) : 요즘 안드로이드 순찰이 강화됐다 들었는데 설마….
	--위 대사와 동시에 리사도 left, scared, idle
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lisa)
	scene_util.set_emotion(lisa, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.shake(maria, 0.03, 0.3)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(maria, 'qc_mario_pre_8')

	--마리아, 리사 right, scared, idle
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(maria, 'right')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(lisa, 'right')

	--0.5초 후 아래의 대사.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--마리아&리사 우측 방향으로 안드로이드들을 뒤쫓아 사라진다.
	do
		local move_key = 'sisters_run'
		local speed = 6

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maria)
		scene_util.set_emotion(maria, self, 'cry')
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(maria, vector(right_exit_x + 1.5, 0, maria.Position.z), speed,
				nil, self, move_key, { run = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lisa)
		scene_util.set_emotion(lisa, self, 'cry')
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(lisa, vector(right_exit_x + 1.5, 0, lisa.Position.z), speed,
				nil, self, move_key, { run = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		--마리아, 리사 (right, cry, run속도9) : [shout] 안 돼!!!!!!
		--FIXME : 말풍선 꼬리 없애야될 것 같지만 일단 리사한테 고정시키고 왼쪽 방향으로 바꿈
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(lisa, 'qc_mario_pre_9', nil, {
			bubble_direction = 'lt', type_speed = 0
		})

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

		do
			local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('mario_pre_scuffle_sisters_center')

			--붉은 원 : 마리아
			--right, tired, cast
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maria)
			character_util.set_position(maria, center_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5))
			character_util.set_direction(maria, 'right')

	--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3초

	scene_util.set_anim(android_1, self, { name = 'carpenter_hammer', count = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(lisa.Position + vector(0.2, 0.1, 0))
	self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(lisa.Position + vector(0.2, 0.1, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(lisa)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(lisa)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(lisa, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(lisa, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_emotion(lisa, self, 'damaged')
	character_util.jump(lisa, 0.3, 0.3)

	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.shake(lisa, 0.03, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.6)
		character_util.shake(lisa, 0.03, 0.3)
	end)

	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(lisa)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(lisa)

	scene_util.set_emotion(maria, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(maria)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, nil, nil, 'mad', 'qc_mario_pre_21')

	scene_util.set_emotion(maria, self, 'attack')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(maria, { key = 'qc_mario_pre_23', bubble_type = 'shout', type_speed = 0 })

	do
		scene_util.set_anim(maria, self, 'gauntlet_run')

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		scene_util.set_anim(android_2, self, { name = 'gauntlet_kick2', count = 1 })
		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	--마리아 대사하면서 우측으로 1타일 달려가다가(대사 끊기면서) 안드로이드2의 gauntle_kick2에 피격
	--위와 동시에 아래 연출 동시 진행
	--fx_hit, fx_lashit
	--카메라 shake 0.1, 0.3초
	--마리아 right, damaged, damaged로 피격(red squish)되며 2타일 좌측으로 날아가 right, damaged, prostrate로 쓰러짐
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(maria)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(maria.Position + vector(0.2, 0.1, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(maria)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(maria)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(maria, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(maria, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_emotion(maria, self, 'damaged')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(maria, self, 'prostrate')
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(maria)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(maria)
	character_util.set_direction(maria, maria.LockedDirection)
	character_util.reset_locked_dir(maria)

	character_util.shake(lisa, 0.03, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	character_util.shake(lisa, 0.03, 0.3)

	--안드로이드2 (left, idle, idle) : 그렇게 이걸 되돌려 받고 싶으면 마스터와 대화 후 정식 절차를 밟으십시오.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_2, self, nil, nil, nil, 'qc_mario_pre_24')
	-- 안드로이드2 (right, idle, bomb_idle) : 허가해 줄 가능성은 없겠지만.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_2, self, 'right', 'bomb_idle', nil, 'qc_mario_pre_24_1')

	--안드로이드들 캐러밴과 함께 우측 방향으로 걸어가(속도6) 사라진다.
	--(캐러밴&안드로이드3,4는 walk모션 / 안드로이드 1,2는 twohand_walk 모션)
	--도어는 안드로이드 지나갈 때 내려갔다가 다시 올라오도록
	do
		local move_key = 'caravan_group'
		local speed = 2
		local right_exit_x = 11

		self.door:open()

		local wagon_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_wagon_loop_01', loop = true })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_push_wagon_01')
		self.android:foreach(function(index, npc)
			local end_pos = vector(npc.Position.x + right_exit_x, 0, npc.Position.z)

			if index == 1 or index == 2 then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'twohand_walk')
			end

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, end_pos, speed, nil, self, move_key)
		end)

		do
			local end_pos = vector(caravan.Position.x + right_exit_x, 0, caravan.Position.z)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(caravan, end_pos, speed, nil, self, move_key)
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
		wagon_sfx:Stop()
		self.door:close()
	end
	--카메라 돌아오고 컨트롤 풀림.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.set_active_state(caravan, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(caravan, 'disabled')
	self.android:foreach(function(index, npc)
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
	end)

	quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(maria)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	character_util.add_listener(maria, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(lisa, self.controller)
end

function local_class:talk_with_sisters_scene()
	local maria = self.get_maria()
	local lisa = self.get_lisa()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local align_pos = maria.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)

	quest_icon_util.remove(maria)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(maria, self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(lisa, self.controller)

	--가디언&카이 마리아, 리사 좌측 중앙에 정렬한후 right, idle, eat 2.5초
	--가디언이 eat모션 시작하고 1초가 지난 후 마리아, 리사 2번 shake후 right, tired, mario jump로 일어남.
	--이후 마리아,리사 left, tried, idle -> 0.3초 후 left, surprise, jump1회 + emoticon_bubble_exclatmaion
	party_util.align_party(align_pos, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.shake_and_wakeup(maria, 'right', 2, nil, true)
			scene_util.set_emotion(maria, self, 'tired')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.shake_and_wakeup(lisa, 'right', 2, nil, true)
			scene_util.set_emotion(lisa, self, 'tired')
		end)
	})
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	scene_util.set_direction(maria, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction(lisa, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(lisa)
	character_util.normal_jump(maria)
	scene_util.set_emotion(lisa, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(maria, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(maria)
	character_util.show_emoticon(lisa, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(maria, nil, 'notice')

	--리사 (left, surprise, release) : 혀, 형씨는 우리 캐러밴 단골 고객이잖아?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lisa, self, nil, 'release', nil, 'qc_mario_pre_25')
	--마리아 (left, surprise, release) : 한동안 소식이 뜸하더니 여기서 만날 줄이야….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, nil, 'release', nil, 'qc_mario_pre_26')

	--선택지 발생
	--[초록색] 상황은 다 지켜봤다
	--[붉은색] 너희도 공주 구하러 왔어?
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_mario_pre_27', 'mercy' },
		{ 'qc_mario_pre_28', 'brutal' },
	})

	if result == 1 then
		--가디언 right, tired, nod
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

		scene_util.set_emotion(maria, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_emotion(lisa, self, 'tired')
		--마리아 (left, tired, cross_arm) : 잠시 화장실 다녀 온 사이에 그만….
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, nil, 'cross_arm', nil, 'qc_mario_pre_29')
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	else
		--가디언 right, idle, bomb_idle
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(maria, self, 'tired')
		--리사 (left, tried, question) : 공주…? 그게 무슨 뜬금없는 소리야?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lisa, self, nil, 'question', 'tired', 'qc_mario_pre_30')
	end

	--마리아 (left, tired, idle) : 가디언 님도 아시다시피 지금 부유성은 완전히 변해버렸어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, nil, nil, nil, 'qc_mario_pre_31')
	--마리아 (up, idle, idle) : 리사와 저, 그리고 주민들은 살아갈 방법을 모색해야 했고…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, 'up', nil, nil, 'qc_mario_pre_32')
	--마리아 (left, tried, release) : 저희는 몰래 물자를 입수해 주민들을 돕기 시작했죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, 'left', 'release', nil, 'qc_mario_pre_33')

	character_util.remove_emotion(lisa)
	--리사 (left, idle, nod) : 맞아, 우리도 목숨 걸고 물건을 구해오고 있다고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lisa, self, nil, { name = 'nod', count = 1 }, nil, 'qc_mario_pre_34')
	--마리아 (left, tired, idle) : 하지만… 캐러밴을 뺏긴 것도 모자라 어디로 갔는지조차 모르게 되었으니….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, nil, nil, nil, 'qc_mario_pre_35')
	--리사 (down, doygao, bomb_idle) : …언니, 정말 그렇게 생각해?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lisa, self, 'down', 'bomb_idle', { name = 'doyagao', keep = true }, 'qc_mario_pre_36')

	--가디언 right, idle, idle + emoticon_bubble_question & 마리아 up, idle, idle + emoticon_bubble_question
	character_util.remove_emotion(maria)
	scene_util.set_direction(maria, 'up')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(maria, nil, 'question')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	--리사 (down, doyagao, bow_idle + 손에 electronic_termina 들려 있음.) : 짠!
	scene_util.set_direction(lisa, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(lisa, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(lisa, '[base]weapon1', 'electronic_terminal')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lisa, self, nil, nil, nil, 'qc_mario_pre_37')

	character_util.normal_jump(maria)

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleMarioSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenCastleMario @
		Comment = QueenCastleMario 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_substage_mario'

	self.flower_key = 'fire_flower_1'

	self.section_state = {
		before_awake_sleep_android = 1,
		crash_sleep_android = 2,
		before_enter_appear_caravan = 3,
		entered_appear_caravan = 4,
	}
	self.current_state = self.section_state.before_awake_sleep_android

	--npc
	self.get_lisa = function()
		return get_character('lisa')
	end

	self.get_maria = function()
		return get_character('maria')
	end

	self.get_caravan_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_caravan_appear_pos')
	end

	self.fx = {
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.flower_key = 'fire_flower_1'

	-- 그리드 진입 시 찍힐 퀘스트 마커 정보
	self.target_type = { character = 1, ifo = 2, marker = 3 }
	self.grid_table = {
		{ grid = 'ghost_puzzle_grid_1', type = self.target_type.ifo, key = 'ghost_puzzle_outer_1' },
		{ grid = 'ghost_puzzle_grid_3', type = self.target_type.ifo, key = 'ghost_puzzle_outer_2' },
		{ grid = 'ghost_grid', type = self.target_type.marker, key = 's2_caravan_appear_pos' }
	}

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	self.controller.caravan:stop()
	self.controller.caravan:set_position_and_dir(vector(999, 0, 999), 'left')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_sleep_android_zone') and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.before_awake_sleep_android then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.crash_sleep_android
		start_coroutine(self.awake_android, self)
		return true
	end
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_caravan_appear') and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.before_enter_appear_caravan then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.entered_appear_caravan
		sp_util.start_scene(self.entered_appear_caravan_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	self:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	for i = 1, #self.grid_table do
		local g = self.grid_table[i]
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, g.grid) then
			local target = nil
			if g.type == self.target_type.character then
				target = get_character(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.available_stage_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.ifo then
				target = get_field_object(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.available_stage_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.marker then
				target = field:GetMarker(g.key).position
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.available_stage_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.cb then
				start_coroutine(g.key, self)
			end
			return
		end
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:pre_setting()
	self.fx:load_all()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('s2_door_flower', false))

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	local flower_fo = get_field_object(self.flower_key)
	flower_fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	self.controller:set_bean_bag_and_android()

	self.controller.mario_gimmick:override_interact(self.interact_fire_flower, self)
	self.controller.caravan:set_position_and_dir(self.get_caravan_pos(), 'left')

	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.available_stage_name, field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_caravan_appear_pos'), true)
end

function local_class:awake_android()
	local android = get_character('s2_android_1')

	character_util.set_direction(android, 'left')
	character_util.remove_emotion(android)
	scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'release')

	local speech_cycle = 8
	local time_passed = speech_cycle

	-- 데미지 입을 수 있도록 추가
	self.controller.mario_gimmick:add_custom_npc('s2_android_1', 1)
	-- airspin 상태거나 죽은 상태면 취소
	while not self.controller.stage_ended and not
	lua_helper.type_compare(android.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed > speech_cycle then
			time_passed = 0
			-- 지, 지진입니까?!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(android, { key = 'qc_mario_s2_1' })
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local flower_fo = get_field_object(self.flower_key)
	flower_fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	self.fx:dead():Instantiate(field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_sleep_android_pos'))
	self.controller:dispose_bean_bag()

	-- 자연재해라니!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(android, { key = 'qc_mario_s2_2', type_speed = 0 })
end

function local_class:interact_fire_flower(gimmick, item_key)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local maria = self.get_maria()
	local lisa = self.get_lisa()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	if item_key ~= self.flower_key then
		return true
	end

	local gimmick_key = gimmick:get_key()

	local flower = get_field_object(self.flower_key)
	party_util.align_party(flower.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	gimmick:consume_item(item_key)

	--itemgetevent
	local spec_name = 'qc_fire_flower'
	--	--타이틀 : 앗뜨거 플라워
	local title = 'qc_fire_flower_title'
	-- 서브타이틀 : 배관공 집안의 2번째 비기!
	local sub_title = 'qc_fire_flower_sub_title'
	-- 왠지 무언가 발사할 수 있을 것 같습니다.
	local title_desc = 'qc_fire_flower_desc'

	-- 아이템 획득 연출
	screen_util.item_get_event(spec_name, title, sub_title, title_desc)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	gimmick:from_mushroom_scene()

	self.controller.mario_gimmick:change_action(gimmick_key)

	-- 오버라이드 해놓은 이벤트 취소
	self.controller.mario_gimmick:cancel_override_interact()

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'notice')

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	-- 마리아 (right, smile, clap) : 가디언 님, 이젠 마치 기다렸다는 듯이 드셔버리는군요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, nil, 'clap', 'smile', 'qc_mario_s2_3')
	-- 가디언 left, smile, nod2
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	-- 가디언 left ,attack, cast2 -> 0.5초 후 right, attack, jingak 2회 ->  left, attack, victory_get
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast2')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'jingak', count = 2, sfx_name = '01_jingak_01' })

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', count = 1 })
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	-- 리사 (right, smile, release) : 형씨, 용암같이 뜨거운 기운이 느껴져?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lisa, self, nil, 'release', 'smile', 'qc_mario_s2_4')

	character_util.normal_double_jump(lisa, true)
	-- 리사 (right, attack, jump2회) : 자, 그럼 한번 가보자고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lisa, self, nil, nil, 'attack', 'qc_mario_s2_5')

	self.current_state = self.section_state.before_enter_appear_caravan

	self.controller.mario_gimmick:set_stage_music()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	return false
end

function local_class:entered_appear_caravan_scene()
	local caravan_pos = self.get_caravan_pos()
	local caravan = self.controller.caravan:get()
	local maria = self.get_maria()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field',0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(caravan_pos, 1)

	local speed = 4
	local left_exit_x = -8
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_push_wagon_01')
	local wagon_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_wagon_loop_01', loop = true })

	self.controller.caravan:move(left_exit_x, speed, vector(999, 0, 999), 'left')

	wait_for_sec(2)

	wagon_sfx:Stop()
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.normal_jump(maria, true)
	-- 마리아 (left, tired, jump1회) : 우리 캐러밴이…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, 'left', nil, 'tired', 'qc_mario_s2_6')

	-- 마리아 (left, attack, release) : 도대체 어디로 가져가려는 거야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, nil, 'release', 'attack', 'qc_mario_s2_7')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field',1)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

return local_class

	for i = 1, #self.crash_android_zone do

function local_class:pre_setting()

	self.door_2_pos = get_field_object('rum_door_2').Position

function local_class:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	for i = 1, #self.grid_table do
		local g = self.grid_table[i]
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, g.grid) then
			local target = nil
			if g.type == self.target_type.character then
				target = get_character(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.available_stage_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.ifo then
				target = get_field_object(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.available_stage_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.marker then
				target = field:GetMarker(g.key).position
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.available_stage_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.cb then
				start_coroutine(g.key, self)
			end
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:crash_android_event_3()

	local android_2 = self.get_crash_android(6)

	-- 윤활유 도시락 챙겨 왔습니까?
	start_coroutine(self.bubble_routine, self, android_1, 'qc_mario_s3_15')
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local duration = 4
	while not self.controller.stage_ended and unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.controller.stage_ended then
		return

function local_class:bubble_routine(npc, key, dead_key)
	local speech_cycle = 8
	local time_passed = speech_cycle

	-- airspin 상태거나 죽은 상태면 취소
	while not self.controller.stage_ended and not
			lua_helper.type_compare(npc.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState) do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed > speech_cycle then
			time_passed = 0
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc, { key = key })
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if dead_key ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc, { key = dead_key, type_speed = 0 })
	end
end

-- 추격 이벤트 시작
function local_class:start_chasing_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)
	local ghost = self.get_chasing_ghost_table()
	local ghost_rand_appear = { 1, 4, 6, 2, 7, 5, 8, 3 }

	self:change_to_opened_door()

	for i = 1, #ghost do
		ghost[i].SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(ghost[i], 0, 0)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	for i = 1, #ghost do
		if i == 1 and self.ghost_sfx == nil then
			self.ghost_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_arcade_ghost_01', loop = true, parent = ghost[i]})
		end

		character_util.set_position(ghost[i], self.get_chasing_ghost_pos(i))
	end

	character_util.align_party(field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_chasing_start_align'), 'down', 0.5, 'arc')
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
	end

	for i = 1, #ghost do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(ghost[ghost_rand_appear[i]], 1, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		ghost[ghost_rand_appear[i]].SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party[i], 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'scared' })
		if i == 1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		end
		wp_util.move(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 1)
	end
	for i = 1, #ghost do
		character_util.set_anim(ghost[i], { name = 'scream' })
		character_util.set_emotion(ghost[i], { name = 'scream' })
		wp_util.move(ghost[i], ghost[i].Position + vector(0, 0 , 0.5), nil, 1)
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.reset_locked_dir(user_party[i])
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	self:reset_chasing_acting()
	start_coroutine(self.ghost_chasing_routine, self)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

-- 유령 쫒아오는 루틴
function local_class:ghost_chasing_routine()
	local ghost = self.get_chasing_ghost_table()
	local speed = 2
	local end_x_pos = 71
	local damage_distance = 0.5
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	while self.current_state == self.section_state.play_chasing_acting do
		if self.controller.mario_gimmick:check_dead() then
			while not self.controller.mario_gimmick:ended_dead_fade() do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			for i = 1, #ghost do
				ghost[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ghost[i])
			end
			self.playing_chasing_acting = false
			self:change_to_closed_door()
			return
		end

		if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.play_chasing_acting or ghost[1].Position.z > end_x_pos then
			return
		end

		for i = 1, #ghost do
			local ghost_pos = ghost[i].Position + vector(0, 0, unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed)
			character_util.set_position(ghost[i], ghost_pos)
		end
		if ghost[1].Position.z + damage_distance > get_party_leader().Position.z then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
			damage_info.sender = ghost[1]
			damage_info.target = leader
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP) * 2
			damage_info.notMortal = true
			damage_info.noCritical = true

			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
		end

		if ghost[1].Position.z > end_x_pos then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:reset_chasing_acting()
	self.chasing_event_1 = false

							'right', 'left', 'right', 'left', 'right', 'down'
						}

						}
	for i = 1, self.android_count do

		local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(android)

		state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
		message_system:SendSync(android.FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)

		character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(android, self.get_android_pos(i))
		character_util.set_direction(android, android_dir[i])
		character_util.set_anim(android, { name = android_anim[i] })
		character_util.spine_scale(android, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
		character_util.spine_rotate(android, 0, 0)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)

		self.controller.mario_gimmick:add_custom_npc(android.Name, 1)

	-- 화로 꺼놓기

	for i = 1, brazier_num do

	end

	-- 문 닫아놓기
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('run_middoor_1'))

	local rock_count = 3
	for i = 1, rock_count do
		local rock = get_field_object('run_rock_' .. i)
		rock.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		rock.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:Heal(10000, false)
	end

	self.controller:set_s4_jump_androids()
end

function local_class:clear_chasing_acting_scene()
	if self.ghost_sfx ~= nil then
		self.ghost_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	end
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local maria = self.get_maria()
	local lisa = self.get_lisa()
	local leader_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_start')
	local maria_align_pos = leader_align_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1)
	local lisa_align_pos = leader_align_pos + vector(1, 0, -1)

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_emotion(maria, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_emotion(lisa, { name = 'attack' })
	wp_util.move(leader, leader_align_pos, nil, 1, { run = true, last_direction = 'down'})
	wp_util.move(maria, maria_align_pos, nil, 1, { run = true, last_direction = 'right'})
	wp_util.move(lisa, lisa_align_pos, nil, 1, { run = true, last_direction = 'left'})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 선택지 발생
	-- [초록색] 따돌렸나?
	-- [붉은색] 네 뒤에 유령!
	local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'qc_mario_s3_3', 'mercy' }, { 'qc_mario_s3_4', 'brutal' } })

	if choose == 1 then
		-- 가디언 down, attack, release
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'release')
		scene_util.set_direction(maria, 'down')
		scene_util.set_direction(lisa, 'down')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		-- 마리아, 리사 down, idle, idle
		-- 리사 (down, idle, nod) : 응, 그런 것 같아!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lisa, self, nil, 'nod', nil, 'qc_mario_s3_5')
	elseif choose == 2 then
		-- 가디언 down, scared, cast2
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast2')
		scene_util.set_direction(maria, 'down')
		scene_util.set_direction(lisa, 'down')

		scene_util.set_emotion(maria, self, 'scared')
		scene_util.set_emotion(lisa, self, 'scared')

		-- 마리아, 리사 down, scared, jump1회
		character_util.normal_jump(maria, true)
		character_util.normal_jump(lisa, true)
		wait_for_sec(1)
