		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, nil, 'nod', nil, 'qc_mario_s3_6')
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maria)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lisa)

	-- 공통 연출
	-- 가디언, 마리아, 리사 down, idle, idle
	-- 마리아 (down, idle, question) : 다행히 무사히 도망친 것 같네요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maria, self, nil, 'question', nil, 'qc_mario_s3_7')

	-- 리사 left, idle, bow_idle + 손에 electronic_termina + emotionc_bubble_silience
	scene_util.set_direction(maria, 'right')
	scene_util.set_direction(lisa, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(lisa, self, 'bow_idle')
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(lisa, '[base]weapon1', 'electronic_terminal')

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(lisa, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(lisa, '[base]weapon1')
	-- 리사 (left, attack, release) : 조금만 더 힘내서 가보자!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lisa, self, nil, 'release', 'attack', 'qc_mario_s3_8')
	-- 리사 (left, attack, nod) : 신호를 보니 캐러밴은 분명히 근처에 있어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lisa, self, nil, 'nod', 'attack', 'qc_mario_s3_9')

	-- 파티 회복
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = member
		heal_info.target = member
		heal_info.heal = member.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	end

	-- 안드로이드 비활성화
	for i = 1, self.android_count do
		local android = self.get_android(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(android, 'disabled')
	end

	-- 폭탄꽃 치워두기
	local bomb = get_field_object('run_bomb_grass')
	local obj_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(bomb.Position, 0.5)
	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = obj_list[i]
		if fo.Name == '[GIMMICK]bomb_grass1' then
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end

	local ghost = self.get_chasing_ghost_table()
	for i = 1, #ghost do
		character_util.set_active_state(ghost[i], 'disabled')
	end

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

local local_class = newclass('RanpangControllerController')

--[[QuestAttribute

		QuestName = RanpangController @

	self.exit_event_zone = 'ranpang_s1_exit_zone'

	end
	self.get_marker_hero_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('ranpang_s1_hero_ai_pos_1')
	end

	end

	-- 선물박스 침대 삭제 용

	--endregion
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.gift_box_list ~= nil then
		for idx = 1, #self.gift_box_list do
			drop_item_util.cancel_shake(self.gift_box_list[idx])
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.gift_box_list[idx])
		end
		self.gift_box_list = nil
	end

		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = nil
	self.starting_grade = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	for i = 1, #self.android_belt_music_list do
		if self.android_belt_music_list[i] ~= nil then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.android_belt_music_list[i])
			self.android_belt_music_list[i] = nil
		end
	end

end

end

end

end

end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		start_coroutine(function(_)
			if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete
					and self:check_ranpang_interact() then
				quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.ranpang_interact_key, 1)
			end
		end,self)
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.exit_event_zone)
			and (self:check_ranpang_interact())
			and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.exit_ranpang_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:exit_ranpang_event()
	--빨간존으로 나가려고 하면 존 이벤트
	--란팡(tired표정): 부단장? 급한일이 생긴 건가?
	local ranpang = get_character('ranpang')
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self,'tried')
	scene_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'left', false)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_30')
	--란팡(smile)(jump 1회) : 좋아! 급한일 부터 처리하고 오라고!
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(ranpang, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_31')
	--안드로이드들 다시 합류 란팡은 다시 말뚝앞으로 (run)이동 란팡 원래 자리로 돌아가면 컨트롤 복귀
	character_util.convert_to_npc(ranpang)
	local return_waypoints = { vector(ranpang.Position.x, 1,field_util.get_marker_pos('ranpang_s1_ranpang_pos_1').z),
							   field_util.get_marker_pos('ranpang_s1_ranpang_pos_1')}

	local ranpang_dash_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01'
	, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default', parent = ranpang})
	wp_util.move_async(ranpang, return_waypoints,
			7, nil, {run = true})
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(ranpang_dash_sound)

	character_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self,'idle')
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'idle')
	character_util.add_listener(ranpang, self)

	self:start_follow_android()
	--이 후 란팡을 재 인터랙트해야지 서브 이벤트 진행
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_key)
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.ranpang_interact_key, 1)
end
--endregion

--region custom
-- 커스텀 스테이트로 란팡 상호작용 이벤트를 진행했는지 확인한다.
function local_class:check_ranpang_interact()
	return (quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.ranpang_interact_key) == 0)
end
--endregion

-- 안드로이드 제자리 대기 명령 함수
function local_class:start_waiting_android()
	local androids = {}
	for i = 2, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local android = user_party[i]
		table.insert(androids, android)
	end
	for i = 1, #androids do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(androids[i])
	end
	self.leader_followed_android = androids
end
function local_class:start_follow_android()
	local androids = self.leader_followed_android
	for i = 1, #androids do
		local android = androids[i]
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(android, user_party, false)
	end
	self.leader_followed_android = {}
end

function local_class:align_setting()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero = get_character('hero_ai')
	local android_align_key = 'ranpnag_aling_android'

	wp_util.move(leader, self.get_marker_leader_pos() + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move(hero, self.get_marker_hero_pos() + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--안드로이드가 한명이라도 있을 경우
	if  user_party.Count > 2 then
		for i = 2, user_party.Count-1 do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i], {
				self.get_marker_align_pos(i-1)
			}, 4, 1, self, android_align_key, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })
		end
		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, android_align_key)
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	local hook_shot = self.get_hook_shot(2)

	end

	self.ranpang_interact_key = controller.ranpang_interact_key

	self.get_ranpang = function()
		return get_character('ranpang')
	end
	self.get_ranpang_android = function(number)
		return get_character('ranpang_s1_android_' .. number)
	end
	self.get_hero_ai = function()
		return get_character('hero_ai')
	end

	--region Object
	self.get_hook_shot = function(idx)
		return get_field_object('hook_shot_' .. idx)
	end
	--endregion


	self.get_marker_ranpang_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('ranpang_s1_ranpang_pos_1')
	end
	self.get_marker_android_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('ranpang_s1_and_pos')
	end
	self.get_marker_landing_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('ranpang_s1_landing_pos')
	end
	self.get_marker_jumping_pos = function(number)
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('ranpang_s1_jumping_pos_' .. number)
	end
	self.get_marker_align_pos = function(number)
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('ranpang_s1_align_pos_' .. number)
	end
	self.first_event_zone = 'ranpang_s1_first_zone'

	self.ranpang_first_key = 'ranpang_first_event'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.first_event_zone) and not
	(quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.ranpang_first_key) == 1) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.comes_ranpang, self)
	end

end

function local_class:comes_ranpang(e)
	--인터렉트와 동시에 bgm 재생, 볼륨 0.5
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.ranpang_first_key, 1)
	--맵중앙으로 카메라 이동
	camera_util.move(self.get_marker_landing_pos() + vector(2, 0, 0), 0.5)
	--유저가 빨간존에 진입시 이벤트 진행.
	--란팡(란)이 그리드 밖에서 외벽 위에서 생성(right,smile,get) ->생성되자마자 이동
	--안드로이드 위치에서 y축 좌표 0.5칸 위로 이동 후 (이동 시간 0.5초)
	--란팡 캐릭터의 충돌 판정 X

	local ranpang = self.get_ranpang()
	local ranpang_creashbehaviout = ranpang.CrashBehaviour
	ranpang.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	local ranpang_pos = self.get_marker_android_pos() + vector(-7, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(ranpang, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(ranpang, ranpang_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'get')
	local ranpang_landing_pos = self.get_marker_android_pos()
	character_util.jump_move(ranpang, ranpang_landing_pos,
			8, 2, true, 'right')
	--란팡 0 지점 착지 시
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	--란팡 생성 1초 후
	start_coroutine(self.chase_android, self, self.get_ranpang_android(1))
	--안드로이드 2명이 0.5초 간격으로 란팡이 생성된 위치와 같은 위치에서 똑같이 생성 후 란팡과 같은 경로와 모션으로 이동
	--(란팡을 쫓아가는 연출)
	--안드로이드들은 z축 spinX
	--(0)위치 도달 시

	--(right,smile,get)상태로 z축 spin+기본 jump높이로 뛰면서 1번 위치로 이동(이동 시간 1초)
	character_util.spine_rotate(ranpang, -360, 0.5)
	--란팡 0 -> 1 지점 점프 시
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_jump_02')
	character_util.jump_move(ranpang, self.get_marker_landing_pos(),
			6, 2, true, 'right')
	start_coroutine(self.chase_android, self, self.get_ranpang_android(2))

	--( 1 ) 위치로 착지시 (right,smile) 상태에서 (run)모션으로 즉시 바뀌고 2번 위치까지 이동
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'run')
	--란팡 달리는 동안 재생
	local ranpang_dash_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01'
	, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default', parent = ranpang})
	wp_util.move_async(ranpang, self.get_marker_jumping_pos(1), 7, 1)
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(ranpang_dash_sound)

	--( 2 ) 위치로 오자마자 (right,smile,get) 상태로 전환 후 3번 위치로 도어를 넘어 점프 이동 (이동 시간 2초)
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'get')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(ranpang, self.get_marker_jumping_pos(2),
			8, 2, true, 'right')

	--( 3 ) 위치 착지시 다시 (right,smile) 상태에서 (run)모션으로 즉시 바뀌고 오른쪽 방향으로 직진
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'run')
	wp_util.move_async(ranpang, ranpang.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 8, 1)

	--해당 도어는 바로 앞에 버튼과 연결 기본 개방 애니메이션 사용 ( 딜레이 있는 오픈 )
	character_util.set_position(ranpang, self.get_marker_ranpang_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'prostrate')
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'idle')
	character_util.add_listener(ranpang, self.controller)

	ranpang.CrashBehaviour = ranpang_creashbehaviout

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.2)
	--이벤트 종료 후 bgm 볼륨 1 로 복귀
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:chase_android(fo)
	character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'enabled')
	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	local fo_pos = self.get_marker_android_pos() + vector(-7, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_position(fo, fo_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'get')
	local fo_landing_pos = self.get_marker_android_pos()
	character_util.jump_move(fo, fo_landing_pos,
			8, 2, true, 'right')

	--(right,smile,get)상태로 z축 spin+기본 jump높이로 뛰면서 1번 위치로 이동(이동 시간 1초)
	--안드로이드 1, 2 점프 마다
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(fo, self.get_marker_landing_pos(),
			6, 2, true, 'right')

	--( 1 ) 위치로 착지시 (right,smile) 상태에서 (run)모션으로 즉시 바뀌고 2번 위치까지 이동
	scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'run')
	--안드로이드 1, 2 달리는 동안 재생
	local android_dash_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01'
	, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default', parent = fo})
	wp_util.move_async(fo, self.get_marker_jumping_pos(1), 7, 1)
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(android_dash_sound)

	--( 2 ) 위치로 오자마자 (right,smile,get) 상태로 전환 후 3번 위치로 도어를 넘어 점프 이동 (이동 시간 2초)
	scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'get')
	--안드로이드 1, 2 점프 마다
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(fo, self.get_marker_jumping_pos(2),
			8, 2, true, 'right')

	--( 3 ) 위치 착지시 다시 (right,smile) 상태에서 (run)모션으로 즉시 바뀌고 오른쪽 방향으로 직진
	scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'run')
	wp_util.move_async(fo, fo.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 8, 1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
	character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'disabled')
end

function local_class:ranpang_event_1(e)
	--인터렉트와 동시에 bgm 재생, 볼륨 0.5
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	self.controller:align_setting()
	local ranpang = self.get_ranpang()
	local hero = self.get_hero_ai()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	--란팡(left,attack,cast2)(shout 말풍선): 구와아앍!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'cast2')
	character_util.normal_jump(ranpang)
	--대사 출력 때 카메라 줌
	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.1)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_1')
	--카메라 줌 풀리면서 란팡(left,surprise,idle)(jump 1회)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.1)
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'idle')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(ranpang, true)
	--란팡(left,smile,release1회): 부단장! 지금까지 어디 있었던 건가!
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, { name = 'release', count = 1, loop = false })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_2')

	--가디언 선택지
	local choose_result_1 = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_ranpang_s1_choose_1_1', 'intellect' }, { 'qc_ranpang_s1_choose_1_2', 'mercy' } })

	--세계를 구하느라 좀 늦었어.(노랑)
	--(right,sleep_deep,cross_arm)
	if choose_result_1 == 1 then
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, {name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false})
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--란팡(left, doyagao, nod 2회) 부단장이라면 그 정도는 할 줄 알았다!
		scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'doyagao')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, {name = 'nod', count = 2, one_shot_sfx = false})
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_2_1')
	else
		--오랜만이야, 보스!(초록)
		--(right,smile,success)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'success')
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'idle')
	--란팡(left,idle,qestion) + (slience) 이모티콘버블
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'question')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(ranpang, nil, 'silence')

	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')

	--란팡(left,smile,idle): 그래, 부단장에게 물어 볼게 있다! 마침 잘됐군!
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_3')

	--란팡(left,idle,idle): 이 곳에 안드로이드들이 갑자기 침입자라면서 쫓아오던데 이유를 아나?
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_4')

	--란팡(left,tried,bomb_idle): 인상도 바뀐 것 같고, 원래라면 퍼질러 있었을 텐데 말이지.
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'tried')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_5')

	--가디언 선택지
	local choose_result_2 = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_ranpang_s1_choose_2_1', 'intellect' }, { 'qc_ranpang_s1_choose_2_2', 'forced' },
		{ 'qc_ranpang_s1_choose_2_3', 'brutal' } })

	--마빈이 안드로이드들을 괴롭히고 있어! (노랑)
	--가디언(right,scared,cast)
	--란팡(left,smile,bomb_idle): 그럴리가! 그 남자는 생긴건 험악해도 마음만은 인형처럼 푹신했던 거다!
	if choose_result_2 == 1 then
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')

		wait_for_sec(1)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'idle')

		scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'bomb_idle')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_6')
	elseif choose_result_2 == 2 then
		--용의 발톱단이 두려운 거지! (보라)
		--가디언(right,doyagao,cross_arm)
		--란팡(left,doyagao,cross_arm) : 좋은 대답이다! 부단장!
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'doyagao')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, {name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false})

		wait_for_sec(1)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'idle')

		scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'doyagao')
		scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'cross_arm')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_7')
	else
		--바로 내가 왔으니까! (빨강)
		--가디언(right,attack,cast2)
		--란팡(left,smile,nod1회) : 그 자신감, 좋은 자세군!
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, {name = 'cast2', sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01'})

		wait_for_sec(1)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'idle')

		scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1, loop = false, one_shot_sfx = false})
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_8')
	end

	--란팡(left,sleep_deep,cross_arm): 뭐, 정답은 너무 뻔하지만.
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_9')

	--란팡(left,attack,shot): 정답은 바로 우리 용의 발톱단을 견제하려는 거다!
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'shoot')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_10')

	--란팡(left,smile,idle):마침 부단장도 왔으니 오랜만에 같이 작전을 수행해보지 않겠나!
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, {name = 'idle', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_11')

	--란팡(left,smile,nod2회):  부단장만 있으면 작전 성공률이 두배는 뛰니까 말이지!
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2, loop = false })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_12')

	--스테이지 클리어 이전(안드로이드가 팔로워로 있을 때)
	local is_android_followed = (user_party.Count > 2)
	if is_android_followed then
		--란팡(left,idle,idle) (question) 이모티콘 버블
		scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'idle')
		scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'idle')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(ranpang, nil, 'question')

		--란팡(left,attack,release 1회): 그런데 저 안드로이드들은 왜 부단장을 따르고 있는 거지?
		scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, { name = 'release', count = 1, loop = false })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ranpang, 'qc_ranpang_s1_13')

		--카메라 정렬된 안드로이드들 중심으로 이동 이동중 가디언, 케이든AI (left,idle,idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'idle')
		scene_util.set_direction(hero, 'left')
		camera_util.move_async(self.get_marker_align_pos(3) +
				vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5), 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		--카메라 복귀 후 가디언, 케이든AI(right,idle,idle) 이 후 선택지
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		scene_util.set_direction(hero, 'right')

		--가디언 선택지
		local choose_result_3 = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'qc_ranpang_s1_choose_3_1', 'forced' }, { 'qc_ranpang_s1_choose_3_2', 'intellect' } })

		--새 단원들이에요. 보스! (초록)
		--가디언(right,smile,success)
		--란팡(left,smile,clap): 과연, 벌써 항복한 안드로이드들이 있을줄이야!
		--란팡(left,doyagao,idle): 그렇다면 작전이 더 쉬워지겠군!
		if choose_result_3 == 1 then
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'success', count = 2, loop = false,
			sfx_name = '01_coop_mvp_01'})

			wait_for_sec(1)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'idle')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')
			scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'clap')

	end

function local_class:start()
	--란팡 등장 이벤트를 보았는지?
	if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.ranpang_first_key) == 1 then
		local ranpang = self.get_ranpang()
		character_util.set_active_state(ranpang, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(ranpang, self.get_marker_ranpang_pos())
		character_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'right')
		scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'prostrate')
		scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'idle')
		character_util.add_listener(ranpang, self.controller)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_ranpang()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.ranpang_event_1, self)
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

return local_class

	-- 디텍트 가드 이벤트
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	-- 마그넷 이벤트
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveByMagnetNoticeEvent), 'on_move_by_magnet_notice_event')
	-- 화로 온오프 이벤트
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent), 'on_brazier_on_off_event')

	-- 카메라 그리드 입장 퇴장 체크 (코루틴 실행 종료)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

	self.get_fx_object_twinkle()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:set_info()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HookShotEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveByMagnetNoticeEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	-- 가드제거
	for idx = 1, 6 do
		local guard = self.get_guard(idx)
		local guard_pos = self.wait_pos
		character_util.set_position(guard, guard_pos)
		character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region setting
function local_class:set_info()
	-- 선택지 진행 X (커스텀 스테이트 값이 없다면 실행)
	if not (self.controller:check_ranpang_interact()) then
		local ranpang = self.get_ranpang()
		character_util.set_active_state(ranpang, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(ranpang, self.get_s1_ranpang_pos(1))
		scene_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'left')
		character_util.add_listener(ranpang, self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self:guard_set_info()
end

function local_class:guard_set_info()
	local guards_dir = {
		'down',
		'left',
		'right',
		'left',
		'left',
		'left'
	}
	for idx = 1, 6 do
		local guard = self.get_guard(idx)
		local guard_pos = self.get_guard_pos(idx)
		character_util.set_active_state(guard, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(guard, guard_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction(guard, guards_dir[idx])

		if idx < 4 then
			if (idx == 1) or (idx == 2) then
				guard.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1, 1, 1))
			end
			guard.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
					guard, self.detected_by_guard_key(1), 5, 50)
		else
			guard.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
					guard, self.detected_by_guard_key(2), 4, 40)
		end
	end
	-- 테슬라
	self:tesla_turn_on()
end
--endregion

--region custom event
function local_class:s1_finish_interact_event()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local ranpang = self.get_ranpang()
	self.controller:align_setting()
	-- 란팡(left,smile,idle): 작전준비는 다 마쳤나, 부단장?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, nil, nil,
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 1)

	-- 가디언 선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ self.get_ranpang_common_string_name .. 1, 'mercy' },
		{ self.get_ranpang_common_string_name .. 2, 'brutal' }
	})

	-- 선택지
	-- 작전 개시입니다! (초록)
	-- 지금은 안돼요. (빨강)
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--란팡(right,attack,release 1회): 좋아, 작전 장소는 바로 이 말뚝을 타고 이동하면 된다!
		--안드로이드 정렬한채로 고정 란팡 파티 합류
		--추 후 확인후 설정
		--반대쪽 말뚝에 서브 퀘스트 마커

		self.controller:start_waiting_android()
		scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, { name = 'release', count = 1 })

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false }, nil, 'attack',
				self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. '1_' .. 1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ranpang)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		local hook_shot_pos = self.get_hook_shot(1).Position + vector(0, 1, 0)
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_key, hook_shot_pos)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(ranpang, self.controller.cs_controller)
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(ranpang, user_party, false)
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.ranpang_interact_key, 0)
		-- 훅샷 종료 이벤트
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HookShotEndEvent), 'on_hook_shot_end_event')
		--local door_1 = self.get_door_name .. 1
		--local door_2 = self.get_door_name .. 2
		----문 올려주기
		--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(door_1, false))
		--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(door_2, false))
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 란팡(left,idle,idle): 흠… 알겠다, 부단장이 바쁘다면 얼마든지 기다려 주지!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, nil, nil,
				self.get_ranpang_common_string_name .. 3)
	end
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

-- 마커 변경
function local_class:hook_shot_event()
	local change_marker_pos = self.get_gift_box_pos(1) + vector(0, 1, 0)

	if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.ranpang_second_key) == 0 then
		local quest_marker_pos = self.get_quest_marker_pos(1)
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_key, quest_marker_pos)
	else
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_key, change_marker_pos)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HookShotEndEvent))
end

function local_class:s2_first_zone_event()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)
	local door_1 = self.get_door_name .. 1
	local door_2 = self.get_door_name .. 2
	--이벤트 시작 되면 문 올라오기
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(door_1, true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(door_2, true))

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local ranpang = self.get_ranpang()

	local leader_pos = self.get_leader_pos(1)
	local hero_ai_pos = self.get_hero_ai_pos(1)
	local ranpang_pos = self.get_ranpang_pos(1)
	local gift_box_pos_list = {
		self.get_gift_box_pos(1) + vector(0.3, 0, 0),
		self.get_gift_box_pos(1) + vector(-0.3, 0, 0),
		self.get_gift_box_pos(1) + vector(0, 0, 0.3)
	}

	-- 클리어 플래그
	self.first_zone_clear_flag = true

	-- 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_key)

	-- 캐릭터 정렬 가디언,케이든AI(right,idle,idle) 란팡(left,idle,idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ranpang)

	-- 위치 이동
	local finish_key = 'finish_key'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, { leader_pos }, nil, 1, self, finish_key,
			{ run = false, last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero_ai, { hero_ai_pos }, nil, 1, self, finish_key,
			{ run = false, last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(ranpang, { ranpang_pos }, nil, 1, self, finish_key,
			{ run = false, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, finish_key)

	-- 란팡(left,doyagao,idle): 그럼 바로 작전을 설명하지!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, nil, 'doyagao',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 2)

	--란팡(right,idle,idle): 란팡님이 조사한 결과 이곳에 안드로이드들의 휴게시설이 있더군!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ranpang)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, 'right', nil, nil,
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 2 .. '_1')

	--란팡(left,sleep_deep,cross_arm): 그말은 즉, 이 곳에 잠입하면 안드로이드들을 일망타진할 수 있단 거다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, 'left', 'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 2 .. '_2')

	-- 란팡(left,idle,throw)손에서 (mall_giftbox 0.5 scale) 를 세개를 바닥에 내려놓는다. (초록색 박스 3개)
	for idx = 1, #gift_box_pos_list do
		table.insert(self.controller.gift_box_list, drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = ranpang.Position, target = gift_box_pos_list[idx], itemid = self.qc_sprite_ids.qc_gift_box, notforinven = true,
				  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.5 }))
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(ranpang, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1})
	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

	-- 란팡(left,attack,idle): 안드로이드들이 맘편히 쉬러 휴게소에 들어가는 순간!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, 'left', 'idle', 'attack',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 2 .. '_3')

	-- 란팡(left,smile,nod1회): 잔뜩 방심한 상태로 이 선물상자를 열어보겠지…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, 'left', { name = 'nod', count = 1 }, 'smile',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 2 .. '_4')

	-- 란팡(left,doyagao,cross_arm): 겉으로 보기엔 평범한 선물상자 같지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, 'cross_arm', 'doyagao',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 3)

	-- 란팡(left,sleep_deep,idle): 건드리는 순간 상자 뚜껑의 전선이…
	-- 카메라 줌 왼쪽으로 한칸 이동
	wp_util.move(ranpang, ranpang.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'left' })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4 * 0.7, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01', 0.7)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, nil, 'sleep_deep',
			{ key = self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 4, skip = false })

	-- 란팡(left,attack,shoot)(shout말풍선): 펑!!!
	-- 카메라 줌 풀림 오른쪽으로 한 칸 이동
	-- 이때 가디언 케이든 AI(right,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader)
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, 'shoot', 'attack',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 5)
	wp_util.move_async(ranpang, ranpang.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'left' })

	-- 란팡(left,doyagao,cross_arm): 이 폭탄을 휴게소 안에 설치하는 거다!
	-- 이 후 가디언(right,idle,eat)으로 상자를 빨아들이고 획득 이후(right,idle,idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, 'cross_arm', 'doyagao',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 6)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')
	local leader_eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name='03_equipping_01', loop = true})
	for idx = 1, #self.controller.gift_box_list do
		self.controller.gift_box_list[idx].ConsumeTarget = leader
		self.controller.gift_box_list[idx].ShowFloatingText = false
		self.controller.gift_box_list[idx]:Fly()
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(leader_eat_sfx)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 케이든(right,attack,bomb_idle): 아무리 강한 폭탄이라고 해도 저희 안드로이드의 장갑을 뚫긴 힘들겁니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', 'attack',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 7)

	-- 란팡(left,smile,idle): 거기! 부단장이 데려온 인턴, 아직 보스에 대한 신뢰가 부족하군!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, 'idle', 'smile',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 7 .. '_1')

	-- 케이든(right,attack,cast): 아… 아닙니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'cast', 'attack',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 7 .. '_2')

	-- 란팡(left,doyagao,nod1회): 하지만 작전이 끝나면 이 보스의 큰뜻을 이해할 수 있을 거다!
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, nil, 'doyagao',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 7 .. '_3')

	-- 란팡(left,smile,victory_get): 그렇다면 작전시작전에 해야할게 있겠지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, 'victory_get', 'smile',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 8)

	-- 란팡(down,smile,idle) : 다같이 구호를 외치는 거다!
	-- 이때 가디언도(down,smile,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'down')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, nil, nil,
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 8 .. '_1')

	-- 케이든AI (right,attack,idle)(jump1회) (!) (exclamation)이모티콘 버블
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(hero_ai, self, 'right', nil, 'attack', 'notice')

	-- 케이든AI(right,attack,release): 구호를 외친다니, 어떤 구호입니까?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'release', 'attack',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 8 .. '_2')

	-- 란팡(left,sleep_deep,cross_arm): 부단장! 새 인턴에게 구호도 알려주지 않다니!
	-- 이때 가디언(right,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, 'left', 'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 8 .. '_3')

	-- 란팡(left,smile,gauntlet_combo_attack loop안함) 괜찮다! 지금이라도 잘 보고 따라하는 거다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack', loop = false, one_shot_sfx = false})
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, 'left', nil, 'smile',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 9)
	character_util.remove_anim(ranpang)

	-- 케이든(right,attack,cast): 우오오오! 알겠습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'cast', 'attack',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 10)

	-- 이 후 정렬
	-- 케, 가, 란 순서
	local dragon_dance_pos_list = { leader_pos, leader_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), leader_pos + vector(2, 0, 0) }
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero_ai, { dragon_dance_pos_list[1] }, nil, 1, self, finish_key,
			{ run = false, last_direction = 'down' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, { dragon_dance_pos_list[2] }, nil, 1, self, finish_key,
			{ run = false, last_direction = 'down' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(ranpang, { dragon_dance_pos_list[3] }, nil, 1, self, finish_key,
			{ run = false, last_direction = 'down' })
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, finish_key)

	-- 란팡(down,smile,idle): 자! 다같이 외치는 거다!
	-- 카메라 줌
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4 * 0.7, 1)
	character_util.remove_anim(ranpang)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, 'down', nil, 'smile',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 11)

	local dance_success = false
	while not dance_success do
		-- 카메라 줌
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4 * 0.7, 1)

		-- 용의 발톱단 QTE 진행
		dance_success = self:dragons_claws_dance(leader, hero_ai, ranpang)

		-- 카메라 줌 풀림
		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 가디언,케이든AI(right,idle,idle)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)

		-- QTE실패시 이벤트
		if not dance_success then
			-- 란팡(left,smile,idle): 오랜만에 하니 몸이 덜 풀렸나 보군!
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
			scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'right')
			scene_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'left')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, nil, 'smile',
					self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 15)

			-- 가디언,케이든AI,란팡(down,idle,idle)
			-- 란팡(down,smile,gauntlet_combo_attack2(loop안함)): 그럼 다시 힘차게 시작하는 거다!
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
			scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'down')
			scene_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'down')
			scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack2', loop = false })
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, nil, nil, 'smile',
					self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 16)
		end
		-- 란팡(down,idle,idle)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ranpang)
	end
	-- 란팡(right,smile,victory_get): 좋았어 그럼 작전 개시다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ranpang, self, 'right', 'victory_get', 'smile',
			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 17)

function local_class:time_check_stop_anim(dance_list, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	-- 잘못된 입력이 가능한 경우, 입력이 뭐라도 들어오기만 하면 넘어감.
	-- 잘못된 입력이 불가능한 경우, 알맞은 입력이 들어올 때 까지 대기함.
	while time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if self.qte_success then
			return
		end
	end
	if self.qte_success then
		return
	end
	for idx = 1, #dance_list do
		dance_list[idx].SpineController.TimeScale = 0
	end
end

function local_class:dragons_claws_dance(leader, hero_ai, ranpang)
	local dance_list = { leader, hero_ai, ranpang }
	-- 애니메이션 duration 체크
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'down')
	scene_util.set_direction(ranpang, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	-- qte 발현
	-- 1.5초 경과시 실패
	local dance_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(ranpang, 'dance_voodoo')

	-- 1번째 qte
	do
		-- 용↘의↗
		-- LEFT QTE재생
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'dance_voodoo', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })
		scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'dance_voodoo', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })
		scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, { name = 'dance_voodoo', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'smile')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(ranpang, { key = self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 12, skip = false })

		-- qte 결과 초기화
		self.qte_success = false

		-- 애니메이션 멈추기
		start_coroutine(self.time_check_stop_anim, self, dance_list, dance_duration / 3)

		-- qte
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		self.qte_success = qte_util.swipe('left', 1.5, nil)

		-- 성공 유무
		if not self.qte_success then
			for idx = 1, #dance_list do
				dance_list[idx].SpineController.TimeScale = 1
				character_util.remove_anim(dance_list[idx])
			end
			return false
		end

		for idx = 1, #dance_list do
			dance_list[idx].SpineController.TimeScale = 1
		end
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1)
	end
	-- 2번째 qte
	do
		-- 발↘톱↗
		-- RIGHT QTE재생
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(ranpang, { key = self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 13, skip = false })

		-- qte 결과 초기화
		self.qte_success = false

		-- 애니메이션 멈추기
		start_coroutine(self.time_check_stop_anim, self, dance_list, dance_duration / 3)

		-- qte
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		self.qte_success = qte_util.swipe('right', 1.5, nil)

		-- 성공 유무
		if not self.qte_success then
			for idx = 1, #dance_list do
				dance_list[idx].SpineController.TimeScale = 1
				character_util.remove_anim(dance_list[idx])
			end
			return false
		end
		for idx = 1, #dance_list do
			dance_list[idx].SpineController.TimeScale = 1
		end
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1)
	end

	-- 3번째 qte
	do
		-- 단~
		-- UP QTE재생
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(ranpang, { key = self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 14, skip = false })

		-- qte 결과 초기화
		self.qte_success = false

		-- 애니메이션 멈추기
		start_coroutine(self.time_check_stop_anim, self, dance_list, dance_duration / 3)

		-- qte
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		self.qte_success = qte_util.swipe('up', 1.5, nil)

		-- 성공 유무
		if not self.qte_success then
			for idx = 1, #dance_list do
				dance_list[idx].SpineController.TimeScale = 1
				character_util.remove_anim(dance_list[idx])
			end
			return false
		end
		for idx = 1, #dance_list do
			dance_list[idx].SpineController.TimeScale = 1
		end
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:co_player_detected_by_guard(guard, event_name)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	local party_list = {
		user_party.Leader,
		self.get_hero_ai(),
		self.get_ranpang()
	}
	self.is_detected = true
	local is_guard_down_to_leader = guard.Position.z < user_party.Leader.Position.z
	if is_guard_down_to_leader then
		guard.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 2)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(guard)
	-- 가디언,케이든AI,란팡 (surprise,embarrassed)상태
	-- 두 대사 동시 출력
	-- 발각한 안드로이드(mad,release)one_shot_sfx = false: 침입자 발견!
	-- 란팡: 부단장, 후퇴하자!
	for idx = 1, #party_list do
		scene_util.set_emotion(party_list[idx], self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_anim(party_list[idx], self, 'embarrassed')
	end
	-- 가드
	scene_util.set_emotion(guard, self, 'mad')
	scene_util.set_anim(guard, self, 'release')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(guard, { key = self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 19, skip = false, one_shot_sfx = false})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(party_list[3], self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 20, skip = false, one_shot_sfx = false})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for idx = 1, #party_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(party_list[idx])
	end

	local reset_point = nil
	local direction = nil
	if event_name == self.detected_by_guard_key(1) then
		reset_point = self.detected_by_guard_reset_marker_name(1)
		direction = 'left'
	else
		reset_point = self.detected_by_guard_reset_marker_name(2)
		direction = 'up'
	end

	party_util.align_party(reset_point, direction, 0, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 순찰 패트롤 좌표랑 상태 다 리셋 시키도록
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'reset', event_name }))
	if is_guard_down_to_leader then
		guard.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.is_detected = false
end

			self.get_ranpang_s2_string_name .. 25)

	scene_util.set_anim(ranpang, self, 'eat')
	character_util.convert_to_npc(ranpang)
	do
		local ranpang_planting_pos = { vector(self.get_finish_effect_pos(1).x, 0, ranpang.Position.z),
									   self.get_finish_effect_pos(1) }
		local ranpang_move_pos = { ranpang.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
								   vector((self.get_finish_effect_pos(3).x - 0.5), 0, (ranpang.Position.z + 1)),
								   vector((self.get_finish_effect_pos(3).x - 0.5), 0, (self.get_finish_effect_pos(3).z)) }

		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim(ranpang)
		scene_util.set_emotion(ranpang, self, 'smile')
		wp_util.move_async(ranpang, ranpang_move_pos, 4, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'right' })
		local ranpang_eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name ='03_equipping_01', loop = true})
		scene_util.set_anim_async(ranpang, self, { name = 'eat', count = 1})

-- 그리드 팬기믹 코루틴 실행 함수 (시원하군요)
function local_class:fan_gimmick_check_in_target_grid_coroutine()
	local fan = self.get_push_fan(1)
	local android_list = { self.get_guard(4), self.get_guard(5), self.get_guard(6) }
	while self.fan_gimmick_check_in_target_grid_coroutine_flag do
		local fan_searching_bounds = fan.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable().searching_bounds
		if fan_searching_bounds then
			for idx = 1, #android_list do
				if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(fan_searching_bounds, android_list[idx].Position)
						and not self.npc_event_check_flag_list[idx] then
					self.fan_event_flag = true
					self.npc_event_check_flag_list[idx] = true
					start_coroutine(self.cool_event, self, android_list[idx])
				end
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local ranpang = self.get_ranpang()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, ranpang) then
		-- 처음 시작 시 진행하는 이벤트
		sp_util.start_scene(self.s1_finish_interact_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local brazier = self.get_brazier(1)

	-- 첫 존 이벤트
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.first_event_zone_name)
			and not self.first_zone_clear_flag
			and not (quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.ranpang_second_key) == 0) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.s2_first_zone_event, self)
		return true
	end
	-- 쿨 존 1번
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.cool_zone_name)
			and not self.cool_zone_clear_flag then
		self.cool_zone_clear_flag = true
		start_coroutine(self.cool_zone_event, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 퍼즐존 1번
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.puzzle_event_zone_name .. 1)
			and not self.puzzle_zone_1_clear_flag then
		self.puzzle_zone_1_clear_flag = true
		start_coroutine(self.puzzle_zone_1_event, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 퍼즐존 2번
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.puzzle_event_zone_name .. 2)
			and not self.puzzle_zone_2_clear_flag then
		self.puzzle_zone_2_clear_flag = true
		start_coroutine(self.puzzle_zone_2_event, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 피니시 존 이벤트
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.finish_zone_name)
			and not self.ending_start_zone_clear_flag then
		self.ending_start_zone_clear_flag = true
		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending_start_zone_event, self)
		return true
	end

	--피니쉬 eixt 존 이벤트 클리어가 아니면
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.exit_zone_name) and not
			(self.quest_progress.IsComplete) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending_exit_zone_event, self)
		return true
	end

	--피니쉬 존에 화로 들어가면
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_ranpang_finish_brazier(), self.finish_zone_name) then
		local reset_finish = get_field_object('ranpang_reset_switch_4')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent.Create(reset_finish))
		return true
	end

	-- 화로 이벤트
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, brazier, self.detect_brazier_zone_name)
			and not self.detect_brazier_flag
			and not self.is_detected then
		self.detect_brazier_flag = true
		start_coroutine(self.s2_detect_brazier_event, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_hook_shot_end_event(e)
	local hook_shot = self.get_hook_shot(1)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Stake, hook_shot) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Character, user_party.Leader) then
			start_coroutine(self.hook_shot_event, self)
			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
		if ((e.Params[0] == self.detected_by_guard_key(1)) or (e.Params[0] == self.detected_by_guard_key(2)))
				and not self.is_detected
				and not self.fan_event_flag then
			--	-- CharacterControllerScreenplayState 상태인 경우엔, early termination
			local current_leader_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
			local screenplay_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState
			if lua_helper.type_compare(current_leader_state, screenplay_state) then
				return
			end
			sp_util.start_scene(self.co_player_detected_by_guard, self, e.Sender, e.Params[0])
			return true
		end

		rotation = nil
	}

	function self.effect_builder.new()
		function self:reset()
			self.position = nil
			self.scale = nil
			self.rotation = nil
			self.parent = nil
		end

		function self:set_position(position)
			self.position = position
			return self
		end

		function self:set_scale(scale)
			self.scale = scale
			return self
		end

		function self:set_rotation(rotation)
			self.rotation = rotation
			return self
		end

		function self:set_parent(parent)
			self.parent = parent
			return self
		end

		function self:create(effect_name)
			if effect_name == nil or #effect_name == 0 then
				logger_util.error("Param: effect_name was expected, empty string was passed")
				return nil
			end

			-- 스케일, 로테이션 상관없이 이펙트 생성
			local function create_default(effect_name, position)
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name):Instantiate(position)
			end

			local function create_with_parent(effect_name, position, transform)
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name):Instantiate(position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, transform)
			end

			-- 스케일 혹은 로테이션 값 적용하여 이펙트 생성
			local function create_customized(effect_name, position)

				local created = nil
				if self.parent == nil then
					created = create_default(effect_name, position)
				else
					created = create_with_parent(effect_name, position, self.parent)
				end

				if self.scale ~= nil then
					created.transform.localScale = self.scale
				end

				if self.rotation ~= nil then
					created.transform.localRotation = self.rotation
				end

				return created
			end

			local created = nil

			if self.scale ~= nil or self.rotation ~= nil then
				created = create_customized(effect_name, self.position)
			else
				created = create_default(effect_name, self.position)
			end

			self:reset()

			return created
		end

		return {
			reset = self.reset,
			set_position = self.set_position,
			set_scale = self.set_scale,
			set_rotation = self.set_rotation,
			set_parent = self.set_parent,
			create = self.create
		}
	end

		start_coroutine(self.jump_to_battle_zone_2, self, android, random_pos, started_battle)

	local angle_axis = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(random_angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
	local dest_pos = leader_pos + (angle_axis * leader_direction) + leader_direction * front_offset

	character_util.jump_move(android, dest_pos, 10, 3, true)

	-- Guard Clausure
	if self.desert_slave_state.is_beating_android_at_boss_room then
		return
	end

	self.desert_slave_state.is_beating_android_at_boss_room = true

	local function desert_slave_keep_beating_android(desert_slave, victim, victim_original_pos)
		local effect_builder = self.effect_builder.new()
		effect_builder:set_position(victim.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		scene_util.hide_weapon(desert_slave)

		self.is_desert_slave_punching = true

		while self.desert_slave_state.is_beating_android_at_boss_room do
			wait_for_sec(1)

			scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = false })

			wait_for_sec(0.3)
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = desert_slave, max_distance = 26 })
			self:android_get_damaged(victim)

			local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				'linear', true, vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, nil,
				nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
				CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

			command_util.publish_knock_back(victim.Owner, victim, knock_back_info, victim.Position)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			character_util.move_to_async(victim, victim_original_pos, 0.25, nil, true, true)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, 'dagger_idle')

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.is_desert_slave_punching = false
	end

	local desert_slave = self.get_desert_slave_helmet()
	local android_victim = self.get_android_victim()
	local victim_original_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('boss_room_victim_android_init_pos')

	start_coroutine(desert_slave_keep_beating_android, desert_slave, android_victim, victim_original_pos)
end

---마빈에게 도전하기 위해 보스 방 안에 들어갔을 경우 정렬 처리
function local_class:align_characters_on_entered_boss_room_async(guardian, hero_ai, desert_slave)
	local function androids_align(align_duration)
		local following_npcs = self:get_following_npcs()

		for i = 1, #following_npcs do
			local align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.marker_names.android_boss_room_align .. i)
			local android = following_npcs[i]

			character_util.move_to(android, align_pos, align_duration, nil, true, true)
		end
	end

	local function knight_and_hero_ai_align(align_duration)
		-- 굳이 타일맵 수정까지 갈 필요 없을 것 같아서 마커만 반대로 사용함.
		local hero_ai_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('on_challange_scene_knight_pos')
		local knight_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('on_challange_scene_hero_ai_pos')

		character_util.move_to(guardian, knight_align_pos, align_duration, nil, true ,true)
		character_util.move_to(hero_ai, hero_ai_align_pos, align_duration, nil, true, true)
	end

	local align_duration = 1

	androids_align(align_duration)

	-- 가디언과 케이든 마빈 5칸 앞까지 1초에 걸쳐 이동.
	knight_and_hero_ai_align(align_duration)

	-- 동시에 카메라도 1초에 걸쳐 가운데 지점으로 포커스 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(desert_slave.Position, align_duration)

	-- 마빈이 안드로이드 때리던 루틴 멈춘다.
	self:stop_desert_slave_beating_android()

	while self.is_desert_slave_punching do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_group_direction(self:get_following_npcs(), 'up')

	-- 마빈 (left, attack, attack) : 당장 그 녀석을…
	local android_victim = self.get_android_victim()

	-- attack에 키가 없네.....
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.3)
			self:android_get_damaged(android_victim, 'damaged', 'damaged')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				'linear', true, vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, nil,
				nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
				CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

			command_util.publish_knock_back(android_victim.Owner, android_victim, knock_back_info, android_victim.Position)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			character_util.remove_anim(android_victim)
		end),

		util.cs_generator(function()
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(desert_slave, self, 'left', { name = 'attack', count = 1 },
				'attack', 'qc_sector_ds_s2_0')
		end),
	})

	scene_util.set_direction(android_victim, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_victim, self, 'scared')

	-- 마빈 down, idle, idle, question 이모티콘.
	--대사 하는 동안 안드로이드 0.3초만에 위쪽으로 0.3칸 이동.
	-- down, scared로 뒷걸음질

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(desert_slave)
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'down')

	-- 마빈(smile, clap 3회) : 하하하, 인베이더 쥐새끼가…
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(desert_slave, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'clap', count = 3 }, nil, 'qc_sector_ds_s2_1')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.move_distance_async(android_victim, vector(0, 0, 0.3), 0.3, nil, false, true)

	})

	-- 마빈(doyagao, idle) : 제 발로 나타났군.

	-- down, scared로 뒷걸음질

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(desert_slave, self, 'down',
			nil, 'doyagao', 'qc_sector_ds_s2_2')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.move_distance_async(android_victim, vector(0, 0, 0.3), 0.3, nil, false, true)
		end),
	})

	-- 안드로이드 위쪽으로 뛰어서 퇴장

	local android_victim_flee_dest = field_util.get_marker_pos('boss_room_victim_android_init_pos') + vector(0, 0, 8)
	local android_flee_wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(android_victim, android_victim_flee_dest, true)

	scene_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'up')
	wp_util.move_async(android_victim, android_flee_wp, 8, nil, { run = true })

	-- 마빈(up, idle) : 흥, 쓸모없는 자식.

	-- 마빈 down, idle 로 전환.

	character_util.remove_anim(desert_slave)

	local function mercy_reaction()
		-- 가디언 right, attack, victory_get 1회

		scene_util.set_emotion(guardian, self, 'attack')

		scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(hero_ai, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		scene_util.set_direction(guardian, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up', false)

		scene_util.set_emotion(guardian, self, 'mad')
		scene_util.set_anim(guardian, self, 'dagger_idle')

		-- 동시에 케이든AI도 left, attack, dagger_idle

		scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, 'dagger_idle')

		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guardian)

		scene_util.set_direction(guardian, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up', false)
	end

	-- 가디언 선택지
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 덤벼라, 마빈!(초록)

		-- 죽여주마, 마빈!(빨강)

		move_duration, nil, false, false)

-- 마빈 차징 어택 연출 씬
function local_class:desert_slave_charge_dash_scene_async(desert_slave, hero_ai, guardian, dash_dist, effect_builder)
	local function desert_slave_dash(desert_slave, dash_dist, effect_builder, loop_duration)
		local effect_spawn_pos =  desert_slave.Position + vector(-0.4, 0.1, 0.4)

		effect_builder:set_position(effect_spawn_pos)
				:create(self.effect_name_cache.desert_slave_charging_start)

		local charge_lv_3 = effect_builder:set_position(effect_spawn_pos)
			:create(self.effect_name_cache.desert_slave_charging_lv_3)


		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_appear_01')
		character_util.shake(desert_slave, 0.1, loop_duration)

		scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, 'gauntlet_boong_attack_ready_loop')

		wait_for_sec(loop_duration * 3)
		charge_lv_3:Dispose()

		local mod_factor = self.time_mod_factor.desert_slave_charge
			time_util.mod(mod_factor.key, mod_factor.scale)

		-- 대쉬
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_aura_slash_01')
		effect_builder:set_position(effect_spawn_pos)
			:set_rotation(unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0))
			:create(self.effect_name_cache.desert_slave_dash)

		-- 어따끄!
		local current_cam_size = stage_camera.Size * 0.5
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(current_cam_size, 0.2)
		character_util.move_distance(desert_slave, dash_dist, 0.2, nil, true, false)

		scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self,
			{ name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack', loop = false })

		wait_for_sec(0.15)

		time_util.unmod(mod_factor.key)

		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	end

	-- 케이든 AI, 마빈에게 달려가는 로직
	local function hero_ai_rushing(hero_ai, loop_duration)
		wait_for_sec(loop_duration)

		scene_util.show_weapon(hero_ai)
		scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'twohand_run' })
		--scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'run' })

		local hero_ai_rushing_dest = hero_ai.Position + vector(0, 0, 3)

		wp_util.move(hero_ai, hero_ai_rushing_dest, nil, 0.8, { run = true })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim(hero_ai)
		character_util.reset_locked_dir(hero_ai)
		scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'twohand_attack3', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
	end

	-- 기사, 마빈에게 달려가는 로직
	local function guardian_rushing(guardian, loop_duration)
		wait_for_sec(loop_duration + 0.3)

		local move_speed = 4
		local move_duration = 0.3
		local move_dist = vector(0, 0, move_speed * move_duration)
		scene_util.show_weapon(guardian)
		scene_util.set_anim(guardian, self, 'bow_run')
		character_util.move_distance_async(guardian, move_dist, nil, move_speed, false, true)

		local shadow_transform = guardian.SpineController.ShadowTransform
		local original_shadow_pos = shadow_transform.position

		self:guardian_dodge_action(guardian, desert_slave, shadow_transform, original_shadow_pos)
	end

	local effect_spawn_pos = desert_slave.Position + vector(-0.4, 0.1, 0.4)
	effect_builder:set_position(effect_spawn_pos):create(self.effect_name_cache.desert_slave_charging_start)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	scene_util.show_weapon(desert_slave)
	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack_ready', loop = false })
	character_util.normal_jump(guardian, true)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(hero_ai, true)

	local loop_duration = 0.3

	start_coroutine(guardian_rushing, guardian, loop_duration)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(desert_slave_dash, desert_slave, dash_dist, effect_builder, loop_duration),
		util.cs_generator(hero_ai_rushing, hero_ai, loop_duration),
	})
end

-- 기사, 마빈의 공격을 피해 우측으로 점프해서 피하는 로직
function local_class:guardian_dodge_action(guardian, desert_slave, shadow_transform, original_shadow_pos)
	scene_util.show_weapon(guardian, false)
	character_util.set_direction(guardian, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(guardian, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(guardian, self, 'bow_attack_ready_start')

	local jump_duration = 0.25
	local jump_start = guardian.Position
	local jump_dest = guardian.Position + vector(3.5, 3, 2.7)
	local time_passed = 0;

	local dividend = unity_class.vector3.Dot(guardian.Position, desert_slave.Position)
	local divisor = vector_util.magnitude(guardian.Position) * vector_util.magnitude(desert_slave.Position)

	local angle_in_radian = math.acos(dividend / divisor)
	local angle_in_degree = math.deg(angle_in_radian) * 100

	character_util.spine_rotate(guardian, (angle_in_degree - 5) - 360, jump_duration)

	while time_passed < jump_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = time_passed / jump_duration

		-- 다음 좌표 계산
		local next_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(jump_start, jump_dest, progress)

		-- 포지션 설정
		guardian.Position = next_pos

		-- 그림자 위치 설정
		shadow_transform.position = vector(next_pos.x, original_shadow_pos.y, next_pos.z)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(guardian, self, 'bow_attack_ready_loop')
end

-- 기사, 마빈에게 활쏘는 로직
function local_class:guardian_fire_arrow_to_desert_slave(guardian, desert_slave, shadow_transform, original_shadow_pos)
	-- 화살 쏜다
	local shoot_offset = 0.35
	local knight_fire_effect_spawn_pos = guardian.Bounds.center - shoot_offset * vector(1, 0, 0)
	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name_cache.knight_projectile_fire)
	pool:Instantiate(knight_fire_effect_spawn_pos)

	self:update_charge_effect(desert_slave, shoot_offset)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 가디언, 마빈에게 화살 쏨
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.1)
	self.boss_room_enty_scene_lock.is_arrow_routine_locked = false
	scene_util.set_anim_async(guardian, self, { name = 'bow_attack', loop = false })
	scene_util.set_anim(guardian, self, 'bow_idle')

	-- 가디언 마빈이 화살을 막는 동안 바닥에 착지.
	local falling_duration = 0.3
	local guardian_floating_pos = guardian.Position
	local ground_pos = vector(guardian.Position.x, 0, guardian.Position.z)

	-- 가디언, 바닥에 떨어지면서 스파인 로테이션 제거
	character_util.spine_rotate(guardian, 360, falling_duration)
	character_util.spine_rotate(guardian, 0, 0)

	local time_passed = 0

	camera_util.move(ground_pos, falling_duration)

	while time_passed < falling_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = time_passed / falling_duration

		-- 다음 좌표 계산
		local next_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(guardian_floating_pos, ground_pos, progress)

		-- 포지션 설정
		guardian.Position = next_pos

		-- 그림자 위치 설정

function local_class:chicken_game_scene_common(desert_slave, hero_ai, guardian, effect_builder)
	local desert_slave_charging_effect = nil

	local function desert_slave_charging_again(desert_slave, effect_builder)
		scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, 'gauntlet_boong_attack_ready_loop')
		scene_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(desert_slave, self, 'attack')

		local effect_spawn_pos = desert_slave.Position + vector(-0.4, 0.1, 0.2)
		desert_slave_charging_effect = effect_builder:set_position(effect_spawn_pos)
			:create(self.effect_name_cache.desert_slave_charging_lv_3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_appear_01')
		character_util.shake(desert_slave, 0.02, 999999)
	end

	local function player_party_get_ready_for_battle(guardian, hero_ai)
		character_util.set_direction(guardian, 'left')

		local hero_ai_move_speed = 6
		local hero_ai_align_pos = guardian.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
		scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, 'run')
		character_util.move_to_async(hero_ai, hero_ai_align_pos, nil, hero_ai_move_speed, false, true)
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim(hero_ai)
		scene_util.set_group_emotion({ guardian, hero_ai}, self, 'attack')
	end

	-- 마빈이 다시 차징하고, 가디언과 케이든AI 딱 달라붙은 채, attack 표정으로 준비.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(desert_slave_charging_again, desert_slave, effect_builder),
		util.cs_generator(player_party_get_ready_for_battle, guardian, hero_ai)
	})

	return desert_slave_charging_effect
end

function local_class:creating_effect_routine(guardian, desert_slave, effect_builder)
	local time_passed = 0
	local effect_spawn_diff = vector(0, 0.1, 0)

	while self.keep_generating_effect do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= 0.5 then
			local effect_spawn_pos = (guardian.Position + desert_slave.Position) / 2 + effect_spawn_diff
			effect_builder:set_position(effect_spawn_pos)
				:create(self.effect_name_cache.desert_slave_shock_wave)

			time_passed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_effect_gen_routine_ended = true
end

-- 안드로이들과 함께 힘겨루기 하는 연출
function local_class:chicken_game_scene_with_power_struggle(desert_slave, hero_ai, guardian, effect_builder, power_struggle_scene)
	local desert_slave_chargin_effect
		= self:chicken_game_scene_common(desert_slave, hero_ai, guardian, effect_builder)

	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--가디언 attack, victory_get 1회.
		-- 안드로이드 어셈블!
		{ 'qc_sector_ds_s2_choose_3', 'mercy', function()

			local voice_file_name_dict = {
				['ko'] = '03_voice_kai_08',
				['en'] = '04_voice_kai_01',
				--['ja'] = '',
			}

			local sfx_file_name = voice_file_name_dict[music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage]
			if sfx_file_name ~= nil then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sfx_file_name)
			end

			scene_util.set_emotion(guardian, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(guardian, self, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })
		end },
	})

	local androids = self:get_following_npcs()
	self:android_assemble_by_teleporting(androids, 0.2, effect_builder)
	character_util.remove_anim(guardian)

	local function player_party_attack(guardian, hero_ai)
		scene_util.hide_weapon(hero_ai)

		scene_util.set_group_anim({guardian, hero_ai}, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false })

		local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('desert_slave_boss_room_center')
		local speed = vector_util.distance(guardian.Position, center_pos + vector(0.85, 0, 0)) / 1.2
		character_util.jump_move(guardian, center_pos + vector(0.85, 0, 0),  speed, 1, false)
		character_util.jump_move(hero_ai, center_pos + vector(1.15, 0, 0), speed, 1, false)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		--0.2초 간격으로 1번부터 순서대로 안드로이드도 attack, twohand_attack4로 점프. 총 1.2초에 걸쳐 각자 정해진 위치로 이동한다.
		start_coroutine(self.androids_make_position, self, androids, speed)
	end

	local function desert_slave_attack(desert_slave)
		character_util.stop_shake(desert_slave)
		scene_util.set_emotion(desert_slave, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'gauntlet_left_jap_attack', scale = 0.125, loop = false })
		local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('desert_slave_boss_room_center')
		local target_pos = center_pos - vector(0.85, 0, 0)
		local speed = vector_util.distance(desert_slave.Position, target_pos) / 1.2
		character_util.jump_move(desert_slave, target_pos, speed, 1, true)
		scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'gauntlet_left_jap_attack', scale = 1, loop = false })
	end

	local function camera_zoom_in_on_attack()
		wait_for_sec(0.6)

		time_util.mod(self.time_mod_factor.chicken_game.key, self.time_mod_factor.chicken_game.scale)
		local default_cam_size = stage_camera:GetDefaultSize()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(default_cam_size * 0.7, 0.6)
	end

	desert_slave_chargin_effect:Dispose()
	desert_slave_chargin_effect = nil

	-- 가디언과 케이든AI twohand_attack4로 1.2초간 가운데 지점으로 점프하여 이동한다.
	-- 동시에 마빈은 gauntlet_left_jap_attack 0.125배속으로 실행해, 1.2초간 가운데 지점으로 점프하여 이동한다.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(player_party_attack, guardian, hero_ai, androids),
		util.cs_generator(desert_slave_attack, desert_slave),
		util.cs_generator(camera_zoom_in_on_attack)
	})

	-- 가디언의 무기끝과 마빈의 무기끝이 맞닿은 상황.
	-- 충돌하는 순간
	-- FX_shockwave 충돌 지점에 생성.
	-- 	마빈과 충돌하고 0.5초간 충돌 유지한 채 보여준다.
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('desert_slave_boss_room_center')
	local effect_spawn_pos = center_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0)
	effect_builder:set_position(effect_spawn_pos)
				:create(self.effect_name_cache.desert_slave_shock_wave)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	time_util.unmod(self.time_mod_factor.chicken_game.key)

	local characters = { guardian, hero_ai, desert_slave, table.unpack(androids, 1, #androids)}
	local player_group = { guardian, hero_ai, table.unpack(androids, 1, #androids) }
	local character_shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true })

	for i = 1, #characters do
		character_util.shake(characters[i], 0.02, 9999999)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 9999999)

	local should_play_power_struggle_scene = self:get_num_following_npcs() >= 5

	while not self.boss_room_enty_scene_lock.is_androids_joined_in_power_struggle_scene do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local desert_slave_kick_ready_fx = nil
	local guardian_kick_ready_fx = nil
	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_raincoat_explosion_01')
		desert_slave_kick_ready_fx =
			unity_object_pool
				.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name_cache.lighting_kick_ready)
				:Instantiate(
					desert_slave.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
					unity_class.quaternion.identity,
					desert_slave.Transform
				)

		guardian_kick_ready_fx =
			unity_object_pool
				.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name_cache.lighting_kick_ready)
				:Instantiate(
					guardian.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
					unity_class.quaternion.identity,
					guardian.Transform
				)

		desert_slave_kick_ready_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
		guardian_kick_ready_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	end

	if should_play_power_struggle_scene then
		power_struggle_scene(self.current_section,  player_group, guardian, desert_slave, effect_builder)
	end

	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	character_shake_sfx:Stop()
	character_shake_sfx = nil

	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then
		desert_slave_kick_ready_fx:Dispose()
		guardian_kick_ready_fx:Dispose()
	end

	for i = 1, #characters do
		character_util.stop_shake(characters[i])

		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress ~= 2 and lua_helper.reference_equals(characters[i], desert_slave) then
			goto continue
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(characters[i])
		::continue::
	end
end

function local_class:androids_make_position(androids, speed)
	for i = 1, #androids do
		local should_wait = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(i ~= #androids, false, true)
		local android = androids[i]
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('android_teleport_pos_' .. i)
		scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false })
		character_util.jump_move(android, pos, speed, 1, should_wait, 'left')
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	self.boss_room_enty_scene_lock.is_androids_joined_in_power_struggle_scene = true
end

--- 마빈이 기를 모았다가 기사와 케이든 AI에게 냅다 돌진하는 연출
function local_class:desert_slave_dash_async(party, desert_slave, dash_dist, effect_builder, callback)
	local guardian = party.guardian
	local hero_ai = party.hero_ai

	self:desert_slave_charge_dash_scene_async(desert_slave, hero_ai, guardian, dash_dist, effect_builder)

	self:guardian_shooting_arrow_scene(desert_slave, hero_ai, guardian, effect_builder)

	if callback ~= nil then
		callback()
	end

function local_class:update_charge_effect(target, shoot_offset)
	local dir_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - user_party.Leader.Position).normalized

	local fx_pos = user_party.Leader.Bounds.center + shoot_offset * dir_vector
	local fx_pos_adj = vector(0.1, 0, 0)

	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name_cache.knight_projectile_cast)
	pool:Instantiate(fx_pos + fx_pos_adj, unity_class.quaternion.identity, user_party.Leader.Transform)

	local timer = 0
	local effect_duration = 0.45

	while timer < effect_duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 기사 화살 업데이트 문
function local_class:update_projectile_move()
	local projectile_spawn_pos = user_party.Leader.Position - vector(0.75, -user_party.Leader.Position.y, 2.5)
	local projectile_move_dist_vec = vector(2, 0, 1)
	local projectile_dest = projectile_spawn_pos - projectile_move_dist_vec

	local function rotate_projectile()
		local trail_spawn_pos = projectile_spawn_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.125)

		local projectile = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name_cache.knight_projectile)
											:Instantiate(projectile_spawn_pos)
		local trail =  unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name_cache.knight_projectile_trail)
										:Instantiate(trail_spawn_pos)

		local projectile_roatation = -125
		if projectile ~= nil and trail ~= nil then
			projectile.transform.localRotation
				= unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, projectile_roatation, 0)
			trail.transform.localRotation
				= unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, (-projectile_roatation) + 10)
		end

		return projectile, trail
	end

	local is_time_mod_on = false

	local function update_projectile(projectile, trail)
		local moving_duration = 0.3
		local timer = 0
		local original_pos = projectile.transform.position

		while timer < moving_duration do
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = timer / moving_duration
			local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(original_pos, projectile_dest, progress)

			if progress > 0.5 and not is_time_mod_on then
				is_time_mod_on = true
				local arrow_time_factor = self.time_mod_factor.arrow_moving
				time_util.mod(arrow_time_factor.key, arrow_time_factor.scale)
			end

			projectile.transform.position = current_pos
			trail.transform.position = current_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local projectile, trail = rotate_projectile()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bow_shot_11')
	update_projectile(projectile, trail)

	projectile:Dispose()
	projectile = nil

	trail:Dispose()
	trail = nil
end

--@region 케이든 AI


---region 안드로이드 미니 이벤트 컨트롤러 용

-- 미니 이벤트 클리어 정보 저장
function local_class:save_mini_event_cleared_state(mini_event_id)
	self.mini_event_save_state = self.mini_event_save_state | (1 << mini_event_id)

	quest_util.set_custom_state(
		self.quest_progress,
		self.mini_event_save_state_key,
		self.mini_event_save_state
	)

	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
		if self:get_num_following_npcs() >= 8 then
			yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self)
		end
	end
end

-- 미니 이벤트 클리어 했는지
function local_class:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(mini_event_id)
	local bit_id = 1 << mini_event_id
	return (self.mini_event_save_state & bit_id) == bit_id
end

-- 미니 이벤트 클리어 이후 공용 연출
function local_class:reaction_on_mini_event_clear(num_androids)
	-- 해당 이벤트는 스테이지 클리어 후 재생하지 않습니다.
	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete or self:is_stage_cleared() then
		return
	end

	-- 합류대사 이벤트
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local num_of_joined_androids = self:get_num_following_npcs() + num_androids

	-- 케이든AI(idle,idle): 이제 N명의 안드로이드가 모였군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, nil, nil,
		{ key = {'qs_sector_ds_android_join_1', num_of_joined_androids }, skip = true })
	if num_of_joined_androids < 8 then
		-- 케이든AI(idle,idle): 앞으로 (8-N)명만 모은다면, 마빈님께 맞설 수 있습니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = {'qs_sector_ds_android_join_2', 8 - num_of_joined_androids }, skip = true })
	else
		-- 8명 이상의 안드로이드를 수집할 경우 2번째 대사 변경
		-- 케이든AI(attack,idle): 이 정도의 안드로이드들이라면 마빈님께 맞설 수 있습니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, nil, 'attack', 'qs_sector_ds_android_join_3')
	end
end

function local_class:is_stage_cleared()
	return user_progress:IsStageCleared('queencastle_1_5')
end

---@endregion

function local_class:save_jerico_clues_acquisition_by_idx_async(idx)
	local binary_data = 1 << idx
	local current_acquisition_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.jerico_android_custom_state_key)
	if (current_acquisition_state ~= nil and current_acquisition_state ~= -1) then
		binary_data = binary_data | current_acquisition_state
	end

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.jerico_android_custom_state_key, binary_data)
end

function local_class:has_acquired_jerico_clues_by_idx(idx)
	local binary_data = 1 << idx
	local current_acquisition_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.jerico_android_custom_state_key)

	return (current_acquisition_state ~= -1) and (current_acquisition_state & binary_data) == binary_data
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	-- 안드로이드 날리기

	self.get_wind_fan = function(idx)

		local dead_mountain_data = {
			{vector(0, 0, 0), nil},
			{vector(0.4, 0, 0.25), 30},
			{vector(1, 0, 0.25), nil},
			{vector(1.5, 0, 0.2), nil},
			{vector(0.1, 0, 0.5), 15},
			{vector(1.5, 0, 0.7), -15},
			{vector(0.5, 0, 0.9), 15},
			{vector(0.8, 0, 0), nil},
			{vector(0.75, 0.5, 0.25), nil},
			{vector(1.25, 0.5, 0.25), -15},
			{vector(0.75, 0.5, 0.75), nil},
			{vector(1.25, 0.3, 0.7), nil},
			--
			{vector(2, 0, 0), nil},
			{vector(2.4, 0, 0.25), 30},
			{vector(3, 0, 0.25), nil},
			{vector(3.5, 0, 0.2), nil},

		for dead_ai_member_idx = 1, self.party_count do

	self:place_androids_on_stage_load()
	self:set_quest_marker()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	
	self:remove_quest_marker()
	
	-- 입구를 막는 npc 동적할당 해제
	if not (self.worker_list == nil) then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.worker_list)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end
