function local_class:on_zone_enter(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.available_zone_names.first_encounter) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.first_encounter_with_desert_slave_async, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local fan_1 = self.get_wind_fan(1)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, fan_1) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'wind_fan_start_rotation' then
			self:remove_quest_marker()
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'wind_fan_end_rotation' then
			if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(fan_1.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable().searching_bounds,
					self.fan_check_ai_pos)
					and (not self.air_spin_flag) then
				self.air_spin_flag = true
				start_coroutine(self.air_spin_ai, self, self.worker_list, fan_1.Direction, idx)
			end
		end
	end
end

--region 날리기
function local_class:air_spin_ai(target, direction)
	local dist = 8
	local spin_pos

	-- 날아가는 위치 확인
	if CS.Oak.Direction.Right == direction then
		spin_pos = vector(dist, 0, 0)
	elseif CS.Oak.Direction.Left == direction then
		spin_pos = vector(-dist, 0, 0)
	elseif CS.Oak.Direction.Up == direction then
		spin_pos = vector(0, 0, dist)
	elseif CS.Oak.Direction.Down == direction then
		spin_pos = vector(0, 0, -dist)
	end

	-- 안드로이드 시체 그룹 날리기 (android_5을 만나면 true)
	for idx = 1, self.party_count do
		character_util.shake(target['s1_dead_ai_'..idx], 0.05, 1)
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 안드로이드 시체 그룹 날리기 (android_5을 만나면 true)
	for idx = 1, self.party_count do
		character_util.air_spin(target['s1_dead_ai_'..idx], { offset = spin_pos })
	end
end

--- 세뇌된 마빈과 처음 만나는 연출 로직
function local_class:first_encounter_with_desert_slave_async()
	local guardian = user_party.Leader
	local desert_slave = self.controller.get_desert_slave_helmet()
	local hero_ai = self.controller.get_hero_ai()
	local android_1 = self.controller.get_android_by_idx(1)
	local android_1_head = self.controller.get_head_only_android_by_idx(1)
	local android_1_body = self.controller.get_body_only_android_by_idx(1)
	local android_list = self.controller.get_androids_for_count(12)
	local other_androids = table_util.filter(android_list, function(android)
		return lua_helper.reference_equals(android, android_1)
	end)

	if is_unity_null(desert_slave) then
		logger_util.error("Cannot find marvin!")
		return
	end

	if is_unity_null(hero_ai) then
		logger_util.error("Cannot find kaden!")
		return
	end

	if is_unity_null(android_1) or is_unity_null(android_1_head) or is_unity_null(android_1_body) then
		logger_util.error("Cannot find one of following characters: android_1, android_1_head, android_1_body")
		return
	end

	-- 이벤트 시작과 동시에 bgm 볼륨 0.5
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	-- 가디언과 케이든은 1초간 각자 위치로 걸어간다.
	-- 동시에 카메라도 마빈이 등장할 위치로 1초에 걸쳐서 포커스 이동.
	local align_duration = 1
	local marvin_first_encounter_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('first_encounter_desert_slave_pos_1')
	self:guardian_and_kaden_align_at_first_encounter_room(guardian, hero_ai, align_duration)
	camera_util.move_async(marvin_first_encounter_align_pos, align_duration)

	-- 0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 검게 틴트가 된 마빈이 위에서 떨어지며 등장한다.
	character_util.hide_weapon(desert_slave, true)
	self:desert_slave_hero_landing(desert_slave, marvin_first_encounter_align_pos)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 마빈이 일어서면서 마빈의 모습이 드러난다.
	do
		-- 0.5초에 걸쳐서 틴트 해제.
		local removing_tint_duration = 0.5
		character_util.remove_color(desert_slave, self.character_tint_key_list.veiled, removing_tint_duration)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(desert_slave)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

		-- 카메라 0.3초만에 원 사이즈로 줌 아웃.
		-- 카메라 쉐이크 0.3초, 세기 0.1
		local camera_play_duration = 0.3
		camera_util.resize_to_default(camera_play_duration)
		camera_util.shake(0.1, camera_play_duration)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 카메라 포커스 방 중앙으로 1초에 걸쳐서 이동
	do
		-- 카메라 1.25배 사이즈로 줌 아웃.
		local room_center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('first_encounter_room_center')
		local camera_play_duration = 1
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, camera_play_duration)
		camera_util.move_async(room_center_pos, camera_play_duration)
	end

	-- 선택지: 마빈?(초록)
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_sector_ds_s1_choose_0', 'mercy', function()
			-- 가디언 question 이모티콘
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
			character_util.normal_jump(guardian, true)
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(guardian, nil, 'notice')
		end },
	})

	-- 가디언이 왼쪽 오브젝트 뒤쪽으로 숨는다.
	do
		-- 속도 5로 이동
		-- 최종 위치에서 up, idle
		-- up, idle
		local guardian_move_dist = vector(-2.5, 0, 0)
		local guardian_move_duration = nil
		local guardian_move_speed = 5
		character_util.move_distance_async(guardian, guardian_move_dist, guardian_move_duration, guardian_move_speed,
				true, true)
		scene_util.set_direction(guardian, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(guardian, self, 'attack')
	end

	-- 케이든
	-- AI(left, attack, release) : 오오, 저 분이 마빈님!
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'up', 'release', nil, 'qc_sector_ds_s1_2')

	-- 가디언 right, attack, release 2회
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction(guardian, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(guardian, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(guardian, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	-- 케이든AI attack, nod 1회
	scene_util.set_anim_async(hero_ai, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	-- 케이든AI 오른쪽 장애물 뒤로 숨는다.
	do
		local move_dist = vector(2.5, 0, 0)
		local duration = 0.5
		local wp_list = { hero_ai.Position + move_dist }
		local wp_data = {
			last_direction = 'up',
			end_callback = function()
				scene_util.set_direction(guardian, 'up')
			end
		}

		wp_util.move(hero_ai, wp_list, nil, duration, wp_data)
	end

	-- 마빈이 1초에 걸쳐 아래로 2칸 걸어오며, 카메라 포커스도 위로 1칸 이동한다.
	do
		local desert_slave_move_dist = vector(0, 0, -2)
		local desert_slave_move_duration = 1
		local desert_slave_camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('first_encounter_room_center')

		character_util.move_distance(desert_slave, desert_slave_move_dist, desert_slave_move_duration, nil, true, true)
		camera_util.move_async(desert_slave_camera_pos, desert_slave_move_duration)
	end

	-- 마빈(down, idle, idle) : 쥐새끼는?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(desert_slave, 'qc_sector_ds_s1_3')

	do
		local function android_1_walk_out(android_1)
			local android_1_move_dist = vector(0, 0, 2)
			local android_1_move_duration = 0.5
			character_util.move_distance_async(android_1, android_1_move_dist, android_1_move_duration, nil, true, true)
		end

		local function camera_focusing_to_desert_slave(desert_slave, move_duration)
			camera_util.move_async(desert_slave.Position, move_duration)
		end

		wait_all({
			-- 가장 왼쪽 앞열에 서 있는 안드로이드(안1)가 0.5초에 걸쳐 앞으로 2칸 걸어나온다.
			util.cs_generator(android_1_walk_out, android_1),

			-- 걸어나오면서 카메라도 0.5초만에 마빈 있는 곳으로 포커스 이동.
			util.cs_generator(camera_focusing_to_desert_slave, desert_slave, 0.5)
		})
	end

	-- 안1(right, idle) : 아직 못 찾았습니다.
	-- 마빈 left, idle, idle로 전환.
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'left')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, 'right', nil, nil, 'qc_sector_ds_s1_4')

	-- 마빈 down, idle, idle로 … 이모티콘
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'down')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(desert_slave, nil, 'silence')

	-- 안1(attack, bomb_idle) : 지금의 수색 방식은 비효율적입니다, 휴먼.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_1, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, 'right', 'bomb_idle', 'attack', 'qc_sector_ds_s1_5')

	-- 안1(attack, cast2) : 벌써 몇 시간 째 쉬지도 못하고 수색작업만 진행중입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, 'right', 'cast2', 'attack', 'qc_sector_ds_s1_5_1')

	local desert_slave_pos_before_hitting_android = desert_slave.Position
	do
		local function desert_slave_moving_toward()
			-- 마빈이 안드로이드 앞으로 2초에 걸쳐 걸어간다.
			-- 안1 대사 끝나지 않았어도 도착하는 즉시 마빈 다음 행동 진행.
			-- 동시에 카메라 포커스도 안1과 마빈의 중앙 지점으로 1초만에 이동.
			local next_to_android = android_1.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 0)
			local desert_slave_move_duration = 2

			camera_util.move(android_1.Position, desert_slave_move_duration)
			character_util.move_to_async(desert_slave, next_to_android, desert_slave_move_duration, nil, true, true)
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(android_1)
		end

		local function android_1_complaining()
			-- 안1(release) : 적절한 휴식이 주어지지 않으면…
			scene_util.set_anim(android_1, self, 'release')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(android_1, { key = 'qc_sector_ds_s1_6', bubble_type = 'normal' })
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_1)
		end

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(android_1_complaining),
			util.cs_generator(desert_slave_moving_toward)
		})
	end

	--마빈이 안1을 때리기 시작한다.
	self:desert_slave_palcon_punching_android_async(desert_slave, android_1, android_1_head, android_1_body, other_androids, desert_slave_pos_before_hitting_android)

	-- 마빈(idle, idle) : 하고 싶은 말 있는 녀석 또 있나?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(desert_slave, 'qc_sector_ds_s1_7')

	-- 1초 대기.
	-- 이 때, 안1 머리 shake 0.3초
	character_util.shake(android_1_head, 0.03, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local head_only_android_1 = self.controller.get_head_only_android_by_idx(1)
	local body_only_android_1 = self.controller.get_body_only_android_by_idx(1)
	self:android_1_trolling_desert_slave_async(desert_slave, head_only_android_1, body_only_android_1, other_androids)

	-- 안1 머리 대사 시작하고 0.2초 뒤에,
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 마빈이 안1 머리를 차서 왼쪽 그리드 바깥으로 날려버린다.
	do

		local function pre_callback()
			-- 날아가는 동안 안드로이드 전원 + 가디언, 케이든, 마빈 left.
			local turn_left_group = { guardian, hero_ai, desert_slave, table.unpack(other_androids, 1, #other_androids) }

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')

			-- 안드로이드 전원 scared.
			scene_util.set_group_emotion(other_androids, self, 'scared')
			-- 가디언 surprise.
			scene_util.set_emotion(guardian, self, 'surprise')
			-- 케이든 attack
			scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, 'attack')
			-- 마빈 idle
			character_util.remove_emotion(desert_slave)

			character_util.set_group_direction(turn_left_group, 'left')
		end

		local function post_callback()
			-- 그리드 바깥으로 사라지면 다시 안드로이드 전원 + 가디언, 케이든 up.
			local turn_up_group = { guardian, hero_ai, table.unpack(other_androids, 1, #other_androids) }
			character_util.set_group_direction(turn_up_group, 'up')
		end

		self:desert_slave_kick_android_head_async(desert_slave, android_1_head, android_1_body, pre_callback, post_callback)
		character_util.remove_anim(desert_slave)
	end

	-- 이후, 마빈 대사 및 연출 진행되는 동안 안1 몸은 5의 속도로 걸어서 머리쪽으로 퇴장한다.
	local function android_body_runs_away(android_body)
		local move_speed = 5
		local bumping_at_wall_pos = android_body.Position - vector(4.5, 0, 0)

		scene_util.set_anim(android_body, self, 'run')
		character_util.move_to_async(android_body, bumping_at_wall_pos, nil, move_speed)

		-- 이펙트 fx_hit
		local effect_builder = self.controller.effect_builder.new()
		effect_builder:set_position(android_body.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0)):create(self.controller.effect_name_cache.hit)

		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				'linear', true, vector(1, 0, 0), nil, nil,
				nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
				CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_knockback_wall_01')
		command_util.publish_knock_back(android_body.Owner, android_body, knock_back_info, android_body.Position)

		-- 0.5초간 damaged 애니메이션으로 대기.
		scene_util.set_anim(android_body, self, { name = 'damaged', loop = false })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		local android_body_wp_list = {
			android_body.Position - vector(0, 0, 2),
			android_body.Position - vector(6, 0, 2)
		}

		-- 이후, 다시 이동 시작.
		scene_util.set_anim(android_body, self, 'run')
		wp_util.move_async(android_body, android_body_wp_list, move_speed, nil)

		character_util.set_active_state(android_body, 'disabled')
	end

	start_coroutine(android_body_runs_away, android_1_body)

	-- 카메라 포커스 1초에 걸쳐 다시 마빈에게로 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(desert_slave.Position, 1)

	-- 마빈(left, doyagao, idle) : 더… 할 말은 없겠지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(desert_slave, self, 'down', nil, 'doyagao', 'qc_sector_ds_s1_11')

	-- 안드로이드 전원 shake 다시 시작.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	self:start_shake_androids_eternally(other_androids, 0.05)

	-- 5, 6, 3, 8은 cast로 애니메이션 변경.
	local casting_androids = { other_androids[3], other_androids[5], other_androids[6], other_androids[8] }
	scene_util.set_group_anim(casting_androids, self, 'cast')

	-- 0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 가디언 찾아로라 명령 내림
	self:desert_slave_give_androids_order(desert_slave, other_androids)

	-- 안드로이드들 퇴장 시작과 동시에 가디언은 left, 케이든AI은 right 바라보며 attack, idle.
	character_util.set_direction(guardian, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'right')
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ guardian, hero_ai }, self, 'attack')

	-- 안드로이드 전원 속도 8로 퇴장
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	self:androids_leaving_async(other_androids)

	-- 안드로이드들이 전부 화면에서 사라진 후, 마빈이 위로 퇴장한다.
	local desert_slave_leavnig_dist = vector(0, 0, 8)
	-- 속도 6으로 퇴장.
	local desert_slave_leaving_speed = 6
	character_util.move_distance_async(desert_slave, desert_slave_leavnig_dist, nil, desert_slave_leaving_speed, true, true)

	character_util.hide_weapon(desert_slave, false)

	-- 이후, 가디언과 케이든 방 중앙으로 1초에 걸쳐 걸어온다.
	local room_center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('first_encounter_room_center')
	self:guardian_and_hero_ai_move_to_room_center(guardian, hero_ai, room_center_pos)
	self:hero_ai_talking_about_desert_slave(guardian, hero_ai)
end

	wp_util.move_async(hero_ai, hero_ai_wp_to_center, nil, moving_to_center_duration)

---@param desert_slave character 마빈
---@param android character 마빈에게 주먹으로 맞는
---@param other_androids array
---@param original_pos vector
function local_class:desert_slave_palcon_punching_android_async(desert_slave, android, android_1_head, android_1_body, other_androids, original_pos)
	-- 마빈이 안1을 때리기 시작한다.

	local origianl_zoom_out_size = 5

	local desert_slave_data = {
		anim = 'attack',
		character = desert_slave
	}

	local android_data = {
		anim = 'damaged',
		emo = 'damaged',
		character = android
	}

	-- 첫번째 펀치
	self:desert_slave_punch_async(desert_slave_data, android_data, origianl_zoom_out_size * 0.9,
	-- before_cb 콜백
			nil,

	-- punched_cb 콜백
			function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

				--나머지 안드로이드 전원 마빈쪽을 바라본다.
				-- 안 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8은 left.
				local turn_left_android_group = {
					other_androids[1],
					other_androids[2],
					other_androids[3],
					other_androids[5],
					other_androids[6],
					other_androids[7]
				}
				-- 안 5 는 up.
				local turn_up_anrdroid_group = {
					other_androids[4]
				}
				character_util.set_group_direction(turn_left_android_group, 'left')
				character_util.set_group_direction(turn_up_anrdroid_group, 'up')
			end
	)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 두번째 펀치
	desert_slave_data.anim = 'attack2'
	android_data.anim = 'damaged2'
	self:desert_slave_punch_async(desert_slave_data, android_data, origianl_zoom_out_size * 0.8, nil, function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	end)


	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 세번째 펀치
	desert_slave_data.anim = 'attack3'
	android_data.anim = 'dead'
	android_data.sound = '02_twohand_stomp_01'

	self:desert_slave_punch_async(desert_slave_data, android_data, origianl_zoom_out_size * 0.7, nil, function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_01')

		-- 카메라 줌아웃 0.2초만에 원 사이즈로 줌아웃.
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(origianl_zoom_out_size, 0.2)

		-- 나머지 안드로이드 전원 scared 표정.
		scene_util.set_group_emotion(other_androids, self, 'scared')

		-- 안드로이드1 카메라 위쪽 바깥으로 0.3초만에 사라진다.
		character_util.move_distance_async(android, vector(0, 9, 0), 0.3)
	end)

	-- 하늘 위로 올라간 안드로이드 비활성화
	character_util.set_active_state(android, 'disabled')

	-- 마빈 1초간 원래 자리로 걸어 돌아온다.
	-- 동시에 카메라도 1초에 걸쳐서 마빈 도착지점으로 포커스 이동
	camera_util.move(original_pos, 1)
	character_util.move_to_async(desert_slave, original_pos, 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'down')

	-- 마빈 이동 끝나면, 안1 제외 나머지 안드로이드 전원 up으로 방향 전환.
	for idx = 1, #other_androids do
		scene_util.set_direction(other_androids[idx], 'up', false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 안드로이드 몸만 left, dead로 먼저 떨어진다.
	-- 360도 회전하면서 떨어진다.
	scene_util.set_direction(android_1_body, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(android_1_body, self, { name = 'dead', scale = 5 })
	character_util.set_position(android_1_body, android.Position)
	character_util.set_position(android_1_head, android_1_body.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(android_1_head, 'right')
	character_util.set_active_state(android_1_body, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(android_1_head, 'enabled')

	-- 동시에 안드로이드들 전원 shake 0.05 시작.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	local effect_builder = self.controller.effect_builder.new()
	self:start_shake_androids_eternally(other_androids, 0.05)
	character_util.spine_rotate(android_1_body, 360, 0.6)
	self:android_part_falling_from_sky(android_1_body, 0.6, effect_builder)

	-- 이후, 안드로이드 머리가 떨어진다.
	-- 360도 회전하면서 떨어진다.
	character_util.spine_rotate(android_1_head, 360, 0.9)
	self:android_part_falling_from_sky(android_1_head, 0.6, effect_builder, '01_trip_01')
	character_util.jump_move(android_1_head, android_1_body.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 2, 0.3)
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_1_head, self, 'damaged')
end

--마빈이 주먹으로 무언가를 치는 연출
---@param before_cb function? 안드로이드가 마빈 펀치에 맞기 전에 호출할 콜백
---@param punched_cb function? 안드로이드가 마빈 펀치에 맞는 순간 호출할 콜백
---@param after_cb function? 안드로이드가 마빈 펀치에 맞고 난 뒤 호출할 콜백
function local_class:desert_slave_punch_async(desert_slave_data, android_data, cam_size, before_cb, punched_cb, after_cb)
	local ds_anim = desert_slave_data.anim
	local ds_emo = 'attack'
	local desert_slave = desert_slave_data.character

	local and_anim = android_data.anim
	local and_emo = android_data.emo
	local android = android_data.character

	-- 카메라 사이즈 기본 사이즈의 0.75배로 줌인 0.3초만에.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(cam_size, 0.3)

	if before_cb ~= nil then
		before_cb()
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = ds_anim, loop = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(desert_slave, self, ds_emo)

	-- 0.3 초 후
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 0.2초간 타임스케일 0.2배속으로 슬로우.
	-- 애니메이션 실행 직후, 0.2초 간 타임스케일 0.2배속으로 슬로우 후 제거
	local mod_factor = self.time_mod_factor.marvin_punch
	time_util.mod(mod_factor.key, mod_factor.scale)

	-- 안드로이드 반응 틀어줌.
	self.controller:android_get_damaged(android, and_anim, and_emo)
	if punched_cb ~= nil then
		punched_cb()
	end


	-- 카메라 줌아웃 0.2초만에 원 사이즈로 줌아웃.
	time_util.unmod(mod_factor.key)

	if after_cb ~= nil then
		after_cb()
	end
end

--- 마빈이 안드로이드 머리를 발로 차는 연출
---@param desert_slave character 마빈
---@param head_only character 머리만 남아있는 안드로이드
---@param pre_callback function 머리가 날아가는 로직 실행전에 호출되어야하는 콜백
---@param post_callback function 모든 연출이 완료된 후 실행되어야하는 콜백
function local_class:desert_slave_kick_android_head_async(desert_slave, head_only, body_only, pre_callback, post_callback)
	if is_unity_null(desert_slave) then
		logger_util.error("Param: desert_slave was expected, nil was passsed")
		return
	end

	if is_unity_null(head_only) then
		logger_util.error("Param: head_only was expected, nil was passsed")
		return
	end

	if is_unity_null(body_only) then
		logger_util.error("Param: body_only was expected, nil was passsed")
		return
	end

	-- 	마빈이 안1 머리를 차서 왼쪽 그리드 바깥으로 날려버린다.
	-- 마빈 gauntlet_kick 애니메이션
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(head_only)
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false, sfx_name = '02_explosion_kick_01' })

	-- 애니메이션 시작 0.167초 후, 안1 머리에 fx_hit, fx_lasthit, 왼쪽으로 포물선 운동하며 그리드 바깥으로 1초에 걸쳐 날아간다.
	wait_for_sec(0.167)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)
	local effect_builder = self.controller.effect_builder.new()
	local effect_spawn_pos = head_only.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0)
	effect_builder:set_position(effect_spawn_pos):create(self.controller.effect_name_cache.lasthit)
	effect_builder:set_position(effect_spawn_pos):create(self.controller.effect_name_cache.hit)

	-- 머리가 날아가는 연출이 실행 되기전에 실행 되어야하는 로직 있다면 실행
	if pre_callback ~= nil then
		pre_callback()
	end

	do
		local total_duration = 1

		local function head_only_curve_move()
			-- 안1 몸은 embarrassed 애니메이션.
			scene_util.set_anim(body_only, self, 'embarrassed')

			local target_curve_height = 8
			local timer = 0
			local start_pos = head_only.Position
			local end_pos = head_only.Position - vector(15, 0, 0)

			while timer < total_duration do
				local progress = timer / total_duration
				local current_height = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * target_curve_height
				local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
						+ unity_class.vector3.up * current_height

				character_util.set_position(head_only, current_pos)

				-- 안1 머리는 날아가는 동안 540도 회전.
				head_only.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -540 * progress)

				timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end

		local function cameara_following()
			-- 안1 머리 날아가는 1초 동안 카메라도 왼쪽으로 2칸 포커스 이동.
			local next_camera_pos = desert_slave.Position - vector(2, 0, 0)
			camera_util.move_async(next_camera_pos, total_duration)
		end

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(head_only_curve_move),
			util.cs_generator(cameara_following)
		})
	end

	if post_callback ~= nil then
		post_callback()
	end
end

---마빈이 안드로이드들에게 가디언 찾아오라고 명령 내리는 연출
function local_class:desert_slave_give_androids_order(desert_slave, other_androids)
	-- 마빈 down으로 전환.
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'down')

	-- 카메라 포커스도 1초에 걸쳐 안드로이드들의 중앙 지점으로 이동.
	local center_of_androids_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('first_encounter_room_center')
	camera_util.move_async(center_of_androids_pos, 1)

	-- 마빈(down, idle) : 가디언을 공격하려는 그 더러운 인베이더 놈…
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(desert_slave)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(desert_slave, self, 'down', nil, nil, 'qc_sector_ds_s1_12')

	-- 마빈(attack, cast2) : 그 놈을 당장 잡아서 내 눈앞에 데려놓지 않는다면…
	-- 다음 대사 시작하기 전까지 마빈 shake 0.05
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(desert_slave, self, 'down', 'cast2', 'attack', 'qc_sector_ds_s1_13')
	character_util.stop_shake(desert_slave)

	-- 대사 시작과 동시에
	do
		-- 카메라 shake 0.3초, 세기 0.1
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		-- 안드로이드 2, 4, 7 제자리에서 점프 1회
		local jumping_androids = { other_androids[2], other_androids[4], other_androids[7] }
		character_util.group_normal_jump(jumping_androids, true)

		-- 안드로이드 전원 cast로 애니메이션 변경.
		scene_util.set_group_anim(other_androids, self, 'cast')
	end
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			-- 마빈(attack, jingak) : 네 녀석들부터 모조리 박살내주마!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(desert_slave, self, 'down', nil, 'attack', 'qc_sector_ds_s1_14')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			-- jingak 애니메이션도 다 끝나고, 대사도 다 끝나야 다음으로 진행.
			scene_util.set_anim_async(desert_slave, self, { name = 'jingak', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		end)
	})

	-- 카메라 shake 0.3초, 세기 0.1

function local_class:androids_leaving_async(other_androids)
	if other_androids == nil or #other_androids == 0 then
		logger_util.error("param: other_androids was expected not to be nil or size of 0")
		return
	end

	local function leaving_left_routine(androids, dest_list, speed)
		for i = 1, #androids do
			if i < #androids then
				character_util.move_to(androids[i], dest_list[i], nil, speed, true, true)
			else
				character_util.move_to_async(androids[i], dest_list[i], nil, speed, true, true)
			end
		end
	end

	local function leaving_right_routine(androids, before_jump_dest, speed, final_dests)
		-- 안드로이드들의 z 좌표만 살려서 이동하도록

		local function leaving_right_impl(android, before_jump_dest, speed, final_dest)
			local jump_height = 2
			local android_before_jump_dest = vector(before_jump_dest.x, 0, android.Position.z)
			character_util.move_to_async(android, android_before_jump_dest, nil, speed, true, true)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			-- 퇴장할 때, 링크 도어 점프해서 넘어감.
			scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'get')
			character_util.jump_move(android, final_dest, speed, jump_height)
			character_util.move_to_async(android, final_dest, nil, speed, true, true)
		end

		local leaving_right_coroutines = {}
		for i = 1, #androids do
			local android = androids[i]
			local final_dest = final_dests[i]
			local coroutine = util.cs_generator(leaving_right_impl, android, before_jump_dest, speed, final_dest)
			table.insert(leaving_right_coroutines, coroutine)
		end

		wait_all(leaving_right_coroutines)
	end

	local android_leaving_speed = 8

	-- shake 전부 중지.
	self:stop_shake_androids(other_androids)

	-- 표정 scared로 이동.
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(other_androids, self, 'scared')

	local leaving_left_group = { other_androids[1], other_androids[4], other_androids[5] }
	local leaving_right_group = { other_androids[2], other_androids[3], other_androids[6], other_androids[7] }

	-- 2, 5, 6은 좌측으로 퇴장
	local leaving_dist = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', vector(0, 0, 0))
	local leaving_left_dests = {
		leaving_left_group[1].Position - leaving_dist,
		leaving_left_group[2].Position - leaving_dist,
		leaving_left_group[3].Position - leaving_dist
	}

	-- 3, 4, 7, 8은 우측으로 퇴장.
	leaving_dist = vector(8, 0, 0)
	local leaving_dest_before_jump_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('first_encoutner_android_right_group_before_jump')
	local leaving_right_dest_factor = 1.5
	local leaving_right_dests = {
		leaving_right_group[1].Position + leaving_dist * leaving_right_dest_factor,
		leaving_right_group[2].Position + leaving_dist * leaving_right_dest_factor,
		leaving_right_group[3].Position + leaving_dist * leaving_right_dest_factor,
		leaving_right_group[4].Position + leaving_dist * leaving_right_dest_factor,
	}

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(leaving_left_routine, leaving_left_group, leaving_left_dests, android_leaving_speed),
		util.cs_generator(leaving_right_routine, leaving_right_group, leaving_dest_before_jump_pos, android_leaving_speed, leaving_right_dests)
	})

	-- 전원 비활성화
	character_util.set_group_active_state(other_androids, 'disabled')
end

-- 안드로이드 파츠가 하늘에서 바닥으로 떨어지는 연출
---@param android_part character 바닥으로 떨어질 안드로이드 파츠
---@param start_pos vector 파츠가 떨어질 좌표
---@param height number 파츠가 떨어지는 높이 (default: 0)
---@param fall_duration number 파츠가 떨어지는 시간 (default: 1)
function local_class:android_part_falling_from_sky(android_part, fall_duration, effect_builder, sound)
	fall_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(fall_duration, 1)
	if is_unity_null(android_part) then
		logger_util.error("Param: android_part was expected, nil was passed")
		return
	end

	local height = android_part.Position.y
	local dest_pos = android_part.Position - vector(0, height, 0)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = android_part.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, android_part.Position.y, 0)
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
			character_util.set_position(android_part, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(android_part, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 땅에 닿는 순간 이펙트 fx_hit
	if sound ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sound)
	end

	character_util.set_position(android_part, dest_pos)
	effect_builder:set_position(android_part.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0)):create(self.controller.effect_name_cache.hit)

	-- damaged 이모션.
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_part, self, 'damaged')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

	free_fall:Dispose()
end

		desert_slave_boss_room = 'boss_room_entrance',
		android_talk_puzzle_area = 'android_talk_puzzle_area'
	}

	-- 첫 번째 안드로이드 퀘스트 이벤트 마커
	self.first_android_event_marker = 'first_android_event'
	self.android_event_marker = 'android_event_marker'

	-- 도망자 안드로이드 독백 연출이 출력 중인지
	self.is_refugee_android_monologue_playing = false
	self.keep_playing_refugee_android_monologue = true

	-- 도망자 안드로이드 구역 문 이름
	self.refugee_switch_name = 'android_talk_puzzle_switch_'
	self.has_seen_refugee_sp_event = false

	-- 포탈이 나타났는지 확인하는 상태
	self.is_portal_appeared = false

	self.refugee_switch_status = {
		['android_talk_puzzle_switch_1'] = false,
		['android_talk_puzzle_switch_2'] = false,

		is_both_stepped_on = function(self)
			return self['android_talk_puzzle_switch_1'] and self['android_talk_puzzle_switch_2']
		end
	}

	-- 도망자 안드로이드 가져오는 함수
	function self.get_refugee_androids()
		local androids = {}
		local android_name = 'refugee_android_'
		for i = 1, 4 do
			table.insert(androids, get_character(android_name .. i))
		end

		return androids
	end

	function self.are_refugee_doors_opened()
		local top_door = get_field_object('android_talk_puzzle_door_1')
		local bottom_door = get_field_object('android_talk_puzzle_door_2')

		-- Guard Clausure
		if top_door == nil or bottom_door == nil then
			return true
		end

		return top_door.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpen and bottom_door.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpen
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')

	self.controller.mini_event_controller:enter()

	-- 보스 필드 설정
	self.controller:set_boss_room_field()

	-- 도망자 안드로이드 처리
	self:set_refugee_androids_to_initial_state()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.controller.mini_event_controller:start()

	if self:are_refugee_doors_opened() and not self.has_seen_refugee_sp_event then
		self.has_seen_refugee_sp_event = true
	end

	if not self.controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(1) then
		return
	end

	-- 안드로이드 머리에 마커 표시
	local portal_active_state 
		= quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'hidden_portal_appeared') == 1

	if not self.are_refugee_doors_opened() then
		local quest_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('me1_finish_marker_pos')
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point('me1_finish_key', 332, true, quest_marker_pos)
	elseif not self.controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(3) then
		local me3_androids_1 = field_util.get_marker_pos('me3_android_3_pos_1')
		local me3_androids_2 = field_util.get_marker_pos('me3_android_4_pos_1')

		local marker_pos = (me3_androids_1 + me3_androids_2) / 2
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(
			self.android_event_marker,
			self.controller.main_quest_id,
			true,
			marker_pos
		)
	elseif not portal_active_state then
		local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('portal_pos_1')
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point('portal_guide_marker', 332, true, marker_pos)
	else
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo('qc_ds_link_door', 332, true, 
			get_field_object('link_door_switch_1'))
	end

	self.controller:start_desert_slave_beating_android()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))

	self.controller:stop_desert_slave_beating_android()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local switch_name = e.SwitchObject.Name

	if string.match(switch_name, self.refugee_switch_name) == nil then
		return
	end

	self.refugee_switch_status[switch_name] = e.IsTurningOn

	if self.refugee_switch_status:is_both_stepped_on() and not self.has_seen_refugee_sp_event then
		self.has_seen_refugee_sp_event = true
		self.keep_playing_refugee_android_monologue = false

		sp_util.start_scene(self.refugee_androids_run_away, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.available_zone_names.desert_slave_boss_room) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.entered_desert_slave_boss_room_async, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.available_zone_names.android_talk_puzzle_area) then
		if self.are_refugee_doors_opened() then
			return
		end

		if self.is_refugee_android_monologue_playing then
			return
		end

		start_coroutine(self.android_monologue, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.available_zone_names.android_talk_puzzle_area) then
		self.keep_playing_refugee_android_monologue = false
		self:set_refugee_androids_to_initial_state()
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:entered_desert_slave_boss_room_async()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	local desert_slave = self.controller.get_desert_slave_helmet()
	local effect_builder = self.controller.effect_builder.new()
	local party = {
		guardian = user_party.Leader,
		hero_ai = self.controller.get_hero_ai()
	}

	-- TODO: 중복 너무 심함. 리팩토링 할 것!
	local androids = self.controller:get_following_npcs()

	local characters = { party.guardian, party.hero_ai, desert_slave, table.unpack(androids, 1, #androids)}
	local player_group = { party.guardian, party.hero_ai, table.unpack(androids, 1, #androids) }

	-- 파티원 정렬 연출 실행
	self.controller:align_characters_on_entered_boss_room_async(party.guardian, party.hero_ai, desert_slave)

	-- 마빈 돌진, 활쏘는 로직까지 실행.
	local desert_slave_dash_dist = vector(0, 0, -2.5)
	self.controller:desert_slave_dash_async(party, desert_slave, desert_slave_dash_dist, effect_builder, nil)

	--- 따라다니는 안드로이드 없이 보스 방에 진입했을 경우의 연출
	if self.controller:get_num_following_npcs() == 0 then
		self:chicken_game_without_power_struggle(desert_slave, party.hero_ai, party.guardian, effect_builder)
	else
		self.controller:chicken_game_scene_with_power_struggle(desert_slave, party.hero_ai, party.guardian,
			effect_builder, self.power_struggle)
			
		self:power_struggle_losed(characters, effect_builder, party.guardian, desert_slave, player_group)
	end

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 마빈 left, gauntlet_victory1회. 굳은 채 유지.
	scene_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(desert_slave, self, { name = 'gauntlet_victory', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 카메라 포커스 0.5초에 걸쳐 가디언에게로
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 화면 1초에 걸쳐검게 서큘러 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self.keep_generating_effect = true
	self.controller:set_boss_room_field()
	self.controller:start_desert_slave_beating_android()
	self:reset_player_group(party.guardian, party.hero_ai)

	if not self.controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(1) then
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.first_android_event_marker, 332, true,
			self.controller.get_head_only_android_by_idx(1))
	end

	-- 0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'field', volume = 1})
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
end

function local_class:reset_player_group(guardian, hero_ai)
	local reset_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('first_encounter_room_center')
	local party = { guardian, hero_ai }

	character_util.spine_rotate(guardian, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(hero_ai, 0, 0)

	party_util.align_party(reset_pos, 'down', 0, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(party)

	local following_npcs = self.controller:get_following_npcs()
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(following_npcs)

	for i = 1, #following_npcs do
		character_util.spine_rotate(following_npcs[i], 0, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:set_refugee_androids_to_initial_state()
	-- 문짝 두 개가 둘다 열려있다면 아래꺼는 세팅 안하고 스킵함.
	if self.are_refugee_doors_opened() then
		return
	end

	local refugee_androids = self.get_refugee_androids()
	local android_init_pos_name = 'refugee_android_init_pos_'
	local androids_init_dir = { 'right', 'left', 'right', 'left' }
	local androids_init_anim = { 'dagger_idle', 'idle', 'cast', 'cast' }
	local androids_init_emo = { 'attack', 'scared', 'scared', 'scared' }

	for i = 1, #refugee_androids do
		local android = refugee_androids[i]
		character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(android, field_util.get_marker_pos(android_init_pos_name .. i))
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, androids_init_anim[i])
		scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, androids_init_emo[i])
		scene_util.set_direction(android, androids_init_dir[i])
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(android)
	end
end

function local_class:android_monologue()
	self.is_refugee_android_monologue_playing = true
	self.keep_playing_refugee_android_monologue = true

	local refugee_androids = self.get_refugee_androids()

	local current_index = 1
	local speecher_android_index_list = { 2, 1, 4, 3 }
	local speecher_android_anim_list = { 'bomb_idle', 'bomb_idle', 'release', 'cast' }
	local speecher_android_emo_list = { 'scared', 'attack', 'scared', 'scard' }
	local speacher_android_sound_list = { '03_dialogue_worker_01', nil, nil, '03_dialogue_worker_03' }

	local androids_init_anim = { 'dagger_idle', 'idle', 'cast', 'cast' }
	local androids_init_emo = { 'attack', 'scared', 'scared', 'scared' }

	local string_key = 'qc_sector_ds_refugee_android_'

	while self.keep_playing_refugee_android_monologue do
		local android_idx = speecher_android_index_list[current_index]
		local android = refugee_androids[speecher_android_index_list[current_index]]
		local anim = speecher_android_anim_list[current_index]
		local emo = speecher_android_emo_list[current_index]
		local bubble_data = { key = string_key .. current_index, skip = false }
		local sound = speacher_android_sound_list[current_index]

		if sound ~= nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sound)
		end
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, anim, emo, bubble_data)

		if not self.keep_playing_refugee_android_monologue then
			goto continue
		end

		local after_anim = androids_init_anim[android_idx]
		local after_emo = androids_init_emo[android_idx]

		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, after_anim)
		scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, after_emo)

		current_index = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(current_index + 1 > 4, 1, current_index + 1)

		::continue::
	end

	self.is_refugee_android_monologue_playing = false
	-- 가디언 퍼즐 풀지 않으면, 위 내용 무한 반복.
	-- 오른쪽으로 다시 나가면 루틴 중지.
	-- 다시 존엔터했을 때 처음부터 재생.
end

function local_class:refugee_androids_run_away()
	-- 앞선 공백 연출 대비해서 한 프레임 쉼
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	quest_marker_util.remove('me1_finish_key')

	local refugee_androids = self.get_refugee_androids()
	local party_align_pos = (refugee_androids[2].Position + refugee_androids[4].Position) / 2 + vector(2, 0, 0)
	party_util.align_party(party_align_pos, 'right', 1, 'arc')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	-- 로이드들 right, surprise, idle, jump 1회
	for i = 1, #refugee_androids do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(refugee_androids[i])
		character_util.remove_anim(refugee_androids[i])
		scene_util.set_direction(refugee_androids[i], 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(refugee_androids[i], self, 'surprise')
		if i ~= #refugee_androids then
			character_util.normal_jump(refugee_androids[i], '01_player_jump_01')
		else
			character_util.normal_jump_async(refugee_androids[i], '01_player_jump_01')
		end
	end

	-- 가디언 smile, idle, question 이모티콘
	scene_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, self, 'smile')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')

	-- 안1(scared, embarrassed) : 새… 새로운 인간…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(refugee_androids[1], self, nil,
		'embarrassed', 'scared', 'qc_sector_ds_refugee_android_5')

	-- 안2(scared, release, jump 2회) : 마빈이 보낸 사람일지도 모릅니다!
	character_util.normal_double_jump(refugee_androids[2], '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(refugee_androids[2], self, nil,
		'release', 'scared', 'qc_sector_ds_refugee_android_6')

	-- 안3(scared, embarrassed) : 도… 도망쳐야 합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(refugee_androids[3], self, nil,
		'embarrassed', 'scared', 'qc_sector_ds_refugee_android_7')

	-- 안드로이드 전원 위쪽으로 퇴장한다.
	local android_move_dist = vector(-1, 0, 12)
	local android_run_away_speed = 6
	local last_idx = #refugee_androids

	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	for i = 1, last_idx - 1 do
		local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(refugee_androids[i], refugee_androids[i].Position + android_move_dist, true)
		wp_util.move(refugee_androids[i], wp, android_run_away_speed, { run = true })
	end

	local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(refugee_androids[last_idx], refugee_androids[last_idx].Position + android_move_dist, true)
	wp_util.move_async(refugee_androids[last_idx], wp, android_run_away_speed, { run = true })

	dash_sfx:Stop()
	dash_sfx = nil
	for i = 1, #refugee_androids do
		character_util.set_active_state(refugee_androids[i], 'disabled')
	end

	local me3_androids_1 = field_util.get_marker_pos('me3_android_3_pos_1')
	local me3_androids_2 = field_util.get_marker_pos('me3_android_4_pos_1')

	local marker_pos = (me3_androids_1 + me3_androids_2) / 2
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(
		self.android_event_marker,
		self.controller.main_quest_id,
		true,
		marker_pos
	)

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
end


-- 힘겨루기 없이 바로 마빈에게 털리는 연출
function local_class:chicken_game_without_power_struggle(desert_slave, hero_ai, guardian, effect_builder)
	local desert_slave_charging_effect
		= self.controller:chicken_game_scene_common(desert_slave, hero_ai, guardian, effect_builder)

	local function player_party_attack(guardian, hero_ai)
		scene_util.hide_weapon(hero_ai)

		scene_util.set_group_anim({guardian, hero_ai}, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false })

		local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('desert_slave_boss_room_center')
		local speed = vector_util.distance(guardian.Position, center_pos + vector(0.85, 0, 0)) / 1.2
		character_util.jump_move(guardian, center_pos + vector(0.85, 0, 0),  speed, 1, false)
		character_util.jump_move(hero_ai, center_pos + vector(1.35, 0, 0), speed, 1, true)
	end

	local function desert_slave_attack(desert_slave)
		character_util.stop_shake(desert_slave)
		scene_util.set_emotion(desert_slave, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'gauntlet_left_jap_attack', scale = 0.125, loop = false })
		local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('desert_slave_boss_room_center')
		local target_pos = center_pos - vector(0.85, 0, 0)
		local speed = vector_util.distance(desert_slave.Position, target_pos) / 1.2
		character_util.jump_move(desert_slave, target_pos, speed, 1, true)
		scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'gauntlet_left_jap_attack', scale = 1, loop = false })
	end

	local function camera_zoom_in_on_attack()
		wait_for_sec(0.6)
		local chick_game_time_factor = self.controller.time_mod_factor.chicken_game
		time_util.mod(chick_game_time_factor.key, chick_game_time_factor.scale)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2, 0.6)
	end

	desert_slave_charging_effect:Dispose()
	desert_slave_charging_effect = nil

	-- 가디언과 케이든AI twohand_attack4로 1.2초간 가운데 지점으로 점프하여 이동한다.
	-- 동시에 마빈은 gauntlet_left_jap_attack 0.125배속으로 실행해, 1.2초간 가운데 지점으로 점프하여 이동한다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(player_party_attack, guardian, hero_ai),
		util.cs_generator(desert_slave_attack, desert_slave),
		util.cs_generator(camera_zoom_in_on_attack),
	})

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('desert_slave_boss_room_center')
	effect_builder:set_position(center_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
				:create(self.controller.effect_name_cache.desert_slave_shock_wave)

	-- 가디언, 카이 shake 시작.
	character_util.shake(guardian, 0.02, 9999999)
	character_util.shake(hero_ai, 0.02, 9999999)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	time_util.unmod(self.controller.time_mod_factor.chicken_game.key)

	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
		'linear', true, vector(8.5, 0.75, 0), nil, nil,
		nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
		CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_plitvice_explosion_02')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0})
	effect_builder:set_position(desert_slave.Position + vector(0.25, 0.1, 0))
		:create(self.controller.effect_name_cache.desert_slave_charge_shock_wave)

	character_util.stop_shake(guardian)
	character_util.stop_shake(hero_ai)

	-- 이후, 가디언과 케이든AI 뒤로 밀려나 벽까지 날아간다.
	-- 둘 다 넉백 + damagesquish + redpulse
	local damage_play_duration = 0.5

	scene_util.set_group_anim({ guardian, hero_ai }, self, 'prostrate')
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ guardian, hero_ai }, self, 'damaged')

	character_util.spine_damage_squish(guardian, 1.2, 0.8, 1, damage_play_duration)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(guardian, unity_class.color.red, 1, 0.5, damage_play_duration)

	character_util.spine_damage_squish(hero_ai, 1.2, 0.8, 1, damage_play_duration)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(hero_ai, unity_class.color.red, 1, 0.5, damage_play_duration)

	command_util.publish_knock_back(guardian.Owner, guardian, knock_back_info, guardian.Position)
	command_util.publish_knock_back(hero_ai.Owner, hero_ai, knock_back_info, hero_ai.Position)

	-- 빠르게 떼굴떼굴 구르며
	-- 1초에 540도 z축 회전.
	character_util.spine_rotate(guardian, -1080, 0.2)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

-- 힘겨루기 루틴
function local_class:power_struggle(player_group, guardian, desert_slave, effect_builder)
	-- FX_shockwave 사이즈 (1 * 루틴 반복 횟수)로 0.5초마다 실행.
	-- 위치는 가디언의무기끝과 마빈의 무기끝이 맞닿아 있는 부분 기준.
	start_coroutine(self.controller.creating_effect_routine, self.controller,
		guardian, desert_slave, effect_builder)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 9999999)

	-- 1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 9999999)

	local default_cam_size = stage_camera:GetDefaultSize()
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(default_cam_size * 0.6, 0.3)

	-- 	1초간 0.5칸 가디언이 마빈쪽으로 밀어붙인다.
	local x_diff = 1
	character_util.move_distance(desert_slave, vector(-x_diff, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)


	for i = 1, #player_group do
		character_util.stop_shake(player_group[i])
		character_util.shake(player_group[i], 0.04, 9999999)
		character_util.spine_rotate(player_group[i], 5, 0.3)
	end

	character_util.spine_rotate(desert_slave, -5, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')

	for i = 1, #player_group - 1 do
		character_util.move_distance(player_group[i],  vector(-x_diff, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)
	end

	character_util.move_distance_async(player_group[#player_group], vector(-x_diff, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)

	-- 1.5초 대기.
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 9999999)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 9999999)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(default_cam_size * 0.5, 0.3)

	-- 2초간 1칸 마빈이 가디언쪽으로 다시 밀어 붙인다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	character_util.stop_shake(desert_slave)
	character_util.shake(desert_slave, 0.04, 9999999)
	character_util.spine_rotate(desert_slave, -15, 0.3)
	character_util.move_distance(desert_slave, vector(1, 0, 0), 2, nil, false, false)

	for i = 1, #player_group do
		character_util.stop_shake(player_group[i])
		character_util.shake(player_group[i], 0.02, 9999999)
		character_util.spine_rotate(player_group[i], 15, 0.3)
	end

	for i = 1, #player_group - 1 do
		character_util.move_distance(player_group[i],  vector(1, 0, 0), 2, nil, false, false)
	end

	character_util.move_distance_async(player_group[#player_group], vector(1, 0, 0), 2, nil, false, false)
	character_util.spine_rotate(desert_slave, 0, 0.3)

	self.controller.keep_generating_effect = false
end

function local_class:power_struggle_losed(characters, effect_builder, guardian, desert_slave, player_group)

function local_class:power_struggle_with_qte(player_group, guardian, desert_slave, effect_builder)
	local function movement_after_qte(dist_x)
		local move_duration_per_once = 0.2
		local total_move_duration = 1
		local num_total_movement_per_sec =  math.floor(total_move_duration / move_duration_per_once)
		
		dist_x = dist_x / num_total_movement_per_sec
		
		-- QTE 화면 보여주고,
		screen_util.show_turbo_tap()
		self.is_qte_input_available = true

		for i = 1, #player_group do
			character_util.spine_rotate(player_group[i], 5, 0.3)
		end

		for _ = 1, num_total_movement_per_sec do
			while self.tap_count <= 2 do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			self.is_qte_input_available = false
			self.tap_count = 0

			character_util.move_distance(desert_slave, vector(-dist_x, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)

			for i = 1, #player_group do
				character_util.stop_shake(player_group[i])
				character_util.shake(player_group[i], 0.04, 9999999)
			end

			for i = 1, #player_group - 1 do
				character_util.move_distance(player_group[i], vector(-dist_x, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)
			end

			character_util.move_distance_async(player_group[#player_group], vector(-dist_x, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)
			self.is_qte_input_available = true

			local cam_pos = (guardian.Position + desert_slave.Position) / 2
			camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		end

		screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
	end

	start_coroutine(self.controller.creating_effect_routine, self.controller, 
		guardian, desert_slave, effect_builder)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 9999999)

	-- 1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 9999999)

	-- 	1초간 1칸 가디언이 마빈쪽으로 밀어붙인다.
	local x_diff = 1
	character_util.spine_rotate(desert_slave, -5, 0.3)
	movement_after_qte(x_diff)

	-- 1.5초 대기.
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 9999999)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 9999999)

	-- 2초간 1칸 마빈이 가디언쪽으로 다시 밀어 붙인다.
	character_util.stop_shake(desert_slave)
	character_util.shake(desert_slave, 0.04, 9999999)

	character_util.spine_rotate(desert_slave, -15, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')

	local cam_dest_2 = (guardian.Position + desert_slave.Position) / 2 + vector(1, 0, 0)
	for i = 1, #player_group do
		character_util.spine_rotate(player_group[i], 15, 0.3)
	end
	character_util.move_distance(desert_slave, vector(1, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)

	for i = 1, #player_group do
		character_util.stop_shake(player_group[i])
		character_util.shake(player_group[i], 0.02, 9999999)
	end

	for i = 1, #player_group - 1 do
		character_util.move_distance(player_group[i], vector(1, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)
	end

	character_util.move_distance(player_group[#player_group], vector(1, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)
	camera_util.move_async(cam_dest_2, 1)
	
	self.controller.keep_generating_effect = false

	while not self.controller.is_effect_gen_routine_ended do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:entered_desert_slave_boss_room_async()
	local desert_slave = self.controller.get_desert_slave_helmet()
	local effect_builder = self.controller.effect_builder.new()
	local androids = self.controller:get_following_npcs()
	local guardian = user_party.Leader
	local hero_ai = self.controller.get_hero_ai()

	self.joined_androids = androids

	local party = {
		guardian = guardian,
		hero_ai = hero_ai
	}	
	local player_group = { guardian, hero_ai, table.unpack(androids, 1, #androids) }

	-- 파티원 정렬 연출 실행
	self.controller:align_characters_on_entered_boss_room_async(guardian, hero_ai, desert_slave)

	-- 마빈 돌진, 활쏘는 로직까지 실행.
	local desert_slave_dash_dist = vector(0, 0, -2.5)
	self.controller:desert_slave_dash_async(party, desert_slave, desert_slave_dash_dist, effect_builder, nil) 

	--- 따라다니는 안드로이드 없이 보스 방에 진입했을 경우의 연출
	self.controller:chicken_game_scene_with_power_struggle(desert_slave, hero_ai, guardian, effect_builder, 
		self.power_struggle_with_qte)

	for i = 1, #androids do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(androids[i])
	end

	local characters = { table.unpack(player_group, 1, #player_group), desert_slave }
	
	-- 1초간 서로 밀리지 않는 상태로 더 세게 shake 시작.
	for i = 1, #characters do
		character_util.stop_shake(characters[i])
		character_util.shake(characters[i], 0.06, 99999999)
	end

	-- 카메라도 1초간 shake, 세기 0.25
	camera_util.shake(0.25, 1)

	-- fx_lasthit, FX_shockwave(크기 4, 4, 4) 이펙트와 함께 마빈은 왼쪽으로, 가디언 일행은 오른쪽으로 3칸씩 밀려난다.
	local effect_pos = (desert_slave.Position + party.guardian.Position) / 2
	local effect_scale = vector(4, 4, 4)
	effect_builder:set_position(effect_pos)
				:set_scale(effect_scale)
				:create(self.controller.effect_name_cache.lasthit)
	effect_builder:set_position(effect_pos)
				:set_scale(effect_scale)
				:create(self.controller.effect_name_cache.desert_slave_shock_wave)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_plitvice_explosion_02')

	local player_party_knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
		'linear', true, vector(3, 0.75, 0), nil, nil,
		nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
		CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)
	
	local desert_slave_knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
		'linear', true, vector(-3, 0.75, 0), nil, nil,
		nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
		CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)
	
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.3)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 1, #androids do
		local android = androids[i]
		android.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	for i = 1, #player_group do
		local member = player_group[i]
		character_util.stop_shake(member)
		command_util.publish_knock_back(member.Owner, member, player_party_knock_back_info, member.Position)
	end

	character_util.stop_shake(desert_slave)
	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, 'gauntlet_idle')
	command_util.publish_knock_back(desert_slave.Owner, desert_slave, desert_slave_knock_back_info, desert_slave.Position)

	-- 0.3초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, #player_group do
		local member = player_group[i]
		character_util.spine_rotate(member, 0, 0)
	end

	character_util.spine_rotate(desert_slave, 0, 0)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.3)
	
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--배틀 실행
	self:start_battle_phase(androids)
end


--- 마빈 내려찍는 전무 공격 연출
function local_class:desert_slave_earth_quake_async(desert_slave, android, party, effect_builder)
	scene_util.set_emotion(desert_slave, self, 'attack')

	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'gauntlet_handskill', loop = false })

	local earthquake_ready_spawn_pos = desert_slave.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.controller.effect_name_cache.desert_slave_earthquake_ready)
					:Instantiate(earthquake_ready_spawn_pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, desert_slave.Transform)

	character_util.move_distance_async(desert_slave, vector(0, 8, 0), 0.4, nil, nil)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 마빈 카메라에 등장하는 순간
	-- 카메라 줌인 가디언과 케이든 AI의 중간 지점으로, 0.3초만에 사이즈 0.5배로.

	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, 'gauntlet_boong_attack_ready')
	character_util.move_distance_async(desert_slave, vector(0, -6, 0), 0.3, nil, false, false)

	-- 타임스케일 0.2배로 슬로우.
	local time_mod_factor = self.controller.time_mod_factor.desert_slave_earthquake
	time_util.mod(time_mod_factor.key, time_mod_factor.scale)

	character_util.move_distance(desert_slave, vector(0, -2, -1.5), 0.9, nil, false, false)

	-- 가디언 일행 피격하는 순간.

	-- 마빈 카메라에 등장하는 순간
	-- 4번 안드로이드가 가디언과 케이든AI를 옆으로 밀어내면서 혼자 마빈의 공격을 맞는다.
	local last_android_wp_to_guardian = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(android, party.guardian.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5), false)

	-- 카메라 줌인 가디언과 케이든 AI의 중간 지점으로, 0.3초만에 사이즈 0.5배로.
	local target_camera_size = stage_camera.Size * 0.5
	local zoom_duration = 0.3
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(target_camera_size, zoom_duration)

	local desert_slave_chainging_anim_wait_duration = 0.2
	wait_for_sec(desert_slave_chainging_anim_wait_duration)
	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack', loop = false })

	scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'prostrate')
	local android_jump_dest = (party.guardian.Position + party.hero_ai.Position) / 2 + vector(0, 0, 0.25)
	character_util.jump_move(android, android_jump_dest, 5, 0.5, true, 'right')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.controller.effect_name_cache.hit):Instantiate(android_jump_dest + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.controller.effect_name_cache.hit):Instantiate(android_jump_dest + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	-- 가디언은 left, attack, prostrate / 케이든AI는 right, attack, prostrate로 점프.
	character_util.set_direction(party.guardian, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(party.hero_ai, 'right')

	scene_util.set_emotion(party.guardian, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(party.hero_ai, self, 'attack')

	scene_util.set_anim(party.guardian, self, 'prostrate')
	scene_util.set_anim(party.hero_ai, self, 'prostrate')

	local jump_move_speed = 3
	local jump_height = 0.75

	character_util.jump_move(party.guardian, party.guardian.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -1), jump_move_speed, jump_height, false, 'left')
	character_util.jump_move(party.hero_ai, party.hero_ai.Position + vector(1.5, 0, -1), jump_move_speed, jump_height, false, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 안드로이드 4번 피격하는 순간.

	-- 타임스케일 원복.
	time_util.unmod(time_mod_factor.key)
	local earthquake_effect_spawn_pos = android.Position

	-- 카메라 쉐이크 0.3초, 세기 0.1
	camera_util.shake(0.1, zoom_duration)

	-- 카메라 줌아웃 원사이즈로 0.3초만에.

function local_class:custom_sine_move(target, data)
	local start_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'from')
	local target_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'to')
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration')
	local height = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'height', 1)
	local cb = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'cb', nil)
	local has_position_prop = target.Position ~= nil

	if start_pos == nil then
		start_pos = has_position_prop and target.Position or target.transform.position
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
		local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)

		if has_position_prop then
			target.Position = cur_pos
			target.SpineController:Rotate(progress * 360 * 4)
		else
			target.transform.position = cur_pos
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if cb ~= nil then
		cb()
	end

	if has_position_prop then
		target.Position = target_pos
	else
		target.transform.position = target_pos
	end
end

		is_any_android_jet_kicking = function(self)

function local_class:start_android_jet_kicking_async(androids, desert_slave, fx_last_hit_pool, fx_hit_pool)
	self.android_jet_kicking_flags:reset(androids)

	local android_teleport_pos_name = 'ninja_scene_android_teleport_pos_'
	
	local teleport_fx_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.controller.effect_name_cache.android_teleport)

	local fx_spawn_diff = vector(0, 0.1, 0)
	local available_anim_list = { 'gauntlet_kick2', 'boong_attack', 'gauntlet_kick' }
	local desert_slave_anim_list = { 'gauntlet_damaged', 'staff_damaged', 'spear_damaged', 'dualsword_damaged' }
	local move_duration = 1.5 / 12
	local random_pick_args = { count = 1, overlap = true }

	for i = 1, 12 do
		local android_index = (i - 1) % #androids + 1
		local android = androids[android_index]
		local teleporting_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(android_teleport_pos_name .. i)
		local deset_slave_anim_idx = (i - 1) % #desert_slave_anim_list + 1
		local desert_slave_anim = desert_slave_anim_list[deset_slave_anim_idx]
		
		local function teleporting()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')
			teleport_fx_pool:Instantiate(teleporting_pos + fx_spawn_diff)
			
			character_util.set_position(android, teleporting_pos)
			character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
			
			local random_anim = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_anim_list, random_pick_args)[1]

			scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = random_anim, loop = false })
		end

		local function end_callback()
			teleport_fx_pool:Instantiate(android.Position + fx_spawn_diff)
			character_util.set_active_state(android, 'disabled')	
			self.android_jet_kicking_flags.flags[i] = false
		end

		self.android_jet_kicking_flags.flags[i] = true

		scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, 'attack')

		start_coroutine(self.start_android_jet_kicking_target, self, android, desert_slave, fx_last_hit_pool, 
			fx_hit_pool, desert_slave_anim, teleporting, move_duration, end_callback)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	while self.android_jet_kicking_flags:is_any_android_jet_kicking() do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:guadian_hero_ai_stands_on_ground(guardian, hero_ai)
	local guardian_stand_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('ninja_scene_guardian_landing_pos')
	local hero_ai_stand_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('ninja_scene_hero_ai_landing_pos')
	
	character_util.set_position(guardian, guardian_stand_pos + vector(0, 10, 0))
	character_util.set_position(hero_ai, hero_ai_stand_pos + vector(0, 10, 0))
	
	character_util.set_direction(guardian, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guardian)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)

	camera_util.move((guardian_stand_pos + hero_ai_stand_pos) / 2, 0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	
	-- 안드로이드는 구해온 숫자에 따라 앞쪽부터 채워 나가는 형태.
	local ending_androids_align_pos_name_prefix = 'ending_androids_align_'

	for i = 1, #self.joined_androids do
		local marker_name = ending_androids_align_pos_name_prefix .. i
		local android_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name)
		local android_align_dir = field_util.get_marker_dir(marker_name)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.joined_androids[i])
		character_util.stop_shake(self.joined_androids[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(self.joined_androids[i], 'enabled')
		character_util.reset_locked_dir(self.joined_androids[i])
		character_util.set_position(self.joined_androids[i], android_align_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(self.joined_androids[i], android_align_dir)
		self.joined_androids[i].SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.1)
	end

	local function hero_landing_adapter(character, dir, pos, height, fall_duration)
		scene_util.hero_landing(character, dir, pos, height, fall_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		local hit_fx_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.controller.effect_name_cache.lasthit)
		hit_fx_pool:Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	end

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(hero_landing_adapter, guardian, 'right', guardian_stand_pos, 10, 1),
		util.cs_generator(hero_landing_adapter, hero_ai, 'left', hero_ai_stand_pos, 10, 1)
	})

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.2)
end

function local_class:desert_slave_free_fall_async(desert_slave)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(desert_slave)

	local desert_slave_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('ninja_scene_desert_slave_landing_pos')
	character_util.set_position(desert_slave, desert_slave_pos + vector(0, 10, 0))

	local fall_duration = 0.4
	local start_pos = desert_slave.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, start_pos.y, 0)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	scene_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, 'prostrate')
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
			character_util.set_position(desert_slave, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(desert_slave, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.2)
	local hit_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.controller.effect_name_cache.hit)
	hit_effect_pool:Instantiate(desert_slave.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
end

function local_class:compute_degree_bet_two_objects(lhs, rhs)
	local radian = math.atan(rhs.Position.z - lhs.Position.z, rhs.Position.x - lhs.Position.x)
	return math.deg(radian)
end

function local_class:start_android_jet_kicking_target(
	android, target, fx_last_hit_pool, fx_hit_pool, desert_slave_anim, 
	teleporting, starting_moving_duration, cb)

	teleporting()
	character_util.look_at(android, target)

	local move_dist_vec = target.Position - android.Position
	local effect_spawn_pos = target.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0)

	character_util.move_distance_async(android, move_dist_vec, starting_moving_duration / 2, nil, false, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	fx_hit_pool:Instantiate(effect_spawn_pos)
	fx_last_hit_pool:Instantiate(effect_spawn_pos)

	--마빈 몸에 redpulse, damagesquish 0.1초

function local_class:convert_battle_desert_slave()
	local desert_slave = self.controller.get_desert_slave_helmet()
	local desert_slave_battle = self.controller.get_desert_slave_battle()

	desert_slave_battle.Position = desert_slave.Position
	scene_util.show_weapon(desert_slave_battle)
	character_util.set_active_state(desert_slave_battle, 'enabled')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(desert_slave)
	scene_util.set_anim(desert_slave, self, 'gauntlet_idle')
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'down')
	character_util.set_active_state(desert_slave, 'disabled')

	character_util.convert_to_monster(desert_slave_battle, 's3_battle_1')
	desert_slave_battle.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Prostrate
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(desert_slave_battle, get_party_leader(), 'battle')

end

function local_class:convert_manual_desert_slave()
	local desert_slave = self.controller.get_desert_slave_helmet()
	local desert_slave_battle = self.controller.get_desert_slave_battle()

	desert_slave.Position = desert_slave_battle.Position
	desert_slave_battle.Position = vector(-999, 0, -999)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(desert_slave)
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_battle_start_event(e)
	if e ~= nil and e.StartedBattle ~= nil and not e.StartedBattle.IsBossBattle then
		local innuit = self.get_innuit_jar()

		-- 섹션4에서는 변장하지 않은 코코 사용
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3 then
			innuit = self.get_innuit_helmet()
		end

		for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
			local member = user_party[i]

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(member, innuit) then
				character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
			end
		end
	end

	end

	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		local member = user_party[i]

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(member, innuit) then
			return
		end
	end

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(innuit, user_party, false)
end

function local_class:innuit_hiding(add_innuit_to_party)
	local hiding_object = self.get_innuit_hiding_object()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit_helmet()
	local innuit_jar = self.get_innuit_jar()
	local add_innuit = lua_helper.get_or_default(add_innuit_to_party, true)

	character_util.set_active_state(innuit_jar, 'enabled')
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	character_util.set_position(innuit_jar, innuit.Position)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(innuit)
	character_util.set_active_state(innuit, 'disabled')
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if add_innuit then
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(innuit_jar, user_party, false)
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)


	character_util.set_locked_dir(innuit_jar, 'left')
	--scene_util.set_anim(innuit_jar, self, { name = 'tail_idle', loop = true })

	-- 항아리 코코 애니와 이모션을 고정시킴(SetAnimation함수 첫번째 인자 Owner를 자신이 아닌 다른 캐릭터 객체 전달하여 다른 애니 재생 처리가 되지 않게 함)
	innuit_jar:SetAnimation( user_party.Leader,
			CS.Oak.AnimationRequest(
					'tail_idle',
					CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom + 1,
					true,
					1,
					-1,
					nil,
					nil,
					nil
			)
	)
	innuit_jar:SetEmotion(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('idle', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom + 1, true))

	-- 코코의 1프레임 전 위치와 방향 저장
	local innuit_past_position
	hiding_object.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	hiding_object.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	while self.innuit_hiding_in_object do
		if not self.innuit_hiding_pause then
			hiding_object.Position = innuit_jar.Position

			-- 코코의 Direction은 잠겨있으므로 이전 위치와 현 위치의 차를 계산해서 방향을 구한다
			if innuit_past_position ~= nil then
				-- 코코의 1프레임 전 위치와 현재 위치 확인해서 방향 변경되었는지 확인
				local cur_dir = (innuit_jar.Position - innuit_past_position):ToDirection()

				if cur_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
					cur_dir = self.innuit_past_direction
				end

				if cur_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
					innuit_jar.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 180)
					innuit_jar.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(0, -0.5, -0.5)
				elseif cur_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
					innuit_jar.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
					innuit_jar.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(0, 0.2, 0.5)
				elseif cur_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					innuit_jar.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -90)
					innuit_jar.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(-0.2, 0.5, 0)
				elseif cur_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
					innuit_jar.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 90)
					innuit_jar.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(0, 0.5, 0.2)
				end

				self.innuit_past_direction = cur_dir
			end

			innuit_past_position = innuit_jar.Position
		end

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:change_hidden_innuit_direction(dir)
	local innuit = self.get_innuit_jar()

	if dir == 'up' then
		self.innuit_past_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		innuit.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 180)
		innuit.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(0, -0.5, -0.5)
	elseif dir == 'down' then
		self.innuit_past_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		innuit.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
		innuit.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(0, 0.2, 1)
	elseif dir == 'left' then
		self.innuit_past_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		innuit.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -90)
		innuit.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(-0.2, 0.5, 0)
	elseif dir == 'right' then
		self.innuit_past_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		innuit.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 90)
		innuit.SpineController.Transform:GetChild(1).localPosition = vector(0, 0.5, 0.2)
	end
end

	self.get_fx_dead()

	self.get_dark_missile_explosion_effect()

end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.typing_text_obj ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text_obj)
		self.typing_text_obj = nil
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	self.is_siren_tint = false

	self.loop_escape = true

	if self.siren_sfx ~= nil then
		self.siren_sfx:Stop()

	self:blizzard_dispose()
	self.blizzard = nil
	self.fade.gradient = nil
	self.fade = nil

	if self.blizzard_sfx ~= nil then
		self.blizzard_sfx:Stop()
		self.blizzard_sfx = nil
	end

	self:ice_dispose()

	for key in pairs(self.preset) do
		self.preset[key] = nil
	end
	self.preset = nil

	drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.drop_item_innuit_weapon)

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_s1_innuit_weapon()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and not self.is_interacting then
			self.is_interacting = true
			start_coroutine(self.interact_innuit_weapon, self, e.Target)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_s1_rec_ice_free_potion()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and not self.is_interacting then
			self.is_interacting = true
			start_coroutine(self.interact_red_ice_free_position, self, e.Target)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_innuit_hiding_object()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and not self.is_interacting then
			self.is_interacting = true
			start_coroutine(self.interact_hiding_object, self, e.Target)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.s1_find_target_switch_zone_name) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and not self.is_interacting then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.talk_event_at_switch_door
			self.is_interacting = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_event_at_switch_door, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.s1_restruct_zone_name) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and not self.is_interacting then
