			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 'intro_' .. 2, skip = true })
	-- 코코(left, idle, cross_arm) : …
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cross_arm' },
			nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 'intro_' .. 3, skip = true })
	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)
	-- 코코(right, attack, dagger_idle) : 반드시 그 인베이더 놈을 잡아서…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'dagger_idle' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 'intro_' .. 4, skip = true })
	-- 코코(right, attack, cast2) : 녀석들을 찍소리도 못하게 해주겠어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cast2', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 'intro_' .. 5, skip = true })

	-- 스테이지 진입 연출
	--CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1.5)
	--music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	-- 팡파레 나오지 않도록 설정
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false
	--wait_for_sec(2.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0.5)

	local cached_leader = get_party_leader()
	sp_util.exit_scene({ show_weapon = false }, cached_leader)
end

function local_class:intro_event()
	local knight = self.get_invader_knight()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local android = self.get_innuit_room_android(1)

	--sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	scene_util.hide_weapon(knight)
	character_util.stop(knight)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(hero_ai)
	character_util.stop(hero_ai)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(innuit)
	character_util.stop(innuit)

	-- 안1(idle, idle) : 보고드립니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, { one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_worker_01' }, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 코코(attack, bomb_idle) : 그 인베이더는 찾았어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'right', { name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 안1 question 이모티콘
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(android, self, nil, nil, nil, 'question')
	-- 안1(idle, bomb_idle) : 침입자 말씀이신가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, { name = 'bomb_idle' }, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 3, skip = true })
	-- 코코(attack, release) : 그래, 침입자든, 인베이더든. 찾은 거 없어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'right', { name = 'release' }, { name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 안1(idle, idle) : 말씀해주신 곳들에 복병들이 대기중입니다만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 5, skip = true })
	-- 안1(idle, bomb_idle) : 아직 연락이 온 곳은 없습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, { name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' }, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 6, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(android)
	-- 코코(idle, nod 1회) : 그래…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, { name = 'nod', count = 1, loop = true }, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 7, skip = true })
	-- 코코(attack, cast2) : 절대 그 인베이더가 $name과 꼬마공주님에게 접근하게 해서는 안 돼.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, { name = 'cast2', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' }, { name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 8, skip = true })
	-- 코코(attack, release) : 발견하는 즉시 경보를…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, { name = 'release' }, { name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 9, skip = true })

	-- 아래 자막 시작과 동시에
	--1초만에 빨갛게 틴트 => 1초만에 다시 해제 루틴 2회 반복.
	start_coroutine(self.siren_tint_event, self)
	--카메라 쉐이크 0.3초, 세기 0.1
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	--코코 + 안드로이드들 attack, idle, jump 1회
	for i = 1, self.innuit_room_android_count do
		local jump_android = self.get_innuit_room_android(i)
		scene_util.set_emotion(jump_android, self, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.normal_jump(jump_android, false)
	end
	scene_util.set_emotion(innuit, self, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(innuit, true)

	-- 자막 : 경보! 경보! 침입자가 감지되었습니다.
	self.typing_text_obj:SetActive(true)
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText(self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 10, 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

	self:siren_tint_off()

	-- 코코(idle, bomb_idle) : 역시… 예상을 벗어나지 않네.
	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, { name = 'bomb_idle' }, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 11, skip = true })
	-- 코코(attack, release) : 발견한 안드로이드에게 연락해!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, { name = 'release' }, { name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 12, skip = true })
	-- 1초에 걸쳐 검은색 페이드아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	-- 0.3초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.15)


	for i = 1, self.innuit_room_android_count do
		local room_android = self.get_innuit_room_android(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(room_android)
	end

	camera_util.move(knight.Position, 0)
	coroutine.yield()
	local outside_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right',knight.Position, -2)
	local s1_camera_pos = outside_pos
	camera_util.move(s1_camera_pos, 0)

	-- 페이드인 되면, 줌아웃 1.25배 뺀 상태.
	--카메라 포커스는 인베이더 가디언에게(그리드 밖이 보이지는 않도록.)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	-- 1초에 걸쳐 검은색 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	-- 화면 전환 되어 가디언 시작 지점 보여준다.

	-- 아래 동작과 동시에, 가디언, 케이든AI smile, victory_get 1회
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'left')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hero_ai, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'smile' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })
		start_coroutine(function()
			scene_util.show_victory_get_async(hero_ai, self, nil)
		end)
		scene_util.show_victory_get_async(knight, self, nil)
	end)
	-- 말풍선(안드로이드, 화면 우측 상단, 스킵 불가능) : 침입자의 위치가 특정되었습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 13,
			  viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.6), bubble_direction = 'ct', skip = false })

	-- --동시에, 가디언, 케이든AI left, smile, idle 1초, right, smile, idle 1초 반복
	--	--가디언이 left면 케이든은 right 하는 식으로.
	local party_look_around = true
	local knight_dir_left = true
	local waitting_time = 1
	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0
		while party_look_around do
			if knight_dir_left then
				scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'right')
				scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hero_ai, 'left')
				knight_dir_left = false
			else
				scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'left')
				scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hero_ai, 'right')
				knight_dir_left = true
			end

			time_passed = 0
			while time_passed < waitting_time do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if self.loop_escape then
					return
				end

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			if self.loop_escape then
				return
			end
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end)
	-- 말풍선(안드로이드, 화면 우측 상단, 스킵 불가능) : 침입한 개체는 2개.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 14,
			  viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.6), bubble_direction = 'ct', skip = false })

	party_look_around = false
	coroutine.yield()
	coroutine.yield()
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'right')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hero_ai, 'right')

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 아래 동작과 동시에, 가디언, 케이든AI 앞으로 걸어간다. 초록색 사각형 위치까지 걸어가면 멈춘다.
	-- 걸어갈 때 + 도착한 후에도 둘 다 표정 smile
	-- 도착하면 가디언 left, 케이든AI right
	local party_wp_key = 'party_members_align'
	local knight_wp_1 = self.get_s1_knight_pos(1, 2)
	local hero_ai_wp_1 = self.get_s1_hero_ai_pos(1, 2)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, knight_wp_1, nil,
			1, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero_ai, hero_ai_wp_1, nil,
			1, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	camera_util.move(knight_wp_1, 1)

	local android_ment_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 말풍선(안드로이드, 화면 우측 상단, 스킵 불가능) : 명령을 내려주시면 발포하도록 하겠습니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, nil, nil,
				{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 15,
				  viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.6), bubble_direction = 'ct', skip = false })
		android_ment_end = true
	end)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	-- 아래 연출은 가디언, 케이든AI 이동 완료된 시점부터, 첫번째 포격 떨어지기 전까지 계속해서 루프해서 실행됩니다.
	-- 케이든AI가 right, attack, jump 2회
	-- 케이든AI right, smile, cast로 하트 이모티콘.
	-- 가디언 smile, nod 2회
	-- 가디언 smile, victory_get 1회
	local party_members_silence_talk = true
	local check_loop_escape = false
	local anim_playing = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0
		local emoticon = nil
		while party_members_silence_talk do
			if self.cur_party_member_behavior == self.party_member_behavior.step_1 then
				anim_playing = true
				character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
				scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'attack' })
				character_util.normal_double_jump(hero_ai, true)
				waitting_time = 0.85
				self.cur_party_member_behavior = self.party_member_behavior.step_2
			elseif self.cur_party_member_behavior == self.party_member_behavior.step_2 then
				anim_playing = true
				scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })
				scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'cast' })
				emoticon = scene_util.play_emoticon_action(hero_ai, self, nil, { one_shot_sfx = '01_bad_fairy_01' }, nil, 'heart')
				waitting_time = 0.1
				self.cur_party_member_behavior = self.party_member_behavior.step_3
			elseif self.cur_party_member_behavior == self.party_member_behavior.step_3 then
				anim_playing = true
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
				scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'smile' })
				scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2, loop = true })
				waitting_time = 0.25
				self.cur_party_member_behavior = self.party_member_behavior.step_4
			elseif self.cur_party_member_behavior == self.party_member_behavior.step_4 then
				anim_playing = true
				scene_util.show_victory_get_async(knight, self, { emotion = 'smile' })
				waitting_time = 0.2
				self.cur_party_member_behavior = self.party_member_behavior.step_1
			end

			anim_playing = false

			if self.loop_escape then
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
				if emoticon ~= nil then
					emoticon:Clear()
				end
				check_loop_escape = true
				return
			end

			if not party_members_silence_talk then
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
				if emoticon ~= nil then
					emoticon:Clear()
				end
				check_loop_escape = true
				return
			end

			time_passed = 0
			while time_passed < waitting_time do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if self.loop_escape then
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
					if emoticon ~= nil then
						emoticon:Clear()
					end
					check_loop_escape = true
					return
				end

				if not party_members_silence_talk then
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
					if emoticon ~= nil then
						emoticon:Clear()
					end
					check_loop_escape = true
					return
				end

				coroutine.yield()
			end
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
		if emoticon ~= nil then
			emoticon:Clear()
		end
		check_loop_escape = true
	end)

	while not android_ment_end do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 1번째 선택지
	-- 발포한다.(빨강)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 16, 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		s1_camera_pos = self.get_artillery_pos(1)
		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
		camera_util.move_async(knight.Position, 1, {end_target = knight})
	end

	-- 말풍선(코코, 화면 좌측 상단, 스킵 불가능) : 공격해!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 17,
			  viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.6), bubble_direction = 'ct', skip = false })

	party_members_silence_talk = false

	while party_members_silence_talk do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	while anim_playing do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	coroutine.yield()
	coroutine.yield()

	start_coroutine(self.bomb_fall, self, s1_camera_pos, 7, 0, 0.25, 1, 1, false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'surprise' })
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'surprise' })
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.8, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	time_util.mod('avoid_cannon_shot', 0.1)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.jump_move(knight, self.get_s1_knight_pos(1, 3), 5.5, 1, false)

	local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(self.get_s1_hero_ai_pos(1, 3), 3, false, CS.Oak.Direction.None)
	info.yMode = CS.Oak.CharacterYMode.Flying
	local duration = info:GetDuration(hero_ai.Position)

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		time_util.unmod('avoid_cannon_shot')

	end)

	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(hero_ai, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.jump_move(hero_ai, self.get_s1_hero_ai_pos(1, 3), 5.5, 1, false)

	-- 카메라 줌아웃하여 원래 사이즈(크기 비율 1)로 돌아간다.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(duration)

	wait_for_sec(duration * 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(duration * 0.5)

	-- 가디언 일행, 이후 0.5초간 부르르 떤 후, 마리오 점프 하며 일어난다.
	--떨고, 일어나는 동안 표정 attack 유지.
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.shake_and_wakeup(hero_ai, 'right', 1,'attack', false)
	end)
	scene_util.shake_and_wakeup(knight, 'right', 1,'attack', true)

	stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(knight)
	stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(hero_ai)

	local cannon_shot_count = 1
	local time_passed = 0
	waitting_time = 0.55
	start_coroutine(function()
		while cannon_shot_count < self.cannon_shot_max_count do
			start_coroutine(self.bomb_fall, self, self.get_artillery_pos(cannon_shot_count + 1), 15, 0, 0.6, 1, 1, false)

			cannon_shot_count = cannon_shot_count + 1

			time_passed = 0
			while time_passed < waitting_time do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if self.loop_escape then
					return
				end

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			if self.loop_escape then
				return
			end
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end)

	party_wp_key = 'party_run_away'
	knight_wp_1 = self.get_s1_knight_pos(1, 4)
	hero_ai_wp_1 = self.get_s1_hero_ai_pos(1, 4)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, knight_wp_1, 5,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero_ai, hero_ai_wp_1, 5,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(knight)
	stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(hero_ai)

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'get', one_shot_sfx = '01_jump_01' })
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'get' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.jump_move(knight, self.get_s1_knight_pos(1, 5), 4, 1.3, false, 'right')
	character_util.jump_move(hero_ai, self.get_s1_hero_ai_pos(1, 5), 4, 1.3, true, 'right')

	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_emotion(hero_ai)

	coroutine.yield()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0 })
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0 })

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	camera_util.move_async(knight.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), 0.5)

	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'victory_extra', keep = true },
				{ name = 'smile', keep = true }, 1)
		scene_util.play_wait_action(hero_ai, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'victory_extra', keep = true },
				{ name = 'smile', keep = true }, 1)
	end)

	-- 말풍선(안드로이드, 화면 우측 상단, 스킵 불가능) : 타겟이 포격 범위를 벗어났다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 18,
			  viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.6), bubble_direction = 'ct', skip = false })

	-- 아래 말풍선 시작과 동시에 가디언 일행 left, attack, gauntlet_combo_attack 3회, right, attack, gauntlet_combo_attack 3회
	-- 가디언이 left로 하면 케이든은 right로 하는 식.
	local party_action_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'left')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hero_ai, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'attack' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'attack' })
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', count = 3, loop = true })
		scene_util.set_anim_async(hero_ai, self, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack', count = 3, loop = true })

		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'right')
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hero_ai, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'attack' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'attack' })
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', count = 3, loop = true })
		scene_util.set_anim_async(hero_ai, self, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack', count = 3, loop = true })

		party_action_end = true
	end)
	-- 말풍선(안드로이드, 화면 우측 하단, 스킵 불가능) : 기동 타격 요원 출격 준비 완료.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 19,
			  viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.6), bubble_direction = 'ct', skip = false })

	while not party_action_end do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	party_action_end = false
	check_loop_escape = false

	-- 풍선 시작된 시점부터, 첫번째 안드로이드 나타나기 전까지 계속해서 루프해서 실행됩니다.
	start_coroutine(function()
		party_members_silence_talk = true
		self.cur_party_member_behavior = self.party_member_behavior.step_1
		time_passed = 0
		local emoticon = nil
		while party_members_silence_talk do
			if self.cur_party_member_behavior == self.party_member_behavior.step_1 then
				anim_playing = true
				-- 케이든AI가 right, greed, sing, jump 2회
				character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
				scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hero_ai, 'right')
				scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'greed' })
				scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'sing' })
				character_util.normal_double_jump(hero_ai, true)
				waitting_time = 0.5
				self.cur_party_member_behavior = self.party_member_behavior.step_2
			elseif self.cur_party_member_behavior == self.party_member_behavior.step_2 then
				anim_playing = true
				-- 케이든AI smile, cast로 하트 이모티콘.
				scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })
				scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'cast' })
				emoticon = scene_util.play_emoticon_action(hero_ai, self, nil, { one_shot_sfx = '01_bad_fairy_01' }, nil, 'heart')
				waitting_time = 0.25
				self.cur_party_member_behavior = self.party_member_behavior.step_3
			elseif self.cur_party_member_behavior == self.party_member_behavior.step_3 then
				anim_playing = true
				-- 가디언 right, smile, nod 2회
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
				scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'right')
				scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'smile' })
				scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2, loop = true })
				waitting_time = 0.25
				self.cur_party_member_behavior = self.party_member_behavior.step_4
			elseif self.cur_party_member_behavior == self.party_member_behavior.step_4 then
				anim_playing = true
				-- 가디언 right, attack, victory_get 1회
				scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'right')
				scene_util.show_victory_get_async(knight, self, { emotion = 'smile' })
				waitting_time = 0.2
				self.cur_party_member_behavior = self.party_member_behavior.step_1
			end

			anim_playing = false

			if self.loop_escape then
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
				if emoticon ~= nil then
					emoticon:Clear()
				end
				check_loop_escape = true
				return
			end

			if not party_members_silence_talk then
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
				if emoticon ~= nil then
					emoticon:Clear()
				end
				check_loop_escape = true
				return
			end

			time_passed = 0
			while time_passed < waitting_time do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if self.loop_escape then
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
					if emoticon ~= nil then
						emoticon:Clear()
					end
					check_loop_escape = true
					return
				end

				if not party_members_silence_talk then
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
					if emoticon ~= nil then
						emoticon:Clear()
					end
					check_loop_escape = true
					return
				end

				coroutine.yield()
			end
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
		if emoticon ~= nil then
			emoticon:Clear()
		end
		check_loop_escape = true
	end)

	-- 말풍선(안드로이드, 화면 우측 하단, 스킵 불가능) : 명령을 내려주십시오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 20,
			  viewport_pos = vector(0.75, 0.6), bubble_direction = 'ct', skip = false })

	-- 2번째 선택지
	-- 출격 명령을 내린다.(빨강)
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 21, 'brutal' } })

	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.3)
	-- 말풍선(코코, 화면 좌측 상단, 스킵 불가능) : 모두 출격해!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, { one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_01' }, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 22,
			  viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.6), bubble_direction = 'ct', skip = false })

	party_members_silence_talk = false

	while not check_loop_escape do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	coroutine.yield()
	coroutine.yield()

	start_coroutine(self.raid_android_setting, self)
	--self:raid_android_setting()

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 안드로이드들이 한번에 텔레포트하며 등장한다.
	-- 등장하는 동안 가디언 일행은 surprise, idle로 jump 1회
	-- 가디언은 left, 케이든은 right
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hero_ai, 'right')

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'surprise' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim(hero_ai)
	character_util.normal_jump(knight, true)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(hero_ai, true)

	-- 가디언 일행 scared, embarrassed.
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'scared' })
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'scared' })
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	--wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(knight.Position, 0.5, {end_target = knight})

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	start_coroutine(self.android_raid_on_knight, self)

	-- 이후, 0.5초 간 타임스케일 0.2배로 슬로우.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	time_util.mod('android_raid_on_knight', 0.2)
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		time_util.unmod('android_raid_on_knight')
	end)
	-- 0.2초간 대기한 후, 가디언 일행 0.3초간 점프해서 회피.
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	-- 카메라 포커스는 가디언을 따라간다.
	-- 점프할 때 모션 : attack, get.
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'get', one_shot_sfx = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01' })
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'get' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.jump_move(knight, self.get_s1_knight_pos(1, 6), 4, 1.3, false, 'right')
	character_util.jump_move(hero_ai, self.get_s1_hero_ai_pos(1, 6), 4, 1.3, true, 'right')

	-- 가디언 일행 attack, idle로 0.5초 대기.
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim(hero_ai)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	-- 가디언 일행 left, attack, idle 1초.
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hero_ai, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 이후, 가디언 일행 right, smile, victory_extra 3회.
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'right')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hero_ai, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'victory_extra' })
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'victory_extra' })
	start_coroutine(function()
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(knight, 'victory_extra')
		for i = 1, 3 do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
			wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
		end
	end)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 화면 1초에 걸쳐서 검게 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 0.3초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 다시 코코와 안드로이드들 모습이 보인다.(카메라 이동)
	s1_camera_pos = self.get_s1_camera_event_pos(1)
	camera_util.move(s1_camera_pos, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 화면 1초에 걸쳐서 다시 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 코코(attack, cross_arm) : 정말 운도 좋은 인베이더네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm', loop = true }, { name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 23, skip = true })
	-- 코코(attack, bomb_idle) : 안 되겠어, 내가 직접 나설게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' }, { name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 24, skip = true })
	-- 코코(attack, release) : 전원 최종 포인트에서 대기하고 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release' }, { name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 25, skip = true })
	-- 안1(attack, nod 1회) : 알겠습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_worker_01', loop = true }, { name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 26, skip = true })
	-- 안드로이드 전원 오른쪽으로 퇴장.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
	for i = 1, self.innuit_room_android_count do
		local room_android = self.get_innuit_room_android(i)
		wp_util.move(room_android, room_android.Position + vector(10, 0, 0), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })
	end
	-- 코코(left, idle, nod 고개 숙인 채) : 아무리 $name(이) 의심스럽다지만…
	local nod_stop_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_anim(innuit, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(innuit, 'nod')
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.5)
		innuit.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
		nod_stop_end = true
	end)
	character_util.remove_emotion(innuit)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 27, skip = true })

	while not nod_stop_end do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	innuit.SpineController.TimeScale = 1
	-- 코코(left, attack, dagger_idle) : 인베이더가 가까이 가게 할 수는 없어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', { name = 'dagger_idle' }, { name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 28, skip = true })

	-- 코코도 속도4로 오른쪽으로 퇴장.
	outside_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right',vector(0,0,0), 1.5)
	local innuit_arrived_pos = vector(outside_pos.x, innuit.Position.y, innuit.Position.z)

	local innuit_wp_key = 'innuit_move_to_next_scene'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(innuit, innuit_arrived_pos, 4, nil, self, innuit_wp_key)

	-- 카메라는 포커스 변경 없이 그대로 유지.
	-- 코코 퇴장 시작하면서 화면 1초에 걸쳐 검게 페이드 아웃.
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, innuit_wp_key)

	-- 이 때, 진짜 가디언으로 플레이 시작.
	-- 시작 지점은 안드로이드 시체 앞.

	local normal_knight = self.get_knight()
	character_util.set_active_state(knight, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(normal_knight, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(normal_knight, knight.Position)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(normal_knight)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(normal_knight, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	self:change_party_leader()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(hero_ai, user_party, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 다시 페이드인 되면 위의 가디언으로 플레이 시작.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name, self.main_sector_innuit_quest_id, true,
			self.get_shrine_switch_pos())

	scene_util.show_weapon(knight)
	scene_util.show_weapon(hero_ai)

	character_util.set_active_state(innuit, 'enabled')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(innuit, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	local outside_pos_1 = self.get_s1_innuit_pos(1, 2) + vector(-10, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(innuit, outside_pos_1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(innuit)

	-- 코코가 오브젝트를 쓴다.
	-- fx_dead 이펙트와 함께 오브젝트 생성.
	self.controller:innuit_hiding_in_breakable_object(false)
	self:innuit_put_on_object(false, false, false)

	for i = 1, self.innuit_room_android_count do
		android = self.get_innuit_room_android(i)
		character_util.stop(android)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
	end

	coroutine.yield()

	for i = 1, self.innuit_room_android_count do
		android = self.get_innuit_room_android(i)

		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(android, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

		--character_util.set_equipment(android, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, self.android_equip_rifle_id, true)

		--scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(android, '[base]weapon1', 'energy_rifle')
		character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
		android.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'rifle_idle'
		android.CustomWalkAnimationName ='rifle_walk'
		android.CustomRunAnimationName = 'rifle_run'

		character_util.set_position(android, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0.5)

	local cached_leader = get_party_leader()
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, cached_leader)
	self.is_interacting = false
end

function local_class:talk_event_at_switch_door()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit_jar()

	local s1_camera_pos = self.get_s1_camera_event_pos(3)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0.5)

	-- 무기 숨기기
	scene_util.hide_weapon(innuit)
	character_util.stop(innuit)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(knight)
	character_util.stop(knight)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(hero_ai)
	character_util.stop(hero_ai)

	local party_wp_key = 'party_members_align'
	local innuit_wp_key = 'innuit_align'
	local knight_wp_1 = nil
	local knight_wp_2 = nil
	local hero_ai_wp_1 = nil
	local hero_ai_wp_2 = nil

	local innuit_wp_1 = self.get_s1_innuit_pos(1, 2)
	local innuit_wp_2 = nil

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })

	-- 케이든AI(down, smile, release) : 용사님! 저기 보이십니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, { name = 'release' }, { name = 'smile' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 케이든AI(down, smile, jump 1회) : 이 신전의 활성화 스위치입니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'down', nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 2, skip = true })

	knight_wp_1 = self.get_s1_knight_pos(2, 1)
	hero_ai_wp_1 = self.get_s1_hero_ai_pos(2, 1)

	start_coroutine(function()
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, knight_wp_1, nil,
				1, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'down' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero_ai, hero_ai_wp_1, nil,
				1, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)
	end)

	local stage_camera_backup_pos = knight_wp_1 + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

function local_class:object_shake(object, amplitude, duration)
	local pos = object.Position
	local time = 0
	while time < duration do
		local rand_1 = unity_class.random.Range(-amplitude, amplitude)

		object.Position = pos + vector(rand_1, 0, rand_1)

		time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	object.Position = pos
end

function local_class:turn_on_blizzard(value, blizzard_fade_time)
	while self.is_blizzard_changing do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if not self.is_blizzard_active then
		self.is_blizzard_changing = true
		--- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = true
		--- blizzard start
		self:blizzard_start()

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		local mult = lua_helper.get_or_default(value, 0.4)
		local fade_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(blizzard_fade_time, 0.3)

		--- blizzard update
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fade_time do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0) * mult

			self:blizzard_update(progress)

			if self.loop_escape then
				return
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.is_blizzard_changing = false
	end
end

function local_class:turn_off_blizzard()
	while self.is_blizzard_changing do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if self.is_blizzard_active then
		self.is_blizzard_changing = true
		--- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = false
		--- blizzard inner param refresh
		self:blizzard_color_refresh()

		--stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff)

		local fade_time = 0.4

		local wait_time = fade_time + 1.5
		--local remove_buff_time = 1.5
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		--- blizzard update
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_time do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(1 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0) * 0.4

			self:blizzard_update(progress)

			if self.loop_escape then
				return
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if unity_class.time.time - cur_time > fade_time then
				break
			end
		end

		--- blizzard dispose
		self:blizzard_dispose()
		self.is_blizzard_changing = false
	end
end

--- blizzard 이펙트 셋업
function local_class:blizzard_start(args)
	if self.blizzard == nil or self.fade == nil then return end
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil or self.fade.obj ~= nil then return end

	local with_fade = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'with_fade', true)
	local alpha = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'alpha', -1)
	local custom_alpha = false

	if not float_util.almost_close_to(alpha, -1) then
		custom_alpha = true
	end

	local camera = stage_camera

	self.blizzard.obj = self.preset.blizzard:Instantiate(
			camera.Transform.position + vector(0, 5, 10), unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
	self.blizzard.material = self.blizzard.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)).material

	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	local target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.blizzard.color.a * 0.2

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, target_alpha }))

	if with_fade then
		self.fade.obj = self.preset.blizzard_fade:Instantiate(
				camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
		self.fade.main_module = self.fade.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
				typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color

		target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.fade.color.a * 0.2

		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, target_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_lerp(from, to, duration)

	self.is_blizzard_changing = true
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local tint = from

	--- blizzard update
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration, 0)
		tint = from + (to - from) * progress

		self:blizzard_update(tint)

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.is_blizzard_changing = false
end
function local_class:blizzard_update(alpha, fade_alpha)
	if fade_alpha == nil then
		fade_alpha = alpha
	end

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, alpha }))

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, fade_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_fade_max()
	if self.fade.obj == nil then return end

	self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color({ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, 1 })

	self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
end

function local_class:blizzard_color_refresh()
	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

--- 눈보라 관련 이펙트 dispose
function local_class:blizzard_dispose()
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil then
		self.blizzard.material = nil
		self.blizzard.color = nil
		self.blizzard.obj:Dispose()
		self.blizzard.obj = nil
	end

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.main_module = nil
		self.fade.color = nil
		self.fade.obj:Dispose()
		self.fade.obj = nil
	end
end

function local_class:siren_tint_event()
	local tint_duration = 1
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false

	self.is_siren_tint = true

	while self.is_siren_tint do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(self.siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_siren_oneshot_04')
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(self.siren_tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_siren_oneshot_04')
			end
		end

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.siren_sfx ~= nil then
		self.siren_sfx:FadeOut()
	end

	if not self.is_siren_tint and is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(self.siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
	end
end

function local_class:bomb_fall(target_pos, shot_start_pos, delay, move_time, radius, explosion_scale, sfx_play)
	local start_pos = target_pos + vector(0, shot_start_pos, 0)

	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, radius)
	attack_range.transform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, target_pos.y + 0.1)
	attack_range:Show(0)
	
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bomb_arrow_shoot_01')

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < delay do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	time_passed = 0
	local missile_effect = self.get_dark_missile_effect():Instantiate(start_pos)
	missile_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * explosion_scale
	if sfx_play then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_magician_shoot_01', play_pos = target_pos })
	end

	while time_passed < move_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / move_time)

		missile_effect.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	missile_effect:Dispose()
	attack_range.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_dark_01', play_pos = target_pos })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_kick_02', play_pos = target_pos })

	local explosion_effect = self.get_dark_missile_explosion_effect():Instantiate(target_pos)
	explosion_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * explosion_scale

	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)
end

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self,

	local innuit_wp_1 = interacted_object.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	local backup_innuit_pos = interacted_object.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(innuit, innuit_wp_1, nil,
			0.5, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })


	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	start_coroutine(function()
		local equip_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })
		scene_util.play_wait_action(innuit, self, 'right', { name = 'eat' }, nil, 1)
		equip_sfx:Stop()
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(interacted_object.Position)
	interacted_object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_heavenhold_build_complete_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	wp_util.move_async(innuit, backup_innuit_pos, nil, 0.5, { locked_dir = 'up' })

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0.5)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		self.is_interacting = false
	end

-- 코코 아래로 정렬, 안드로이드들 등장
function local_class:pre_intro_event(innuit_verti)
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 3개에 다 인터랙트했으면 컨트롤 해제하지 않고 바로 이벤트 진행.
	--코코 정렬 위치로 가서 대사
	local innuit_arrive_pos = self.get_s1_innuit_pos(1, 1)
	local party_wp_key = 'party_members_align'
	local innuit_wp_1 = vector(innuit_arrive_pos.x, innuit.Position.y, innuit.Position.z)
	local innuit_wp_2 = innuit_arrive_pos

	local innuit_wp_list = nil
	if innuit_verti then
		local innuit_wp_0 = innuit.Position + vector(0, 0, -2)
		innuit_wp_1 = vector(innuit_arrive_pos.x, innuit_wp_0.y, innuit_wp_0.z)
		innuit_wp_list = { innuit_wp_0, innuit_wp_1, innuit_wp_2 }
	else
		innuit_wp_list = { innuit_wp_1, innuit_wp_2 }
	end

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(innuit, innuit_wp_list, nil,
			1, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	-- 코코(left, idle, idle) : 안드로이드들이 보고하러 올 시간일텐데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', nil,
			nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 8, skip = true })
	-- 그 때, 안드로이드들이 오른쪽에서 등장해 들어온다.
	local outside_pos_1 = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right',vector(0,0,0))
	local outside_pos_2 = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right',vector(0,0,0), 2)

	local android_arrive_pos = {}
	for i = 1, self.innuit_room_android_count do
		local android = self.get_innuit_room_android(i)
		android_arrive_pos[i] = self.get_innuit_room_android_pos(1, i)
		local android_start_pos = nil
		if i == 1 then
			android_start_pos = vector(outside_pos_1.x, android_arrive_pos[i].y, android_arrive_pos[i].z)
		else
			android_start_pos = vector(outside_pos_2.x, android_arrive_pos[i].y, android_arrive_pos[i].z)
		end
		character_util.set_position(android, android_start_pos)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local android_wp_key = 'android_align'
	for i = 1, self.innuit_room_android_count do
		local android = self.get_innuit_room_android(i)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(android, android_arrive_pos[i], 3.5,
				nil, self, android_wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	-- 안드로이드 이동하는 동안 카메라 포커스 아래 그림에 맞게 이동.
	local s1_camera_pos = self.get_s1_camera_event_pos(1)
	camera_util.move(s1_camera_pos, 0.5)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, android_wp_key)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	start_coroutine(self.intro_event, self)
end

-- 3개 오브젝트 상호작용 다 안하고 존 넘어가려 했을 경우
function local_class:turning_back_to_center_event()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()

function local_class:debug_loop()
	while true do

			if not self.once_move_to_first_event_area then
				self.once_move_to_first_event_area = true

			end
		end

		end

	end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self ,typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_door_opened_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PushStartEvent), 'on_event')

	self.get_fx_dead()
	self.get_fx_blink()
	self.get_fx_red_ice()
	self.get_twinkle_effect()

	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	scene_util.hide_weapon(innuit)
	character_util.stop(innuit)

	self.controller:innuit_hiding_in_breakable_object()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('switch_room_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('switch_room_door_2', false))

	-- 마커는 다음 지나가야 하는 도어에.
	self.controller:backup_sector_quest_marker(true, self.controller.get_quest_marker_pos(2, 1, 1))
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name .. 1, self.main_sector_innuit_quest_id,
			true, self.controller.get_quest_marker_pos(2, 1, 1))
end

function local_class:start()

	local twinkle_buoy_1 = self.get_twinkle_buoy(1)
	local twinkle_buoy_2 = self.get_twinkle_buoy(2)
	self:create_twinkle(2, { twinkle_buoy_1.Position, twinkle_buoy_2.Position })

	-- 임시
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/audio:bgm_queencastle_temple', state = 'field' })
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self ,typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PushStartEvent))

	self:ice_dispose()
	self:twinkle_dispose()
	self.loop_escape = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.loop_escape = true
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PushStartEvent) then
		if not self.twinkle_off then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_twinkle_buoy(1)) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_twinkle_buoy(2)) then
				self.twinkle_off = true
				self:twinkle_dispose()
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.s2_enter_android_room_zone_name then
			if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
				self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_android_battle_zone
				self.destroyed_object = true
				sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_android_room_event, self)
				return true
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.s2_check_enter_first_floor_zone_name then
			if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
				if not self.entered_first_floor_zone then
					self:change_quest_marker_in_s2_first_floor()
				end
				return true
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.s2_check_enter_second_floor_zone_name then
			if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
				if not self.entered_first_floor_zone and not self.entered_second_floor_zone then
					self:change_quest_marker_in_s2_second_floor()
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if not self.twinkle_off then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.s2_check_buoy_zone_name then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_twinkle_buoy(1)) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_twinkle_buoy(2)) then
				self.twinkle_off = true
				self:twinkle_dispose()
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)

	-- 브레이커블 오브젝트 파괴 시
	if string_helper.start_with(e.FieldObject.name, '[breakable]') then
		if not self.destroyed_object then
			start_coroutine(self.innuit_whisper, self)
			self.destroyed_object = true
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if not self.innuit_whisper_in_puzzle_area then
			if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.gimmick_puzzle_area_1_grid_name) then
				start_coroutine(self.check_time_in_puzzle_area, self)
			end
		end
	end

end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.gimmick_puzzle_area_1_grid_name) then
			self:reset_info_in_puzzle_area()
		end
	end

end

function local_class:on_door_opened_event(e)
	local puzzle_1_door_1 = self.get_puzzle_1_door(1)
	local puzzle_1_door_2 = self.get_puzzle_1_door(2)


	if e.DoorHandleName == puzzle_1_door_1.Name or e.DoorHandleName == puzzle_1_door_2.Name then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name .. 1)
		-- 마커는 다음 메인 이벤트 장소로.
		self.controller:backup_sector_quest_marker(true, self.controller.get_quest_marker_pos(2, 2, 1))
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name, self.main_sector_innuit_quest_id, true, self.controller.get_quest_marker_pos(2, 2, 1))
		if not self.innuit_whisper_in_puzzle_area then
			self.innuit_whisper_in_puzzle_area = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)

	if e.BattleGroupName == 'android_room_battle_1' then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.post_battle_event_in_android_room, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 코코, 오브젝트에서 나오기
function local_class:innuit_take_off_object(dir, hide_end, party_on)
	local innuit = self.get_innuit_jar()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_heavenhold_build_complete_01')
	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(innuit.Position)
	self.controller:set_innuit_breakable_object_active_state('disabled', hide_end, party_on)

-- 코코, 오브젝트에 숨기
function local_class:innuit_put_on_object()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_heavenhold_build_complete_01')
	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(innuit.Position)
	self.controller:set_innuit_breakable_object_active_state('enabled', false, false)
	self.controller:change_hidden_innuit_direction('right')

-- breakable object 파괴 시 코코가 컨트롤 뺏지 않은 이벤트로 말풍선 출력
function local_class:innuit_whisper()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit_jar()

	-- 코코 : 폭력적인 인베이더 녀석…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 1, skip = false })

	-- 코코 : 하지만 $name도 저런 걸 부수고 다녔었지…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 3 .. '_' .. 2, skip = false })
end

function local_class:check_time_in_puzzle_area()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local time_passed = 0
	local screen_play = false

	while time_passed < self.puzzle_area_check_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.reset_event_loop_at_innuit_whisper or self.innuit_whisper_in_puzzle_area then
			return
		end

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		-- 스크린 플레이 이벤트 체크
		if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
				CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
			screen_play = true
		end

		while screen_play do
			if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
					CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
				screen_play = false

				if self.loop_escape then
					return
				end
			end
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 코코 : 바보 같은 인베이더 같으니…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 1, skip = false })
	-- 코코 : $name은(는) 더 똑똑… 했었나?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 2, skip = false })

	self.innuit_whisper_in_puzzle_area = true
end

function local_class:reset_info_in_puzzle_area()
	self.reset_event_loop_at_innuit_whisper = false
end

-- 안드로이드 습격 방 zone enter
function local_class:enter_android_room_event()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit_jar()

	local knight_pos_1 = self.get_s2_knight_pos(1, 1)
	local hero_ai_pos_1 = self.get_s2_hero_ai_pos(1, 1)
	local innuit_pos_1 = self.get_s2_innuit_pos(1, 1)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0.5)

	local party_wp_key = 'enter_android_room_center'
	local knight_wp_1 = knight_pos_1
	local hero_ai_wp_1 = knight_pos_1 + vector(0, 0, 1)
	local hero_ai_wp_2 = vector(hero_ai_pos_1.x, hero_ai.Position.y, hero_ai_wp_1.z)
	local hero_ai_wp_3 = hero_ai_pos_1
	local innuit_wp_1 = vector(innuit_pos_1.x, innuit.Position.y, innuit.Position.z)
	local innuit_wp_2 = innuit_pos_1
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, { knight_wp_1 }, 2.5,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero_ai, { hero_ai_wp_1, hero_ai_wp_2, hero_ai_wp_3 }, 2.5,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	-- 코코 문 뒤로 위치
	character_util.set_position(innuit, innuit_wp_2)
	coroutine.yield()
	self.controller:change_hidden_innuit_direction('down')

	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(hero_ai, self,
				nil,
				{ one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01' },
				nil,
				'question'
		)
	end)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(innuit.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 0.7)

	self.controller:change_hidden_innuit_direction('down')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 코코 대사 : (shout 말풍선)여기 인베이더가 있다!
	local scene_name = 'enter_android_room'
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, { one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_01' }, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. scene_name .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('android_room_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('android_room_door_2', false))

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_util.move_async(knight.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 0.5)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(innuit)

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'attack' })

	self:battle_android_setting()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	while not self.battle_android_1_speech_end do
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	start_coroutine(self.start_battle, self)

	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_emotion(hero_ai)
end

function local_class:start_battle()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	for i = 1, self.battle_android_group_count do
		for j = 1, self.battle_android_member_count do
			local android = self.get_battle_android(i, j)
			local android_pos = self.get_s2_battle_android_pos(i, j)
			character_util.convert_to_monster(android, 'android_room_battle_1')
			command_util.execute_monster_notice(android, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:battle_android_setting()
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.get_battle_android(1, 2), 'up')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.get_battle_android(2, 1), 'right')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.get_battle_android(2, 2), 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.get_battle_android(3, 1), 'right')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.get_battle_android(3, 2), 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.get_battle_android(4, 1), 'up')

	for i = 1, self.battle_android_group_count do

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')
		self.get_fx_blink():Instantiate(self.get_s2_battle_android_pos(i, 1))
		self.get_fx_blink():Instantiate(self.get_s2_battle_android_pos(i, 2))

		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		for j = 1, self.battle_android_member_count do
			local android = self.get_battle_android(i, j)
			local android_pos = self.get_s2_battle_android_pos(i, j)

			character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_position(android, android_pos)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, { name = 'mad' })

			if i == 1 and j == 1 then
				start_coroutine(function()
					wait_for_sec(0.2)
					-- 근1 : (shout 말풍선)침입자! 제거하겠습니다!
					scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(android, self,
							nil,
							{ name = 'cast2', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_worker_04' },
							nil,
							{ key = self.string_key .. 0 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

					self.battle_android_1_speech_end = true
				end)
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.15)
	end
end

function local_class:post_battle_event_in_android_room()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit_jar()

	local knight_pos_1 = self.get_s2_knight_pos(1, 2)

	local innuit_pos_2 = self.get_s2_innuit_pos(1, 2)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

function local_class:change_quest_marker_in_s2_first_floor()
	if self.entered_second_floor_zone then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name .. 2)
	end
	self.entered_first_floor_zone = true
end

function local_class:change_quest_marker_in_s2_second_floor()
	self.controller:backup_sector_quest_marker(true, self.controller.get_quest_marker_pos(2, 1, 2))
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name .. 2, self.main_sector_innuit_quest_id,
			true, self.controller.get_quest_marker_pos(2, 1, 2))

	self.entered_second_floor_zone = true
end

function local_class:create_red_ice(count, pos_list)
	self:ice_dispose()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_blizzard_02')

	self.ice = { }
	for i = 1, count do
		self.ice[i] = self.get_fx_red_ice():Instantiate(pos_list[i])
		local animation = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.ice[i].transform, 'fx'):GetComponent(
				typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state
		animation:SetAnimation(0, 'ice_start', false)
	end

	self.ice_max_count = count

	-- 생겨날 때 카메라 쉐이크 0.3초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
end

function local_class:melt_red_ice()
	for i = 1, self.ice_max_count do
		local animation = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.ice[i].transform, 'fx'):GetComponent(
				typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state
		local entry = animation:SetAnimation(0, 'ice_end', false)
		entry.TimeScale = 1.5

	end

	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	self:ice_dispose()
end

function local_class:ice_dispose()
	if self.ice ~= nil then
		for i = 1, self.ice_max_count do
			if self.ice[i] ~= nil then
				self.ice[i]:Dispose()
				self.ice[i] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	self.ice = nil
end

function local_class:create_twinkle(count, pos_list)
	self:twinkle_dispose()

	self.twinkle = { }
	for i = 1, count do
		local pos = pos_list[i] + vector(0.5, 1, 0.5)
		self.twinkle[i] = self.get_twinkle_effect():Instantiate(pos)
	end

	self.twinkle_max_count = count
end

function local_class:twinkle_dispose()
	if self.twinkle ~= nil then
		for i = 1, self.twinkle_max_count do
			if self.twinkle[i] ~= nil then
				self.twinkle[i]:Dispose()
				self.twinkle[i] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	self.twinkle = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JumpStartEvent), 'on_jump_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_event')

	self.get_fx_dead()
	self.get_fx_blink()
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()
	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_out()
	self.get_fx_hit()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	scene_util.hide_weapon(innuit)
	character_util.stop(innuit)

	self.controller:innuit_hiding_in_breakable_object()

	local passed_escape_waterpool_event = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.passed_escape_waterpool_event)
	local passed_puzzle_2_event = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.passed_puzzle_2_event)

	if passed_escape_waterpool_event == 1 then

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.escape_water_pool_end
		-- 2번째 퍼즐 구역 마커
		self.controller:backup_sector_quest_marker(true, self.controller.get_quest_marker_pos(3, 2))
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name, self.main_sector_innuit_quest_id, true, self.controller.get_quest_marker_pos(3, 2))
	else
		-- 물에 빠지는 기사, 케이든AI 이벤트 구역 마커
		self.controller:backup_sector_quest_marker(true, self.controller.get_quest_marker_pos(3, 1))
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name, self.main_sector_innuit_quest_id, true, self.controller.get_quest_marker_pos(3, 1))
	end

	-- 두번째 퍼즐 내 연출 이벤트를 다 봤었는지 체크
	if passed_puzzle_2_event == 1 then
		self.check_passed_puzzle_2_event = true
	end

	-- 두번째 퍼즐 내 연출 이벤트를 다 보지 않았고 퍼즐 내 문이 열린 상태였었다면 문을 다시 닫아줌
	if not self.check_passed_puzzle_2_event then
		if self:check_puzzle_2_area_door_condition() then
			local door = self.get_puzzle_2_door()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(door.Name, false))
		end
	elseif self.check_passed_puzzle_2_event then
		self.puzzle_1_door_open = true
		self.puzzle_2_door_open = true
		self:change_quest_marker_pos()
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_2_area_event_end
	end
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JumpStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))

	self.loop_escape = true

	if self.touch_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end
	if self.fx_water_splash_loop_1 ~= nil then
		self.fx_water_splash_loop_1:Dispose()
		self.fx_water_splash_loop_1 = nil
	end

	if self.fx_water_splash_loop_2 ~= nil then
		self.fx_water_splash_loop_2:Dispose()
		self.fx_water_splash_loop_2 = nil
	end

	if self.water_splash_sfx ~= nil then
		self.water_splash_sfx:Stop()
		self.water_splash_sfx = nil
	end

	self.puzzle_lever_door_pair_list = {}
	self.puzzle_lever_door_pair_list = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.loop_escape = true
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_1_area then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.s3_waterpool_event_zone_name and not self.entered_event then
				self.current_section_state = self.section_state.escape_water_pool
				self.entered_event = true
				sp_util.start_scene(self.start_escape_water_pool_event, self)
				return true
			end
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.escape_water_pool_end then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.s3_puzzle_area_event_zone_name and not self.entered_event then
				if self:check_puzzle_2_area_door_condition() then
					self.entered_event = true

					sp_util.start_scene(self.play_post_puzzle_2_room_event, self)
					return true
				end
			end
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_2_area_event_end then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.s3_enter_android_room_zone_name and not self.entered_event then
				self.entered_event = true
				self.current_section_state = self.section_state.android_room
				sp_util.start_scene(self.play_event_to_meet_android, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.escape_water_pool then
			if not self.innuit_whisper_in_puzzle_area and not self.reset_event_loop_at_innuit_whisper then
				if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.gimmick_puzzle_area_2_grid_name) then
					start_coroutine(self.check_time_in_puzzle_area, self)
				end
			end
		end
	end

end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.gimmick_puzzle_area_2_grid_name) then
			self:reset_info_in_puzzle_area()
		end
	end

end

function local_class:on_jump_start_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, e.JumpInfo.jumper) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_1_area then
			start_coroutine(self.innuit_exit_party, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')

		if not self.qte_complete_1 and not self.qte_knight_moving then
			self.qte_tap_count = self.qte_tap_count + 1

			return true
		end
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		if self.qte_complete_1 then
			self.qte_complete_2 = true
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_fifth_puzzle_buoy_switch_1()) then
		if not self.puzzle_2_door_open and not self.is_pushing then
			self.is_pushing = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.push_switch_button, self, self.get_puzzle_2_door())
			self.puzzle_2_door_open = true
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(innuit.Position)
	self.controller:set_innuit_breakable_object_active_state('enabled')
	self.controller:change_hidden_innuit_direction(dir)
end

function local_class:check_time_in_puzzle_area()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local time_passed = 0
	local screen_play = false

	while time_passed < self.puzzle_area_check_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.reset_event_loop_at_innuit_whisper then
			return
		end

		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		-- 스크린 플레이 이벤트 체크
		if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
				CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
			screen_play = true
		end

		while screen_play do
			if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
					CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
				screen_play = false

				if self.loop_escape then
					return
				end
			end
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 코코 : $name은 더 똑똑했던 것 같은데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 1, skip = false })

	self.innuit_whisper_in_puzzle_area = true
end

function local_class:reset_info_in_puzzle_area()
	self.reset_event_loop_at_innuit_whisper = true
end

-- 물이 차오르는 구역 탈출 이벤트 재생
function local_class:innuit_exit_party()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit_jar()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(innuit)

	scene_util.hide_weapon(innuit)
	character_util.stop(innuit)
end

function local_class:start_escape_water_pool_event()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit_jar()

	local knight_pos_1 = self.get_s3_knight_pos(1, 1)
	local hero_ai_pos_1 = self.get_s3_hero_ai_pos(1, 1)
	local innuit_pos_1 = self.get_s3_innuit_pos(1, 1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0.5)

	local party_wp_key = 'start_escape_water_pool_event'

	local innuit_wp_key = nil
	start_coroutine(function()
		innuit_wp_key = 'innuit_moving_1'
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(innuit, { innuit_pos_1 }, 2.5,
				nil, self, innuit_wp_key)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, innuit_wp_key)

		self.controller:change_hidden_innuit_direction('left')
	end)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, { knight_pos_1 }, 2.5,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero_ai, { hero_ai_pos_1 }, 2.5,
			nil, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	-- 가디언, 케이든 정렬할 때에, 카메라 1초에 걸쳐 코코에게로 포커스 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(innuit.Position, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 코코 fx_dead 이펙트와 함께 쓰고 있던 브레이커블 벗는다.
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.get_innuit(), { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	self:innuit_take_off_object('left', false, false)
	innuit = self.get_innuit()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	innuit_wp_key = 'innuit_moving_2'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(innuit, { self.get_s3_innuit_pos(1, 2) }, nil,
			1, self, innuit_wp_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

	-- 이동 시작하면 가디언과 케이든 둘다 scared, idle
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'scared' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'scared' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, innuit_wp_key)

	-- 카메라 0.5초에 걸쳐 가디언에게로 포커스 이동.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 1번째 선택지
	-- 지금 무슨 짓을 하려는 거야!(보라)
	-- 믿어주기로 했잖아!(초록)
	-- 또, 또, 너냐!(빨강)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 1, 'forced' }, { self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 2, 'mercy' }, { self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 3, 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 가디언 attack, cast2, jump 2회
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'attack' })
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'cast2' })
		character_util.normal_double_jump(knight, true)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
		-- 코코(left, idle, idle) : 이 스위치를 작동시킬 거야.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', nil, nil,
				{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 4, skip = true })
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 가디언 tired, release 3회.
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'tired' })
		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 3, loop = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
		-- 코코(left, idle, nod 1회) : 이건 신뢰의 문제가 아니야.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', { name = 'nod', count = 1, loop = true }, nil,
				{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 5, skip = true })
	elseif choose_result == 3 then
		-- 가디언 mad, jingak 1회.
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'mad' })
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'jingak' })
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(knight, 'jingak')
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration - 0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jingak_01')
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
		-- shake 0.3초
		scene_util.shake(innuit, 0.05, 0.3)
		-- 코코(down, idle, idle) : …
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, nil, nil,
				{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 6, skip = true })
	end

	-- 코코(left, idle, cast) : 이번에는 먼저 설명해줄 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', { name = 'cast' }, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 7, skip = true })
	-- 코코(left, tired, idle) : $name은 어떤 위기도 이겨냈었어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', nil, { name = 'tired' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 8, skip = true })
	-- 코코(left, tired, cast) : 눈보라도… 쉬버링 산맥의 예티들도…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 9, skip = true })

	-- 코코 shake 0.3초
	scene_util.shake(innuit, 0.05, 0.3)
	-- 대기 1초
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 코코(left, idle, idle) : 그곳의 설인들도.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 10, skip = true })
	-- 코코(left, attack, release) : 그러니까 물에 빠져도 충분히 이겨낼 수 있을 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', { name = 'release' }, { name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 11, skip = true })
	-- 코코(left, idle, bow_idle) : 물에서도 살아남고 $name이라는 걸 증명해봐.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', { name = 'bow_idle' }, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 12, skip = true })
	--코코(left,idle,idle): 만약에 네가 여기서 그냥 죽어버린다면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 12 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })
	--코코(left,attack,release): 넌 그냥 일개 인베이더일 뿐이라는 거겠지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, 'left', 'release', 'attack',
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 12 .. '_' .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 케이든AI(right, attack, bow_idle) : 오오, 코코님이 주시는 시련!
	-- 대사 하며 오른쪽으로 0.5칸 이동한다.
	start_coroutine(function()
		hero_ai_pos_1 = hero_ai.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
		party_wp_key = 'start_escape_water_pool_event'
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero_ai, hero_ai_pos_1, nil,
				1, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

		scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'bow_idle' })
	end)

	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 13, skip = true })

	-- 가디언 attack, release 2회
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2, loop = true })
	-- 케이든AI(left, smile, release) : 용사님! 이 시련을 이겨내면 코코님이 용사님을 더 믿어주실 겁니다!

		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'jingak', scale = 2, loop = false })
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(knight, 'jingak') / 2

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 케이든AI : 세상을…
	local first_hero_ai_ment_end = false
	local first_hero_ai_move_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, nil, nil,

	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.move_to_async(hero_ai, backup_hero_ai_pos, 2, nil, false, false)
		first_hero_ai_move_end = true
	end)

	-- 케이든AI는 sleep_deep, prostrate로 물 아래로 가라앉는다.
	-- dead3 애니메이션 재생 속도 0.5배로

		end

	end

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, nil, nil,

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(knight, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, knight_wp_key)

	self:character_interact_water_switch_movement(knight, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'left')

	local cmd = CS.Oak.InteractCommand.Create(innuit, self.get_waterpool_event_switch(), innuit.Position)

	self.fx_water_splash_loop_2:Dispose()

	-- 물이 완전히 빠지면 가디언 + 코코 케이든 AI에게 다가간다.

	knight_wp_pos_1 = vector(self.get_s3_knight_pos(1, 5).x, knight.Position.y, knight.Position.z)
	knight_wp_pos_2 = self.get_s3_knight_pos(1, 5)

	knight_wp_key = 'knight_moving_3'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, { knight_wp_pos_1, knight_wp_pos_2 }, 5,
			nil, self, knight_wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, knight_wp_key)

	local knight_arrived = false
	local innuit_arrived = false

	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'get' })
		character_util.jump_move(knight, self.get_s3_knight_pos(1, 6), 5, 1.3, false, 'left')

		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		knight_wp_pos_1 = vector(self.get_s3_knight_pos(1, 7).x, knight.Position.y, knight.Position.z)
		knight_wp_pos_2 = self.get_s3_knight_pos(1, 7)

		knight_wp_key = 'knight_moving_3'
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, { knight_wp_pos_1, knight_wp_pos_2 }, 5,
				nil, self, knight_wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, knight_wp_key)

		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'push', upper = true })
		character_util.move_to_async(knight, hero_ai.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0), nil, 1, true, false)

		knight_arrived = true
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		innuit_pos_1 = vector(innuit.Position.x, innuit.Position.y, self.get_s3_knight_pos(1, 5).z)
		local innuit_pos_2 = self.get_s3_knight_pos(1, 5)
		innuit_wp_key = 'innuit_moving_4'
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(innuit, { innuit_pos_1, innuit_pos_2 }, 5,
				nil, self, innuit_wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		scene_util.set_anim(innuit, self, { name = 'get' })
		character_util.jump_move(innuit, self.get_s3_innuit_pos(1, 4), 5, 1.3, true, 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim(innuit)

		innuit_pos_1 = vector(self.get_s3_innuit_pos(1, 5).x, innuit.Position.y, innuit.Position.z)
		innuit_pos_2 = self.get_s3_innuit_pos(1, 5)
		innuit_wp_key = 'innuit_moving_5'

				nil, self, innuit_wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 25, skip = true })
	-- 가디언 left, attack, release 2회

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2, loop = true })
	-- 이후에도 attack 표정 유지.
	-- 코코 right, nod 1회

	-- 코코(right, bow_idle) : 자, 일단 이걸 먹어.
