		NextSections = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_1_6'

	-- npc
	self.get_hero_ai = function()
		return get_character('hero_ai')
	end
	self.get_knight = function()
		return user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
	end

	self.get_tanker = function()
		return get_character('tanker')
	end

	self.get_tanker_battle = function()
		return get_character('tanker_battle')
	end

	self.get_knight_maid = function()
		return user_util.get_knight_character('knight_maid_female', 'knight_maid_male')
	end

	self.get_hero_ai_maid = function()
		return get_character('hero_ai_maid')
	end

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_lasthit_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	end

	self.get_field_fire_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_field_fire')
	end

	self.get_dead_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	end

	self.section_state = {
		before_battle = 1,
		in_battle = 2,
		after_battle = 3,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_battle

	self.s5_boss_battle_group_name = 's5_battle_1'

	self.battle = {
		get_shooter = function(num)
			return get_field_object('s5_battle_shooter_' .. num)
		end,
		shooter_count = 2,
		fire_damage_ratio = 1 / 5,
	}
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

	self.get_lasthit_effect()
	self.get_field_fire_effect()
	self.get_dead_effect()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:pre_setting()

	start_coroutine(self.battle_intro_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.controller.ui.scoring_activated = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local boss = self.get_tanker_battle()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_battle and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, boss) and
			type_util.check_lua_gimmick(e.Info.sender, 'FireballStatue') then

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = self.get_tanker()
		damage_info.target = boss
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(boss.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.battle.fire_damage_ratio) -
				e.Info:GetTotalDamage()

		command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.s5_boss_battle_group_name and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_battle then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_battle

		start_coroutine(self.battle_end_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

		fx_scaling_req_id = fx_scaling_req_id + 1

		local cur_req_id = fx_scaling_req_id
		local start_scale = knight_fire_effect.transform.localScale.x
		local time_passed = 0
		local cur_scale = 0
		local knight_fire_start_pos = knight_fire_effect.transform.position
		local hero_ai_fire_start_pos = hero_ai_fire_effect.transform.position
		local knight_fire_target_pos = knight.Position + target_offset
		local hero_ai_fire_target_pos = hero_ai.Position + target_offset

		while cur_req_id == fx_scaling_req_id and time_passed < duration do
			cur_scale = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_scale, scale - start_scale, duration)

			local progress = time_passed / duration
			knight_fire_effect.transform.position = knight_fire_start_pos * (1 - progress) + knight_fire_target_pos * progress
			hero_ai_fire_effect.transform.position = hero_ai_fire_start_pos * (1 - progress) + hero_ai_fire_target_pos * progress

			knight_fire_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale
			hero_ai_fire_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_fire_01')
		self.get_dead_effect():Instantiate(new_knight.Position)
		self.get_dead_effect():Instantiate(new_hero_ai.Position)

		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		param.HidePreviousParty = true
		param.MoveCamera = false

		character_util.convert_to_manual_character(new_knight, param, true)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(new_hero_ai, user_party, true)

		stage_camera:SetTarget(new_knight)

		knight = new_knight
		hero_ai = new_hero_ai
	end

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(fire_sfx_loop)

	knight_fire_effect:Dispose()
	hero_ai_fire_effect:Dispose()

	self.controller.s4_knight_fire_effect = nil
	self.controller.s4_hero_ai_fire_effect = nil

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--이후 플레이어 일행 right, surprise, jump 1회 실행. 크레이그 동시에 left, attack, jump 1회 실행.
	character_util.set_group_direction({ knight, hero_ai }, 'right')
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ knight, hero_ai }, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(tanker, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(tanker, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.group_normal_jump_async({ knight, hero_ai })

	--크레이그 (left, attack, idle) : 그 더러운 몰골은… 인베이더…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
			'idle', nil, 'qc_sector_tk_s5_2_4')

	--크레이그 (left, tired, idle) : …지금껏 내 안드로이드 병사들 속에서 숨어있었던 건가…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
			'idle', nil, 'qc_sector_tk_s5_2_5')

	-- 이 교관과… 나의 병사들을 모두 속여온 것들…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
			'idle', 'eyelight', 'qc_sector_tk_s5_3')
	-- 그 목숨으로 갚게 해주마!!!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
			{ name = 'jingak', loop = false, sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_01' },
			'eyelight', 'qc_sector_tk_s5_4')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tanker)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)

	--현혹된 챔피언 크레이그
	--교관님의 마지막 훈련입니다
	screen_util.show_boss_title('qc_sector_tanker_s5_boss_title',
			'qc_sector_tanker_s5_boss_subtitle', 2, false)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(2)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_battle

	for i = 1, 4 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s5_battlegate_' .. i, false))
	end
	--보스전 npc 변경
	self:convert_battle_tanker()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 4 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end

	for i = 1, self.battle.shooter_count do
		local shooter = self.battle.get_shooter(i)

		shooter.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable():turn_on()
	end

	-- 전투 종료 이벤트를 점수에 포함시키지 않기 위해 잠시 기능 꺼둠
	self.controller.ui.scoring_activated = false

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, knight)
end

--배틀 종료 시 컨트롤 제어 후 다음 섹션 넘겨 주기
function local_class:battle_end_scene()
	local tanker_battle = self.get_tanker_battle()

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	for i = 1, self.battle.shooter_count do
		local shooter = self.battle.get_shooter(i)
		local lua_table = shooter.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()

		lua_table:turn_off()
		lua_table:dispose_fireball()
	end

	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('s5_battlegate_' .. i, false))
	end

	tanker_battle.Position = vector(-999, 0, -999)
	character_util.set_active_state(tanker_battle, 'disabled')

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)

function local_class:convert_battle_tanker()
	local tanker = self.get_tanker()

	tanker_battle.Position = tanker.Position
	tanker.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	character_util.set_active_state(tanker_battle, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(tanker_battle, tanker.Direction)

	command_util.execute_monster_notice(tanker_battle, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(tanker_battle))

	local hero_ai_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_race_end_hero_ai')

	character_util.set_position(leader_maid, leader_pos)
	character_util.set_position(hero_ai_maid, hero_ai_pos)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader_maid, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai_maid, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(tanker, 'left', false)
end

return local_class

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenCastleSectorTanker @

	end

	end

	end

	end

function local_class:on_pre_load()

end

end

function local_class:start()

end

	self.quest_spec = nil

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)

		self.qte_touched = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:battle_after_scene()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local tanker = self.get_tanker()
	local tanker_without_helmet = self.get_tanker_without_helmet()

	do
		local leader_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_knight_battle_pos')
		character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
		character_util.set_position(knight, leader_pos)

		local hero_ai_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_hero_ai_battle_pos')
		character_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'right')
		character_util.set_position(hero_ai, hero_ai_pos)

		local tanker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_tanker_battle_pos')

		character_util.set_direction(tanker, 'left')
		character_util.set_position(tanker, tanker_pos)
		scene_util.set_anim(tanker, self, 'prostrate')
		scene_util.set_emotion(tanker, self, 'damaged')
	end

	--보스전 완료 후 페이드 인 시 카메라 플레이어 중심으로 배치된 상태.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 5 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music(
				{ state = 'field', name = 'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/audio:bgm_queencastle_temple', volume = 0.5 })
	else
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.get_qc_util():break_sector_boss_helmet({
		sector_boss = tanker,
		sector_boss_no_helmet = tanker_without_helmet,
		knight = knight
	})

	tanker = tanker_without_helmet

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(tanker, 'left', 1, nil, true)

	scene_util.set_emotion(tanker, self, 'tired')

	--크레이그 (left, tired, idle) : 으윽… 도대체 무슨 일이…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil, nil, nil, 'qc_sector_tk_s6_1')

	--병정 놀이는 끝났어?(빨강)
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'qc_sector_tk_s6_2', 'brutal' } })

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'doyagao')

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	--케이든 AI (right, attack, cast) : 크레이그님! 비록 적에게 현혹된 모습이었지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			'cast', 'attack', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_3')

	--카이 (right, smile, cast) : 용사님을 지키기 위해 수많은 병사들을 지도하는 모습은…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			'cast', 'smile', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_4')

	--카이 (right, smile, cast2, jump 1회) : 챔피언 그 자체였습니다!!!
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			'cast2', 'smile', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_4_1')

	--케이든 AI (right, awesome, victory_extra) : 이 케이! 챔피언님의 진심에 감복했습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			'victory_extra', 'awesome', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_5')

	--크레이그 (left, tired, idle) : 정말 바보같은 짓을 했던 것 같군…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
			nil, 'tired', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_6')

	--크레이그 (left, idle, idle) : 이젠 정신이 말끔해졌다. 이제 모든 게 다 기억났어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'qc_sector_tk_s6_7')

	--던전왕국에서 악마를 잡았던 일?(초록)
	--공주님을 해칠뻔했던 일?(빨강)
	--안드로이드들로 병정놀이를 했던 일?(보라)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'qc_sector_tk_s6_8', 'mercy' }, { 'qc_sector_tk_s6_9', 'brutal' }, { 'qc_sector_tk_s6_10', 'forced' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'cast2')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		--크레이그 (left, smile, cross_arm) : 그것도 포함해서, 너가 내 가장 소중한 친구였다는 것도 모두 기억났어.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
				'cross_arm', 'smile', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_11')

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		--크레이그 (left, tired, idle) : 정신이 나가서 소중한 사람들을 해치려 했다니… 한심스러운 일이지만…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
				nil, 'tired', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_12')

	else
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'cross_arm')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'doyagao')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		--크레이그 (left, blush, idle) : 그 일은 에일리에겐 비밀로 해줘. 분명 엄청 놀릴테니까…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
				nil, 'blush', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_13')
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(tanker, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	--크레이그 (left, smile victory_get) : 이젠 걱정하지마. 예전처럼 너희를 지켜주도록 하지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
			nil, 'smile', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_14')
	character_util.remove_anim(tanker)

	--케이든 AI (right, attack, release 2회) : 크레이그님. 협력도 좋지만, 지금은 적절한 휴식이 우선입니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_15')

	--케이든 AI (right, smile, cast 2) : 부유성 제어실에서 회복하는 것을 권해드립니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			'cast2', 'smile', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_16')

	--크레이그 (left, attack, idle) : 그렇다면 알겠어. 필요하면 언제든 불러줘!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil,
			nil, 'attack', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_17')

	do
		local exit_x = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_tanker_exit_x').x
		local target_pos = vector(exit_x, 0, tanker.Position.z + 1)
		local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(tanker, target_pos, false)

		wp_util.move_async(tanker, waypoints,4)
	end

	character_util.set_position(tanker, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
	--케이든 AI (up, idle, idle) : 크레이그님도 무사히 구출되어 다행입니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'up', nil, nil, 'qc_sector_tk_s6_18')

	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	--케이든 AI (left, smile, victory_get) : 자! 이제 신전의 활성화 스위치를 가동시키러 가죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'left', nil,
			'smile', 'qc_sector_tk_s6_19')
	character_util.remove_anim(hero_ai)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 5 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:set_tesla_connection_on_stage_load()
	local size = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

	self.giant_teslas = {}
	self.s3_giant_teslas = {}
	self.s4_giant_teslas = {}
	self.s5_giant_teslas = {}
	self.last_teslas = {}

	--1,2 섹션은 비워둔다
	self.giant_teslas[1] = {}
	self.giant_teslas[2] = {}
	self.giant_teslas[3] = self.s3_giant_teslas
	self.giant_teslas[4] = self.s4_giant_teslas
	self.giant_teslas[5] = self.s5_giant_teslas

	for i = 3, 5 do
		local idx = 1
		while true do
			local cur_tesla = self.get_giant_tesla_coil(i, idx)
			if cur_tesla == nil then
				break
			end

			cur_tesla.Transform.localScale = size
			cur_tesla.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(size)

			table.insert(self.giant_teslas[i], cur_tesla)
			idx = idx + 1
		end
	end

	--1,2 섹션은 비워둔다
	self.last_teslas[1] = false
	self.last_teslas[2] = false
	self.last_teslas[3] = self.s3_giant_teslas[#self.s3_giant_teslas]
	self.last_teslas[4] = self.s4_giant_teslas[#self.s4_giant_teslas]
	self.last_teslas[5] = self.s5_giant_teslas[#self.s5_giant_teslas]

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			self:connect_all_giant_tesla_by_section(3, true)
			self:connect_all_giant_tesla_by_section(4, true)
			self:connect_all_giant_tesla_by_section(5, true)
		else
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 5 then
				self:connect_all_giant_tesla_by_section(3, true)
				self:connect_all_giant_tesla_by_section(4, true)
				self:connect_all_giant_tesla_by_section(5, true)
			elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 4 then
				self:connect_all_giant_tesla_by_section(3)
				self:connect_all_giant_tesla_by_section(4)
			elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3 then
				self:connect_all_giant_tesla_by_section(3)
			end
		end
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:set_iron_teatans_rush_barricades_active_state(state)
	local idx = 1

	while true do
		local s6_barricade = self.get_s6_barricade(idx)

		if s6_barricade == nil then
			break
		end

		s6_barricade.ActiveState = active_state(state)
		idx = idx + 1
	end
end

function local_class:set_s2_androids_active_state(state)
	local idx = 1

	while true do
		local s2_android = self.get_s2_android_worker(idx)

		if s2_android == nil then
			break
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(s2_android, state)
		idx = idx + 1
	end
end

function local_class:set_2_barricades_active_state(state)
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local s2_barricade = self.get_s2_barricade(i)

		if s2_barricade ~= nil then
			s2_barricade.ActiveState = active_state(state)
		end
	end

	self:set_s2_androids_active_state('disabled')

function local_class:create_iron_teatans_headless(pos)
	pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos, field_util.get_marker_pos('iron_teatan_headless_pos'))

	if self.res_holder == nil then
		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, self.res_holder,
			'theatres/iron_teatans', 'iron_teatans_headless', function(prefab)
				local obj = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.iron_teatans_headless_trans = obj.transform
				self.iron_teatans_headless_trans.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
				self.iron_teatans_headless_trans.position = pos
			end)
end

function local_class:turn_on_iron_teatans_headless_android_effect()
	local android_1 = self.get_headless_teatan_android(1)
	local android_2 = self.get_headless_teatan_android(2)

	local effect_pos_1 = android_1.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 0)
	self.twosword_oppose_spark_effect_1 = self.get_fx_twosword_oppose_spark():Instantiate(
			effect_pos_1
	)

	local effect_pos_2 = android_2.Position + vector(-0.75, 0, 0)
	self.twosword_oppose_spark_effect_2 = self.get_fx_twosword_oppose_spark():Instantiate(
			effect_pos_2
	)
end

function local_class:turn_off_iron_teatans_headless_android_effect()
	if self.twosword_oppose_spark_effect_1 ~= nil then
		self.twosword_oppose_spark_effect_1:Dispose()
	end
	self.twosword_oppose_spark_effect_1 = nil

	if self.twosword_oppose_spark_effect_2 ~= nil then
		self.twosword_oppose_spark_effect_2:Dispose()
	end
	self.twosword_oppose_spark_effect_2 = nil
end

function local_class:connect_all_giant_tesla_by_section(section_num, exclude_last_tesla)
	local section_n_giant_teslas = self.giant_teslas[section_num]
	local section_n_giant_teslas_len = #section_n_giant_teslas

	if section_n_giant_teslas_len == 0 then
		return
	end

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(section_n_giant_teslas[1].Name))


	if exclude_last_tesla then
		section_n_giant_teslas_len = section_n_giant_teslas_len - 1
	end

	if section_n_giant_teslas_len > 1 then
		for i = 1, section_n_giant_teslas_len - 1 do
			local from_fo = section_n_giant_teslas[i]
			local to_fo = section_n_giant_teslas[i + 1]
			self:connect_giant_tesla(from_fo, to_fo)
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(to_fo.Name))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:connect_giant_tesla(tesla_1, tesla_2)
	if self.giant_tesla_ray_fxs == nil then
		self.giant_tesla_ray_fxs = {}
	end

	local key = self:make_ray_connect_key(tesla_1, tesla_2)

	if self.giant_tesla_ray_fxs[key] == nil then
		local ray_effect = CS.Oak.TeslaRayEffect.GetOrCreate(tesla_1, tesla_2)
		local pos_1 = vector_util.get_x0z(tesla_1.Bounds.center, tesla_1.Position.y + tesla_1.Bounds.size.y)
		local pos_2 = vector_util.get_x0z(tesla_2.Bounds.center, tesla_2.Position.y + tesla_2.Bounds.size.y)
		ray_effect:SetRay(pos_1, pos_2, true)
		self.giant_tesla_ray_fxs[key] = ray_effect
	else
		self.giant_tesla_ray_fxs[key]:SetAppear()
	end
end

function local_class:disconnect_giant_tesla(key)
	if self.giant_tesla_ray_fxs[key] ~= nil then
		self.giant_tesla_ray_fxs[key]:SetDisappear()
	end
end

function local_class:disconnect_giant_tesla_v2(from_fo, to_fo)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create(to_fo.Name))
	local key = self:make_ray_connect_key(from_fo, to_fo)
	self:disconnect_giant_tesla(key)
end

function local_class:make_ray_connect_key(from_fo, to_fo)
	return from_fo.Name .. '_to_' .. to_fo.Name
end

function local_class:add_quest_marker(fo_or_pos, tag_num)
	local key = self.quest_marker_name
	if tag_num ~= nil then
		key = key .. tag_num
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(fo_or_pos, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject)) or
			lua_helper.type_compare(fo_or_pos, typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(key, self.quest_id, true, fo_or_pos)
	else
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(key, self.quest_id, true, fo_or_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_quest_marker(tag_num)
	local key = self.quest_marker_name
	if tag_num ~= nil then
		key = key .. tag_num
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove(key)
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:start()
	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
		self:npc_setting()
	end
end

function local_class:move_iron_head()
	if self.iron_teatan_head == nil then
		return
	end
	self.show_iron_head_scene = true

	local start_pos = self.get_marker_iron_head_pos(1) * 1.25 + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local end_pos = self.get_marker_iron_head_pos(2) * 1.25

	self.iron_teatan_head:move(start_pos, end_pos, nil, nil, nil, true)
end

	local function local_hero_landing(fo, dir, pos, jump_height, fall_duration)
		-- 캐릭터를 히어로 랜딩 할 위치로 배치
		character_util.set_position(fo, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
		character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'attack2', loop = false })

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local start_pos = fo.Position
		local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, fo.Position.y, 0)
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
			free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

			if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
				character_util.set_position(fo, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
			else
				character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 낙하 위치
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
		character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
		self.get_fx_shockwave():Instantiate(pos)
		scene_util.set_group_emotion(androids, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.group_normal_jump(androids)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_emotion(hero, self, 'surprise')
	end

	local_hero_landing(fat_androids[2], 'right', self.get_marker_fat_android_pos(2) + vector(-1, 0, 0), 10, 0.6)

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero, 'qc_sector_th_s1_37')

	--『우리 중에서 제일 뛰어난 공학자야.』(mercy)

function local_class:enter()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet = {}
	for i = 1, 9 do
		self.pooled_bullet[i] = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
		bullet_sprite.SortingLayer = 'Top Effects'
		bullet_sprite.SortingOrder = 2

		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'bullet.png'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
	end

	self.iron_teatan_head = self.controller.iron_teatan_head
	self.iron_teatan_head:set_position(vector(999, 0, 999))

	self.iron_teatan_head.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self.iron_teatan_head_2 = self.controller.iron_teatan_flying_head

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.controller:add_quest_marker(quest_marker_pos)

		}
	}

	for i = 1, #barricade_holder_idx do
		local holder = self.get_android_worker(barricade_holder_idx[i].holder)
		local barricade = self.get_barricade(barricade_holder_idx[i].barricade)

	self.iron_teatan_head_2 = nil

	if self.pooled_bullet ~= nil then

		end
		self.pooled_bullet = nil
	end

	self.move_2_end = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()

		for i = 1, #self.pooled_bullet do
			self.pooled_bullet[i]:Dispose()

		self.pooled_bullet = nil
	end

	self.iron_teatan_head = nil

	self.controller = nil

	self.quest_progress = nil

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.iron_teatan_head.fo) and not self.is_interacted then
		self.is_interacted = true
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.teatan_meet
		sp_util.start_scene(self.teatan_meet_scene, self)
		target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.teatan_head then
		for i = 1, self.android_scene_count do
			if self.android_scene_flag[i] and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.get_android_zone_name(i)) then
				self.android_scene_flag[i] = false
				self:android_event(i)
				return true
			end
		end
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.teatan_head_event_zone_name) then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.teatan_head
			sp_util.start_scene(self.teatan_head_move_event, self, e.Zone)
			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.center_exit_block_zone) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.block_exit, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.tutorial_zone) and
			not self.saw_tutorial then
		self.saw_tutorial = true
		sp_util.start_scene(self.lightning_tutorial, self)
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

 function local_class:block_exit()

	 scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
	 scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
	 scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s2_5_2')

	 party_util.align_party(leader.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0), 'right', 1)

 end

function local_class:lightning_routine(character, on_wait_callback)
	local casting_time = 3
	character_util.show_attack_timer(character, casting_time)
	local fx_pos = character.Bounds.center
	local cloud_thunder_fx = self.get_cloud_thunder_player_elec_effect():Instantiate(fx_pos)

	if on_wait_callback ~= nil then
		on_wait_callback()
	end

	wait_for_sec(casting_time)

	cloud_thunder_fx:Dispose()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_thunder_02')

	character_util.hide_attack_timer(character)
	self.get_cloud_thunder_effect():Instantiate(fx_pos)

	scene_util.set_direction(character, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, { name = 'hurt' })
	character_util.add_color(character, 'dead_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
end

function local_class:lightning_tutorial()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local android_a = self.get_lightning_tutorial_android(1)
	local android_b = self.get_lightning_tutorial_android(2)
	local lightning_holdable = self.get_tutorial_lightning_holdable()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	android_a.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	--가디언 left 방향 바라봄.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	--화면 왼쪽으로 4타일 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position + vector(-4, 0, 3.5), 1)

	--안드로이드A(right, idle, bomb_idle) : 이거면 정말 번개로부터 안전한게 맞습니까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.set_anim(android_a, self, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_a, 'qc_sector_th_s2_lightning_tutorial_1')

	--안드로이드B(left, idle, idle) : 물론이죠. 마리안님께서 제작한 특수 피뢰침을 설치하면 전혀 문제될게 없습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_b, 'qc_sector_th_s2_lightning_tutorial_2')

	--안드로이드B(up, idle, release) : 제가 설치 작업을 진행할테니, 저쪽에서 실험을 진행해주세요.
	scene_util.set_anim(android_b, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_b, 'qc_sector_th_s2_lightning_tutorial_3')

	--안드로이드B가 오른쪽에 있는 홀더블 피뢰침을 hold 한 뒤 up 방향으로 3타일 위쪽에 throw하여 내려놓음.
	scene_util.set_direction(android_b, 'right')
	command_util.execute_holdup(android_b, lightning_holdable, android_b.Position, nil, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--홀더블 피뢰침이 깔리며 동일한 스펙으로 안전 구역 생성됨.
	scene_util.set_direction(android_b, 'up')
	command_util.execute_throw(android_b, lightning_holdable,
			vector(0, 0, 1), android_b.Position + vector(0, 0, 3), 10.5, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--안드로이드A가 3타일 위쪽으로 이동. 이후 피뢰침이 작동하며, 왼쪽에 있는 고정형 테슬라에도 테슬라가 연결 됨.
	character_util.move_distance_async(android_a, vector(0, 0, 3),
			nil, 2, true, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_thunder_02',
		type_priority = sfx_type_priority.gimmick,
		player_priority = sfx_player_priority.object
	})

	self.get_cloud_thunder_effect():Instantiate(lightning_holdable.Position)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(lightning_holdable))

	--홀더블 피뢰침 타이머(5초)가 돌고 있음.
	--안드로이드A(down, idle, jump 1회) : 성공입니다! 원활한 작업을 위해 다음 피뢰침을 설치해주세요!
	scene_util.set_direction(android_a, 'down')
	character_util.normal_jump(android_a, true)

	--해당 대사가 시작된 거의 직후에 하단의 대사 진행.
	--안드로이드B(down, sleep, sleep)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sleep_02')
	scene_util.set_direction(android_b, 'down')
	scene_util.set_anim(android_b, self, { name = 'sleep' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_b, self, { name = 'sleep' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(android_a, { key = 'qc_sector_th_s2_lightning_tutorial_4', skip = true })

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < 3.7 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(android_a)

	--피뢰침 타이머(5초)가 다 될 시, 피뢰침이 사라지고 안드로이드A 대사 진행.
	--안드로이드A에 번개가 모이는 이펙트(fx_gimmick_cloud_thunder_player_elec)가 출력되며 down 방향 surprise 표정 jump 1회.
	--안드로이드A(down, scared, embarrassed) : 빨, 빨리 다음 피뢰침을…!
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			self:lightning_routine(android_a)
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(android_a)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			scene_util.set_direction(android_a, 'down')
			scene_util.set_emotion(android_a, self, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump_async(android_a, true)
			scene_util.set_anim(android_a, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })
			scene_util.set_emotion(android_a, self, { name = 'scared' })
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_a, 'qc_sector_th_s2_lightning_tutorial_5')
		end)
	})

	wait_for_sec(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:barricade_throw_event(android_num, barricade_num, dir, target_pos)
	local android = self.get_android_worker(android_num)
	local throw_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(dir)
	local barricade = self.get_barricade(barricade_num)

	if not barricade.Holdable.IsHeld then
		scene_util.set_direction(android, 'left')
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'eat')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
		scene_util.set_direction(android, dir)

		barricade.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

		command_util.execute_holdup(android, barricade, android.Position, 0, true)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	command_util.execute_throw(android, barricade, throw_dir, android.Position, 1, true)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	sp_util.sine_move(barricade,
			{
				from = barricade.Position,
				to = target_pos,
				duration = 0.5,
				height = 0.8
			})

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_magwi_rock_set_01', parent = barricade,
		type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
end

function local_class:android_event(num)
	if num == 1 then
		start_coroutine(self.android_event_1, self)
	elseif num == 2 then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.android_event_2, self)
	end
end

function local_class:android_event_1()
	local move_speed = 4.5
	local function get_waypoint(android, target_pos, flag)
		flag = lua_helper.get_or_default(flag, false)
		return wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(android, target_pos, flag)
	end

	local function reload(android, wp_list)
		wp_util.move_async(android, wp_list, move_speed, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'down' })
		scene_util.set_anim_async(android, self, { name = 'rifle_reload', count = 1, sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_03' })
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'rifle_idle')
	end

	local function reload_and_look_around(android, wp_list)
		wp_util.move_async(android, wp_list, move_speed, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'down' })
		scene_util.set_anim_async(android, self, { name = 'rifle_reload', count = 1, sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_03' })
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'rifle_idle')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		scene_util.set_direction(android, 'left')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		scene_util.set_direction(android, 'right')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		scene_util.set_direction(android, 'down')
	end

	-- 안드로이드 1,2,3,4 NPC 각각 루트를 따라 움직인 후 down 방향 바라봄
	-- 도착시
	-- 안드로이드1 (down,idle, rifle_reload 1회)
	-- 안드로이드2 (down,idle, idle) 자세로 대기.
	-- 안드로이드3 (down,idle, idle) 자세로 대기.
	-- 안드로이드4 (down,idle, rifle_reload 1회) 자세 후 대기.
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local android = self.get_android_worker(i)
		local target_pos = self.get_move_pos(i)
		local wp_list = get_waypoint(android, target_pos)

		if i == 1 then
			start_coroutine(reload, android, wp_list)
		elseif i == 3 or i == 4then
			start_coroutine(reload_and_look_around, android, wp_list)
		else
			wp_util.move(android, wp_list, move_speed, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'down' })
		end
	end

	-- 안드로이드 5,6,7,8 NPC 각각 루트를 따라 움직인 후 down 방향 바라봄
	-- 도착시
	-- 안드로이드5,6
	-- 두 NPC 모두 도착시, 안드로이드 5가 left 방향으로 eat 자세 1초. 이후 안드로이드5 npc가 hold자세로 바리케이드 2x1 오브젝트를 생성해서 머리 위에 든다.
	-- (wall_in2_barricade)
	-- 이후 down 방향 throw 자세로 1타일 아래쪽에 2x1 오브젝트 내려놓음.
	-- 이후 안드로이드6은 right 방향 , 안드로이드5는 left 방향으로 동시에 nod 1회 한 후
	-- 두 NPC 모두 down방향 push 자세로 바리케이드 오브젝트와 함께 1칸 아래로 이동. 이후 둘 다 idle 자세 대기.
	-- 안드로이드7 (down,idle, idle) 자세로 대기.
	-- 안드로이드8 (down,idle, rifle_reload 1회) 자세 후 대기.
	for i = 5, 8 do
		local android = self.get_android_worker(i)
		local target_pos = self.get_move_pos(i)
		local wp_list = get_waypoint(android, target_pos)

		if i == 6 then
			wp_util.move(android, wp_list, move_speed, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'down' })
		elseif i == 7 then
			start_coroutine(reload_and_look_around, android, wp_list)
		elseif i == 5 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				local version_holder = self
				local android_a = android
				local android_b = self.get_android_worker(6)
				local barricade = self.get_barricade(1)

				wp_util.move_async(android_a, wp_list, move_speed, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'down' })
				self:barricade_throw_event(5, 1, 'down', android_a.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))
				scene_util.set_direction(android_a, 'right')
				scene_util.set_anim(android_a, version_holder, 'nod')
				scene_util.set_direction(android_b, 'left')
				scene_util.set_anim(android_b, version_holder, 'nod')
				wait_for_sec(1)

				-- 미는 장면
				local target_vec = vector(0, 0, -1)
				scene_util.set_direction(android_a, 'down')
				scene_util.set_anim(android_a, version_holder, { 'shoot', loop = true })
				character_util.move_to(android_a, android_a.Position + target_vec, nil, 1)

				scene_util.set_direction(android_b, 'down')
				scene_util.set_anim(android_b, version_holder, { 'shoot', loop = true })
				wp_util.move(android_b, android_b.Position + target_vec, nil, 1)

				character_util.move_to_async(barricade, barricade.Position + target_vec, 1, nil)

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_a)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_b)

				end)
		elseif i == 8 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				local version_holder = self
				reload(android, wp_list)

				self.android_8_move_end = true

				while self.android_9_move_end ~= true do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				local android_9 = self.get_android_worker(9)

				--해당 NPC 도착시, 0.5초 후 (down, deep_sleep, sleep) 자세로 누움.
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				scene_util.set_direction(android_9, 'down')
				scene_util.set_anim(android_9, version_holder, { name = 'sleep' })
				scene_util.set_emotion(android_9, version_holder, { name = 'deep_sleep' })

				--0.5초뒤 왼쪽의 안드로이드8 NPC가 right 방향 전환 후, 0.5초 이후 안드로이드9한테 attack 자세 1회 실행.
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				scene_util.set_direction(android, 'right')
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'attack', loop = false, remove_after = 0.5, sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_09'})

				--안드로이드9 hit 이펙트와 함께 left 방향 전환 후 scared 표정으로 embarrassed 1초.
				wait_for_sec(0.15)
				music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_hit_critical_01'})
				self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(android_9.Bounds.center)

				scene_util.set_direction(android_9, 'left')
				scene_util.set_anim(android_9, version_holder, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })
				scene_util.set_emotion(android_9, version_holder, { name = 'scared' })

				--0.5초 뒤 안드로이드8이 left 방향 attack 표정으로 release 2회.
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				character_util.set_anim(android, {name = 'release', remove_after = 0.98})
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--이후 안드로이드 8,9 NPC 둘다 down 방향, idle 표정으로 바라봄.
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_9)
				scene_util.set_direction(android, 'down')
				scene_util.set_direction(android_9, 'down')
			end)
		end
	end

	-- 안드로이드 9,10,11 NPC 각각 루트를 따라 움직인 후 down 방향 바라봄
	-- 도착시
	-- 안드로이드9 (down,idle, idle) 자세로 대기.
	-- 안드로이드10 (down,idle, rifle_reload 1회) 자세 후 대기.
	-- 안드로이드11 (down,idle, idle) 자세로 대기.
	-- 안드로이드12 (down,idle, idle) 자세로 대기.
	-- 안드로이드13 (down,idle, rifle_reload) 자세 후 대기.
	-- 안드로이드14 (down,idle, rifle_idle) 자세 후 대기.
	for i = 9, 14 do
		local android = self.get_android_worker(i)
		local target_pos = self.get_move_pos(i)
		local wp_list = get_waypoint(android, target_pos)

		if i == 9 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				wp_util.move_async(android, wp_list, move_speed, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'down' })
				self.android_9_move_end = true
			end)
		elseif i == 10 then
			start_coroutine(reload, android, wp_list)
		elseif i == 1 then
			start_coroutine(reload_and_look_around, android, wp_list)
		elseif i == 13 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				local version_holder = self
				local android_a = android
				local barricade = self.get_barricade(2)

				scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'walk' })
				scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'hold', upper = true, one_shot_sfx = false })
				for i = 1, #wp_list do
					character_util.move_to_async(android, wp_list[i], nil, move_speed, true, false)
				end
				character_util.remove_anim(android)
				character_util.remove_anim(android, true)

				self:barricade_throw_event(13, 2, 'down', android_a.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))
				character_util.remove_emotion(android_a)
				scene_util.set_anim(android_a, version_holder, { name = 'carpenter_hammer' })
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mining_01')
			end)
		elseif i == 14 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				wp_util.move_async(android, wp_list, move_speed, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'down' })
				self.android_14_move_end = true
			end)
		else
			wp_util.move(android, wp_list, move_speed, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'down' })
		end
	end

	-- 안드로이드 15,16,17,18,19,20 NPC 각각 루트를 따라 움직인 후 down 방향 바라봄
	-- 도착시
	-- 안드로이드15
	-- left 방향으로 eat 자세 1초, 이후 npc가 hold자세로 바리케이드 2x1 오브젝트를 생성해서 머리 위에 든다.
	-- (wall_in2_barricade)
	-- 이후 down 방향 throw 자세로 1타일 아래쪽에 2x1 오브젝트 내려놓음.
	-- 안드로이드16
	-- left 방향으로 eat 자세 1초, 이후 npc가 hold자세로 바리케이드 2x1 오브젝트를 생성해서 머리 위에 든다.
	-- (wall_in2_barricade)
	-- down 방향 throw 자세로 1타일 아래쪽에 2x1 오브젝트 내려놓음.
	-- 이후 down방향 push 자세로 바리케이드 오브젝트와 함께 1칸 아래로 이동. 이후 idle 자세 대기.
	-- 안드로이드17 (down,idle, rifle_reload) 자세 후 대기.
	-- 안드로이드18 (down,idle, idle) 자세로 대기.
	-- 안드로이드19 (down,idle, rifle_reload) 자세 후 대기.
	-- 안드로이드20 (down,idle, idle) 자세로 대기.
	for i = 15, 19 do
		local android = self.get_android_worker(i)
		local target_pos = self.get_move_pos(i)
		local wp_list = get_waypoint(android, target_pos)

		if i == 15 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				local version_holder = self
				local android_a = android
				local barricade = self.get_barricade(3)

				wp_util.move_async(android_a, wp_list, move_speed, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'down' })

				while self.android_14_move_end ~= true do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				self:barricade_throw_event(15, 3, 'down', android_a.Position + vector(-1, 0, -1))
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_a)

				local android_14 = self.get_android_worker(14)
				scene_util.set_direction(android_14, 'right')
				scene_util.set_direction(android, 'left')
				scene_util.set_anim(android_14, version_holder, { name = 'nod', loop = false, remove_after = 1 })
				scene_util.set_anim(android, version_holder, { name = 'nod', loop = false, remove_after = 1 })
				wait_for_sec(1)

				-- 미는 장면
				local target_vec = vector(0, 0, -1)
				scene_util.set_direction(android_a, 'down')
				scene_util.set_direction(android_14, 'down')
				scene_util.set_anim(android_a, version_holder, { name = 'push' })
				scene_util.set_anim(android_14, version_holder, { name =  'push' })
				character_util.move_to(android_a, android_a.Position + target_vec, nil, 1)
				character_util.move_to(android_14, android_14.Position + target_vec, nil, 1)

				character_util.move_to_async(barricade, barricade.Position + target_vec, 1, nil)
				scene_util.set_anim(android_a, version_holder, { name =  'carpenter_idle' })
				scene_util.set_anim(android_14, version_holder, { name =  'carpenter_idle' })
			end)
		elseif i == 16 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				local version_holder = self
				local android_a = android
				local barricade = self.get_barricade(4)

				scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'walk' })
				scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'hold', upper = true, one_shot_sfx = false })
				for i = 1, #wp_list do
					character_util.move_to_async(android, wp_list[i], nil, move_speed, true, false)
				end
				character_util.remove_anim(android)
				character_util.remove_anim(android, true)

				self:barricade_throw_event(16, 4, 'down', android_a.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -1))
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_a)

				-- 미는 장면
				local target_vec = vector(0, 0, -1)
				scene_util.set_direction(android_a, 'down')
				scene_util.set_anim(android_a, version_holder, { 'shoot', loop = true })
				character_util.move_to(android_a, android_a.Position + target_vec, nil, 1)

				character_util.move_to_async(barricade, barricade.Position + target_vec, 1, nil)

				character_util.remove_emotion(android_a)
				scene_util.set_anim(android_a, self, { name = 'carpenter_hammer' })
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mining_01')
			end)

		elseif i == 17 or i == 19 then
			start_coroutine(reload_and_look_around, android, wp_list)
		elseif i == 18 then
			start_coroutine(reload, android, wp_list)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:android_event_2()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()

	-- 플레이어가 강제 존 진입 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	-- 케이든 AI, 가디언 캐릭터 정렬하며 left 방향 바라봄.
	local knight_pos = self.get_knight_pos(2)
	local hero_ai_pos = self.get_hero_ai_pos(2)
	local knight_wp = { vector(knight.Position.x, knight_pos.y, knight_pos.z), knight_pos }
	local hero_ai_wp = { vector(hero_ai.Position.x, hero_ai_pos.y, hero_ai_pos.z), hero_ai_pos }

	local move_key = 's2_android_event_3_move_key'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, knight_wp, 4, nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero_ai, hero_ai_wp, 4, nil, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(hero_ai, nil, 'silence')

	--플레이어가 강제 존 진입 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	--케이든 AI down 방향, 가디언 up 방향 바라봄.
	--카이(left, idle, question) : 전혀 파고들 빈틈이 보이지 않는군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'question', loop = false },
			'idle',
			{ key = 'qc_sector_th_s2_android_11', skip = true })
	--카이(down, idle, idle) : 맨몸으로 이 길을 지나갈 시, 실패확률이 무려 95.4%나 됩니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'down',
			'idle',
			'idle',
			{ key = 'qc_sector_th_s2_android_12', skip = true })
	--카이(left, idle, release) : 용사님, 아무래도 다른 길을 찾아봐야 할 것 같습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'down',
			'release',
			'idle',
			{ key = 'qc_sector_th_s2_android_13', skip = true })
	--가디언 up 방향으로 nod 2회.
	scene_util.set_direction(knight,'up')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight,self, {name = 'nod', count = 2})
	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.

	local quest_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('teatan_head_fall_end_pos') + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	self.controller:add_quest_marker(quest_marker_pos)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

end

function local_class:teatan_meet_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local teatan_head_pos = self.get_teatan_head_pos()

	local knight_end_pos = self.get_teatan_head_knight_pos(1)
	local hero_ai_end_pos = self.get_teatan_head_hero_ai_pos(1)
	-- 케이든AI와 가디언이 각각 타일로 정렬하며 둘 다 up 방향 바라봄.

function local_class:teatan_head_move_event(zone)
	if self.iron_teatan_head_2 == nil then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	--최초 안드로이드 NPC는 ‘energy_rifle_normal’ 무기를 든채, right 방향 rifle_idle 자세중
	--플레이어가 강제 트리거 존 진입 시 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	--카메라가 방의 중앙 부분으로 1초동안 패닝.
	local cam_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(zone.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, 0))
	camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, 1)

	local screen_outside_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', vector(0, 0, 0), 0.5)
	screen_outside_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', screen_outside_pos, -3)

	local wp_1 = screen_outside_pos
	local wp_2 = vector(53, 0, -55)
	local wp_3 = vector(120, 0, -110)
	local speed = 1.6
	local angular_speed = -90

	local android_1 = self.get_android_shooter(1)
	local android_2 = self.get_android_shooter(2)
	local android_3 = self.get_android_shooter(3)
	local androids = { android_1, android_2, android_3 }

	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(android_2, nil, 'notice')

		--안드로이드2(right, idle, rifle_reload 1회) : 탈주 로봇 머리 포착! 사격 개시!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(android_2, { key = 'qc_sector_th_s2_1', skip = false })

		for i = 1, #androids do
			start_coroutine(self.shoot_routine, self, androids[i], self.iron_teatan_head_2.fo, i == 1)
		end
	end)

	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_iron_teatan_head_hover_01',
		type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', loop = true })

	self.iron_teatan_head_2.fo.Position = wp_1
	self.iron_teatan_head_2:move(wp_1, wp_2, speed, angular_speed, true)

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.move_2_end = false
		while true and self.iron_teatan_head_2 ~= nil do
			character_util.look_at(android_3, self.iron_teatan_head_2.fo)
			android_1.Direction = android_3.Direction
			android_2.Direction = android_3.Direction

			if not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(self.iron_teatan_head_2.fo.Position, { bonus_distance = 4 }) or self.move_2_end then
				character_util.set_group_direction(androids, 'down')
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				self.iron_teatan_head_2:stop()
				if loop_sfx ~= nil then
					loop_sfx:Stop()
					loop_sfx = nil
				end
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	self.iron_teatan_head_2:move(self.iron_teatan_head_2.fo.Position, wp_3, speed * 2.5, angular_speed * -1.5, true)
	self.move_2_end = true
	self.iron_teatan_head_2.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	if loop_sfx ~= nil then
		loop_sfx:Stop()
		loop_sfx = nil
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_fall_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 1.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--안드로이드(right, idle, rifle_idle) : 격추완료. 오늘도 한건 해냈군요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(android_2, 'right', false)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_2, 'qc_sector_th_s2_2')

	--안드로이드(right, idle, idle) : 다시 적정량의 휴식을 취할 때가 왔습니다.
	scene_util.set_direction(android_3, 'left', false)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_3, 'qc_sector_th_s2_3')

	--안드로이드1(right, idle, bomb_idle) : 잠시 누워서 전력 소비를 줄이도록 하죠..
	scene_util.set_direction(android_1, 'right', false)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_1, 'qc_sector_th_s2_4')

	--안드로이드 (down. sleep_deep, sleep) 으로 전환.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sleep_02')
	for i = 1, #androids do
		scene_util.set_direction(androids[i], 'down')
		scene_util.set_anim(androids[i], self, { name = 'sleep' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(androids[i], self, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	end

	self:set_teatan_head_pos()

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:get_bullet()
	local pos = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	for i = 1, #self.pooled_bullet do
		local bullet = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		if bullet.transform.localPosition == pos then
			return bullet
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_routine(shooter, target, play_sfx)
	local reload_sfx = nil
	if play_sfx ~= nil then
		reload_sfx = '02_gun_reload_03'
	end

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(shooter, { name = 'rifle_reload', count = 1, sfx_name = reload_sfx })
	scene_util.set_anim(shooter, self, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_anim(shooter, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot2' })

	for i = 1, 3 do
		character_util.look_at(shooter, target)
		local offset = direction_util.to_vector3(shooter.Direction)
		local shoot_pos = shooter.Bounds.center + offset * 0.4

		if play_sfx ~= nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_03')
		end

		self:shoot_to_target(self:get_bullet(), shoot_pos, target, i == 3)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(shooter, self, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
end

function local_class:shoot_to_target(bullet, start_pos, target, last_shot)
	local bullet_speed = 25
	local timer = 0
	local diff = target.Bounds.center - start_pos
	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(diff)
	local duration = diff.magnitude / bullet_speed;

	bullet.Transform.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	while timer < duration do
		local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Bounds.center, 3.5)
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(timer / duration)
		local current_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
		bullet.Transform.localPosition = current_pos

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Bounds.center, 3.5)

	-- fx hit 스폰
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(target_pos)
	bullet.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

	if last_shot == true and not self.last_shot_scene_played then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_head_break_01')
		self.last_shot_scene_played = true
		self.get_fx_explosion():Instantiate(target_pos)
		self.iron_teatan_head_2:stop()
	end

	bullet.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
end

return local_class

function local_class:connecting_scene()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'lightning_turn_off' }))

	local teslas = self.controller.s3_giant_teslas
	local tesla_num = #teslas
	local speed = 7
	local fade_out_started = false
	local fade_out_end = false

	if tesla_num > 1 then
		for i = 1, tesla_num - 1 do
			local from_fo = teslas[i]
			local to_fo = teslas[i + 1]
			local dis = (to_fo.Position - from_fo.Position).magnitude
			local dur = dis / speed

			self.controller:connect_giant_tesla(from_fo, to_fo)
			if i < tesla_num - 1 then
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(to_fo.Name))
			end

			if not fade_out_started then
				-- 3번 째 테슬라로 이동할 때 중간에 페이드 아웃
				if i + 1 == 3 then
					start_coroutine(function()
						fade_out_started = true
						camera_util.move(to_fo.Position, dur)
						wait_for_sec(dur * 0.3)
						screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
						fade_out_end = true
					end)
				else
					camera_util.move_async(to_fo.Position, dur)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if fade_out_started then
		while not fade_out_end do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self:connect_first_tesla(teslas[tesla_num])
end

-- 거대 테슬라에 전력 연결 시
function local_class:connect_first_tesla(tesla)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local y_offset = vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	--카메라가 무빙 이벤트 진행.
	--시간 : 0.1초
	--시작 위치 : 플레이어(가디언) 카메라
	--도착 위치 : 아이언 티탄 머리 중앙
	camera_util.move_async(self.get_teatan_head_pos(), 0.1)
	--화면 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--전력 연출 이벤트
	--오른쪽의 거대 테슬라에 불이 들어오며 아이언 티탄 머리에 연결됌.
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(tesla.Name))
	--이후 아이언 티탄 머리에 하단의 이펙트가 출력되며, 아이언 티탄 머리 1.5초동안 shake. (진폭값은 0.02)
	self:teatan_shake(0.02, 1.5)
	--Fx_emp_field ( 이펙트 크기는 아이언 티탄 머리와 동일 )
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_energy_charge_03')
	self.emp_field_effect = self.get_fx_emp_field():Instantiate(self.get_teatan_head_pos() + y_offset)
	self.emp_field_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.emp_field_effect_scale[1]
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--아이언 티탄 : 전력 충전중.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.iron_teatan_head.script, self, nil, nil, nil,
			self.get_s3_string_name .. 1)
	--아이언 티탄 : 현재, 30% 완료.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.iron_teatan_head.script, self, nil, nil, nil,
			self.get_s3_string_name .. 2)

	--이후 아이언
	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	--화면 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	--카메라가 무빙 이벤트 진행.
	--시간 : 0.1초
	--시작 위치 : 아이언 티탄 머리 중앙
	--도착 위치 : 플레이어(가디언) 카메라
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	character_util.look_at(leader, hero_ai)
	character_util.look_at(hero_ai, leader)

	--화면 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--이후 대사 진행.
	--카이(left, smile, idle) : 용사님! 아이언 티탄에 전력이 충전되고 있습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, nil, 'smile',
			self.get_s3_string_name .. 3)
	--카이(left, smile, release) : 다른 곳에도 연결할 것이 있는지 찾아 보죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'release', 'smile',
			self.get_s3_string_name .. 4)
	--가디언 nod 2회.
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'lightning_turn_on' }))

	-- 섹션 진행
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.

end

function local_class:teatan_shake(magnitude, duration)
	if self.iron_teatan_head ~= nil then
		self.iron_teatan_head:shake(magnitude, duration)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_emp_field()
	if self.emp_field_effect ~= nil then
		self.emp_field_effect:Dispose()
		self.emp_field_effect = nil
	end
end

return local_class

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_event_battle_zone') and
			not self.battle_talked and self.get_golem().ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
		self.battle_talked = true
		start_coroutine(self.event_battle_start, self)
	end
end

		start_coroutine(function()
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.iron_teatan_head.fo)
			self.iron_teatan_head:normal_talk_async('qc_sector_th_iron_teatan_oneline_2')
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_golem()) and
			self.cur_section_progress == self.section_progress.battle_prepared and
			self.battle_monsters ~= nil then
		stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()
		for i = 1, #self.battle_monsters do
			local monster = self.battle_monsters[i]
			character_util.convert_to_npc(monster)
		end
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('event_battle_gate_1', true))
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('event_battle_gate_2', true))

		return

	if e.DoorHandleName == self.door_1_name and not self.puzzle_1_cleared then
		self.puzzle_1_cleared = true
		self:connect_ray(1, 2)
		quest_marker_pos_name = 's4_giant_tesla_coil_2'

		if self.puzzle_2_cleared then
			self:connect_ray(2, 3)
			quest_marker_pos_name = 's4_giant_tesla_coil_3'

			if self.puzzle_3_cleared then
				self:connect_ray(3, 4)
				quest_marker_pos_name = 's4_giant_tesla_coil_4'
			end
		end

	elseif e.DoorHandleName == self.door_2_name and not self.puzzle_2_cleared then

			self:connect_ray(2, 3)

			if self.puzzle_3_cleared then
				self:connect_ray(3, 4)
				quest_marker_pos_name = 's4_giant_tesla_coil_4'
			end
		end

		self.puzzle_3_cleared = true

		if self.puzzle_1_cleared and self.puzzle_2_cleared then
			self:connect_ray(3, 4)
			quest_marker_pos_name = 's4_giant_tesla_coil_4'
		end
	end

	if self.puzzle_1_cleared and self.puzzle_2_cleared and self.puzzle_3_cleared then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.connecting_scene, self, 4)
	else
		local quest_marker_pos = get_field_object(quest_marker_pos_name).Bounds.center
		self.controller:add_quest_marker(quest_marker_pos)
	end

		self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.battle_end
		sp_util.start_scene(self.robot_ride_scene, self)
	end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(monster, leader, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
		message_system:Send(monster.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(
				monster, leader, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	self.battle_monsters[1].DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Prostrate

	self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.battle_prepared
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.get_golem(), 'qc_sector_th_s4_29')
end

	local from_fo = teslas[from_idx]
	local to_fo = teslas[to_idx]
	self.controller:connect_giant_tesla(from_fo, to_fo)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(to_fo.Name))
end

function local_class:connecting_scene(start_idx)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'lightning_turn_off' }))

	local teslas = self.controller.s4_giant_teslas
	local tesla_num = #teslas
	local speed = 7
	local fade_out_started = false
	local fade_out_end = false

	if tesla_num > 1 then
		for i = start_idx, tesla_num - 1 do
			local from_fo = teslas[i]
			local to_fo = teslas[i + 1]
			local dis = (to_fo.Position - from_fo.Position).magnitude
			local dur = dis / speed

			self.controller:connect_giant_tesla(from_fo, to_fo)
			if i < tesla_num - 1 then
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(to_fo.Name))
			end

			if not fade_out_started then
				if i + 1 == 6 then
					start_coroutine(function()
						fade_out_started = true
						camera_util.move(to_fo.Position, dur)
						wait_for_sec(dur * 0.3)
						screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
						fade_out_end = true
					end)
				else
					camera_util.move_async(to_fo.Position, dur)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if fade_out_started then
		while not fade_out_end do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self:connect_second_tesla(teslas[tesla_num])
end

--region start scene
function local_class:start_scene()
	self:enter_start_zone_scene()
	self:camera_show_lightning_path_scene()
	self:android_and_golem_talk_scene()

end

	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()

	--카이(left방향 전환 1회/right 방향 전환 1회, idle, release) : 다음으로 가야 할 곳은…
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

			nil, 'qc_sector_th_s4_5')

	--시간 : 1.5초
	--시작 위치 : 플레이어(가디언) 카메라

	camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, 1.5)

	--카이(right, smile, release) : 저쪽이군요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'right', 'release',
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'qc_sector_th_s4_6')

	--카이(right, smile, idle) : 용사님! 가뿐하게 달려가볼까요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'right', nil,
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'qc_sector_th_s4_7')

	--카메라가 오른쪽으로 패닝하며 페이드 아웃.
	cam_pos = cam_pos + vector(4, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move(cam_pos, 1)
end

function local_class:camera_show_lightning_path_scene()
	--카메라가 페이드 인하며 오른쪽으로 패닝.
	--속도 값 : 3
	--카메라가 패닝하는 동안 표시된 번개1,2,3,4,5 지역에 각각 번개 이펙트(fx_gimmick_cloud_thunder) 출력.
	--카메라가 방의 그리드 끝에 닿은 후, 1초 대기 이후 화면 페이드 아웃.

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local cam_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_cam_move_start')
	local cam_end_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_cam_move_end')
	local cam_dis = (cam_end_pos - cam_start_pos).magnitude
	local cam_speed = 3
	local cam_dur = cam_dis / cam_speed
	camera_util.move_async(cam_start_pos, 0)

	local cam_move_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		camera_util.move_async(cam_end_pos, cam_dur)
		cam_move_end = true
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.cloud_effect = self.get_fx_cloud_thunder():Instantiate(
				stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 8), unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)

		while not cam_move_end and not self.game_end do
			local cur_pos = self.cloud_effect.transform.localPosition + 14 *
					unity_class.vector3.back * unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if cur_pos.z - stage_camera.LookAtPosition.z > 4 then
				self.cloud_effect.transform.localPosition = cur_pos

			else
				cur_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(self.cloud_effect.transform.localPosition,
						stage_camera.LookAtPosition.z + 4)
				self.cloud_effect.transform.localPosition = cur_pos
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	local thunder_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_thunder_03', loop = true })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local thunder = {
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_thunder_pos_1'),
			played = false
		},
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_thunder_pos_2') + vector(-3, 0, 0),
			played = false
		},
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_thunder_pos_3'),
			played = false
		},
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_thunder_pos_4'),
			played = false
		},
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_thunder_pos_5'),
			played = false
		}
	}

	while not cam_move_end and not self.game_end do
		for i = 1, #thunder do
			if not thunder[i].played and screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(thunder[i].pos, { bonus_distance = -0.5 }) then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_thunder_02')
				self.get_fx_thunder():Instantiate(thunder[i].pos)
				thunder[i].played = true
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	thunder_loop_sfx:Stop()
end

function local_class:android_and_golem_talk_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()

	--카메라는 다시 플레이어(가디언)에게 포커스.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if self.cloud_effect ~= nil then
		self.cloud_effect:Dispose()
		self.cloud_effect = nil
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--선택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--『가는 길이 너무 위험한데?』(intellect)
		{ 'qc_sector_th_s4_8', 'intellect' },
		--『그대로 갔다간 번개 구이 신세가 될거야!』(brutal)
		{ 'qc_sector_th_s4_9', 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--가디언이 right 방향 tired 표정으로 bomb_idle 1초.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'tired' })
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--카이(left, tired, idle) : 확실히… 주변에 번개를 막아줄 피뢰침도 보이지 않는군요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'tired' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s4_10')
	else
		--가디언 right 방향, scared 표정으로 cast 자세로 shake 1초.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'cast' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'scared' })
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--카이(left, tired, idle) : 그러게요… 소중한 용사님을 번개에 맞게 할순 없죠.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'tired' })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s4_11')
	end

	--카이(left, smile, victory_get) : 하지만 저, 카이! 용사님과 함께라면 무엇도 두렵지 않답니다!
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s4_12')

	--대기 1초
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--이후 화면이 주기적으로 shake 하기 시작 (0.02 값으로, 1.5초 마다)
	local shake_start = true
	local shake_cnt = 0
	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 1.5

		while shake_start and not self.game_end do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if time_passed >= 1.5 then
				time_passed = 0
				shake_cnt = shake_cnt + 1
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')
				camera_util.shake(0.02, 0.3)
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	--가디언,카이 idle 자세로 jump 1회와 동시에 surprise.
	character_util.remove_anim(hero_ai)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'surprise' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wp_util.move_async(hero_ai, hero_ai.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
			3, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--카이 up 방향 idle 자세로 (exclamation) 이모티콘 표시.
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(hero_ai, nil, 'notice')

	--카이 left 방향으로 release 2회.
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.set_anim_async(hero_ai, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	--가디언 right 방향으로 attack 표정 nod 1회.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	--카메라는 현재 시점으로 고정.
	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 0)

	--카이와 가디언이 표시된 루트를 따라 각각 ■타일,■타일 위치로 정렬 후, right 방향 바라봄.
	local leader_wp = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_leader_hide_pos_1'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_leader_hide_pos_2'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_leader_hide_pos_3')
	}

	local hero_ai_wp = {
		hero_ai.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_hero_ai_pos_1'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_hero_ai_pos_2'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_hero_ai_pos_3')
	}

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, leader, leader_wp, 5, nil,
				{ last_direction = 'right', run = true, play_sfx = true }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, hero_ai, hero_ai_wp, 5, nil,
				{ last_direction = 'right', run = true, play_sfx = true })
	})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)

	--화면 상단에서 골렘 안드로이드와, 일반 안드로이드 A,B가 아래쪽으로 walk 하며 내려옴.
	local golem_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_golem_pos_1')
	local android_a_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_android_a_pos_1')
	local android_b_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_android_b_pos_1')

	local golem = self.get_golem()
	local android_a = self.get_android_a()
	local android_b = self.get_android_b()

	golem.Position = golem_pos + vector(0, 0, 10)
	android_a.Position = android_a_pos + vector(0, 0, 12)
	android_b.Position = android_b_pos + vector(0, 0, 12)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, golem, golem_pos, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'down' }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, android_a, android_a_pos, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'up' }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, android_b, android_b_pos, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
	})

	shake_start = false

	--이후 지정된 위치에 멈추며 대화 이벤트 진행.
	--골렘(down, idle, idle) : 이 수트만 있으면 내리치는 번개로부터 안전하다는 보고… 검증된 사실입니까?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(golem, 'qc_sector_th_s4_14')

	--안드로이드A(up, idle, release) : 물론입니다. 그 마리안님이 특별 제작한 수트니까요.
	scene_util.set_anim(android_a, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_a, 'qc_sector_th_s4_15')

	--안드로이드A(up, idle, release) : 단 1기 제작된 것이니 테스트에 신중을 기하세요.
	scene_util.set_anim(android_a, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_a, 'qc_sector_th_s4_16')

	--안드로이드B(left, idle, bomb_idle) : 만약 손상되기라도 한다면, 마리안님이 당신을 폐기처분할지도 모릅니다.
	scene_util.set_anim(android_b, self, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_b, 'qc_sector_th_s4_17')

	--골렘(down, scared, shake 상태) : 그건 싫습니다…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.set_emotion(golem, self, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.shake(golem, 0.03, 0.5)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(golem, 'qc_sector_th_s4_18')

	--안드로이드B(right, idle, release) : 꾸물 거릴 시간이 없습니다. 이동하시죠.
	scene_util.set_direction(android_b, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(android_b, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android_b, 'qc_sector_th_s4_19')

	--안드로이드 A,B , 골렘이 right 방향 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(android_a, 'right')
	scene_util.set_direction(golem, 'right')

	--골렘 NPC부터 walk 하며 오른쪽 방향으로 화면 밖으로 나감.
	--계단 걸어올라가야 하니까 MoveOneFrameStageLogic을 사용해야 함
	--이후 차례로 안드로이드 A,B 또한 골렘 NPC를 따라 계단을 올라감.
	local move_one_frame_stage_logic = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic
	local movers = { android_a, android_b, golem }
	local dir_vector = vector(1, 0, 0)
	local speed = 3
	local mover_n = #movers

	for i = 1, 3 do
		movers[i].Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(golem, self, { name = 'walk' })
	local time_passed = 0
	local move_dis = 5
	local dur = move_dis / speed
	while time_passed < dur do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		move_one_frame_stage_logic.ExecuteMove(golem, dir_vector, speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(android_a, self, { name = 'walk' })
	scene_util.set_anim(android_b, self, { name = 'walk' })
	while screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(android_a.Position, { bonus_distance = 2 }) do
		for i = 1, mover_n do
			local mover = movers[i]
			move_one_frame_stage_logic.ExecuteMove(mover, dir_vector, speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, mover_n do
		local mover = movers[i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mover)
		mover.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		mover.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.1, 0.75, 1.1))
	end

	--카메라 다시 플레이어에게 포커스.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--카이(right, idle, idle) : 번개에도 끄떡없는 로봇을 만들다니…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s4_20')

	--카이(left, idle, idle) : 마리안님은 정말 대단하군요!
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'down')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s4_21')

	--선택지 출력
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--『저걸 탈취해서 우리가 사용하자!』(mercy)
		{ 'qc_sector_th_s4_23', 'mercy' },
		--『저 로봇을 ‘잠깐’ 빌리는건 어때?』(intellect)
		{ 'qc_sector_th_s4_22', 'intellect' }
	})

	if choose_result == 2 then
		--가디언이  방향 doyagao표정으로 release 2회.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'doyagao' })
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	else
		--가디언이  방향 greed표정으로 cast2 1초.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'smile' })
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	end

	--가디언 캐릭터 한테, (slience) 이모티콘 표시.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	--카이(left, smile, jump 1회) : 그거 정말 좋은 생각입니다!
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim(hero_ai)
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s4_26')

		local start_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.emp_field_effect_scale[1]
		local end_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.emp_field_effect_scale[2]

			local scale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)
			self.emp_field_effect.transform.localScale = scale

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)
	wait_for_sec(routine_duration)

	--아이언 티탄의 눈이 빛나는 상태를 유지하기 시작.

			self.get_s4_string_name .. 2)

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	--화면 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	--카메라가 무빙 이벤트 진행.

	--시작 위치 : 아이언 티탄 머리 중앙

			self.get_s4_string_name .. 3)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'get', 'smile',

function local_class:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	if self.s5_tesla_1_on and self.s5_tesla_3_on then

	if e.IsTurningOn then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, get_field_object('s5_tesla_1')) and
				not self.s5_tesla_1_on then
			self.s5_tesla_1_on = true

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, get_field_object('s5_tesla_3')) and

function local_class:connecting_scene()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'lightning_turn_off' }))

	local teslas = self.controller.s5_giant_teslas
	local tesla_num = #teslas
	local speed = 7
	local fade_out_started = false
	local fade_out_end = false

	if tesla_num > 1 then
		for i = 1, tesla_num - 1 do
			local from_fo = teslas[i]
			local to_fo = teslas[i + 1]
			local dis = (to_fo.Position - from_fo.Position).magnitude
			local dur = dis / speed

			self.controller:connect_giant_tesla(from_fo, to_fo)
			if i < tesla_num - 1 then
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create(to_fo.Name))
			end

			if not fade_out_started then
				-- 3번 째 테슬라로 이동할 때 중간에 페이드 아웃
				if i + 1 == 3 then
					start_coroutine(function()
						fade_out_started = true
						camera_util.move(to_fo.Position, dur)
						wait_for_sec(dur * 0.3)
						screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
						fade_out_end = true
					end)
				else
					camera_util.move_async(to_fo.Position, dur)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if fade_out_started then
		while not fade_out_end do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self:connect_third_tesla(teslas[tesla_num])
end

	local emp_scale_routine = function(duration, start_num, end_num)
		local progress = 0
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.emp_field_effect_scale[start_num]
