	end
	local emp_routine_duration = 0.5
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_energy_charge_03')
	start_coroutine(emp_scale_routine,emp_routine_duration, 2, 3)
	wait_for_sec(emp_routine_duration)

	local remove_dummy = false
	local move_iron_teatan = function(start_pos, end_pos, duration, is_emp_field_effect)
		local time_passed = 0
		local progress = 0

		while progress < 1 do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInCubic(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)

			local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

			if not remove_dummy then
				dummy.Position = pos
			end

			if is_emp_field_effect then
				self.emp_field_effect.transform.localPosition = pos + y_offset
			end
			self.iron_teatan_head:set_position(pos)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	--아이언 티탄의머리가 2초동안 (y값 2.5만큼) 아래쪽 방향을 바라본채 공중부양 하기 시작.
	local rising_duration = 2
	local levitating_duration = 1.0
	emp_routine_duration = 0.5
	local explosion_wait_sec = 0.5
	local start_pos = self.iron_teatan_head.fo.Position
	local end_pos = self.iron_teatan_head.fo.Position + vector(0,2.5,0)
	self.iron_teatan_head:turn_on_fx()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_prepare_02')
	start_coroutine(move_iron_teatan, start_pos, end_pos, rising_duration, true)
	--이 때, 아이언 티탄 머리는 shake 상태 지속.
	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_iron_teatan_head_hover_01', loop = true })
	self:teatan_shake(0.02, rising_duration + emp_routine_duration + levitating_duration)
	--동시에 Stage camera 2초동안 (2)값 만큼 줌인.
	local target_cam_size = stage_camera.Size * 0.5
	camera_util.move(end_pos,rising_duration)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(target_cam_size, rising_duration)
	wait_for_sec(rising_duration)
	wait_for_sec(levitating_duration)

	--줌인 완료시, Fx_emp_field 이펙트의 크기가 값(0)으로 점점 줄어듬.
	start_coroutine(emp_scale_routine,emp_routine_duration, 3, 4)
	wait_for_sec(emp_routine_duration)
	self.emp_field_effect.transform.localPosition = vector(999,0,999)

	--이펙트 크기가 0이 되었을 시, 거대 테슬라 3곳의 전원 OFF
	dummy = self.get_teatan_head_tesla_dummy()
	dummy.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	remove_dummy = true

	for i = 3, 5 do
		local len = #self.controller.giant_teslas[i]
		local from = self.controller.giant_teslas[i][len - 1]
		local to = self.controller.giant_teslas[i][len]
		self.controller:disconnect_giant_tesla_v2(from, to)
	end

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create(tesla.Name))

	--0.5초 뒤 아이언 티탄 머리에서 ‘fx_emp_explosion’ 이펙트 출력.
	wait_for_sec(explosion_wait_sec)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_energy_combine_01')
	self.get_fx_emp_explosion():Instantiate(self.iron_teatan_head.fo.Position + y_offset)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1.0)
	wait_for_sec(1.75)

	--이후 줌인 완료시, 아이언 티탄이 바닥(y값1)으로 떨어지며 동시에 화면 원래 크기대로 0.5초동안 줌아웃.
	local falling_duration = 1
	self.iron_teatan_head:turn_off_fx()
	loop_sfx:FadeOut(1.5)
	start_coroutine(move_iron_teatan, end_pos, start_pos, falling_duration, false)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(falling_duration)
	camera_util.move(start_pos,falling_duration)
	wait_for_sec(falling_duration)
	--아이언 티탄이 바닥에 떨어짐과 동시에, 화면과 아이언 티탄 머리 오브젝트에 강한 shake 0.5초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_mech_land_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
	self:teatan_shake(0.1, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--아이언 티탄 : 전력 100% 충전 완료.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.iron_teatan_head.script, self, nil, nil, nil,
			self.get_s5_string_name .. 1)
	--아이언 티탄 : 카이, 가디언. 즉시 귀환 요청.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.iron_teatan_head.script, self, nil, nil, nil,
			self.get_s5_string_name .. 2)

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	--화면 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	--카메라가 무빙 이벤트 진행.
	--시간 : 0.1초
	--시작 위치 : 아이언 티탄 머리 중앙
	--도착 위치 : 플레이어(가디언) 카메라
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.1)

	character_util.look_at(leader, hero_ai)
	character_util.look_at(hero_ai, leader)

	--화면 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--이후 대사 진행.
	--케이든 AI(left, smile, idle) : 용사님! 아이언 티탄의 충전이 완료됐다고 합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, nil, 'smile',
			self.get_s5_string_name .. 3)
	--케이든 AI(left, smile, release) : 어서 가서 아이언 티탄 상태를 확인해 보죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'release', 'smile',
			self.get_s5_string_name .. 4)
	--가디언 nod 2회.
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'lightning_turn_on' }))

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	--퀘스트 마커 제거 (예외 처리)
	self.controller:remove_quest_marker()
	self.controller:remove_quest_marker(1)

	-- 섹션 진행
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
end

function local_class:teatan_shake(magnitude, duration)
	if self.iron_teatan_head ~= nil then
		self.iron_teatan_head:shake(magnitude, duration)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_emp_field()
	if self.emp_field_effect ~= nil then
		self.emp_field_effect:Dispose()
		self.emp_field_effect= nil
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()

end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self:disable_shooting()

	self.res_holder = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.is_game_end = true

	self.is_iron_teatans_rushing = false
	self.is_qte_input_available = false
	self.is_qte_input_teatan_fight = false

	if self.fat_androids ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.fat_androids)
	end

	if self.fight_fxs ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.fight_fxs do
			self.fight_fxs[i]:Dispose()
			self.fight_fxs[i] = nil
		end
		self.fight_fxs = nil
	end

	self:disable_shooting()

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.res_holder = nil
	self.iron_teatans_headless = nil

	self.iron_teatans_talk_trans = nil
	self.iron_teatans_main_character_spot_trans = nil

	self.android_army_data = nil

	self.iron_teatan_head_con = nil
	self.iron_teatans_con = nil
	self.iron_teatans = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.cur_section_progress == self.section_progress.iron_teatans_marching then
		self.android_army_data:special_death_event(e)
	end
end

--region 전투가 없이 디버깅 하기 위한 임시 함수
function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	if get_party_leader().FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead == true then
		return
	end

	if self.cur_section_progress == self.section_progress.battle_start then
		self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.after_battle
		sp_util.start_scene(self.after_battle, self)
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.cur_section_progress == self.section_progress.iron_teatans_marching then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.iron_teatans, 's6_iron_teatan_rush_zone_2') and
				self.cur_missile_state == self.missile_state.none then
			start_coroutine(function()
				self.cur_missile_state = self.missile_state.on_ready
				self.iron_teatans:StartTutorial()

				wait_for_sec(2)

				if self.cur_missile_state == self.missile_state.on_ready then
					self.cur_missile_state = self.missile_state.ready
					self.iron_teatans:EndTutorial()
					self.iron_teatans:AllowShoot()
				end
			end)
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.iron_teatans, 's6_iron_teatan_rush_zone_1') and
				self.army_routine_started ~= true then
			self.army_routine_started = true
			--존에 들어왔을 때 아이언 티탄 대쉬 시작 및 안드로이드 군대 행동 시작
			self:android_army_run_routine()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.iron_teatan_head_con.fo) and
			self.cur_section_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.interact_iron_teatan_head
		self.iron_teatan_head_con.fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_iron_teatan_head, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		if self.cur_missile_state == self.missile_state.on_ready then
			self.iron_teatans:EndTutorial()
			self.iron_teatans:AllowShoot()
		elseif self.is_qte_input_available then
			start_coroutine(self.iron_teatans_con.shoot_missile, self.iron_teatans_con, self.iron_teatan_missile[self.tap_count])
			self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1
		elseif self.is_qte_input_teatan_fight then

			if self.can_move then
				self.can_move = false
				start_coroutine(function()
					if self.move_up == true then
						self:move_all_teatan_fight(vector(0, 0, 0.33), 0.1)
						self.can_move = true
						self.move_up = false
					else
						self:move_all_teatan_fight(vector(0, 0, -0.33), 0.1)
						self.can_move = true
						self.move_up = true
					end
				end)
			end

			self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--- 첫 번째 상호작용 대화 이벤트
function local_class:interact_iron_teatan_head()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()

	--케이든AI는 ■타일로 , 가디언은 ■타일로 정렬하며 둘 다 up 방향 바라봄.
	local iron_teatan_head_pos = self.iron_teatan_head_con.fo.Position
	local leader_align_pos = iron_teatan_head_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1.5)
	local hero_ai_align_pos = iron_teatan_head_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, leader, leader_align_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, hero_ai, hero_ai_align_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })
	})

	--케이든 AI(up, idle, jump 1회) : 성공입니다, 용사님!
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_1')

	--케이든 AI(up, idle, idle) : 아이언 티탄의 전력이 100%로 완충되었습니다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_2')

	--가디언 left 방향 smile 표정으로 clap.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'clap' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'clap', count = 4 })

	--케이든AI와 가디언 up 방향으로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up')

	--(머리 앞뒤로 끄덕임 2회)아이언 티탄 : 발진 준비 완료.
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:nod_front_async(2)
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:normal_talk_async('qc_sector_th_s6_2_1')

	--아이언 티탄 : 좌표 설정, 아이언 티탄 몸통.
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:normal_talk_async('qc_sector_th_s6_2_2')

	--아이언 티탄 : 카이, 가디언. 탑승 요청.
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:normal_talk_async('qc_sector_th_s6_2_3')

	--카이(up, idle, jump 1회) : 알겠습니다, 아이언 티탄!
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_4')

	--케이든 AI(right, smile, idle) : 카이(right, smile, idle) : 용사님, 올라타시죠!
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_5')

	--가디언 left 방향 nod 1회.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	--가디언과 케이든 AI가 각각 left 방향 , right 방향으로 get자세를 하며 아이언 티탄 머리위로 jump 한 뒤 idle 자세로 대기 1초.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'get' })
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'get' })

	character_util.set_locked_dir(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(hero_ai, 'right')

	--아이언 티탄 날아가는 연출
	local leader_offset = vector(0.5, 1, 0)
	local hero_ai_offset = vector(-0.5, 1, 0)
	local leader_jump_to = iron_teatan_head_pos + leader_offset
	local hero_ai_jump_to = iron_teatan_head_pos + hero_ai_offset

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(self.jump_move, self, leader, leader_jump_to, 1.5, 0.7),
		util.cs_generator(self.jump_move, self, hero_ai, hero_ai_jump_to, 1.5, 0.7)
	})
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(hero_ai)

	--0.7초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--아이언 티탄 : 아이언 티탄, 비행 시작.
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:normal_talk_async('qc_sector_th_s6_5_0_1')

	--부양 하는 동안, 카메라도 아이언 티탄 머리를 중점으로 함께 올라감.
	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 0)

	--최초 아이언 티탄 머리가 shake(진폭값 0.03)되며 2초동안 공중 부양하기 시작.
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:shake(0.03, 2)

	--부양하는 동안 가디언은 left 방향으로 smile 표정, idle 자세중.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'smile' })

	--이후 아이언 티탄 머리가 빠른 속도로 화면의 좌측 상단으로 날아감.
	self.cached_leader_parent = leader.transform.parent
	self.cached_hero_ai_parent = hero_ai.transform.parent

	camera_util.move(leader.Position + vector(0, 3, 0), 2)

	leader.transform.parent = self.iron_teatan_head_con.fo.transform
	hero_ai.transform.parent = self.iron_teatan_head_con.fo.transform

	--아이언 티탄 머리가 shake(진폭값 0.03)되며 화면 상단으로 공중에 올라감.
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:shake(0.03, 9999)
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:turn_on_fx()

	character_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 9999)
	character_util.shake(hero_ai, 0.03, 9999)

	--최초 아이언 티탄 머리가 shake(진폭값 0.03)되며 2초동안 공중 부양하기 시작.
	--부양 하는 동안, 카메라도 아이언 티탄 머리를 중점으로 함께 올라감.

	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_iron_teatan_head_hover_01', loop = true })

	local dur = 2
	local start_pos = self.iron_teatan_head_con.fo.Position
	local end_pos = self.iron_teatan_head_con.fo.Position + vector(0, 3, 0)
	local time_passed = 0

	while not self.is_game_end do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / dur

		if progress > 1 then
			break
		end

		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		self.iron_teatan_head_con:set_position(pos)
		self.iron_teatan_head_con:snap_shadow_on_floor()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--1차 공중부양 완료 시 1.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--shake가 진행되는동안 가디언은 left 방향으로 surprise 표정, cliff 애니 진행.
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'cliff' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'surprise' })

	loop_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_head_break_01')
	local height = 10
	dur = 3.5
	start_pos = self.iron_teatan_head_con.fo.Position
	end_pos = self.iron_teatan_head_con.fo.Position + vector(-7, 0, -7.5)
	time_passed = 0

	while not self.is_game_end do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInCubic(time_passed, 0, 1, dur)

		if progress > 0.5 then
			break
		end

		local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height * 2
		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		self.iron_teatan_head_con:set_position(pos)
		self.iron_teatan_head_con:snap_shadow_on_floor()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--화면에서 아이언 티탄의 머리가 사라졌을 시, 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.iron_teatan_head_con:reset_shadow()

	self.shear_field_obj = field:GetFieldObject('shear')

	if self.shear_field_obj ~= nil then
		self.previous_shear = self.shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear
		self.shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0
	end

	self:docking_iron_teatans()
end

--- 아이언 티탄 머리와 몸통 합쳐지는 연출
function local_class:docking_iron_teatans()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()

	local headless_teatan_androids = {
		self.get_headless_teatan_android(1),
		self.get_headless_teatan_android(2),
		self.get_headless_teatan_android(3)
	}

	self.controller:turn_on_iron_teatans_headless_android_effect()

	local iron_teatan_headless_pos = field:GetMarker('iron_teatan_headless_pos').position

	self.iron_teatans_headless = self.controller.iron_teatans_headless_trans

	-- 목이 날아갈 위치를 Bone에서 얻는다.
	local neck = self.iron_teatans_headless.transform:Find('Bone/Bone Pelvis/Bone Spine/Bone Neck')

	local start_pos = neck.position + vector(0, 6, 1)
	local end_pos = neck.position + vector(0, 1, 0)

	self.iron_teatan_head_con:set_position(start_pos)
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:cancel_shake()

	camera_util.move_async(iron_teatan_headless_pos + vector(0, 0, 2), 0)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, 0)

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = nil
	heal_info.target = leader
	heal_info.heal = leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_light_loop_04', loop = true, volume = 0.6 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--화면 페이드 인 되고 0.5초 대기 후 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--안드로이드2 (left, idle, drill) : 폐기 작업이 지연되고 있습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(headless_teatan_androids[2], 'qc_sector_th_s6_5_0_2')

	--안드로이드3 (down, idle, drill) : 무식할 정도로 단단하게 만들었군요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(headless_teatan_androids[3], 'qc_sector_th_s6_5_0_3')

	--대기 1초.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--화면 0.2값으로 shake 하기 시작. (지속적으로 shake)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 9999)

	self.controller:turn_off_iron_teatans_headless_android_effect()

	--동시에 안드로이드 다음과 같이 행동.
	--안드로이드1(right, surprise, jump 1회),
	--안드로이드2(left, surprise, jump 1회)
	--안드로이드3(up, surprise, jump 1회)
	loop_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_iron_teatan_head_hover_01', loop = true })
	local dirs = { 'right', 'left', 'left' }
	for i = 1, #headless_teatan_androids do
		local android = headless_teatan_androids[i]
		scene_util.set_direction(android, dirs[i], false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.remove_anim(android)
		character_util.normal_jump(android, true)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--이후 안드로이드 ‘동시에’ 주변을 살핌.
	--안드로이드1 surprise 표정으로 left 방향 전환 , 이후 down 방향 전환.
	--안드로이드2 surprise 표정으로 down 방향 전환 , 이후 right 방향 전환.
	--안드로이드3 surprise 표정으로 right 방향 전환 , 이후 left 방향 전환.
	dirs = {
		{ 'left', 'down' },
		{ 'down', 'right' },
		{ 'right', 'left' }
	}

	--안드로이드들 주변 살피는 행동 마친 후, 대기 0.7초
	for i = 1, #dirs[1] do
		for j = 1, #dirs do
			local android = headless_teatan_androids[j]
			scene_util.set_direction(android, dirs[j][i])
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.7)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	for i = 1, #headless_teatan_androids do
		local headless_teatan_android = headless_teatan_androids[i]
		scene_util.set_anim(headless_teatan_android, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(headless_teatan_android, self, { name = 'scared' })
	end

	-- 머리가 몸통으로 날아가는 부분
	local dur = 1.5
	local time_passed = 0

	while not self.is_game_end and time_passed < dur do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutExpo(time_passed, 0, 1, dur))
		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		self.iron_teatan_head_con:set_position(pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	dur = 1.5
	time_passed = 0
	start_pos = end_pos
	end_pos = neck.position
	local effect_on = false

	self.iron_teatan_head_con:shake(0.03, 2)

	while not self.is_game_end do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / dur

		if not effect_on and progress > 0.97 then
			effect_on = true

			local head_bounds = self.iron_teatan_head_con.fo.Bounds
			local shockwave_pos = vector(head_bounds.center.x, head_bounds.min.y, head_bounds.min.z + 0.15)
			if loop_sfx ~= nil then
				loop_sfx:Stop()
				loop_sfx = nil
			end
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_head_crush_01')
			self.get_fx_shockwave():Instantiate(shockwave_pos)
			camera_util.cancel_shake()
			camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.7)
		end

		if progress > 1 then
			break
		end

		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		self.iron_teatan_head_con:set_position(pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.iron_teatan_head_con:turn_off_fx()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.stop_shake(leader)
	character_util.stop_shake(hero_ai)

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(hero_ai)

	-- 도킹 후 파티원들의 parent를 머리에서 분리
	leader.transform.parent = self.cached_leader_parent
	hero_ai.transform.parent = self.cached_hero_ai_parent

	--도킹이 완료되면, 안드로이드 NPC들이 지정된 방향을 따라 run 자세로 도망치며 대사.
	--안드로이드1(up, scared, run) : 탈주 로봇이 깨어났습니다!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(headless_teatan_androids[1], { key = 'qc_sector_th_s6_5_0_4', lower_priority = true })

	--안드로이드2(down, scared, run) : 도망쳐야 합니다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(headless_teatan_androids[2], { key = 'qc_sector_th_s6_5_0', lower_priority = true })

	local wps = {
		{ headless_teatan_androids[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
		  headless_teatan_androids[1].Position + vector(1, 0, 2),
		  headless_teatan_androids[1].Position + vector(1, 0, 8) },
		{ headless_teatan_androids[2].Position + vector(0, 0, -8) },
		{ headless_teatan_androids[3].Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
		  headless_teatan_androids[3].Position + vector(-1, 0, -1),
		  headless_teatan_androids[3].Position + vector(-1, 0, -8) },
	}

	local routines = {}

	for i = 1, #headless_teatan_androids do
		local headless_teatan_android = headless_teatan_androids[i]
		character_util.remove_anim(headless_teatan_android)
		routines[i] = util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, headless_teatan_android, wps[i], 6, nil, { run = true })
	end

	wait_all(routines)

	for i = 1, #headless_teatan_androids do
		local headless_teatan_android = headless_teatan_androids[i]
		character_util.remove_emotion(headless_teatan_android)
		character_util.set_active_state(headless_teatan_android, 'disabled')
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'get' })
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'get' })

	local leader_jump_to = iron_teatan_headless_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1.75)
	local hero_ai_jump_to = iron_teatan_headless_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.75)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(self.jump_move, self, leader, leader_jump_to, 5.5, 1.25),
		util.cs_generator(self.jump_move, self, hero_ai, hero_ai_jump_to, 5.5, 1.25)
	})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(hero_ai)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(leader, 'none')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(hero_ai, 'none')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up')

	--해당 대사와 동시에 아이언 티탄의 양쪽 눈 부분에 하단의 이펙트가 출력됌.
	--(fx_queencastle_iron_teatans_head_flare_on) 1초 출력.
	--이후 (fx_queencastle_iron_teatans_head_flare_off) 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_teatan_robot_emerge_01')
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:eye_light_event()

	--아이언 티탄 오브젝트 0.04값으로 0.5초동안 shake 1회.
	-- 티탄 머리는 치우고, 머리 없는 아이언 티탄은 비활성

	--아이언 티탄 : 합체 완료.
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:normal_docked_talk_async('qc_sector_th_s6_5_1')

	--카메라가 다시 주인공(가디언) 에게 포커스.

	--이후 대화 이벤트 진행.
	--케이든 AI(up, idle, jump 1회) : 이것이 아이언 티탄의 본 모습…!
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_6')

	--케이든 AI(up, idle, idle) : 보기만해도 가슴이 웅장해지는 것 같습니다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_7')

	--가디언 left 방향 바라봄.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	--케이든 AI(right, smile, idle) : 이거라면 스위치까지 가는 길도 문제없을 거예요!
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_8')

	--가디언 left 방향 smile 표정으로 nod 2회.
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'nod', remove_after = 0.934, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언,카이 up 방향 바라봄.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up')

	--아이언 티탄 : 조종칸, 탑승자 필요.
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:normal_docked_talk_async('qc_sector_th_s6_9')

	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'right')

	local choose_table = {
		--『카이, 조종은 너한테 맡길게!』(mercy)
		{ 'qc_sector_th_s6_10', 'mercy' },
		--『다 비켜! 조종은 내가 할 거야!』(forced)
		{ 'qc_sector_th_s6_11', 'forced' },
		--『내가 붉은 혜성이다!』(brutal)
		{ 'qc_sector_th_s6_11_1', 'brutal' }
	}

	local choose_result = -1
	while choose_result ~= 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(hero_ai)

		--선택지 출력
		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_table)

		if choose_result == 1 then
			--가디언이 left 방향 smile 표정으로 release 2회.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'smile' })
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'release', remove_after = 0.934, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
			wait_for_sec(1)

			--케이든 AI(right, smile, nod 1회) :알겠습니다! 맡겨만 주세요!
			scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(hero_ai, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_12')
		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			--가디언 left 방향 attack 표정, release 2회.
			if choose_result == -1 then
				scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
			else
				scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
			end

			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'attack' })
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'release', remove_after = 0.934, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
			wait_for_sec(1)

			--아이언 티탄 : 가디언, 헤실헤실. 비추천.
			self.iron_teatan_head_con:normal_docked_talk_async('qc_sector_th_s6_13')

			--아이언 티탄 : 조종 시, 사고 다발 우려.
			self.iron_teatan_head_con:normal_docked_talk_async('qc_sector_th_s6_13_1')

			--가디언 tired 표정 전환.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'tired' })

			--카이(right, smile, idle) : 그렇다는군요, 용사님!
			scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, { name = 'smile' })
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_13_2')

			--케이든 AI(right, smile, release) : 조종은 제게 맡겨주시죠!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'release', remove_after = 0.934, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_14')
			character_util.remove_anim(hero_ai)

			--가디언 다시 idle 표정으로 돌아옴.
			character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

			--선택지 창 제거. 이후 케이든AI 재인터렉트 시 “준비됐습니까, 용사님?” 대사부터 다시 시작.

			choose_table[choose_result] = choose_table[3]
			choose_table[3] = nil
		elseif choose_result == 3 then
			--가디언 left 방향 eyelight 표정, cast2 자세 1초.
			if leader.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
				scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'eyelight' })
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'cast2' })
			wait_for_sec(1)
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)

			--카이(right, smile, release) : 역시! 남들보다 3배나 빠른 용사님, 멋지십니다!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'right',
					'release', 'smile', 'qc_sector_th_s6_11_2')

			--아이언 티탄 : 적군에, 고성능 신병기 존재.
			self.iron_teatan_head_con:normal_docked_talk_async('qc_sector_th_s6_11_3')

			--아이언 티탄 : 주의 해야함.
			self.iron_teatan_head_con:normal_docked_talk_async('qc_sector_th_s6_11_4')

			--가디언 다시 idle 표정으로 돌아옴.
			character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

			--해당 선택지는 소거되며, 선택지 창부터 다시 시작.
			choose_table[choose_result] = nil
		end
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:preload_fat_androids()
	self:android_army_preload()
	self.controller:set_iron_teatans_rush_barricades_active_state('enabled')

	--s2 부터 배치된 겹치는 npc와 기믹들 제거
	self.controller:remove_other_object_in_s6_path()

	-- 티탄 머리는 치우고, 머리 없는 아이언 티탄은 비활성
	self.iron_teatan_head_con:set_position(vector(999, 0, 999))
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.iron_teatans_headless.gameObject)

	self:iron_teatans_march()
end

--- 아이언 티탄을 타고 돌진하는 연출
function local_class:iron_teatans_march()
	self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.iron_teatans_marching

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()

	local iron_teatan_headless_pos = field:GetMarker('iron_teatan_headless_pos').position

	self.iron_teatans_con:load_async()
	self.iron_teatans = self.iron_teatans_con.fo
	self.iron_teatans.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(3.5, 1, 0.5))
	self.iron_teatans.Position = iron_teatan_headless_pos
	self.iron_teatans.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	self.iron_teatans_con:use_real_leader_or_character_on_shoulder(nil, vector(0, 0, -0.25))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

	self.iron_teatans:SetYAngle(180)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'down', false)

	character_util.set_active_state(hero_ai, 'disabled')

	camera_util.move_async(self.iron_teatans.Position + vector(0, 3, 0), 0)

	self.iron_teatans:ShowPilot(true)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_iron_teatan', state = 'event', mix = 1.5, volume = 1 })

	--화면 페이드 인 되며, 이후 대사 진행.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--케이든 AI(down, idle, idle) : 시스템 올 그린!
	self.iron_teatans_con:move_fo_to_pilot_talk_pos(hero_ai)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_15')

	--케이든 AI(down, idle, idle) : 준비되셨습니까, 용사님?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_16')

	--선택지 출력
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--『$name, KAI, 아이언 티탄, 갑니다!』(mercy)
		{ 'qc_sector_th_s6_17', 'mercy' }
	})

	--가디언 down 방향으로 attack 표정 jingak 1회.
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'jingak', loop = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--Jingak 과 동시에. 화면 shake와 함께 화면 줌아웃.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	self.iron_teatans:SetMarchingCamera(0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.iron_teatans_con:use_fake_leader_or_character_on_shoulder()

	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local cur_wp = field:GetMarker('s6_iron_teatan_wp_' .. i).position
		waypoint_list:Add(cur_wp)
	end

	local speed = 3
	yield_return(self.iron_teatans, 'March', waypoint_list, speed, 90)

	local walk_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_iron_teatan_walk_01',
												  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc',
												  fade_in_time = 0.1 })
	self.iron_teatans_con:start_walking()

	local start_pos = self.iron_teatans.Position
	local end_pos = field:GetMarker('s6_iron_teatan_wp_4').position
	local distance = (end_pos - start_pos).magnitude
	local duration = distance / speed
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.iron_teatans.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.iron_teatans_con:stop_walking()
	walk_sfx:FadeOut(0.1)

	self.is_iron_teatans_rushing = false
	self.cur_missile_state = self.missile_state.finish
	if self.iron_teatans ~= nil then
		self.iron_teatans:DisableShoot()
	end
	self.iron_teatans_con:change_to_normal_hitbox()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.5, 1)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	self.android_army_data:clean()
	self:before_battle()
end

function local_class:move_teatan(distance, duration)
	local start_pos = self.iron_teatans.Position
	local end_pos = start_pos + distance
	local time_passed = 0
	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress

		progress = time_passed / duration

		if progress >= 1 then
			break
		end

		self.iron_teatans.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.iron_teatans.Position = end_pos
end

function local_class:move_all_teatan_fight(distance, dur, leader_out)
	character_util.move_distance(self.fat_androids.fat_android_1, distance, dur)
	character_util.move_distance(self.fat_androids.fat_android_2, distance, dur)
	character_util.move_distance(self.fat_androids.fat_android_3, distance, dur)
	character_util.move_distance(self.fat_androids.fat_android_4, distance, dur)

	if leader_out == nil then
		character_util.move_distance(get_party_leader(), distance, dur)
	end

	self:move_teatan(distance, dur)
end

function local_class:fat_android_qte_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local teatan_hero_monster = self.get_teatan_hero_monster()
	local teatan_start_pos = self.iron_teatans.Position
	local teatan_end_pos = self.iron_teatans.Position + vector(0, 0, 3)
	local teatan_speed_speed = 2
	local dur = (teatan_end_pos - teatan_start_pos).magnitude / teatan_speed_speed

	--오우가 안드로이드 A,B가 아이언 티탄을 향해 run 자세로 달려온뒤 attack2 자세로 맞부딪힘.

	scene_util.set_anim(self.fat_androids.fat_android_3, self, { name = 'attack2', loop = false, scale = 2 })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to_async(self.fat_androids.fat_android_1, self.iron_teatans.Position + vector(-1.75, 0, 3.5), nil, 7)
			character_util.shake(self.fat_androids.fat_android_1, 0.04, 9999)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to_async(self.fat_androids.fat_android_3, self.iron_teatans.Position + vector(1.75, 0, 3.5), nil, 7)
			character_util.shake(self.fat_androids.fat_android_3, 0.04, 9999)
		end)
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true })

	--최초 오우거 2마리 부딪혔을 때 화면 0.4값으로 1초 shake 하며 FX 이펙트 출력.
	self.fight_fxs = {}
	local first_wave_androids = { self.fat_androids.fat_android_1, self.fat_androids.fat_android_3 }
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 1)
	for _, fat_android in pairs(first_wave_androids) do
		local fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(fat_android.Bounds.center)
		local fx = self.get_ammi_fight_effect():Instantiate(fx_pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, fat_android.Transform)
		table.insert(self.fight_fxs, fx)
	end

	local anim_speed = 0.2
	self.iron_teatans_con:start_walking(anim_speed)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--마리안(down, idle, shake 상태) : 이이…! 끈질긴 고철 덩어리가…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.shake(teatan_hero_monster, 0.04, 9999)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(teatan_hero_monster, 'qc_sector_th_s6_30_1_1')
	character_util.stop_shake(teatan_hero_monster)

	--위에서 내려오는 두번째 오우거들과 동시 진행을 위한 코루틴
	--start_coroutine(move_teatan, teatan_backstep_pos, second_wave_start_pos, dur)

	scene_util.set_anim_async(teatan_hero_monster, self, { name = 'release', count = 1 })

	--상단에서 오우거 안드로이드 C,D가 아이언 티탄을 향해 run 자세로 달려온 뒤 attack2 자세로 맞부딪힘.
	scene_util.set_anim(self.fat_androids.fat_android_2, self, { name = 'run' })
	scene_util.set_anim(self.fat_androids.fat_android_4, self, { name = 'run' })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to(self.fat_androids.fat_android_2, teatan_hero_monster.Position + vector(-0.75, 0, 1), nil, 7)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to_async(self.fat_androids.fat_android_4, teatan_hero_monster.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 1), nil, 7)
		end),
	})

	scene_util.set_anim(self.fat_androids.fat_android_2, self, { name = 'attack2', loop = false, scale = 2 })
	scene_util.set_anim(self.fat_androids.fat_android_4, self, { name = 'attack2', loop = false, scale = 2 })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to(self.fat_androids.fat_android_2, self.iron_teatans.Position + vector(-0.75, 0, 4), nil, 7)
			character_util.shake(self.fat_androids.fat_android_2, 0.04, 9999)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to_async(self.fat_androids.fat_android_4, self.iron_teatans.Position + vector(0.75, 0, 4), nil, 7)
			character_util.shake(self.fat_androids.fat_android_4, 0.04, 9999)
		end)
	})

	--카메라 진동(0.15, 무한)
	--오우거 안드로이드 4마리 shake(0.04, 무한)
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 9999)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')

	local second_wave_androids = { self.fat_androids.fat_android_2, self.fat_androids.fat_android_4 }

	-- 이펙트 생성후 부모로 fat_android 지정
	for _, fat_android in pairs(second_wave_androids) do
		local fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(fat_android.Bounds.center)
		local fx = self.get_ammi_fight_effect():Instantiate(fx_pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, fat_android.Transform)
		table.insert(self.fight_fxs, fx)
	end

	--QTE 액티비티 출력.
	--QTE 종류 : 터보 탭
	--제한시간 : 무제한 / QTE 실패 유무 : 무
	--횟수 : 12번
	--QTE 도중 암전 됨.
	--self.iron_teatans_con:start_walking(0.5)
	screen_util.show_turbo_tap()
	self.tap_count = 0
	self.is_qte_input_teatan_fight = true
	self.move_up = true
	self.can_move = true
	while self.tap_count <= 12 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_qte_input_teatan_fight = false
	wait_for_sec(0.12)

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	self.iron_teatans_con:move_fo_to_pilot_talk_pos(hero_ai, true)

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_30_2')

	--카이 : 마리안님을 부탁합니다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sector_th_s6_30_3')

	--QTE 클리어 이후 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	self.iron_teatans_con:start_walking(anim_speed)

	local end_move_dur = 4
	local end_move_dis = vector(0, 0, -7)

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(1)
		--가디언이 left 방향 get 자세로 점프하여 아이언 티탄의 왼쪽에 내려온 뒤, up 방향 바라봄.
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'get' })
		local leader_jump_to = teatan_hero_monster.Position + vector(0, 0, -2)
		character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, true)
		start_coroutine(self.jump_move, self, leader, leader_jump_to, 3, 0.7)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(leader, 'none')
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	end)

	self:move_all_teatan_fight(end_move_dis * 0.25, end_move_dur * 0.25)

	--오우거4마리와 아이언 티탄이 함께 화면 아래로 사라짐.
	--이후 화면에서 아이언 티탄이 사라졌을 시, 이벤트 진행.
	self:move_all_teatan_fight(end_move_dis * 0.75, end_move_dur * 0.75, true)
	loop_sfx:FadeOut()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/audio:bgm_queencastle_temple',
										 state = 'event', mix = 1, volume = 0.5 })

	self.iron_teatans_con:restore_pilot_original_parent(hero_ai)

	--카메라 및 오우거 흔들림 off, 이펙트 제거
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	for i = 1, #self.fight_fxs do
		self.fight_fxs[i]:Dispose()
		self.fight_fxs[i] = nil
	end
	self.fight_fxs = nil

	self.iron_teatans_con:stop_walking()

	--동적할당 해제
	load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.fat_androids)
	self.fat_androids = nil
end

--- 전투 이후 연출
function local_class:after_battle()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
	local teatan_hero_helmet = self.get_teatan_hero_helmet()
	local ogres = {}
	local ogre_count = 3

	character_util.hide_weapon(teatan_hero_helmet, true)
	--화면 0.7초에 걸쳐 검게 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	self.iron_teatans.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	--티탄 주먹 미리 생성
	if self.res_holder == nil then
		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	end
	self:create_teatan_arm()
	self.arm.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(hero_ai, user_party, true)

	--0.3초 대기.
	--0.7초에 걸쳐 페이드 인.
	character_util.set_active_state(teatan_hero_helmet, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(leader, self.get_leader_after_pos())
	character_util.set_position(teatan_hero_helmet, self.get_teatan_hero_after_pos())

	for i = 1, ogre_count do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.get_ogre_monsters(i), 'disabled')
	end
	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_teatan_hero_monster(), 'disabled')

	for i = 1, ogre_count do
		local ogre = self.get_ogres(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(ogre, 'enabled')
		scene_util.set_direction(ogre, 'left')
		scene_util.set_anim(ogre, self, { name = 'attack2', loop = false })
		table.insert(ogres, ogre)
	end
	--각 캐릭터가 이미지의 위치에 맞게 배치됌.
	--마리안 right 방향 tired 표정 prostrate 자세.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction(teatan_hero_helmet, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(teatan_hero_helmet, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(teatan_hero_helmet, self, 'prostrate')

	character_util.set_position(teatan_hero, teatan_hero_helmet.Position)
	scene_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, 'right')
	character_util.hide_weapon(teatan_hero, true)
	scene_util.set_emotion(teatan_hero, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(teatan_hero, self, { name = 'prostrate', scale = 9999 })

	-- 전투용 오우거 데스 이펙트 사라질때 까지 대기
	wait_for_sec(2.5)
	character_util.set_active_state(teatan_hero, 'disabled')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.move_distance_async(leader, vector(-2, 0, 0), nil, 2, false, true)

	--마리안(right, idle, prostrate) : 이… 이 내가…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(teatan_hero_helmet, 'qc_sector_th_s6_32_1_1')

	--(화면 0.2값으로 0.7초 shake하며) 마리안(right, idle, prostrate) : [shout] 이대로 무너질 거 같아, 인베이더!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_mech_land_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.7)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(teatan_hero_helmet, 'qc_sector_th_s6_32_1_2')

	local function local_hero_landing(fo, dir, pos, jump_height, fall_duration)
		-- 캐릭터를 히어로 랜딩 할 위치로 배치
		character_util.set_position(fo, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
		character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'attack2', loop = false })

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local start_pos = fo.Position
		local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, fo.Position.y, 0)
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
			free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

			if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
				character_util.set_position(fo, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
			else
				character_util.set_position(fo, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 낙하 위치
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	end

	for i = 1, ogre_count do
		local_hero_landing(ogres[i], 'left', self.get_ogre_after_pos(i) - vector(-1, 0, 0), 10, 0.5)
		if i == 1 then
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
			character_util.normal_jump(leader)
		end
		camera_util.shake(0.08, 0.2)
	end
	--오우거2 (left, idle, idle) : 침입자를 처단합니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(ogres[2], 'qc_sector_th_s6_32_2')
	--슬로우 모션 진행. ( 하단 영상의 연출을 참조 가디언테일즈 10-5 운명의 수레바퀴 공략(GuardianTales10-5)(ガーディアンテイルズ 10-5)
	--1초동안 Stage camera 값2 만큼 줌인.
	camera_util.resize_to(3, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	time_util.mod('slow_move', 0.1)
	--오우거 1,2,3 NPC가 동시에 가디언을 향해 attack2 자세로 jump.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'embarrassed')
	for i = 1, #ogres do
		scene_util.set_anim(ogres[i], self, 'attack2')
		character_util.jump_move(ogres[i], leader.Position
				+ vector(0.5, 0, 0), 7, 2, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.17)

	--동시에 가디언은 right 방향 scared 표정으로 embarrassed 애니메이션 반복.
	--슬로우 모션 진행 도중 2초 대기.
	--이후 아이언 티탄의 주먹(iron_teatns_rocket) 오브젝트가 FX이펙트와 함께 「주먹 낙하 지점」에 내리꽂힘.
	self.arm.Position = leader.Position + vector(1, 10, 0)
	local finish_slow_motion = false

	local arm_drop_pos = leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
	local arm_current_pos = self.arm.Position
	local duration = 0.3
	local timepassed = 0
	while (timepassed < duration) do
		timepassed = timepassed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, timepassed / duration)
		self.arm.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(arm_current_pos,
				arm_drop_pos, progress)

		if progress > 0.36 and not finish_slow_motion then
			finish_slow_motion = true
			time_util.unmod('slow_move')
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_fall_01')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_steam_princess_drone_explosion'):Instantiate(arm_drop_pos)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_minotaur_buttbounce'):Instantiate(arm_drop_pos)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_SmokeScreen'):Instantiate(arm_drop_pos)
	camera_util.shake(0.25, 2)
	--아이언 티탄 주먹 오브젝트가 땅에 꽂히는 동시에 오우거 안드로이드 1,2,3은 우측 상단으로 airspin 되며 날아감.
	for i = 1, #ogres do
		character_util.air_spin(ogres[i])
	end
	--Stage 카메라 0.5초 동안 원래 크기 (4)로 줌아웃.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

	--가디언 right 방향 surprise 표정 cast 자세로 jump 1회와 동시에 (exclamation) 이모티콘 표시.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'notice')
	--
	--화면 아래쪽에서 대사 출력.
	--[shout] 용사님! 괜찮으세요?!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
			{ key = 'qc_sector_th_s6_32_3', bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(0, -300), skip = true })
	--아이언 티탄이 화면 아래에서 위쪽 방향으로 walk 자세로 지정된 위치까지 걸어옴
	--해당 아이언 티탄은 ‘팔 한쪽이 빠진 아이언 티탄’ 모션(walking_futurecastle) 사용
	self.iron_teatans_con:play_anim('walking_futurecastle')
	local walk_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_iron_teatan_walk_01', loop = true })
	duration = 4
	timepassed = 0.0
	local current_iron_pos = self.iron_teatans.Position
	while (timepassed < duration) do
		timepassed = timepassed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, timepassed / duration)
		self.iron_teatans.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(current_iron_pos,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_after_battle_ogre_pos_3'), progress)

		local start_angle = fo.Transform.localRotation

			local progress = timer / turn_duration

			if progress > 1 then

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleSummerAndroidPreSection')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_1_7'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		show_shout_summer_android = 2, -- aa72가 소리치는 연출 봄
		holdup_rope = 3, -- 로프 들어올렸을 때
		ending = 4, -- 로프 들고 존에 들어갔을 때
		clear = 999,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- string key
	self.string_key = 'qc_summer_android_pre_'

	-- effect
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fish_water_splash2_loop') end

	-- character
	self.get_hero_ai = function() return get_character('hero_ai') end

	self.innuit_origin_id = 305154

	-- 로프 및 물 이팩트
	self.rope_item = nil
	self.fx_fish_water = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop()
	self.get_hook_shot()
	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_in()
	self.get_water_splash_out_effect()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	-- aa72 세팅
	local summer_android = self.controller.get_summer_android()
	local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('summer_android_pos_1')
	character_util.set_position(summer_android, vector_util.get_x0z(pos, 0.05))
	scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, 'unique/overturn_embarrassed')
	character_util.set_active_state(summer_android, 'enabled')
	self.fx_fish_water = self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop():Instantiate(summer_android.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.25)
	, unity_class.quaternion.identity, summer_android.transform)

	-- 상호작용 가능한 오브젝트들 세팅
	self.controller:set_interact_sprites()

	-- 로프 세팅
	local rope_name = 'summer_android_pre_rope'
	local obj = self.controller.get_rope_fo()
	obj.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos(rope_name)
	self.rope_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = obj.Position
	, itemid = 20915, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
	self:dispose_fx_fish_water()
	self:dispose_rope_item()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'summer_android_reset_zone') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.shout_summer_android, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'summer_android_event_zone')
			and self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.holdup_rope then
		local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			local target = current_state.HoldTarget
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.controller.get_rope_fo()) then
				start_coroutine(self.ending, self, target)
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	local rope_obj = self.controller.get_rope_fo()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, rope_obj) then
		if self.rope_item ~= nil then
			self.rope_item.Position = rope_obj.Position
		end

		if rope_obj.Position.z < -13 or rope_obj.Position.z > -4.5 then
			message_system:SendSync(rope_obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	local rope_obj = self.controller.get_rope_fo()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, rope_obj)
			and self.rope_item ~= nil then
		local summer_android = self.controller.get_summer_android()
		self.rope_item:SetSortingLayer(true)
		self.rope_item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, summer_android, true)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	local rope_obj = self.controller.get_rope_fo()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, rope_obj)
			and self.rope_item ~= nil then
		self.rope_item:SetSortingLayer(false)
		self.rope_item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, rope_obj, true)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:shout_summer_android()
	local summer_android = self.controller.get_summer_android()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0)
	self.water_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_water_loop_06', parent = summer_android, volume = 0.6,
		loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })

	camera_util.move_async(summer_android.Position, 1.5)

	-- 제… 제발  누가 도와주십시오!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(summer_android, self.string_key .. 1)

	-- 기체가 뒤집혔습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(summer_android, self.string_key .. 2)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.5)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.holdup_rope

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_throw_event')

	local rope_obj = self.controller.get_rope_fo()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, rope_obj, true)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:ending(held_obj)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending

	sp_util.enter_scene({ release_hold = false })

	local summer_android = self.controller.get_summer_android()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local is_in_party_innuit = false
	local innuit = nil
	local innuit_dir_key = 'change_hiding_innuit_direction'

	local party_count = user_party.Count
	if party_count >= 3 then
		is_in_party_innuit = true
		innuit = user_party[party_count - 1]
	end

	local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('summer_android_align_pos_1')

	if is_in_party_innuit then
		wp_util.move(innuit, pos + vector(1, 0, -1.75)
		, nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'up', end_callback = function()
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { innuit_dir_key, 'up' }))
				end })
	end

	wp_util.move(leader, pos, nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move_async(hero_ai, pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5
	, nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'up' })

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	qte_util.swipe('up', nil)

	character_util.release_hold_object(leader, held_obj)
	held_obj.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	held_obj.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })

	local pooled_hook_shot = self.get_hook_shot():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local hook_shot = pooled_hook_shot:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))
	hook_shot.Head.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local is_hook_end = false
	local function hook_shot_routine(start_pos, end_pos)
		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.3

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

			local diff = (end_pos - start_pos)
			local direction = diff.normalized
			hook_shot:SetFromTo(start_pos, cur_pos + direction * 1)
			self.rope_item.Position = cur_pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self:dispose_rope_item()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_02')
		self.get_fx_common_water_splash_in():Instantiate(summer_android.Position)

		start_coroutine(function()
			while not is_hook_end do
				local leader_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position, 1)
				local summer_android_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(summer_android.Position, 1)
				local diff = (summer_android_pos - leader_pos)
				local direction = diff.normalized
				hook_shot:SetFromTo(leader_pos, summer_android_pos + direction * 1)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end)
	end

	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 2)
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 0.5)

	local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position, 1)
	local end_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(summer_android.Position, 1)
	hook_shot_routine(start_pos, end_pos)

	-- (1) 스파인이  (down,tired,idle)상태 180도 회전하여 다시 정방향이 된다
	scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'tired')
	wp_util.move(summer_android, vector_util.get_x0z(summer_android.Position, 0.5), 0.25, nil)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(summer_android, self, { name = 'unique/overturn_2', loop = false })
	character_util.remove_anim(summer_android)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 9999)
	character_util.shake(hero_ai, 0.03, 9999)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'damaged')

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleSummerAndroidSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_substage_lifesaving'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		show_opening = 2, -- 오프닝 본 후
		enter_rescue_zone = 3, -- 구출 존 입장 후,
		ending = 4 -- 구출 후 엔딩,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- 물 이팩트 관련
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fish_water_splash2_loop') end
	self.fx_fish_water = nil

	-- string key
	self.string_key = 'qc_sm_s1_'

	-- 구출 존을 나가는 연출을 하고 있는지?
	self.is_show_escape_event = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local bad_student = self.controller.get_bad_student_female()
	character_util.set_position(bad_student, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_rescued_npc_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(bad_student, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(bad_student, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_active_state(bad_student, 'enabled')
	self.fx_fish_water = self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop():Instantiate(bad_student.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.25)
	, unity_class.quaternion.identity, bad_student.transform)

	start_coroutine(self.opening_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's1_show_saving_target')
			and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.show_opening then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_rescue_zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_rescue_zone_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.enter_rescue_zone
			and not self.is_show_escape_event then
		local escape_point_count = 2
		for i = 1, escape_point_count do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's1_escape_saving_zone_' .. i) then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.leave_escape_zone, self, (i == 1))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self:dispose_fx_fish_water()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'rescue_active' and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.ending then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending
		start_coroutine(self.rescue_loop, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	-- AA72,가디언,카이 (walk)모션과 속도로 left로 2칸 이동
	local move_pos = vector(-3.5, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move(leader, leader.Position + move_pos, 2, nil)
	wp_util.move(hero_ai, hero_ai.Position + move_pos, 2, nil)
	wp_util.move_async(summer_android, summer_android.Position + move_pos, 2, nil)

	-- AA72 (up) 1초 (down) 1초 (left) 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- AA72(left,tired,idle): 분명히 여기가…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, nil, nil, 'tired'
	, self.string_key .. 1)

	-- 이때 AA72,가디언,카이 (left,attack,idle)(jump1회)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		scene_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], self, 'attack')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'left')
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i])
	end

	-- 화면 좌측 상단에 shout 말풍선 : 누가 도와줘!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(leader, self.string_key .. 2, true, {
		viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.75), scale = 1.2
	})

	-- AA72(left,attack,release): 저 쪽입니다. 마스터!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, nil, 'release'
	, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, self.string_key .. 3)

	-- AA72 , 가디언 , 카이 경로대로 이동
	move_pos = vector(-6.5, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move(leader, leader.Position + move_pos, 6, nil, { run = true })
	wp_util.move(hero_ai, hero_ai.Position + move_pos, 6, nil, { run = true })
	wp_util.move_async(summer_android, summer_android.Position + move_pos, 6, nil, { run = true })

	-- 카이(up)0.5초(down)0.5초
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 카이(left,attack,cast): 물길을 지날 방법이 안보입니다…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'left', 'cast', 'attack'
	, self.string_key .. 4)

	-- 카이(left,sleep_deep,idle): 어쩔 수 없군요. 저를 발판 삼아 건너가는 게…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, nil, 'sleep_deep'
	, self.string_key .. 5)

	-- AA72(right,surprise,idle)(jump1회),기사(right,tired,idle)
	character_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')

	character_util.normal_jump(summer_android, true)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, true)

	-- AA72(right,tired,release): 그… 그럴 필요 없습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, nil, 'release', 'tired'
	, self.string_key .. 6)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	-- AA72(right,attack,eat)1초 후 (right,idle,idle)손에 밧줄 스프라이트가 있다 0.5초 대기후 (right)방향으로 0.5칸 이동 다시 (left)방향으로 0.5칸복귀 가디언에게 밧줄이 획득된다.
	local equip_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })
	scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	equip_sfx:FadeOut(0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(summer_android, '[base]weapon2', 'empty')
	local rope = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = summer_android.Position, target = leader.Position
	, itemid = 20915, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })
	rope.ConsumeTarget = leader
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(summer_android)

	-- AA72(right,attack,idle): 이 튜브형 구조 장치에는 물체를 옮기기 위한 위한 추진 장치가 있습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, nil, nil, 'attack'
	, self.string_key .. 7)

	-- AA72(right,tired,idle)(shake 0.03)1초: 무… 물론 저 혼자 제어하기는 힘들지만!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(summer_android, 0.03, 1)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, nil, nil, 'tired'
	, self.string_key .. 8)

	-- AA72(right,attack,idle)(jump2회): 마스터가 이 밧줄만 잡아주신다면, 길을 만들 수 있을 겁니다!
	start_coroutine(character_util.normal_double_jump, summer_android, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, nil, nil, 'attack'
	, self.string_key .. 9)

	-- AA72(right,attack,cast2): 저를 힘껏 던져주십시오, 마스터!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, nil, 'cast2', 'attack'
	, self.string_key .. 10)

	-- 카이(left,attack,cast)(jump1회): 자신의 몸을 아끼지 않는 살신성인의 모습이라니!
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'cast', 'attack'
	, self.string_key .. 11)

	-- 카이(left,attack,release): 이 얼마나 저스티스한 안드로이드 인가…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'release', 'attack'
	, self.string_key .. '11_1')

	-- AA72(right,tired,idle) (?)(question)이모티콘 버블
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'tired')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(summer_android, nil, 'question')

	-- 카이(left,attack,release): 역시 용사님 세대의 안드로이드는 다르군요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'release', 'attack'
	, self.string_key .. 12)

	-- AA72(right,blush,idle)(jump1회): 어… 어쨋든 빨리 구조를 하러가야 합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.normal_jump(summer_android, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, nil, nil, 'blush'
	, self.string_key .. 13)

	-- 모든 조작을 막아놓음
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActionTap(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1, 1)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'screenplay_active' }))

	local wait_check = false
	local touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.CustomFunction1TouchDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightTriggerDown then
				wait_check = true
				return true
			end

			if CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
				wait_check = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	message_system:Subscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	while not wait_check do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'screenplay_deactive' }))

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.show_opening
end

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local bad_student = self.controller.get_bad_student_female()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')

	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(bad_student, self.string_key .. 16, true, {
		viewport_pos = vector(viewport_pos_x, 0.75), scale = 1.05
	})

function local_class:ending()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local summer_android = self.controller.get_summer_android()
	local hero_ai = self.controller.get_hero_ai()
	local bad_student = self.controller.get_bad_student_female()

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_center_1')

	-- 미나(right,damaged,prostrate) AA72 (left,idle,eat) 가디언,케이든(left,idle,idle)
	character_util.set_direction(bad_student, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(bad_student, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_position(bad_student, center_pos - vector(1.5, 0, 0))

	scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, 'eat')
	character_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(summer_android, center_pos - vector(0.5, 0, 0))

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(leader, center_pos + vector(0.75, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(hero_ai, center_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0))

	camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 0)

	wait_for_sec(1)

			{ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- AA72(left,idle,idle)로 0.5칸 (right)로 이동 (뒷걸음질)
	-- 그와 동시에 미나 (right,damaged,seat)로 변경

	scene_util.set_anim(bad_student, self, 'seat')

	wp_util.move_async(summer_android, summer_android.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 2, nil,
			{ locked_dir = 'left' })

	-- 카이(left,attack,release): 괜찮으십니까?! 뭔가 필요한 게 있으시다면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'release', 'attack'
	, self.string_key .. 17)

	-- 미나(right,damaged,nod 0.5속도 2회): 켈록켈록…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_student, self, nil
	, { name = 'nod', count = 2, scale = 0.5, upper = true }, nil, self.string_key .. 18)

	-- 미나(right,tired,idle): 됐어, 괜찮아.
	character_util.remove_anim(bad_student, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_student, self, nil, nil
	, 'tired', self.string_key .. 19)

	-- 미나(right,attack,release): 갑자기 안드로이드들이 달려들다니, 이게 무슨일이야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_student, self, nil, 'release'
	, 'attack', self.string_key .. 20)

	-- 미나(right,tired,bomb_idle): 아끼는 옷이 다 젖어버렸잖아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_student, self, nil, 'bomb_idle'
	, 'tired', self.string_key .. 21)

	-- 가디언 선택지 1) 원수라도 진거야? (빨강) / 2) 안 다쳐서 다행이야.(초록)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ self.string_key .. 22, 'brutal' }, { self.string_key .. 23, 'mercy' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 가디언(left,tired,bomb_idle)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		-- 미나(right,tired,idle): 난 걔네들이랑 친하지도 않다고.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_student, self, nil, nil
		, 'tired', self.string_key .. 24)
	else
		-- 가디언(left,smile,nod2회)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'nod')
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		-- 미나(right,idle,idle): 너는 뭐 언제나 한가하구나.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_student, self, nil, nil
		, nil, self.string_key .. 25)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 미나(right,attack,cast): 아! 그래, 꼬맹이 안드로이드!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_student, self, nil, 'cast'
	, 'attack', self.string_key .. 26)

	-- 미나 이때 (right,tired,idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(bad_student, self, 'tired')

	-- AA72/카이 동시 대답: 왜 그러십니까?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(hero_ai, { key = self.string_key .. 27, skip = true })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(summer_android,
			self.string_key .. 27, true, { bubble_direction = 'lb' })

	-- 미나(right,tired,iidle)(annoyed) 이모티콘 버블
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(bad_student, self, 'tired')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(bad_student, nil, 'annoyed')

	-- 미나(right,tired,bomb_idle) : 튜브 낀 꼬맹이말이야.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_student, self, nil, 'bomb_idle'
	, 'tired', self.string_key .. 28)

	-- AA72(left,idle,idle)(jump1회): 아… 네!
	character_util.normal_jump(summer_android, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(summer_android, self.string_key .. 29)

	-- 미나(right,tired,idle): 네가 날 구하러 간 후 안드로이드들이 여길 지나갔어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_student, self, nil, nil
	, 'tired', self.string_key .. 30)

	-- 이때 동시에 카이 ,AA72(attack)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)

	-- 미나(left,attack,release): 아마 안쪽에 사람들도 무슨 일이 생겼을 거야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_student, self, 'left', 'release'
	, 'attack', self.string_key .. 31)

	-- 대사 넘어갈 때 (right,idle,idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)

	-- AA72(left,attack,idle): 다… 다른분들도 위기에!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, nil, nil
	, 'attack', self.string_key .. 32)

	-- 카이(left,attack,release): 용사님! 빨리 이동하도록 하죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, nil
	, 'attack', self.string_key .. 33)

	-- 미나 팔로우 합류
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(bad_student, user_party, false)

	-- 카메라 원복
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.25)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:rescue_loop()
	local summer_android = self.controller.get_summer_android()
	local bad_student = self.controller.get_bad_student_female()

	local move_pos = {
		bad_student.Position + vector(0.6, 0, 0),
		bad_student.Position + vector(0.55, 0, 0),
		bad_student.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
		bad_student.Position + vector(0.45, 0, 0),
		bad_student.Position + vector(0.4, 0, 0),
	}

	character_util.move_to_async(summer_android,
			bad_student.Position + vector(0.65, 0, 0), nil, 4)

	-- 구해드리겠습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	character_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'left')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(summer_android, 'qc_sm_rescued_2')

	screen_util.show_turbo_tap(1)

	local tap_count = 0
	local touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
				tap_count = tap_count + 1
				return true
			end

			return false
		end

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleSummerAndroidSection2')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_substage_lifesaving'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		enter_rescue_zone = 2, -- 구출 존 입장 후,
		ending = 3 -- 구출 후 엔딩,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- 물 이팩트 관련
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fish_water_splash2_loop') end
	self.fx_fish_water = nil

	-- string key
	self.string_key = 'qc_sm_s2_'

	-- 구출 존을 나가는 연출을 하고 있는지?
	self.is_show_escape_event = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 서큐버스 세팅
	local succubus = self.controller.get_succubus()
	character_util.set_position(succubus, field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_rescued_npc_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(succubus, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(succubus, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_active_state(succubus, 'enabled')
	character_util.spine_rotate(succubus, 30, 0)
	self.fx_fish_water = self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop():Instantiate(succubus.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.25)
	, unity_class.quaternion.identity, succubus.transform)

	-- 마커 세팅
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_center_1'), true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_show_saving_target')
			and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_rescue_zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_rescue_zone_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.enter_rescue_zone
			and not self.is_show_escape_event then
		local escape_point_count = 2
		for i = 1, escape_point_count do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_escape_saving_zone_' .. i) then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.leave_escape_zone, self, (i == 1))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.game_ended = true

	self:dispose_fx_fish_water()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'rescue_active' and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.ending then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending
		start_coroutine(self.rescue_loop, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
