local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleSummerAndroidSection3')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_substage_lifesaving'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		enter_rescue_zone = 2, -- 구출 존 입장 후,
		ending = 3 -- 구출 후 엔딩,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- 물 이팩트 관련
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fish_water_splash2_loop') end
	self.fx_fish_water = nil

	-- string key
	self.string_key = 'qc_sm_s3_'

	-- 구출 존을 나가는 연출을 하고 있는지?
	self.is_show_escape_event = false

	self.touch_handler = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 티탄 닌자 세팅
	local teatan_ninja = self.controller.get_teatan_ninja()
	character_util.set_position(teatan_ninja, field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_rescued_npc_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(teatan_ninja, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(teatan_ninja, { name = 'cast2' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_active_state(teatan_ninja, 'enabled')
	character_util.spine_rotate(teatan_ninja, -30, 0)
	self.fx_fish_water = self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop():Instantiate(teatan_ninja.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.25)
	, unity_class.quaternion.identity, teatan_ninja.transform)

	-- 구조된 npc 세팅
	self.controller:set_rescued_npc(2)

	-- 마커 세팅
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_center_1'), true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	if self.touch_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_show_saving_target')
			and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_rescue_zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_rescue_zone_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.enter_rescue_zone
			and not self.is_show_escape_event then
		local escape_point_count = 2
		for i = 1, escape_point_count do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's3_escape_saving_zone_' .. i) then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.leave_escape_zone, self, (i == 1))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.game_ended = true

	self:dispose_fx_fish_water()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'rescue_active' and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.ending then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending
		start_coroutine(self.rescue_loop, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleSummerAndroidSection4')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_substage_lifesaving'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		enter_rescue_zone = 2, -- 구출 존 입장 후,
		ending = 3 -- 구출 후 엔딩,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- string key
	self.string_key = 'qc_sm_s4_'

	-- 물 이팩트 관련
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fish_water_splash2_loop') end
	self.fx_fish_water = nil

	-- 구출 존을 나가는 연출을 하고 있는지?
	self.is_show_escape_event = false

	self.get_fx_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 페기 세팅
	local researcher = self.controller.get_succubus_researcher()
	character_util.set_position(researcher, field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_rescued_npc_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(researcher, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(researcher, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_active_state(researcher, 'enabled')
	self.fx_fish_water = self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop():Instantiate(researcher.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.25)
	, unity_class.quaternion.identity, researcher.transform)

	-- 구조된 npc 세팅
	self.controller:set_rescued_npc(3)

	-- 마커 세팅
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_center_1'), true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop()
	self.get_fx_hit()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's4_show_saving_target')
			and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_rescue_zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_rescue_zone_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.enter_rescue_zone
			and not self.is_show_escape_event then
		local escape_point_count = 2
		for i = 1, escape_point_count do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's4_escape_saving_zone_' .. i) then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.leave_escape_zone, self, (i == 1))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.game_ended = true

	self:dispose_fx_fish_water()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'rescue_active' and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.ending then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending
		start_coroutine(self.rescue_loop, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

	return false

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	for i = 1, self.zone_count do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's5_safe_zone_' .. i)
				and not self.is_zone_enter then

			sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_safe_zone, self)

	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fish_water_splash2_loop') end

	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_in = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in') end
	-- character
	self.get_shop_girl = function() return get_character('shop_girl') end
	self.get_monk_disciple = function() return get_character('monk_disciple') end

	-- string key
	self.string_key = 'qc_sm_s6_'

	-- 구출 존을 나가는 연출을 하고 있는지?
	self.is_show_escape_event = false

	self.touch_handler = nil
	self.game_pad_handler = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_center_1'), true)

	start_coroutine(self.debug_loop, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	if self.touch_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_fish_water_splash2_loop()
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_out()
	self.get_fx_common_water_splash_in()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's6_show_saving_target')
			and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_rescue_zone
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_rescue_zone_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.enter_rescue_zone
			and not self.is_show_escape_event then
		local escape_point_count = 2
		for i = 1, escape_point_count do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's6_escape_saving_zone_' .. i) then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.leave_escape_zone, self, (i == 1))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.game_ended = true
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'rescue_active' and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.rescue_after then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.rescue_after
		start_coroutine(self.rescue_loop, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:local_sine_move(target, data)
	local start_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'from')
	local target_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'to')
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration')
	local height = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'height', 1)
	local flying = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'flying', true)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
		local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)
		character_util.set_position(target, cur_pos, flying)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:debug_loop()
	self.game_ended = false
	while not self.game_ended do
		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.Q)
				and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.ending then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending
			sp_util.start_scene(self.ending, self)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:play_first_meet_survivor_event()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local survivor = self.get_survivor()

	local check_innuit_in_party = false
	local innuit_index = 2

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0.5)

	innuit = user_party[innuit_index]
	if innuit ~= nil then
		check_innuit_in_party = true
	else
		check_innuit_in_party = false
	end

	local party_wp_key = 'party_members_align'
	local knight_wp_1 = self.get_knight_pos(1)
	local hero_ai_wp_1 = self.get_hero_ai_pos(1)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, knight_wp_1, nil,
			1, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero_ai, hero_ai_wp_1, nil,
			1, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	if check_innuit_in_party then
		local innuit_wp_1 = self.get_innuit_pos(1)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(innuit, innuit_wp_1, nil,
				1, self, party_wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, party_wp_key)

	if check_innuit_in_party then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'change_hiding_innuit_direction', 'left' }))
	end

	-- 카이(attack, bomb_idle) : 용사님, 아시는 분이신가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 1번째 선택지
	-- 응, 빨리 도와주자!(초록)
	-- 더 이상 동료로는 못 쓰겠군.(빨강)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 2, 'mercy' },
		{ self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 3, 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 가디언 tired, cast1초
		scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self, nil, { name = 'cast', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' }, { name = 'tired' }, 1)
		-- 가디언 attack, release 2회
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, { name = 'attack' })
		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2, loop = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
		-- 카이(attack, salute 1회) : 알겠습니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'salute', loop = false },
				{ name = 'attack' },
				{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 4, skip = true })
		-- 카이(sleep_deep, bow_idle) : 용사님의 동료는 저, 카이의 동료이기도 합니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'bow_idle', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
				{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
				{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 5, skip = true })
		-- 카이(attack, victory_get 1회) : 이 분을 도와드리고 저스티스를 실현하겠습니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'victory_get', loop = false },
				{ name = 'attack' },
				{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 6, skip = true })
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 가디언 doyagao, cross_arm 1초
		scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self, nil,
				{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_angry_01' },
				{ name = 'doyagao' },
				1
		)
		-- 가디언 doyagao, bomb_idle 1초
		scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self, nil,
				{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
				{ name = 'doyagao' },
				1
		)
		-- 카이(sleep_deep, nod 1회) : 용사님… 겉으로는 매정하지만…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'nod', count = 1 },
				{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
				{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 7, skip = true })
		-- 카이(attack, bomb_idle, jump 2회) : 속으로는 안타까워하시는 그 마음!
		scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
		character_util.normal_double_jump(hero_ai, true)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'attack' },
				{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 8, skip = true })
		-- 카이(attack, victory_get 1회) : 저 카이는 그 저스티스함을 느낄 수 있습니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self,
				nil,
				{ name = 'victory_get', loop = false },
				{ name = 'attack' },
				{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 9, skip = true })
		-- 가디언 tired, bomb_idle 1초
		scene_util.play_wait_action(knight, self, nil, { name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'tired' }, 1)

		-- 카이(attack, idle, jump 2회) : 용사님! 어서 저분을 구해드리죠!
		character_util.normal_double_jump(hero_ai, true)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'attack' },
				{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 10, skip = true })
	end

	-- 가디언 캐서린 앞으로 걸어간다.
	wp_util.move_async(knight,
			survivor.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			nil,
			1
	)

	-- 1번째 선택지
	-- 반갑게 인사한다.(노랑)
	-- 물건을 뒤진다.(빨강)
	-- 깨운다.(초록)
	local select_1_string = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 11
	local select_2_string = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 12
	local select_3_string = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 13
	local choice_table = {
		{ select_1_string, 'Intellect' },
		{ select_2_string, 'brutal' },

function local_class:on_pre_load()

end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent), 'on_tesla_coil_on_off_event')

	self.tesla_states = {
		star_piece_tesla_1 = false,
		star_piece_tesla_2 = false,
		star_piece_tesla_3 = false,
		star_piece_tesla_4 = false
	}

	return true
end

	self.fx = self.get_fx_thunder_sign():Instantiate(fx_pos)

end

	if self.fx ~= nil then
		self.fx:Dispose()
		self.fx = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	if self.all_clear == true then
		return
	end

	local name = e.CoilObject.Name
	if self.tesla_states[name] ~= nil then
		local is_turning_on = e.IsTurningOn
		self.tesla_states[name] = is_turning_on

		if is_turning_on then
			for _, state in pairs(self.tesla_states) do
				if state == false then
					return
				end
			end

			self.all_clear = true
			start_coroutine(self.clear_scene, self)
		end
	end
end

	if self.fx ~= nil then
		self.fx:Dispose()
		self.fx = nil
	end

	local from = self.get_fx_pos()
	local to = from + vector(0, 0, -1)
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, from, to)
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

	}

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'ui/prologue', 'typing_text', function(prefab)
				local typing_text_go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.time_loop_text = typing_text_go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))
			end)
	self.time_loop_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 0, 100, 0, 0)
	self.time_loop_text.Label.fontSize = 64
	self.time_loop_text.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Center
	self.time_loop_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	res_holder:Dispose()
end

function local_class:fade_type_loop_text_in(typing_text, duration)
	local cur_time = 0
	typing_text.Label.alpha = 0
	while cur_time < duration do
		cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		typing_text.Label.alpha = cur_time / duration
		if typing_text.Label.alpha >= 1 then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	typing_text.Label.alpha = 1
end

-- 시간 플 텍스트 페이드
function local_class:show_time_text()
	if self.time_loop_text == nil then
		return
	end

	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	-- 남은 시간 앞으로
	local default_string_key = game_string:Format('qc_pa_tonio_42')
	self.time_loop_text.Label.pivot = CS.UIWidget.Pivot.Top
	self.time_loop_text.Label.width = 3500

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	local reset_string_key_2 = game_string:Format('qc_pa_tonio_43')
	local random_count_state = true
	local count_digits = 9
	local counting_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_count_number_01' })

	start_coroutine(function()
		local cur_string_key = default_string_key
		while random_count_state do
			for j = 1, 9 do
				for i = 1, count_digits do
					local temp = random_util.get_random_int(1, 9)
					cur_string_key = default_string_key .. temp
				end
				cur_string_key = cur_string_key .. reset_string_key_2
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_number_01')
				self.time_loop_text.Label.text = cur_string_key
			end
			wait_for_sec(0.01)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	default_string_key = default_string_key .. '5'
	count_digits = count_digits - 1

	for i = 1, 8 do
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		default_string_key = default_string_key .. '0'
		count_digits = count_digits - 1
	end
	random_count_state = false
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(counting_sfx)

	self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format('qc_pa_tonio_44')
	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_01')
	self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format('qc_pa_tonio_45')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

--  라스트 시간 텍스트
function local_class:show_time_text_ending(fx)
	if self.time_loop_text == nil then
		return
	end
	local string_key = game_string:Format('qc_pa_tonio_42')
	local second_key = game_string:Format('qc_pa_tonio_46')
	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.time_loop_text.Label.pivot = CS.UIWidget.Pivot.Top
	self.time_loop_text.Label.width = 3500

	local time_count = 5
	for i = 1, time_count do
		if i == 5 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_01')
		end
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_number_01')
		self.time_loop_text.Label.text = string_key .. '[ff0000]' .. (5 - i) .. '[-]' .. second_key
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(fx)
	fx = nil

	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.time_loop_text.Label.text = game_string:Format('qc_pa_tonio_47')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.time_loop_text.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)

end

	return false
end

end

		return get_field_object('tonio_star_piece')
	end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource('FX_lasthit', 'FX_starpiece_in_character',
			'FX_hit', 'fx_qc_event_energyspread')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent), 'on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	local android = self.get_android()
	scene_util.set_direction(android, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false })
	self.star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect_pool():Instantiate(android.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, android.Transform)

	if (quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.coin_state_key) > 0) then
		self.get_android().Interactable.Talk = 'qc_pa_tonio_37'
		return
	end

	character_util.add_listener(android, self.controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local android = self.get_android()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(android, self.controller)
	self.shadow = nil

	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end

	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil  then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.tonio_zone_name) and
			quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.coin_state_key) > 0 and
			quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.coin_state_key) < 5 then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending_switch_event, self)
	end
end
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_android()) and
			quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.coin_state_key) < 1 then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.android_meet, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	local name = self.dark_room_grids[e.CameraGrid.name]
	if name == nil and self.is_darkening then
		self.leave_dark_room()
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, name) then
		self:enter_dark_room()
	end
end

function local_class:on_exit_interact_teleport_start_event(e)
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.leader_enter_dark_room_key) do
		if e.ExitHandleName == self.leader_enter_dark_room_key[i] then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.tonio_scene_list[i], self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_scene_2_touch_state == self.scene_2_touch_state.wait_input and
			e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.current_scene_2_touch_state = self.scene_2_touch_state.succeed

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:enter_dark_room()
	self.is_darkening = true
	field:Tint('dark_room_key', unity_color({ 0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1 }), 0)
end

function local_class:leave_dark_room()
	field:RemoveTint('dark_room_key', 0)
end

function local_class:android_meet()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local android = self.get_android()

	party_util.align_party(android.Position, 'right', 1, 'linear')
	if self.cur_section_progress < 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

		--잠깐 잠깐!! 난 로봇이 아니야!
		character_util.normal_jump(android)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')

					{ name = 'release', count = 2, one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		end
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--난 세계의 흥미로운 것들을 연구하는 과학자!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false }, 'idle', 'qc_pa_tonio_4')

		--앗, 그런데 너…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'release', loop = false }, 'attack', 'qc_pa_tonio_5')

		--과학자 안드로이드, 매뉴얼 캐릭터 중심으로 한바퀴 (9시 / 6시 / 3시) 돌며, 관심을 비춘다
		--과학자 안드로이드 : (9시)호오…(right, cross_arm) / (6시)이건…(up, cross_arm) / (3시)과연…(left, crap)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				'cross_arm', nil, 'qc_pa_tonio_6')

		local android_original_pos = android.Position
		local pivot = leader.Position
		local wp_1 = {
			vector(android.Position.x, 0, pivot.z - 1),
			vector(pivot.x, 0, pivot.z - 1)
		}
		local dash_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
		wp_util.move_async(android, wp_1, 5, nil, { run = true })
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(dash_sound)

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'up',
				'cross_arm', nil, 'qc_pa_tonio_7')

		local wp_2 = {
			vector(pivot.x - 1, 0, pivot.z - 1),
			vector(pivot.x - 1, 0, pivot.z + 1),
			vector(pivot.x, 0, pivot.z + 1)
		}

		dash_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
		wp_util.move_async(android, wp_2, 5, nil, { run = true })
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(dash_sound)

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'down',
				'clap', nil, 'qc_pa_tonio_8')

		--매뉴얼 캐릭터 (down방향, question 동작) : [? 이모티콘 표시]
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

		--과학자 안드로이드 ([emo]smile, right방향, release 3회 ) : 돈이 필요해 보이는 그대
		local wp_3 = {
			vector(android_original_pos.x, 0, pivot.z + 1),
			android_original_pos
		}
		wp_util.move_async(android, wp_3, 2, nil)

		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'release', count = 3 }, 'smile', 'qc_pa_tonio_9')

		--쉽고 빠르게 돈을 벌 수 있는 아르바이트 하나 하지 않겠는가?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = false }, 'smile', 'qc_pa_tonio_10')

		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--아르바이트?
			{ 'qc_pa_tonio_11', 'normal' },
		})

		scene_util.set_direction(android, 'right')
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'release', loop = false })

		--과학자 안드로이드 (right방향, release 동작) : 말 그대로 매우 간단한 아르바이트.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'release', loop = false }, 'doyagao', 'qc_pa_tonio_12')

		--주변에 있는 door가 열린다. (door에 카메라 포커스) 내부에 button이 보인다.
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('tonio_door_1', false))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('tonio_door_2', false))

		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		camera_util.move_async(self.get_switch().Position, 1)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)

		--이 버튼을 누르는 것이라네.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'bomb_idle' }, 'attack', 'qc_pa_tonio_13')

		--버튼을 누르면 미세한 전류가 발생하며, 순식간에 의식이 이공간으로 워프한다네.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'cross_arm' }, 'sleep_deep', 'qc_pa_tonio_14')

		--		--과학자 안드로이드 (댄스): 단, 워프해서 5억 년간, 이공간에 홀로 남아 쏟아져 나오는 적들과 전투를 하면 된다네.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'cast2' }, 'smile', 'qc_pa_tonio_15')

		--		--과학자 안드로이드 (댄스): 단, 워프해서 5억 년간, 이공간에 홀로 남아 쏟아져 나오는 적들과 전투를 하면 된다네.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'dance' }, 'smile', 'qc_pa_tonio_15_1')

		--[선택지]
		local choose_result_2 = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--무슨 변신 훈련이라도 하나요?
			{ 'qc_pa_tonio_16', 'intellect' },
			--5억년? 장난해요?
			{ 'qc_pa_tonio_17', 'brutal' }
		})
		if choose_result_2 == 1 then
			--무슨 변신 훈련이라도 하나요? (매뉴얼 캐릭터, left, [emo]doyagao + cross_arm)
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'doyagao')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'cross_arm', count = 1 })
		else
			--5억년? 장난해요?  (매뉴얼 캐릭터, left, [emo]mad + release 2회)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'mad')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
		end
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--과학자 안드로이드(right를 향해 nod 4번) : 물론 5억년은 상당히 길다네…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'idle', 'qc_pa_tonio_18')

		--하지만 그곳은 배고픔이나 피로를 느낄 수가 없다네.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'idle' }, 'idle', 'qc_pa_tonio_19')

		--무엇보다도 약속한 시간이 끝나는 순간,
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'idle' }, 'attack', 'qc_pa_tonio_20')

		--시간과 몸 모두 원래대로인 채로 기억도 지워진채 다시 의식이 돌아온다네.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',

		camera_util.resize_to(4 * 0.8, 0.5)
		--과학자 안드로이드 (right를 향해 victory_get) : [강한 말풍선] 즉, 아무런 감각도 없이 돈을 벌게되는 버튼이라네.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(android, self, 'right',

	--어떤가 눌러보겠나?

			{ name = 'cross_arm', loop = false }, 'doyagao', 'qc_pa_tonio_23')

		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')

	end

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(self.optimized_npcs['monster_7'], self, 'attack')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_02')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	character_util.set_position(leader, field_util.get_marker_pos('tonio_battle_room_2'))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

function local_class:tonio_scene_2()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	camera_util.move_async(vector(888, 0, 888), 0.0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--[100일 뒤], 여기도 점점 익숙해지는 상황. 오늘도 전투 또 전투, 갈고 닦은 실력을 보여줄 때
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_pa_tonio_28' })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.environmental_sfx)
	self.environmental_sfx = nil
	self.environmental_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_amb_computer_01',type_priority = 'event', mix = 6 })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.0)

	local monster_count = table_util.get_size(self.optimized_npcs)
	local monster_z_offset = { -0.5, 0.3, -0.1, 0.5, 0.1, -0.3, 0 }
	local monster_start_x = { 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17 }
	local monsters = {}

	for i = 1, monster_count do
		local monster_pos = self.get_marker_main_room_start_pos() +
				vector(monster_start_x[i], 0, monster_z_offset[i])

		--매뉴얼 캐릭터 (좌에서 우로, right 방향으로 run)
		--곳곳에 있던 적 몬스터,  left, idle 상태에서 매뉴얼 캐릭터가 지나치자마자 die
		local monster = self.optimized_npcs['monster_' .. i]
		character_util.set_direction(monster, 'left')
		character_util.set_position(monster, monster_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim(monster)
		scene_util.set_emotion(monster, self, { name = 'attack', upper = true })

		table.insert(monsters, monster)
	end

	character_util.set_position(leader, self.get_marker_main_room_start_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', count = 1 })

	for i = 1, monster_count do
		local monster = self.optimized_npcs['monster_' .. i]
		wp_util.move(monster, vector(leader.Position.x, 0, monster.Position.z), 4, nil)
	end

	do
		self.tap_count = 0

		local slow_key = 'qte_attack'

		screen_util.show_turbo_tap(nil, nil, true)

		self.current_scene_2_touch_state = self.scene_2_touch_state.none

		for i = 1, monster_count do
			while monsters[i].Position.x > leader.Position.x + 1.5 do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			time_util.mod(slow_key, 0)

			self.current_scene_2_touch_state = self.scene_2_touch_state.wait_input

			while self.current_scene_2_touch_state ~= self.scene_2_touch_state.succeed do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			self.current_scene_2_touch_state = self.scene_2_touch_state.none

			time_util.unmod(slow_key)

			if i % 2 == 0 then
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'gauntlet_left_jap_attack', count = 1 })
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'gauntlet_right_jap_attack', count = 1 })
			end

			if i == 1 then
				wp_util.move(leader, leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 10,
						7, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_02')

			character_util.stop(monsters[i])
			character_util.air_spin(monsters[i], { speed = 3 })
		end

		screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
	end

	--절망하며 쓰러지는 매뉴얼 캐릭터 (right방향, frustration) 적들로부터 얻어맞고 있는 모습
	--적들은 주변을 둘러싸며 attack

	--넘어지는 연출
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'damaged')
	local leader_fall_duration = 0.7

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	character_util.jump(leader, 0.5, leader_fall_duration)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'prostrate', { mix_duration = leader_fall_duration })
	wp_util.move(leader, leader.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0), nil, leader_fall_duration)

	character_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 2)
	wait_for_sec(leader_fall_duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
	wp_util.move(leader, leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 2, nil)

	local monster_attack_duration = 1
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.optimized_npcs) do
		local monster = self.optimized_npcs['monster_' .. i]
		local rand_x = 1 * (random_util.get_random_int(1, 4) * 0.1)
		local rand_z = 1 * (random_util.get_random_int(1, 4) * 0.1)
		if monster.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
			if not direction_util.is_side_ver2(monster.Direction) then
				character_util.set_direction(monster, 'left')
			end
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
			character_util.jump(monster, 1, monster_attack_duration)
			scene_util.set_emotion(monster, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(monster, 'prostrate', { mix_duration = monster_attack_duration })
			character_util.move_to(monster, leader.Position + vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z), monster_attack_duration,
					nil, true, false)
		end
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_position(leader, field_util.get_marker_pos('tonio_battle_room_3'))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

function local_class:tonio_scene_3()

	self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.dark_room

	camera_util.move_async(vector(888, 0, 888), 0.0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--[10년 뒤], 탈출구따윈 없다는 것을 확인. 어이없는 버튼을 누른 것을 후회 또 후회

	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_2'], scene_third_pos + vector(0.6, 0, 0.3))
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_3'], scene_third_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.3))
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_4'], scene_third_pos + vector(-0.6, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_5'], scene_third_pos + vector(-0.6, 0, -0.25))
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_6'], scene_third_pos + vector(0.6, 0, -0.25))

	wait_for_sec(1)
	local function npc_setting(fo, dir, emo, anim)
		scene_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
		scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, emo)
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, anim)
	end
	npc_setting(self.optimized_npcs['monster_1'], 'left', 'mad',
			{ name = 'jingak', loop = true, one_shot_sfx = false })
	npc_setting(self.optimized_npcs['monster_2'], 'left', 'mad',
			{ name = 'jingak', loop = true, one_shot_sfx = false })
	npc_setting(self.optimized_npcs['monster_3'], 'down', 'mad',
			{ name = 'jingak', loop = true, one_shot_sfx = false })
	npc_setting(self.optimized_npcs['monster_4'], 'right', 'mad',
			{ name = 'jingak', loop = true, one_shot_sfx = false })
	npc_setting(self.optimized_npcs['monster_5'], 'right', 'mad',
			{ name = 'jingak', loop = true, one_shot_sfx = false })
	npc_setting(self.optimized_npcs['monster_6'], 'left', 'mad',
			{ name = 'jingak', loop = true, one_shot_sfx = false })
	npc_setting(self.optimized_npcs['monster_7'], 'right', 'mad',
			{ name = 'jingak', loop = true, one_shot_sfx = false })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.3, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local time_end_state = true
	start_coroutine(function()
		while time_end_state do
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)
			character_util.shake(leader, 0.05, 0.5)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end
	end)

	wait_for_sec(4)
	time_end_state = false

	camera_util.move_async(vector(888, 0, 888), 0.0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--[1000년 뒤], 이젠 숨 쉬는 것도 귀찮다. 어둠에 동화되며 세상의 이치를 고뇌, 또 고뇌한다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_pa_tonio_30' })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.0)

	self.shadow = leader.transform:Find('shadow')
	self.shadow_original_local_pos = self.shadow.localPosition
	self.shadow_original_local_scale = self.shadow.localScale

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'seat')

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.optimized_npcs) do
		local monster = self.optimized_npcs['monster_' .. i]
		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'disabled')
	end

	character_util.set_position(leader, self.get_marker_main_room_pos())

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local shake_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	camera_util.resize_to(4 * 0.7, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	camera_util.resize_to(4 * 0.4, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(shake_sound)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(888, 0, 888), 0.0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--[3억년하고도…….7000년 뒤], 무언가 진리를 깨달아버린 것 같다.
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.environmental_sfx)
	self.environmental_sfx = nil
	self.environmental_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_amb_sun_01',type_priority = 'event', mix = 6 })
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_pa_tonio_31' })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.0)
	camera_util.resize_to(4 * 0.7, 0.0)

	character_util.shake(leader, 0.05, 9999)

	local distance_to_leader = 8

	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_1'], leader.Position + vector(-distance_to_leader, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_2'], leader.Position + vector(-distance_to_leader, 0, distance_to_leader))
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_3'], leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -distance_to_leader))
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_4'], leader.Position + vector(distance_to_leader, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_5'], leader.Position + vector(distance_to_leader, 0, -distance_to_leader))
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_6'], leader.Position + vector(-distance_to_leader, 0, -distance_to_leader))
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_npcs['monster_7'], leader.Position + vector(distance_to_leader, 0, distance_to_leader))

	character_util.set_position(leader, self.get_marker_main_room_pos())
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'seat', loop = false })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.optimized_npcs) do
		local monster = self.optimized_npcs['monster_' .. i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(monster)
		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'enabled')
	end

	local fx_hit_list = {}
	local fx_last_hit_list = {}

	local function monster_ending(fo)
		local fx_monster_hit = self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(fo.Position)
		local fx_monster_last_hit = self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(fo.Position)
		local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(fo)
		local temp = direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite(look_dir))
		local rand_speed = random_util.get_random_int(1, 7)
		character_util.air_spin(fo, { offset = temp, speed = rand_speed })
		table.insert(fx_hit_list, fx_monster_hit)
		table.insert(fx_last_hit_list, fx_monster_last_hit)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_change_01')
	character_util.set_position(leader, self.get_marker_main_room_pos(), true)
	self:snap_shadow_on_floor()

	local fx_energyspread_leader = self.get_fx_qc_event_energyspread():Instantiate(
			leader.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, leader.Transform)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local android_run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx = '01_dash_01' })
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.optimized_npcs) do
		local monster_speed = random_util.get_random_int(4, 7)
		local monster = self.optimized_npcs['monster_' .. i]
		scene_util.set_emotion(monster, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, 'run')
		wp_util.move(monster, self.get_marker_main_room_pos(), monster_speed, nil)
	end

	local flying_duration = 0.5
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), nil, flying_duration)
	wait_for_sec(flying_duration)

	camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_princess_explosion_04')
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(android_run_sfx)
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.optimized_npcs) do
		monster_ending(self.optimized_npcs['monster_' .. i])
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_position(leader, self.get_marker_main_room_pos(), false)
	self:reset_shadow()
	fx_energyspread_leader:Dispose()
	if table_util.get_size(fx_hit_list) > 0 then
		for i = 1, #fx_hit_list do
			fx_hit_list[i]:Dispose()
			fx_hit_list[i] = nil
		end
	end
	if table_util.get_size(fx_last_hit_list) > 0 then
		for i = 1, #fx_last_hit_list do
			fx_last_hit_list[i]:Dispose()
			fx_last_hit_list[i] = nil
		end
	end
	camera_util.move_async(vector(888, 0, 888), 0.0)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.controller:show_time_text_ending(self.environmental_sfx)
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	character_util.stop_shake(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.back_room
	self:ending_scene()
end

function local_class:ending_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local android = self.get_android()

	scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, 'doyagao')
	scene_util.set_direction(android, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false, one_shot_sfx = false })

	self:change_world_event()

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ state = 'field', name = 'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/audio:bgm_queencastle_temple' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field'})

	--페이드 인, 5억년 버튼을 눌렀던 시점으로 돌아온다.
	--매뉴얼 캐릭터 버튼을 눌러도 반응이 없다고 생각한다. (right 방향, question)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cross_arm')
	camera_util.resize_to(4 * 0.8, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
	local android_current_pos = android.Position

	--과학자 안드로이드 이동
	local android_move_pos = leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	local android_bewteen_pos = android.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local leader_move_list = {
		vector(android.Position.x, 0, android_bewteen_pos.z),
		vector(android_move_pos.x, 0, android_bewteen_pos.z),
		android_move_pos }

	--매뉴얼 캐릭터 5억년 버튼을 향해 이동
	local npc_move_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	wp_util.move_async(android, leader_move_list, 7, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(npc_move_sfx)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	--선택지
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_pa_tonio_32', 'intellect' },
		{ 'qc_pa_tonio_33', 'forced' }, })
	--언제까지 밞고있어야되죠?
	--이거 혹시 몰래 카메라?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'doyagao')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent), 'on_treasure_open_screen_play_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	self:puzzle_1_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 상자 열었을 경우 퀘스트 클리어 처리(테스트 단계에서는 이미 클리어한 퀘스트입니다 떠서 불편함)
	if get_field_object('bravery_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		start_coroutine(function()
			-- 퀘스트 클리어
			yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
		end)
		return true
	end

	if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.battle_4_custom_key) >= 0 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_4_battle
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_4_restart, self)
		return true
	elseif quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.puzzle_2_custom_key) == 1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_2_start
		start_coroutine(self.puzzle_2_start, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.item_walls ~= nil then
		for i, item in ipairs(self.item_walls) do
			item:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.item_walls = nil
	end

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_lab_daughter(), self.controller)

	if self.puzzle_1_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.puzzle_1_npcs)
		self.puzzle_1_npcs = nil
	end

	if self.puzzle_2_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.puzzle_2_npcs)
		self.puzzle_2_npcs = nil
	end

	if self.puzzle_4_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.puzzle_4_npcs)
		self.puzzle_4_npcs = nil
	end

	if self.typing_text_obj ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text_obj)
		self.typing_text_obj = nil
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_lab_daughter()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_2_phase_2 then
			if not self.lab_daughter_routine then
				self.lab_daughter_routine = true
				start_coroutine(function()
					local lab_daughter = self.get_lab_daughter()
					character_util.look_at(lab_daughter, user_party.Leader)
					scene_util.set_emotion(lab_daughter, self, 'smile')
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_baby_laugh_01')
					character_util.show_emoticon_async(lab_daughter, nil, 'heart')

					scene_util.set_emotion(lab_daughter, self, 'idle')

					self.lab_daughter_routine = false
				end)
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_princess()) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_4_battle_end then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_end_before
		sp_util.start_scene(self.puzzle_4_princess_talk, self)
	end

	for i = 1, 6 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('courage_puzzle_2_wall_' .. i)) then
			start_coroutine(function()
				sp_util.enter_scene()

				field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_trial_of_courage_s1_' .. 11 + i })

				self:hide_ui()
			end)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'courage_puzzle_1_start_zone') then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_1_start
			sp_util.start_scene(self.puzzle_1_start, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'courage_puzzle_1_zone_1') then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_1_start then
			start_coroutine(self.first_jump, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_end_before then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.jump_after, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'courage_puzzle_2_zone_1') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_2_start then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_02')
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_2_phase_1
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'courage_puzzle_2_zone_3') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_2_phase_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_2_phase_2
		start_coroutine(self.puzzle_2_princess_run, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'courage_puzzle_2_zone_2') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_2_phase_3 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_2_phase_4
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_02')
		start_coroutine(self.puzzle_2_princess_routine, self, 2)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'courage_battle_before_zone') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_2_phase_4 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_4_battle_before
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:puzzle_4_setting()
			wait_for_sec(1.1)
		end)
		return true
	end

	-- 퍼즐 4구역
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'courage_battle_zone_1') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_4_battle_before then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_4_battle
		sp_util.start_scene(self.puzzle_4_battle_start, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	for i = 1, 8 do
		if e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_switch(i)) and
				self.current_section_state == self.section_state.puzzle_2_phase_2 then
			self:puzzle_2_switch_check(i)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- 리더가 적 가디언을 때릴 경우 같이 데미지를 입음
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.get_knight_monster(), e.Info.target) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(get_party_leader(), e.Info.sender) then
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = user_party.Leader
		damage_info.target = user_party.Leader
		damage_info.damage = e.Info.damage
		local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
		command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)

		self.leader_attack_event = true

		if user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < 1 then
			start_coroutine(self.battle_4_lose, self)
		end
	end

	-- 적 가디언이 공격한 데미지는 무효화
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(get_party_leader(), e.Info.target) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(self.get_knight_monster(), e.Info.sender) then
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = e.Info.sender
		heal_info.target = user_party.Leader
		heal_info.heal = e.Info.damage
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.princess_run_loop = false
	self.battle_4_loop = false
	self.alpha_loop = false
	return true
end

---region 첫 번째 점프 선택지 루틴
function local_class:first_jump()
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local queen = self.puzzle_1_npcs['courage_puzzle_1_queen']
	local move_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_1_pos')
	local queen_pos = move_pos + vector(5, 0, 0)
	local camera_pos = move_pos + vector(12, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move_async(leader, move_pos, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	if not self.first_jump_check then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)


		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 3.5)

		wait_for_sec(2)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(2)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		--가디언 (right, attack, idle), 점프 (0.5, 0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_jump_01')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		qte_util.swipe('right')

		character_util.set_position(queen, queen_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction(queen, 'left', false)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_agro_01')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(queen, 0.7, 0.5)

		--가디언 속도 6으로 우측으로 4칸 이동
		wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(4, 0, 0),
				6, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

		--가디언 이동 종료까지 대기
		--가디언 (right, scared, embarrassed), 점프 (0.5, 0.3)
		--1초 대기
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'embarrassed')
		character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--가디언 (right, tired, cast)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--카밀라 (left, idle, idle) : 모두를 위해서 당신은 이 자리에서 사라져야만 합니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(queen, 'qc_trial_of_courage_s1_6')

		--카밀라 1초 간 알파 페이드 아웃
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(queen, 0, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.set_position(queen, vector(999, 0, 999))
		--가디언 … 이모티콘 2.5초 대기
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'silence')

		--가디언 (right, idle, idle)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	end

	--점프한다 - mercy
	--그만둔다 - brutal
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_trial_of_courage_s1_5', 'mercy' }, { 'qc_trial_of_courage_s1_8', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--가디언 (right, sleep_deep, idle) … 이모티콘 2.5초 대기
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'silence')

		--가디언 (right, attack, idle), 점프 (0.5, 0.3)
		--1초 대기
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_jump_01')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		qte_util.swipe('right')

		--가디언 점프대까지 속도 6으로 달려서 이동
		--점프대에 닿으면 속도 6으로 우측으로 점프 (실제 점프하는 것이 아니라 연출로 점프하되 실제 점프대 탄 것과 동일하게 보이도록 설정)
		if not self.first_jump_check then
			wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
					6, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
		else
			wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(6, 0, 0),
					6, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
		end

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		local jump_tile = self.get_jump_tile()
		local jump_tile_animator = jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		jump_tile_animator.speed = 1.5
		jump_tile_animator:Play('on')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_jumptile_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			jump_tile_animator:Play('off')
		end)

		--가디언 (right, attack, get)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'get')

		--처음 0.7초 간 캐릭터 y축으로 3까지 이동 (대기)
		character_util.jump(leader, 3, 1.4)
		character_util.move_to(leader, leader.Position + vector(9, 0, 0), 1.4)
		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		--가디언 (right, damaged, embarrassed)
		--이후 0.7초 간 y축으로 -3초간 이동 (대기)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'embarrassed')
		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		--0.6초 간 가디언 추락
		--y축으로 -3 이동
		--720도 회전
		--Scale 1-> 0
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
		character_util.move_to(leader, leader.Position - vector(0, 3, 0), 0.6)
		character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 720, 0.6)
		character_util.spine_scale(leader, vector(0, 0, 0), 0.6)
		wait_for_sec(0.6)

		--가디언 추락 완료되면 2초 간 페이드 아웃
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)
		character_util.spine_scale(leader, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_2_start

		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.puzzle_2_custom_key, 1)

		self:puzzle_2_start()
	else
		if not self.first_jump_check then
			wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position - vector(6, 0, 0), 3)
		else
			wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position - vector(2, 0, 0), 3)
		end

		self.first_jump_check = true
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
	end
end

function local_class:puzzle_2_princess_routine(case)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	local move_points = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_pos_1'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_pos_2'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_pos_3'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_pos_4'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_pos_5'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_pos_6'),
	}

	if case == 2 then
		move_points = {
			field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_alpha_4'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_pos_12'),
		}
	end

	local point = 1
	self.princess_run_loop = true
	while self.princess_run_loop and point <= #move_points do
		local player_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position - princess.Position).normalized
		local dist = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position - princess.Position).magnitude

		if dist < 4 then
			local min_product = 4
			local index = -1

			for i = point, #move_points do
				local next_pos = move_points[i]
				local next_dir = (next_pos - princess.Position).normalized
				local product = next_dir.x * player_dir.x + next_dir.z * player_dir.z

				if product < min_product then
					min_product = product
					index = i
				end
			end

			wp_util.move_async(princess, move_points[index],
					7, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

			point = index + 1
			character_util.look_at(princess, leader)
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.princess_run_loop = false

	if case == 2 then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(princess, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 0, 1)
		princess.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end
end

function local_class:alpha_loop_routine(npc, case)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local anim_key = 'idle'
	local cur_anim_key = 'idle'

	-- 애니메이션 처리
	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(leader)
	message_system:SendSync(leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	npc.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim_key)

	-- 알파 처리
	local left = field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_alpha_1').x
	local right = field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_alpha_2').x

	if case == 2 then
		left = field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_alpha_3').x
		right = field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_alpha_4').x
	end

	local start_alpha = 0
	local end_alpha = 1
	self.alpha_loop = true

	while self.alpha_loop do
		npc.Position = leader.Position
		character_util.set_direction(npc, leader.Direction)
		local current_state = leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState
		if current_state and lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState) then
			if current_state.MoveMode == CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.AnalogueMode.Stop then
				anim_key = 'idle'
			elseif current_state.MoveMode == CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.AnalogueMode.Walk then
				anim_key = 'walk'
			else
				anim_key = 'run'
			end

			if cur_anim_key ~= anim_key then
				cur_anim_key = anim_key
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, anim_key)
			end
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_alpha, end_alpha, (leader.Position.x - left) / (right - left))
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, progress, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1 - progress, 0)

		if leader.Position.x > right then
			self.alpha_loop = false
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:puzzle_2_princess_run()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local lab_daughter = self.get_lab_daughter()

	while self.princess_run_loop do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	wp_util.move_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 7, nil, { run = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', play_pos = princess.Position })

	character_util.jump(princess, 1, 0.7)
	character_util.move_to_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(1, 0.5, 0), 0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_land_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', play_pos = princess.Position })

function local_class:puzzle_2_switch_check(index)
	if self.current_puzzle_2_state + 1 == index then
		self.current_puzzle_2_state = self.current_puzzle_2_state + 1

		local npc = self.puzzle_2_npcs['courage_puzzle_2_npc_' .. index]
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_catch_fire_01', type_priority = 'event', max_distance = 12,
				  player_priority = 'npc', play_pos = self.get_brazier(index).Position })
		command_util.execute_burn(nil, self.get_brazier(index), false)

		start_coroutine(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_evolve_result_01')
			field:Tint('puzzle_2_switch_answer', unity_color({ 0.2, 1, 0.2, 1 }), 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			field:RemoveTint('puzzle_2_switch_answer', 0.5)
		end)
	elseif self.current_puzzle_2_state + 1 < index then
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			-- 리셋
			for i = 1, 8 do
				local npc = self.puzzle_2_npcs['courage_puzzle_2_npc_' .. i]
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0.5, 1)
				local brazier = self.get_brazier(i)
				if brazier.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
					command_util.execute_extinguish(nil, brazier)
				end
			end

			self.current_puzzle_2_state = self.puzzle_2_state.none

			local leader = get_party_leader()
			character_util.set_position(leader,
					field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_pos_7') + vector(2, 0, 0))
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
			wait_for_sec(1)

			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			party_util.reset_controllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()

			stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
			field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
			if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
				CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
			end
		end)
	end

	if self.current_puzzle_2_state == self.puzzle_2_state.future_princess then
		start_coroutine(function()
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_2_phase_3

			local door = get_field_object('courage_switch_door')

			camera_util.move_async(door.Position, 2)

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('courage_switch_door', false))
			wait_for_sec(2.5)

			local princess = self.get_princess()
			local lab_daughter = self.get_lab_daughter()

			character_util.set_direction(lab_daughter, 'right')
			character_util.set_position(princess, lab_daughter.Position)
			camera_util.move_async(lab_daughter.Position, 1.5, { end_target = princess })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_02')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 0.7, 1)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(lab_daughter, 0, 1)
			wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.set_position(lab_daughter, vector(999, 0, 999))

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'get')
			character_util.jump(princess, 1, 0.7)
			character_util.move_to_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(1, -0.5, 0), 0.7)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
			character_util.remove_anim(princess)
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			wp_util.move_async(princess, field_util.get_marker_pos('courage_puzzle_2_pos_11'),
					7, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'left', play_sfx = true })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			wait_for_sec(1)

			quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, true, princess)

			camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

			local leader = get_party_leader()
			local knight = user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')

			character_util.set_position(knight, leader.Position)
			field_ui_manager:SetUI(knight, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

			local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
			character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, knight })
			character_util.convert_to_manual_character(knight, param, true)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 0, 0)
			scene_util.hide_weapon(knight)
			start_coroutine(self.alpha_loop_routine, self, leader, 2)

			knight.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
			self:hide_ui()
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:hide_ui()
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)
end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('courage_puzzle_4_battle_gate'))

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = leader
	heal_info.target = leader
	heal_info.heal = leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	start_coroutine(self.battle_4_clear_routine, self)
end

function local_class:giant_factor_routine(npc, start_scale, add_scale, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		if not self.battle_4_loop then
			return
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = (time_passed / duration)

		self.battle_4_damage_time = 0
		character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, start_scale + add_scale * progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.knight_monster_scale = start_scale + add_scale
end

function local_class:battle_4_lose()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)
	self.battle_4_loop = false

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	heal_info.target = leader
	heal_info.heal = leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	heal_info.sender = knight_monster
	heal_info.target = knight_monster
	heal_info.heal = knight_monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	self.battle_4_custom_count = self.battle_4_custom_count + 1
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.battle_4_custom_key, self.battle_4_custom_count)

end

function local_class:battle_4_clear_routine()
	local knight_monster = self.get_knight_monster()
	local battle_4_clear = false

	self.battle_4_damage_time = 0
	self.battle_count = 0
	self.knight_monster_scale = 2
	while self.battle_4_loop do
		self.battle_4_damage_time = self.battle_4_damage_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 시간이 지나서 크기가 작아지는 경우
		if self.battle_4_damage_time >= 5 then
			self.battle_4_damage_time = 0
			self.battle_count = math.min(self.battle_count + 1, 3)

			if self.battle_count == 1 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')

				self.amb_sfx.Volume = 0.6
			elseif self.battle_count == 2 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
				self.amb_sfx.Volume = 0.3
			elseif self.battle_count == 3 then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
				battle_4_clear = true
				break
			end

			self:giant_factor_routine(knight_monster, self.knight_monster_scale,
					self.knight_monster_scale == 0.6 and 0 or -0.7, 2)
		end

		-- 리더가 때린 경우
		if self.leader_attack_event then
			self.leader_attack_event = false
			self.battle_count = math.max(self.battle_count - 1, 0)

			if self.battle_count == 0 then
				self.amb_sfx.Volume = 1
			elseif self.battle_count == 1 then
				self.amb_sfx.Volume = 0.6
			end

			self:giant_factor_routine(knight_monster, self.knight_monster_scale,
					self.knight_monster_scale == 2 and 0 or 0.7, 1)
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if battle_4_clear then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.puzzle_4_battle_end
		sp_util.start_scene(self.puzzle_4_battle_clear, self)
	end
end

			-- 퀘스트 클리어
			yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.battle_group = nil

	if self.dynamic_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npcs)
		self.dynamic_npcs = nil
	end

	if self.items ~= nil then
		for i, item in ipairs(self.items) do
			item:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.items = nil
	end

	if self.typing_text_obj ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text_obj)
		self.typing_text_obj = nil
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_table(i)) then
			start_coroutine(self.choose_item, self, i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	-- 마법진 이동
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'power_test_start') then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.test_start
			start_coroutine(self.power_test_start, self, true)
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.test_start and self.power_test_out then
			self.power_test_out = false
			start_coroutine(self.power_test_start, self, false)
		end
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'power_teleport_zone_2') then
		scene_util.show_weapon(get_party_leader())
		self.power_test_out = true
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'power_battle_zone') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.weapon_choose then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_1
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_1_start, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.battle_group[1].battle_group_name == e.BattleGroupName and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_2
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_2_start, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.battle_group[2].battle_group_name == e.BattleGroupName and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_3
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_3_start, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.battle_group[3].battle_group_name == e.BattleGroupName and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_3 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_end
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_end, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_treasure_open_screen_play_end_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('power_proof_chest')) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.power_proof_get, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.battle_group[3].monster do
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_3 and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.battle_group[3].monster[i]) then
			self.battle_group[3].monster[i == 1 and 2 or 1].DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.BossExplosion
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'switch_knight_bow' then
		start_coroutine(self.reset_weapon, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
