--- 힘의 시련의 방 첫 입장
function local_class:power_test_start(show_text)
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	if show_text then
		wait_for_sec(2)

		--미래의 용사, 힘의 시련에 온 것을 환영합니다.
		self.typing_text_obj:SetActive(true)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
		coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_trial_of_power_s1_1', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

		--아래 자막 : 이 시련에서는 강력한 적들이 나타나 당신을 막아설 것입니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
		coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_trial_of_power_s1_2', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

		--아래 자막 : 자신이 용사의 힘을 가지고 있다는 것을 증명하십시오.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
		coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_trial_of_power_s1_3', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))
		self.typing_text_obj:SetActive(false)

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	else
		while lua_helper.type_compare(
				user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
	end

	self:hide_attack_ui()
end

function local_class:hide_attack_ui()
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton, user_party.Leader)
end

--- table interact
function local_class:choose_item(number)
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	local center = vector_util.get_x0z(field_util.get_marker_pos('power_table_pos_' .. number))

	party_util.align_party(center, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	--선택지
	--이 무기를 선택한다 - mercy
	--그만둔다 - brutal
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_trial_of_power_s1_4', 'mercy' }, { 'qc_trial_of_power_s1_5', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 2 and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.test_start then
		self:hide_attack_ui()
		return
	end

	if choose_result == 1 then
		self.get_table(number).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		self.get_table(number == 1 and 2 or 1).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		if number == 1 then
			start_coroutine(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async, self.items[2], 1)
			local item = self.items[1]
			item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

			self.items[1] = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ itemid = 20910, pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('power_table_pos_1'),
					  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.8, skip_text = true })
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.items[1], 0, 0)

			self:switching_leader(self.get_knight_sword())
		else
			start_coroutine(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async, self.items[1], 1)
			local item = self.items[2]
			item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

			self.items[2] = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ itemid = 20911, pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('power_table_pos_2'),
					  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.6, skip_text = true })
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.items[2], 0, 0)

			self:switching_leader(self.get_knight_bow())
		end
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.test_start then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.weapon_choose

		camera_util.move_async(get_field_object('power_battle_1_door').Position, 2)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('power_battle_1_door', false))
		wait_for_sec(3)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	end

	party_util.remove_animation()
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function local_class:reset_weapon()
	if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.weapon_choose then
		return
	end
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async(self.items[1], 0)
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.items[2], 0, 0)

	self.get_table(1).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.get_table(2).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

---가디언 스위칭 함수
function local_class:switching_leader(target)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.shake(leader, 0.01, 0.75)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_light_02')
	self.get_fx_change():Instantiate(leader.Position)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'dualgun_victory', scale = 0.85 })
	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(target, leader) then
		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		character_util.set_active_state(target, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(target, leader.Position)
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'right')
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character(target, param, true)
		coroutine.yield()
		character_util.set_position(leader, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	self.get_fx_cast():Instantiate(target.Position)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_knight_sword()) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_impact_lightning_01')

		local sword = target.Weapon1.WeaponSpec.SpriteName
		local shield = target.Weapon2.WeaponSpec.SpriteName
		target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', sword)
		target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', shield)

		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'cwp/knight', loop = false })
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'sword_idle')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lightning_strike_01')

		local bow = target.Weapon1.WeaponSpec.SpriteName
		target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', bow)
		target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')

		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'dualgun_victory', scale = 0.75 })
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.75)

		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'bow_idle')
	end
end

					and boss.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled do

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleTrialOfPowerChallengeSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenCastleTrialOfPowerChallenge @
		Comment = QueenCastleTrialOfPowerChallenge 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	--region npc
	self.get_knight_bow = function()
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			return get_character('knight_male')
		else
			return get_character('knight_female')
		end
	end

	self.get_knight_sword = function()
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			return get_character('knight_male_sword')
		else
			return get_character('knight_female_sword')
		end
	end

	self.get_knight_gatling = function()
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			return get_character('knight_male_gatling')
		else
			return get_character('knight_female_gatling')
		end
	end
	--endregion

	--region progress
	self.section_state = {
		test_start = 1,
		weapon_choose = 2,
		battle_1 = 3,
		battle_2 = 4,
		battle_end = 5
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.test_start
	--endregion

	--region field object
	self.get_table = function(number)
		return get_field_object('power_table_' .. number)
	end
	--endregion

	--region item
	self.items = nil
	--endregion

	--region object pool
	self.get_fx_change = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_erina_spawn')
	end

	self.get_fx_cast = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_thunderstrike')
	end
	--endregion

	self.quest_clear_count = 0
	self.quest_active = false
	self.power_test_out = true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource('fx_erina_spawn', 'fx_cwp_thunderstrike')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	if get_field_object('power_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		self.quest_clear_count = self.quest_clear_count + 1
	end

	if get_field_object('wisdom_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		self.quest_clear_count = self.quest_clear_count + 1
	end
	if get_field_object('bravery_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		self.quest_clear_count = self.quest_clear_count + 1
	end

	if self.quest_clear_count >= 3 then
		self.quest_active = true
		self:set_item()
		self:set_monster()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.battle_group = nil

	if self.dynamic_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npcs)
		self.dynamic_npcs = nil
	end

	if self.items ~= nil then
		for i, item in ipairs(self.items) do
			item:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.items = nil
	end

	self.get_table(1).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.get_table(2).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.get_table(3).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.quest_active then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_table(i)) then
			start_coroutine(self.choose_item, self, i)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.quest_active then
		return false
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'power_test_start') then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.test_start and self.power_test_out then
			self.power_test_out = false
			start_coroutine(self.power_test_start, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'power_teleport_zone_2') then
		scene_util.show_weapon(get_party_leader())
		self.power_test_out = true
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'power_challenge_battle_zone') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.weapon_choose then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_1
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_start, self)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'switch_knight_bow' and self.quest_active then
		start_coroutine(self.reset_weapon, self)
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'power_test_clear' or
			e:GetParamAt(0) == 'wisdom_test_clear' or
			e:GetParamAt(0) == 'courage_test_clear' then
		self.quest_clear_count = self.quest_clear_count + 1

		if self.quest_clear_count >= 3 then
			self.quest_active = true
			self:set_item()
			start_coroutine(self.set_monster, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if not self.quest_active then
		return false
	end

	if self.battle_group[1].battle_group_name == e.BattleGroupName and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_2
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_2_start, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.battle_group[2].battle_group_name == e.BattleGroupName and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_end
		sp_util.start_scene(self.battle_end, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:set_item()
	self.items = {}

	self.items[1] = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = 20910, pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('power_table_pos_1'),

	self.items[3] = drop_item_util.create_item(

function local_class:power_test_start()
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	while lua_helper.type_compare(
			user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	self:hide_attack_ui()
end

function local_class:choose_item(number)
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	local center = vector_util.get_x0z(field_util.get_marker_pos('power_table_pos_' .. number))

	party_util.align_party(center, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	--선택지
	--이 무기를 선택한다 - mercy
	--그만둔다 - brutal
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_trial_of_power_s1_4', 'mercy' }, { 'qc_trial_of_power_s1_5', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 2 and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.test_start then
		self:hide_attack_ui()
		return
	end

	if choose_result == 1 then
		self.get_table(number).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		if number == 1 then
			self.get_table(2).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			self.get_table(3).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			start_coroutine(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async, self.items[2], 1)
			start_coroutine(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async, self.items[3], 1)
			local item = self.items[1]
			item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

			self.items[1] = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ itemid = 20910, pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('power_table_pos_1'),
					  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.8, skip_text = true })
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.items[1], 0, 0)

			self:switching_leader(self.get_knight_sword())
		elseif number == 2 then
			self.get_table(1).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			self.get_table(3).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

			start_coroutine(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async, self.items[1], 1)
			start_coroutine(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async, self.items[3], 1)
			local item = self.items[2]
			item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

			self.items[2] = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ itemid = 20911, pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('power_table_pos_2'),
					  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.6, skip_text = true })
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.items[2], 0, 0)

			self:switching_leader(self.get_knight_bow())
		else
			self.get_table(1).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			self.get_table(2).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			start_coroutine(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async, self.items[1], 1)
			start_coroutine(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async, self.items[2], 1)

			local item = self.items[3]
			item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

			self.items[3] = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ itemid = 20892, pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('power_table_pos_3'),
					  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.6, skip_text = true })
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.items[3], 0, 0)

			self:switching_leader(self.get_knight_gatling())
		end
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.test_start then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.weapon_choose

		camera_util.move_async(get_field_object('power_challenge_door_1').Position, 2)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('power_challenge_door_1', false))
		wait_for_sec(3)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	end

	party_util.remove_animation()
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

function local_class:hide_attack_ui()
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton, user_party.Leader)
end

function local_class:switching_leader(target)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.shake(leader, 0.01, 0.75)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_light_02')
	self.get_fx_change():Instantiate(leader.Position)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'dualgun_victory', scale = 0.85 })
	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(target, leader) then
		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		character_util.set_active_state(target, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(target, leader.Position)
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'right')
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character(target, param, true)
		coroutine.yield()
		character_util.set_position(leader, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	self.get_fx_cast():Instantiate(target.Position)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_knight_sword()) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_impact_lightning_01')

		local sword = target.Weapon1.WeaponSpec.SpriteName
		local shield = target.Weapon2.WeaponSpec.SpriteName
		target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', sword)
		target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', shield)

		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'cwp/knight', loop = false })
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'sword_idle')
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_knight_bow()) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lightning_strike_01')

		local bow = target.Weapon1.WeaponSpec.SpriteName
		target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', bow)
		target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')

		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'dualgun_victory', scale = 0.75 })
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.75)

		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'bow_idle')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_plasma_hit_01')

		local gatling = target.Weapon1.WeaponSpec.SpriteName
		target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', gatling)
		target.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')

		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'dualgun_victory', scale = 0.75 })
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.75)

		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'dualgun_idle')
	end
end

function local_class:reset_weapon()
	if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.weapon_choose then
		return
	end

	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async(self.items[1], 0)
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async(self.items[3], 0)
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.items[2], 0, 0)

	self.get_table(1).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.get_table(2).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.get_table(3).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:battle_start()
	local center = field_util.get_marker_pos('battle_5_pos')
	local leader = get_party_leader()

--[[QuestAttribute

	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_1_2'

	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		puzzle_started = 1,
		puzzle_ended = 2
	}

	end

	self.get_puzzle_npc_center_pos = function()

	end

	self.get_puzzle_camera_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('wisdom_puzzle_camera_pos_4')
	end

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_reset_fx = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
	end

	self.quest_marker_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_4'
	self.puzzle_enter_door_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_enter_door_4'
	self.puzzle_exit_door_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_exit_door_4'

	self.puzzle_exit_zone_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_exit_zone_2'

	self.puzzle_start_event_zone_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_start_event_zone_4'

	self.quest_clear_count = 0
	self.quest_active = false
	self.key_spawn_check = false

	self.knight_state = { idle = 1, walk = 2 }
	self.current_knight_state = self.knight_state.idle
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent), 'on_burn_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StarPieceGetEvent), 'on_starpiece_get_event')

	if get_field_object('power_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		self.quest_clear_count = self.quest_clear_count + 1
	end

	if get_field_object('wisdom_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		self.quest_clear_count = self.quest_clear_count + 1
	end
	if get_field_object('bravery_proof_chest').FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpened then
		self.quest_clear_count = self.quest_clear_count + 1
	end

	if self.quest_clear_count >= 3 then
		self.quest_active = true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local puzzle_key = self.get_puzzle_key()
	puzzle_key.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(puzzle_key.Position, 10)
	puzzle_key.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	local shadow_transform = puzzle_key.Transform:Find("shadow")
	shadow_transform.localPosition = vector(0, -20 + 0.03, 0)

	if get_field_object('wisdom_puzzle_exit_door_4').FieldObjectBehaviour.Opened then
		start_coroutine(function()
			-- 퀘스트 클리어
			yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
		end)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StarPieceGetEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_burn_event(e)
	if not self.quest_active then
		return false
	end

	local burn_count = 0
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local brazier = self.get_puzzle_brazier(i)
		if brazier.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
			burn_count = burn_count + 1
		end
	end

	if burn_count == 4 and not self.key_spawn_check then
		self.key_spawn_check = true
		start_coroutine(self.key_spawn, self, 1)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.quest_active then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if self.current_event_state  == self.event_state.none then
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, e.FieldObject, self.puzzle_start_event_zone_name) then
				self.current_event_state = self.event_state.puzzle_started
				sp_util.start_scene(self.puzzle_start, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'power_test_clear' or
			e:GetParamAt(0) == 'wisdom_test_clear' or
			e:GetParamAt(0) == 'courage_test_clear' then
		self.quest_clear_count = self.quest_clear_count + 1

		if self.quest_clear_count >= 3 then
			self.quest_active = true
			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_starpiece_get_event(e)
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:puzzle_start()
	-- 문 닫힘
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.puzzle_enter_door_name, false))
	-- 0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 거울 세팅
	self:mirror_setup()

	-- 퀘스트 마커 설정
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name, get_field_object(self.puzzle_exit_door_name), true)

	-- 퍼즐 업데이트 시작
	start_coroutine(self.puzzle_update, self)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:puzzle_update()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local knight_mirror = self.get_knight_mirror()

	local knight_prev_pos = knight.Position

	while self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.puzzle_ended and
			self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.none do
		local knight_current_pos = knight.Position
		-- 플레이어의 이전 좌표와 현재 좌표가 다르다면 방향 벡터를 구해서
		-- 거울속 세계의 npc에게 작용시킨다.
		if knight_current_pos ~= knight_prev_pos then
			-- 가공 전 벡터
			local vec = knight_prev_pos - knight_current_pos
			local speed = vector_util.distance(knight_prev_pos, knight_current_pos)
			--local knight_mirror_pos = knight_mirror.Position
			-- -1을 곱해줘야 반대 벡터가 완성
			local dir = vector_util.normalized(vec)
			knight_mirror.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
					knight_mirror,
					dir,
					speed)

			if self.current_knight_state == self.knight_state.idle then
				self.current_knight_state = self.knight_state.walk
				character_util.set_anim(knight_mirror, { name = 'walk' })
			end
		else
			if self.current_knight_state == self.knight_state.walk then
				self.current_knight_state = self.knight_state.idle
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight_mirror)
			end
		end
		knight_prev_pos = knight_current_pos
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:puzzle_end()
	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	-- 카메라 귀환 시키기
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.move(self.get_knight().Position,
			1, { target = self.get_knight(), end_target = self.get_knight() })
end

function local_class:mirror_setup()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local knight_mirror = self.get_knight_mirror()
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(knight_mirror, 0, 0)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight_mirror, 'left')

	-- 카메라를 가운데로 이동
	camera_util.move(self.get_puzzle_camera_pos(), 1.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(6.3, 1.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 화로를 키고 holdup 시켜주자.
	local brazier = self.get_brazier()
	command_util.execute_burn(nil, brazier, true)
	command_util.execute_holdup(knight_mirror, brazier, knight_mirror.Position, 0)

	-- 거울속 캐릭터 좌표 셋팅
	local diff = self.get_puzzle_player_center_pos() - knight.Position
	-- 거울로 스폰 시키기 위해 x만 반전시켜준다.
	diff = vector(-diff.x, diff.y, diff.z)

	local goal_pos = self.get_puzzle_npc_center_pos() - diff
	knight_mirror.Position = goal_pos

	-- 거울속 기사에게 이펙트 생성
	self.get_reset_fx():Instantiate(knight_mirror.Position)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(knight_mirror, 1, 1)

	-- 히트 박스를 설정해야 ExecuteMove가 제대로 된다.
	knight_mirror.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.45, 0.5, 0.45))
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:key_spawn(duration)
	local key = self.get_puzzle_key()
	local height = stage_util.get_height(key.Position)

	key.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	local shadow_transform = key.Transform:Find("shadow")
	shadow_transform.localPosition = vector(0, -20 + 0.03, 0)

	-- 낙하 계산
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(0.5, 20, 3)
	local end_pos = vector(key.Position.x, 0, key.Position.z)

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_angle = 0
	local end_angle = 1080
	local is_bounce = false
	local bounce_num = 0

	local rotate_duration = free_fall:GetTotalTime()

	while not free_fall:IsDone() do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if not is_bounce and cur_y < 0 then
			key.Position = vector(end_pos.x, 20 + height + cur_y, end_pos.z)
		else
			if not is_bounce then
				is_bounce = true
			end

			key.Position = vector(end_pos.x, height + cur_y, end_pos.z)
		end

		shadow_transform.localPosition = vector(0, -key.Position.y + height + 0.03, 0)

		if time_passed < rotate_duration then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local cur_angle = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
					time_passed, start_angle, end_angle - start_angle, rotate_duration)

			key.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, cur_angle, 0)
		else
			key.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
		end

		if bounce_num < free_fall:NumBounced() then
			bounce_num = bounce_num + 1

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_key_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	key.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	key.Position = end_pos
	shadow_transform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.03, 0)
	key.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)

	start_coroutine(self.check_door_opened, self)
end

function local_class:check_door_opened()
	local key = self.get_puzzle_key()
	local keydoor = get_field_object(self.puzzle_exit_door_name)

	while key.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') and
			self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.none do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local brazier = self.get_puzzle_brazier(i)
		if brazier.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
			command_util.execute_extinguish(nil, brazier)
		end
	end

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	camera_util.move_async(keydoor.Position, 1)

	while keydoor.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') and
			self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.none do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.puzzle_ended

	-- 카메라 귀환 시키기
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.move_async(self.get_knight().Position, 1, { end_target = self.get_knight() })

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.puzzle_enter_door_name, false))

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_hit_by_character(from, to)
	-- nil이거나 죽은 상태면 처리 불가능.

	if self.worker_info[to] == nil and not (self.worker_info[to].is_alive) then
		return
	end
	local worker_info = self.worker_info[to]
	local index = worker_info.index

	-- 넉백 중이니 리턴
	if not table_is_empty(worker_info.knockback_info) then
		return
	end

	-- 02_hit_big_01
	worker_info.hit_count = worker_info.hit_count + 1

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', play_pos = to.Position, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- talk가 가능한지 체크
	local pair_index = index + 1
	if index % 2 == 0 then
		pair_index = index - 1
	end

	-- 페어인 안드로이드와 내가 전부 talk 플래그가 false은 상태에만 동작해야한다
	if (not self.android_talk_flag[pair_index]) and (not self.android_talk_flag[index]) then
		start_coroutine(self.show_talk, self, to, index, pair_index, worker_info.hit_count)
	end


	-- 넉백이 최대치를 넘어버리면 그에 맞는 처리 시작
	if worker_info.hit_count >= self.max_hit_count then
		-- airspin start
		start_coroutine(self.air_spin, self, to, from)
	else
		start_coroutine(self.knockback, self, to, from)
	end
end

function local_class:show_talk(talker, index, pair_index, hit_count)
	self.android_talk_flag[pair_index] = true
	self.android_talk_flag[index] = true

	-- qc_fall_guardian_s2_26부터 시작.
	local talk_index = 26

	if hit_count == 1 then
		talk_index = random_util.get_random_int(26, 27)
	elseif hit_count == 2 then
		talk_index = random_util.get_random_int(28, 29)
	else
		talk_index = random_util.get_random_int(30, 31)
	end

	local talk_key = 'qc_fall_guardian_s2_' .. talk_index

	if hit_count == 3 then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, { key = talk_key, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, { key = talk_key })
	end

	self.android_talk_flag[pair_index] = false
	self.android_talk_flag[index] = false
end

function local_class:air_spin(fo, from)
	local worker_info = self.worker_info[fo]
	if worker_info == nil or worker_info.is_alive == false then
		return
	end

	local event_key = 'airspin_' .. worker_info.index
	self.scene_play_infos[event_key] = true

	self.section:unregister_bound_fo(worker_info.index)

	worker_info.is_alive = false
	character_util.air_spin(fo, {
		offset = (fo.Position - from.Position).normalized * 3
	})
	wait_for_sec(3)
	fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	if self.scene_play_infos ~= nil then
		self.scene_play_infos[event_key] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:knockback(fo, from)
	local worker_info = self.worker_info[fo]
	local key = 'kn'

	if worker_info ~= nil then
		worker_info.knockback_info[key] = true
	end

	-- 일단은 위쪽으로 0.5만큼 밀린다...
	knock_back_from_pos(fo, vector(fo.Position.x, 0, from.Position.z))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if worker_info ~= nil then
		worker_info.knockback_info[key] = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class
	end
}

	local key = 'falling_' .. num
	local buoy = self.get_buoy(num)
	local buoy_data = self.buoy_data[num]

	self.scene_play_infos[key] = true
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_02')
	while buoy_data.state ~= self.buoy_state.destroyed and buoy_data.state ~= self.buoy_state.idle do
		-- 게임 오버씬에서는 타임 스케일 사용 금지.
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if buoy_data.state == self.buoy_state.falling then
			if buoy.Position.y <= ((self.falling_y * -1) - 0.4) then
				buoy.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				buoy_data.state = self.buoy_state.destroyed
			else
				-- 여기서 낙하 시키자
				local move_speed = self.falling_y * (dt / self.falling_duration)
				buoy.Position = buoy.Position + (vector(0, -1, 0) * move_speed)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.scene_play_infos[key] = nil
end

	local buoy_data = self.buoy_data[num]
	local bounds = buoy.Bounds

	-- 부표 자신이 트랩일 경우
	if buoy_data.is_trap then
		if buoy_data.state == self.buoy_state.idle then
			buoy_data.state = self.buoy_state.falling
			-- 부표를 섹션에서 제거해준다
			local section = self.section
			section:remove_custom_tile_bounds(get_buoy_key(num), bounds)
			start_coroutine(self.buoy_fall_scene, self, num)
		end
	end
end

		local offset = self.arm_info.group_offset[group]
		local bounds_size = self.arm_info.bounds_size
		local bounds = {
			min = {
				x = offset.x - bounds_size.x,
				z = offset.z - bounds_size.z
			},
			max = {
				x = offset.x + bounds_size.x,
				z = offset.z + bounds_size.z
			}
		}
		return {
			initial_pos = pos,
			group = group,
			num = num,
			current_state = self.arm_info.state.idle,
			center_pos = center_pos,
			--hit_goal_pos = center_pos + (self.arm_info.group_dir[group] * self.arm_info.smash_distance),
			-- 바운드는 offset이 적용된 상대적인 바운드 값이라 pos를 더해줘야한다.

			-- smash가 진행 된 시간으로 사용 되는 중
			current_duration = 0

	for i = 1, #self.arm_list do
		self:arm_update(dt, i)

function local_class:arm_update(dt, index)
	local current_arm_info = self.arm_list[index]
	local group = current_arm_info.group
	local teatan_arm = self.get_teatan_arm(group, current_arm_info.num)

	-- 주먹이 끝점까지 도달하는 시간
	local smash_time = self.arm_info.smash_time
	-- 주먹이 끝점에 도달 한 후 대기할 시간
	local stay_time = self.arm_info.stay_time
	-- 주먹이 돌아가는데 걸리는 시간
	local return_time = self.arm_info.return_time
	-- 주먹이 제자리로 돌아온 후 기다릴 시간 (쿨다운 타임)
	local after_return_wait_time = self.arm_info.after_return_wait_time
	local move_distance = self.arm_info.move_distance
	local smash_distance = self.arm_info.smash_distance

	if self.arm_constants[index] ~= nil then
		local override_value = self.arm_constants[index]
		-- 주먹이 끝점까지 도달하는 시간
		smash_time = override_value.smash_time
		stay_time = override_value.stay_time
		return_time = override_value.return_time
		after_return_wait_time = override_value.after_return_wait_time
		move_distance = override_value.move_distance
		smash_distance = override_value.smash_distance
	end

	-- idle = 0,
	-- smash = 1,
	-- stay = 2,
	-- return_to_initial = 3,
	-- wait = 4
	local current_state = current_arm_info.current_state

	if current_state == self.arm_info.state.idle then
		-- 주먹의 기본 상태 (가능하다면 smash로 바꾸어 움직인다.)
		current_arm_info.current_state = self.arm_info.state.smash
		--02_iron_teatan_head_break_01
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_iron_teatan_head_break_01', play_pos = teatan_arm.Position, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'npc' })

		current_arm_info.hit_entities = { }
	elseif current_state == self.arm_info.state.smash then
		-- 주먹이 날아가는 도중 상태 로직
		local duration = smash_time
		local dir = self.arm_info.group_dir[group]
		local speed = move_distance * (dt / duration)
		local entities = self.section.entities

		current_arm_info.current_duration = current_arm_info.current_duration + dt
		teatan_arm.Position = teatan_arm.Position + (dir * speed)
		current_arm_info.total_distance = current_arm_info.total_distance + speed

		local bounds = self:get_bounds(index)

		for key, value in pairs(entities) do
			local entity_info = value
			local hit_entities = current_arm_info.hit_entities

			if hit_entities[entity_info.fo] == nil and entity_info.is_alive and (not entity_info.is_pause) and (not entity_info.is_sleep) and (not entity_info.is_falling) then
				local entity_bounds = entity_info.fo.Bounds
				if entity_info.knockback_time <= 0 and aabb(bounds, entity_bounds) then--teatan_arm.Bounds:Intersects(entity_bounds) then
					entity_info.is_pause = true
					hit_entities[entity_info.fo] = true
					start_coroutine(self.on_teatan_arm_hit, self, index, entity_info)
				end
			end
		end

		if current_arm_info.total_distance >= move_distance then
			current_arm_info.total_distance = 0
			current_arm_info.current_duration = 0
			current_arm_info.current_state = self.arm_info.state.stay
		end
	elseif current_state == self.arm_info.state.stay then
		-- 주먹이 끝에 도달해서 대기중인 상태
		current_arm_info.total_stay_time = current_arm_info.total_stay_time + dt
		if current_arm_info.total_stay_time >= stay_time then
			current_arm_info.total_stay_time = 0
			current_arm_info.current_state = self.arm_info.state.return_to_initial
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_magwi_drill_hit_01', play_pos = teatan_arm.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		end
	elseif current_state == self.arm_info.state.return_to_initial then
		-- 주먹이 제자리로 돌아가는 상태
		local duration = return_time
		local dir = self.arm_info.group_dir[group]
		local speed = move_distance * (dt / duration)

		teatan_arm.Position = teatan_arm.Position - (dir * speed)
		current_arm_info.total_distance = current_arm_info.total_distance + speed

		if current_arm_info.total_distance >= move_distance then
			current_arm_info.total_distance = 0
			teatan_arm.Position = current_arm_info.initial_pos
			current_arm_info.current_state = self.arm_info.state.wait
		end
	elseif current_state == self.arm_info.state.wait then
		-- 주먹의 쿨다운 타임이 적용 되는 상태
		current_arm_info.total_stay_time = current_arm_info.total_stay_time + dt
		if current_arm_info.total_stay_time >= after_return_wait_time then
			current_arm_info.total_stay_time = 0
			current_arm_info.current_state = self.arm_info.state.idle
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_bounds(index)
	local current_arm_info = self.arm_list[index]
	local teatan_arm = self.get_teatan_arm(current_arm_info.group, current_arm_info.num)
	local bounds = current_arm_info.bounds
	local offset = self.arm_info.group_offset[current_arm_info.group]
	local position = teatan_arm.Position

	return {
		min = {
			x = position.x + offset.x + bounds.min.x,
			z = position.z + offset.z + bounds.min.z
		},
		max = {
			x = position.x + offset.x + bounds.max.x,
			z = position.z + offset.z + bounds.max.z
		}
	}
end

function local_class:on_teatan_arm_hit(index, target_info)
	local current_arm_info = self.arm_list[index]
	local teatan_arm = self.get_teatan_arm(current_arm_info.group, current_arm_info.num)
	local target_fo = target_info.fo

	if target_info.is_player then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	end

	-- 대상을 밀어주어야 한다.
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(target_fo.Position)

	if not self:game_is_running() then
		return
	end

	local target_pos = target_fo.Position
	local hit_goal_pos = current_arm_info.hit_goal_pos
	local goal_pos = vector(hit_goal_pos.x, 0, target_fo.Position.z)
	local goal_dir = goal_pos - target_pos
	local goal_distance = goal_dir.magnitude
	goal_dir = goal_dir.normalized

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', play_pos = target_pos, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- EaseInQuad (이동 시 보간)
	-- 날아가는 동안 피격 방향 바라보고 damaged 이모션, embarrassed 애니메이션
	local dir_str = direction_util.to_str(vector_util.to_direction(teatan_arm.Position - target_fo.Position))
	-- 피격 연출 완료되면 바로 절벽 추락 연출로 이어짐
	scene_util.set_direction(target_fo, dir_str)
	scene_util.set_anim(target_fo, self, 'embarrassed')
	scene_util.set_emotion(target_fo, self, 'damaged')

	local duration = math.max(self.arm_info.smash_time - current_arm_info.current_duration, 0.3)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration and self:game_is_running() and target_info.is_alive and not target_info.is_sleep do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(
				time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

		local current_distance = goal_distance * progress
		target_fo.Position = target_pos + (goal_dir * current_distance)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if target_info.is_alive then
		target_fo.Position = goal_pos

		if self:game_is_running() then
			target_info.is_pause = false
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class
	end
}

-- 테이블이 비어있는지 검사
local function table_is_empty(table)
	local is_empty = true
	for key, value in pairs(table) do
		is_empty = false
		break
	end

	return is_empty
end

-- 테이블이 비어있을때까지 기다리는 함수
local function wait_for_table_is_empty(table)
	local table_is_not_empty = not table_is_empty(table)

	while table_is_not_empty do
		table_is_not_empty = not table_is_empty(table)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

local function to_direction(v)
	if math.abs(v.x) >= math.abs(v.z) then
		if v.x > 0 then
			return 'right'
		else
			return 'left'
		end
	else
		if v.z > 0 then
			return 'up'
		else
			return 'down'
		end
	end

	return 'none'
end

	fo.Position = fo.Position + (dir * speed)

local function knock_back(a, b)
	local function knock_back_internal(from, to)
		local prev_dir = to.Position - from.Position
		local origin_dir = vector(prev_dir.x, 0, prev_dir.z)
		local knock_back_dir = (origin_dir.normalized)
		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				'physics', true, knock_back_dir, 12000, 0.05,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

		local dir = to_direction(knock_back_dir)
		character_util.set_direction(to, dir)
		command_util.publish_knock_back(to.Owner, to, knock_back_info, to.Position)
	end


	knock_back_internal(a, b)
	knock_back_internal(b, a)
end

function local_class:enter()
	for i = 1, self.section.wall_zone_count do
		local zone = field:GetZone(self.section.wall_zone_list[i])
		local zone_bounds = zone.Bounds
		table.insert(self.wall_bounds_list, zone_bounds)
	end

	self.knight = self.get_knight()

	for team = 1, #self.team_info do
		for num = 1, self.team_info[team].count do
			local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(maiden, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end
	end

	for key, value in pairs(self.maiden_spawn_info) do
		local marker_list = value
		for j = 1, #marker_list do
			local marker_name = marker_list[j]
			self.marker_pos_list[marker_name] = vector_util.get_x0z(field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	self.stage_end = false
	self.world_screen_size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size()
	start_coroutine(self.maiden_color_update, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.marker_pos_list = nil
	self.is_completed = true
	self.stage_end = true
	self.is_game_running = false
	for team = 1, #self.team_info do
		for num = 1, self.team_info[team].count do
			local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
			maiden.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end
	end

	self.wall_bounds_list = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.scene_play_infos = nil
	self.maiden_info = nil
	self.downfall_zone_info = nil
	self.maiden_condition_info = nil
	self.knight = nil
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self:game_is_running() and self.section.knight_info.is_alive then
		local knight = self.knight
		for key, value in pairs(self.maiden_zone_flag_info) do
			--local flag = self.maiden_zone_flag_info[key]
			if (not value) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, knight) and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, key) then
				self.maiden_zone_flag_info[key] = true
				start_coroutine(self.spawn_maiden_zone, self, key)
				break
			end
		end

		if not self.is_completed and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, knight) and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, self.game_end_zone_name) then
			self.is_completed = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:stage_setup(game_is_reset, check_point_num)
	self.world_screen_size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size()
	-- 아래 셋팅을 하기전에 maiden들은 무조건 999, 0, 999로 전송해 두어야한다.
	for team = 1, #self.team_info do
		for num = 1, self.team_info[team].count do
			local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]
			local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
			maiden_info.fo = maiden
			maiden_info.state = self.maiden_anim_state.idle
			maiden.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			self:maiden_reset_state(team, num)
			self.section:add_entity(self.get_maiden_key(team, num), self.maiden_info[team][num])
		end
	end

	for i = 1, self.team_info[1].count do
		local team = 1
		local checkpoint = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.maiden_checkpoint_info[team][i], 0)

		if check_point_num <= checkpoint then
			local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, i)
			maiden.Position = self.get_maiden_start_pos(team, i)
			character_util.set_direction(maiden, 'up')
			character_util.set_active_state(maiden, 'visible')
			self:maiden_resurrect(team, i)

			if game_is_reset then
				character_util.spine_scale(maiden, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maiden)
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, self.team_info[2].count do
		local team = 2
		local checkpoint = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.maiden_checkpoint_info[team][i], 0)

		if check_point_num <= checkpoint then
			local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, i)
			character_util.spine_rotate(maiden, 0, 0)
			maiden.Position = self.get_maiden_start_pos(team, i)
			character_util.set_direction(maiden, 'up')
			character_util.set_active_state(maiden, 'visible')
			self:maiden_resurrect(team, i)

			if game_is_reset then
				character_util.spine_scale(maiden, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maiden)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 3번 팀은 특별한 취급이라 체크포인트에 영향 받지 않음.
	for i = 1, self.team_info[3].count do
		local team = 3
		local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, i)
		character_util.spine_rotate(maiden, 0, 0)
		maiden.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		character_util.set_direction(maiden, 'up')
		character_util.set_active_state(maiden, 'visible')

		-- 3번 애들은 트리거 되기전엔 무조건 pause 시킨다.
		local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[3][i]
		self:maiden_resurrect(team, i)
		--maiden_info.is_pause = true
		maiden_info.is_alive = false
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maiden)

		if game_is_reset then
			character_util.spine_scale(maiden, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maiden)
		end

		self:hide_attack_range(i)
	end

	for i = 1, self.downfall_event_zone_count do
		self.section:register_player_zone_event(self.get_downfall_zone_name(i), self.downfall_event_1, self, i)
	end
end

function local_class:start_scene()
	for team = 1, #self.team_info do
		for i = 1, self.team_info[team].count do
			--start_coroutine(self.maiden_move, self, team, i)
			local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][i]
			maiden_info.state = self.maiden_anim_state.idle
		end
	end
	self.world_screen_size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size()
	--self.is_game_running = (not self.is_completed) and self.section.game_is_running and self.maiden_info ~= nil
	start_coroutine(self.maiden_color_update, self)
end

function local_class:reset_game()
	for team = 1, #self.team_info do
		for num = 1, self.team_info[team].count do
			local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]
			local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
			maiden_info.is_alive = false
			maiden_info.fallcheck_delay = 0
			character_util.spine_rotate(maiden, 0, 0)
			maiden:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	wait_for_table_is_empty(self.scene_play_infos)

	for team = 1, #self.team_info do
		for num = 1, self.team_info[team].count do
			local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
			local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]

			maiden.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			self:maiden_reset_state(team, num)
			self:maiden_resurrect(team, num)
			maiden_info.is_alive = false
			maiden_info.is_pause = false
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		local attack_range = self.attack_range_list[i]
		if attack_range ~= nil then
			attack_range:Hide()
		end
	end

	for key, value in pairs(self.maiden_spawn_info) do
		self.maiden_zone_flag_info[key] = false
	end
end

local function can_action(maiden_info)
	return (not maiden_info.is_pause) and (maiden_info.is_alive) and (not maiden_info.is_sleep) and (not maiden_info.is_falling)
end

local function is_wait_mode(maiden_info)
	return (not maiden_info.is_pause) and (not maiden_info.is_alive) and (not maiden_info.is_sleep) and (not maiden_info.is_falling) and maiden_info.knockback_time <= 0
end

-- 플레이어와 npc의 충돌 이벤트
function local_class:on_npc_hit_event(team, num)
	local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]
	local knight_info = self.section.knight_info
	if maiden_info == nil or (not maiden_info.is_alive) or maiden_info.knockback_delay > 0 then
		return
	end

	if (not self:game_is_running()) then
		return
	end

	maiden_info.knockback_delay = self.knockback_delay
	local knight = self.knight
	local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
	local event_key = 'npc_hit_' .. team .. '_' .. num

	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(knight.Position - maiden.Position)
	local half_distance = dir.magnitude * 0.5
	dir = dir.normalized
	-- 로레인이 영향 받는 벨로시티는 기사를 바라보는 방향 벡터의 반대
	maiden_info.velocity = dir * -1

	local fx_pos = maiden.Position + (dir * half_distance) + vector(0, 0.02, 0)
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(fx_pos)

	if maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen then
		self:play_hit_sfx('02_hit_big_01', fx_pos)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maiden)
	maiden_info.knockback_time = self.knockback_time
	knight_info.knockback_time = self.knockback_time
	knock_back(knight, maiden)


	local chaser_team = team == 2 or team == 3

	if chaser_team then
		maiden_info.is_alive = false
		self.get_fx_missile_small_explosion():Instantiate(maiden.Position)
		character_util.air_spin(maiden, {
			offset = (maiden.Position - knight.Position).normalized * 3
		})
		maiden_info.is_pause = true
		local delay = 3
		if delay > 0 then
			while delay > 0 and self:game_is_running() do
				local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
				delay = delay - dt

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end

		maiden.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		self:maiden_resurrect(team, num)
		self:maiden_reset_state(team, num)
		maiden_info.is_alive = false
	end
end

function local_class:wait_for_delay(delay)
	while delay > 0 and self:game_is_running() do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		delay = delay - dt

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 스테이지 기준으로 예외 처리하는 wait 함수
function local_class:wait_for_delay_stage(delay)
	while delay > 0 and (not self.stage_end) do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		delay = delay - dt

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- npc가 추락하는것을 플레이어가 맞을 경우 이벤트
function local_class:on_npc_fall_hit_event(team, num)
	local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]
	if maiden_info == nil or (not maiden_info.is_alive) or maiden_info.knockback_delay > 0 then
		return
	end

	maiden_info.knockback_delay = self.knockback_delay
	local knight = self.knight
	local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
	local event_key = 'npc_hit_' .. team .. '_' .. num

	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(knight.Position - maiden.Position)
	local half_distance = dir.magnitude * 0.5
	dir = dir.normalized

	local fx_pos = maiden.Position + (dir * half_distance) + vector(0, 0.02, 0)
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(fx_pos)
	if maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen then
		self:play_hit_sfx('02_hit_big_01', fx_pos)
	end

	maiden_info.knockback_time = self.knockback_time
	knock_back_from_pos(knight, maiden.Position)
end

-- point와 npc의 충돌 이벤트
function local_class:on_npc_hit_from_pos_event(team, num, pos, instigator, sfx_key)
	local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]
	if maiden_info == nil or not (maiden_info.is_alive) then
		return
	end

	-- 기믹과 충돌하면 딜레이 주는 기능
	--if instigator ~= nil then
	--	if lua_helper.reference_equals(maiden_info.last_knockback_info.instigator, instigator) then
	--		return
	--	end
	--
	--	maiden_info.last_knockback_info.instigator = instigator
	--	maiden_info.last_knockback_info.duration = self.section.knockback_delay
	--end

	sfx_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(sfx_key, '02_hit_big_01')

function local_class:npc_fall_scene(team, num)
	local fo = self.get_maiden(team, num)
	local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]

	fo.Position.y = 0
	maiden_info.is_falling = true
	maiden_info.is_alive = false
	maiden_info.is_pause = true
	maiden_info.is_sleep = true

	--reset_state(fo)
	--coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 캐릭터 (down, damaged, embarrassed)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'embarrassed')

	-- 1초 간 y축으로 -3 이동
	-- 1초 간 720도 회전
	-- 1초 간 scale 1 -> 0
	character_util.spine_rotate(fo, 720, 1)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.zero, 1)
	if maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen and maiden_info.is_falling then
		local max_duration = 1
		local duration = max_duration
		local move_speed = 3 / duration
		while duration > 0 and self:game_is_running() and maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen and maiden_info.is_falling do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			duration = duration - dt

			fo.Position = fo.Position + (vector(0, -1, 0) * (move_speed * dt))
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
	--coroutine.yield(nil)
	if self:game_is_running() then
		fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		character_util.spine_rotate(fo, 0, 0)
		self:maiden_resurrect(team, num)
		self:maiden_reset_state(team, num)
		maiden_info.is_alive = false
		maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen = false
	end
end

-- npc가 낙사할 경우
function local_class:fall_npc_event(team, num)
	local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
	local fall_event_key = 'fall_event_' .. team .. '_' .. num

	self.scene_play_infos[fall_event_key] = true
	self:npc_fall_scene(team, num)
	self.scene_play_infos[fall_event_key] = nil
end

-- 로레인 부활
function local_class:maiden_resurrect(team, num)
	local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]
	maiden_info.knockback_list = { }
	maiden_info.state = self.maiden_anim_state.idle
	maiden_info.is_alive = true
	maiden_info.is_pause = false
	maiden_info.is_sleep = false
	maiden_info.is_falling = false
	maiden_info.is_flying = false
	maiden_info.fallcheck_delay = 0
	maiden_info.knockback_delay = 0
	maiden_info.hitcheck_delay = 0
	maiden_info.velocity = vector(0, 0, 0)

function local_class:play_hit_sfx(sfx_key, pos)
	for i = 1, self.hit_sfx_count do
		if self.hit_sfx_pool[i] <= 0 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_key, play_pos = pos, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'npc' })
			self.hit_sfx_pool[i] = self.hit_sfx_delay
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update()
	self.is_game_running = (not self.is_completed) and self.section.game_is_running and self.maiden_info ~= nil
	if not self:game_is_running() then
		return
	end

	local unscale_dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
	local dt = unscale_dt * self:get_time_scale()
	for i = 1, self.hit_sfx_count do
		if self.hit_sfx_pool[i] > 0 then
			self.hit_sfx_pool[i] = self.hit_sfx_pool[i] - dt
			if self.hit_sfx_pool[i] < 0 then
				self.hit_sfx_pool[i] = 0
			end
		end
	end

	self.world_screen_size = self.section.world_screen_size

	for team = 1, #self.team_info do
		local team_count = self.team_info[team].count
		for num = 1, team_count do
			local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
			local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]
			maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen = is_fo_in_screen(self.world_screen_size, maiden.Position, { bonus_distance = 1 })

			if maiden_info.knockback_time > 0 then
				maiden_info.knockback_time = maiden_info.knockback_time - unscale_dt
				if maiden_info.knockback_time < 0 then
					maiden_info.knockback_time = 0
					maiden_info.state = self.maiden_anim_state.idle
				end
			end

			self:maiden_update(unscale_dt, dt, team, num)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:maiden_update(unscale_dt, dt, team, num)
	local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]
	local knight = self.knight
	local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
	--local current_speed = 4

	local event_key = 'npc_move_' .. team .. '_' .. num
	local screen_timer = 0
	local screen_out_time = 3
	local is_maiden_in_screen = maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen

	--character_util.set_anim(maiden, { name = 'run' })

	--maiden_info.state = self.maiden_anim_state.run

	if maiden_info.is_alive and maiden_info.is_sleep and is_maiden_in_screen then
		maiden_info.is_sleep = false
	end

	if maiden_info.knockback_delay > 0 then
		maiden_info.knockback_delay = maiden_info.knockback_delay - dt
	else
		maiden_info.knockback_delay = 0
	end

	if maiden_info.fallcheck_delay > 0 then
		maiden_info.fallcheck_delay = maiden_info.fallcheck_delay - dt
	else
		maiden_info.fallcheck_delay = 0
	end

	if maiden_info.hitcheck_delay > 0 then
		maiden_info.hitcheck_delay = maiden_info.hitcheck_delay - dt
	else
		maiden_info.hitcheck_delay = 0
	end

	if not maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen and maiden_info.knockback_time <= 0 then
		if maiden_info.is_falling then
			maiden.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			self:maiden_resurrect(team, num)
			maiden_info.is_alive = false
			maiden_info.is_falling = false
		elseif (not maiden_info.is_sleep) and (not vector_util.almost_close_to(maiden.Position, vector(999, 0, 999))) then
			if self.section:is_fall_pos_by_entity_info(maiden_info) then
				maiden.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				self:maiden_resurrect(team, num)
				maiden_info.is_alive = false
			end
		end
	end

	if can_action(maiden_info) then
		local knight_bounds = knight.Bounds
		local maiden_bounds = maiden.Bounds

		-- 중복된 대상과 0.5초간의 충돌 방지 로직
		--if maiden_info.last_knockback_info.instigator ~= nil then
		--	maiden_info.last_knockback_info.duration = maiden_info.last_knockback_info.duration - dt
		--
		--	if maiden_info.last_knockback_info.duration <= 0 then
		--		maiden_info.last_knockback_info.instigator = nil
		--		maiden_info.last_knockback_info.duration = 0
		--	end
		--end

		-- 충돌과 관련된 로직
		if self.section.can_player_knockback and (not self.section.knight_info.is_pause) and knight_bounds:Intersects(maiden_bounds) then
			start_coroutine(self.on_npc_hit_event, self, team, num)
		elseif maiden_info.hitcheck_delay <= 0 then
			local event_result = self.section:bound_event_trigger_by_character(maiden)

			if event_result.result then
				local target = event_result.fo
				start_coroutine(self.on_npc_hit_from_pos_event, self, team, num, target.Position, event_result.fo, event_result.sfx_key)
			else
				local wall_hit = false
				local wall_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

				for i = 1, self.section.wall_zone_count do
					local zone_bounds = self.wall_bounds_list[i]
					if zone_bounds:Intersects(maiden_bounds) then
						wall_hit = true
						wall_pos = zone_bounds.center
						maiden_info.velocity = (vector_util.get_x0z(maiden.Position - wall_pos)).normalized
						break
					end
				end

				-- 벽 충돌 했다면 거기에 대한 처리
				if wall_hit then
					start_coroutine(self.on_npc_hit_from_pos_event, self, team, num, wall_pos)
				else
					-- 여기서 낙사 유무를 체크하자.
					if maiden_info.fallcheck_delay <= 0 then
						if self.section:is_fall_pos_by_entity_info(maiden_info) then
							maiden_info.is_alive = false
							maiden_info.state = self.maiden_anim_state.idle
							start_coroutine(self.fall_npc_event, self, team, num)
						end
						maiden_info.fallcheck_delay = self.fallcheck_delay
					end
				end
			end

			local max = self.hitcheck_delay * 100
			local min = max - 3
			local delay = random_util.get_random_int(min, max) * 0.01
			maiden_info.hitcheck_delay = delay
		end

		-- 넉백에 관련된 체크
		local is_not_knockback = maiden_info.knockback_time <= 0

		if can_action(maiden_info) then
			--  넉백중이 아닐때 동작하는 로직
			if is_not_knockback and self:get_time_scale() > 0 then
				dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
				local move_speed = maiden_info.current_speed * dt
				local chaser_team = team == 2 or team == 3

				if team == 1 then
					if maiden_info.state == self.maiden_anim_state.idle then
						character_util.set_anim(maiden, { name = 'run' })
						character_util.set_direction(maiden, 'up')
						maiden_info.state = self.maiden_anim_state.run
					end
					maiden_info.velocity = vector(0, 0, 1)
					maiden.Position.y = 0
					execute_move_up(maiden, move_speed)
					maiden_info.speed_duration = maiden_info.speed_duration - dt
					if maiden_info.speed_duration <= 0 then
						maiden_info.speed_duration = self.speed_max_duration
						maiden_info.current_speed = random_util.get_random_int(3, 4)
					end
				elseif chaser_team and self.section.knight_info.is_alive then
					-- 플레이어가 멈췄다면 가만히 idle 상태로
					if self.section.knight_info.is_pause then
						if maiden_info.state == self.maiden_anim_state.run then
							character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maiden)
							maiden_info.state = self.maiden_anim_state.idle
						end
					else
						if maiden_info.state == self.maiden_anim_state.idle then
							character_util.set_anim(maiden, { name = 'run' })
							maiden_info.state = self.maiden_anim_state.run
						end

						maiden_info.speed_duration = maiden_info.speed_duration - dt
						if maiden_info.speed_duration <= 0 then
							maiden_info.speed_duration = self.speed_max_duration
							maiden_info.current_speed = random_util.get_random_int(3, 4)
						end

						local dir = (vector_util.get_x0z(knight.Position - maiden.Position)).normalized
						maiden_info.velocity = dir
						maiden.Position.y = 0
						execute_move(maiden, dir, move_speed)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 넉백에 관련된 체크
	local is_not_knockback = maiden_info.knockback_time <= 0

	if maiden_info.is_alive and (not maiden_info.is_sleep) then
		-- 시야내에서 사라지면 동작하는 로직
		if is_maiden_in_screen then
			screen_timer = 0
		elseif is_not_knockback then
			dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
			screen_timer = screen_timer + dt

			if screen_timer >= screen_out_time then
				self.maiden_info[team][num].is_alive = false
				maiden.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

				self:maiden_reset_state(team, num)
				self:maiden_resurrect(team, num)
				self.maiden_info[team][num].is_alive = false

				screen_timer = 0
			end
		else
			dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
			screen_timer = screen_timer + dt
		end
	end
end

function local_class:maiden_color_update()
	local team_list = { 2, 3 }
	while not self.stage_end do


		for team_index = 1, #team_list do
			local team = team_list[team_index]
			local team_count = self.team_info[team].count
			for i = 1, team_count do
				local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, i)
				local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][i]

				if not self:game_is_running() then
					maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen = is_fo_in_screen(self.world_screen_size, maiden.Position, { bonus_distance = 1 })
				end

				if maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen then
					character_util.add_fade_color(maiden, 'team_tint', CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 0, 0, 1), 1, 1)
				end
			end
		end

		self:wait_for_delay_stage(1)

		if not self.stage_end then
			for team_index = 1, #team_list do
				local team = team_list[team_index]
				local team_count = self.team_info[team].count
				for i = 1, team_count do
					local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, i)
					local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][i]
					if not self:game_is_running() then
						maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen = is_fo_in_screen(self.world_screen_size, maiden.Position, { bonus_distance = 1 })
					end
					if maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen then
						character_util.add_fade_color(maiden, 'team_tint', CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1), 1, 1)
					end
					--character_util.remove_fade_color(maiden, 'team_tint', 0.5)
				end
			end
		end

		self:wait_for_delay_stage(1)
	end
end

-- 로레인 클론 추락 이벤트들
function local_class:downfall_event_internal(event_num)
	local event_info = self.downfall_zone_info[event_num]
	if (not self:game_is_running()) or event_info == nil then
		return
	end

	local team = 3
	local fall_start_y = 10
	local fall_end_y = 0
	local fall_duration = 1
	local event_markers = event_info
	local maidens = { }
	local time_passed = 0
	local fall_dir = vector(0, -1, 0)

	local fall_sfx = nil

	-- 풀링 기반 시스템으로 변경.
	for i = 1, #event_markers do
		local marker_num = event_markers[i]
		local end_pos = self.get_downfall_pos(marker_num)
		local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos, fall_start_y)

		for num = 1, self.team_info[team].count do
			local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
			local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]

			if is_wait_mode(maiden_info) then
				self:maiden_resurrect(team, num)
				--self:maiden_reset_state(team, num)
				maiden_info.is_pause = true
				maiden_info.is_sleep = true
				--maiden_info.is_falling = true
				maiden.Position = start_pos
				self:show_attack_range(marker_num, fall_duration)
				if fall_sfx == nil and maiden_info.is_fo_in_screen then
					fall_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01', play_pos = end_pos, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'npc' })
				end

				table.insert(maidens, num)
				break
			end
		end

	end

	fall_sfx = nil

	while self:game_is_running() and time_passed < fall_duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
		local move_speed = fall_start_y * (dt / fall_duration)
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		for i = 1, #maidens do
			local num = maidens[i]
			local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)
			local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]

			maiden.Position = maiden.Position + (fall_dir * move_speed)

			if maiden.Position.y < 0 then
				maiden.Position.y = 0
			end
		end


		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self:game_is_running() then
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		local is_hit = false

		for i = 1, #maidens do
			local marker_num = event_markers[i]
			local num = maidens[i]
			local maiden = self.get_maiden(team, num)

			local pos = vector_util.get_x0z(maiden.Position, fall_end_y)
			local maiden_info = self.maiden_info[team][num]

			self:maiden_resurrect(team, num)
			self:hide_attack_range(marker_num)
			maiden.Position = pos
			self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(pos)

			if not is_hit then
				local knight = self.knight
				local distance = (knight.Position - maiden.Position).magnitude

				if distance <= self.attack_range_radius then
					is_hit = true
					start_coroutine(self.on_npc_fall_hit_event, self, team, num)
				end
			end

			character_util.set_anim(maiden, { name = 'run' })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:downfall_event_1(index)
	start_coroutine(self.downfall_event_internal, self, index)
end

function local_class:show_attack_range(num, duration)
	local attack_range = self.attack_range_list[num]
	local target_pos = self.get_downfall_pos(num)
	if attack_range == nil or target_pos == nil then
		return
	end

	attack_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, target_pos, 0)
	attack_range_util.show(attack_range, 0)
end

function local_class:hide_attack_range(num)

local function table_is_empty(table)
	local is_empty = true
	for key, value in pairs(table) do
		is_empty = false
		break
	end

	return is_empty
end

-- 테이블이 비어있을때까지 기다리는 함수
local function wait_for_table_is_empty(table)
	local table_is_not_empty = not table_is_empty(table)

	while table_is_not_empty do
		table_is_not_empty = not table_is_empty(table)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

local function execute_move(fo, dir, speed)
	local dir_str = direction_util.to_str(vector_util.to_direction(dir))
	fo.Position = fo.Position + (dir * speed)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, dir_str)
end

local function aabb(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

-- target bounds 와 pos + size의 커스텀한 바운드의 aabb 체크
local function aabb_by_pos(target_bounds, pos, size)
	size = lua_helper.get_or_default(size, 1)

	local half = size * 0.5
	return aabb({
		min = {
			x = pos.x - half,
			z = pos.z - half
		},
		max = {
			x = pos.x + half,
			z = pos.z + half
		}
	}, target_bounds)
end

			'physics', true, knock_back_dir, 12000, 0.05,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	character_util.set_direction(target, dir)

local function get_bound(fo, offset)
	local bounds = fo.Bounds
	offset = lua_helper.get_or_default(offset, vector(0, 0, 0))
	-- min x, min z, max x, max z
	return {
		min = {
			x = bounds.min.x + offset.x,
			z = bounds.min.z + offset.z
		},
		max = {
			x = bounds.max.x + offset.x,
			z = bounds.max.z + offset.z
		}
	}
end

	-- sqrMagnitude로 거리 비교

function local_class:update()
	if not self:game_is_running() then
		return
	end

	local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
	local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
	local onigirl_last_knockback_info = self.onigirl_last_knockback_info

	if onigirl_last_knockback_info.instigator ~= nil then
		onigirl_last_knockback_info.duration = onigirl_last_knockback_info.duration - dt

		if onigirl_last_knockback_info.duration <= 0 then
			onigirl_last_knockback_info.instigator = nil
			onigirl_last_knockback_info.duration = 0
		end
	end

	local event_result = self.section:bound_event_trigger_by_character(onigirl)

	if event_result.result then
		local target = event_result.fo
		start_coroutine(self.on_onigirl_hit_from_pos_event, self, target.Position, event_result.fo, true)
	end

function local_class:onigirl_infinite_move()
	self.is_knockback_block = true
	local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
	local move_speed = self.onigirl_speed

	while screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(onigirl.Position) and self:game_is_running() do
		local target_pos = onigirl.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
		local onigirl_pos = onigirl.Position

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
		local speed = move_speed * dt
		local dir = (target_pos - onigirl_pos).normalized

		character_util.set_anim(onigirl, { name = 'run' })

		execute_move(onigirl, dir, speed)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(onigirl)

	if self:game_is_running() then
		onigirl.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		self.is_knockback_block = false
	end

function local_class:on_onigirl_hit_from_pos_event(pos, instigator, fix_x)
	if self:game_is_running() and not self.is_knockback_block then
		local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
		local pos_key = pos

		if instigator ~= nil then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.onigirl_last_knockback_info.instigator, instigator) then
				return
			end

			self.onigirl_last_knockback_info.instigator = instigator
			self.onigirl_last_knockback_info.duration = self.knockback_delay
		end

		local from_pos = pos
		if fix_x then
			from_pos.x = onigirl.Position.x
		end

		local dir = (onigirl.Position - from_pos)
		local dist = dir.magnitude * 0.5
		local fx_pos = (dir.normalized) * dist
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(from_pos + fx_pos)

		self.onigirl_knockback_list[pos_key] = true
		knock_back_from_pos(onigirl, from_pos)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		self.onigirl_knockback_list[pos_key] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:onigirl_move(target_pos, delay, move_speed)
	local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
	delay = lua_helper.get_or_default(delay, 0)
	move_speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(move_speed, self.onigirl_speed)
	if not self:game_is_running() then
		return
	end

	while not pos_is_equal(onigirl.Position, target_pos) do
		if not self:game_is_running() then
			return
		end

		-- 넉백이 진행 중이면 넉백이 끝날때까지 대기한다.
		wait_for_table_is_empty(self.onigirl_knockback_list)

		local onigirl_pos = onigirl.Position

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
		local speed = move_speed * dt
		local dir = (target_pos - onigirl_pos).normalized

		character_util.set_anim(onigirl, { name = 'run' })

		execute_move(onigirl, dir, speed)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(onigirl)

	if delay > 0 then
		while delay > 0 do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
			delay = delay - dt
			-- 게임이 멈추면 무조건 중단해야함.
			if not self:game_is_running() then
				return
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:onigirl_windfan_move(target_pos, knockback_pos, decrease_time, delay)
	self.is_knockback_block = true

	local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()

	if not self:game_is_running() then

	end

	local current_speed = self.onigirl_speed
	local time_passed = 0

	while (not pos_is_equal(onigirl.Position, target_pos)) and current_speed > 0 do
		if not self:game_is_running() then
			return
		end

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		time_passed = math.min(time_passed, decrease_time)

		local decrease_speed_mult = time_passed / decrease_time
		local decrease_speed = self.onigirl_speed * decrease_speed_mult

		--logger_util.error('decrease_speed ' .. decrease_speed .. ' decrease time ' .. decrease_time)

		current_speed = math.max((self.onigirl_speed - decrease_speed) * dt, 0)

		local onigirl_pos = onigirl.Position

		local dir = (target_pos - onigirl_pos).normalized

		character_util.set_anim(onigirl, { name = 'run' })

		execute_move(onigirl, dir, current_speed)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(onigirl)

	-- knockback action 뒤로 밀려나는 액션
	local knockback_speed = self.windfan_knockback_speed
	local knockback_dir = knockback_pos - onigirl.Position
	local knockback_distance = knockback_dir.magnitude

	knockback_dir = knockback_dir.normalized

	time_passed = 0
	local knockback_duration = knockback_distance / knockback_speed

	-- 속도가 0이 되면 라나 (down, damaged, embarrassed) 되며 속도 4로 아래로 밀려남
	character_util.set_direction(onigirl, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(onigirl, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(onigirl, { name = 'damaged' })
	while time_passed < knockback_duration and self:game_is_running() do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		onigirl.Position = onigirl.Position + (knockback_dir * knockback_speed * dt)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(onigirl)

	if delay > 0 then
		while delay > 0 do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
			delay = delay - dt
			-- 게임이 멈추면 무조건 중단해야함.
			if not self:game_is_running() then
				return
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self.is_knockback_block = false
end

function local_class:onigirl_jump_move(target_pos, speed, height, duration, delay)
	self.is_knockback_block = true

	local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
	jump(onigirl, height, duration)
	delay = lua_helper.get_or_default(delay, 0)
	if not self:game_is_running() then
		return
	end

	while not pos_is_equal(onigirl.Position, target_pos) do
		if not self:game_is_running() then
			return
		end

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
		local onigirl_pos = onigirl.Position
		local move_speed = speed * dt
		local dir = (target_pos - onigirl_pos).normalized

		character_util.set_anim(onigirl, { name = 'run' })

		execute_move(onigirl, dir, move_speed)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(onigirl)

	if delay > 0 then
		while delay > 0 do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
			delay = delay - dt
			-- 게임이 멈추면 무조건 중단해야함.
			if not self:game_is_running() then
				return
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self.is_knockback_block = false
end

function local_class:jump_tile_activate(target, jump_tile)
	local jump_tile_animator = jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	local jump_tile_data = jump_tile.FieldObjectBehaviour

	if not lua_helper.type_compare(jump_tile_data, CS.Oak.JumpTileBehaviour) or (not self:game_is_running()) then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_jumptile_01')
	jump_tile_animator:Play('on')

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		if not self.stage_end then
			jump_tile_animator:Play('off')
		end
	end, self)

	local jump_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(jump_tile.Direction)
	local dir = jump_tile_data.HorizontalSpeed * jump_dir + jump_tile_data.JumpSpeed * unity_class.vector3.up

	local jumpInfo = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()
	jumpInfo.jumper = target
	jumpInfo.jumpSource = jump_tile
	jumpInfo.jumpType = CS.Oak.JumpType.JumpTileJump
	jumpInfo.speed = dir.magnitude
	jumpInfo.direction = dir.normalized
	jumpInfo.jumpStartPos = target.Position
	jumpInfo.jumpTimeScale = 1.75
	jumpInfo.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity
	command_util.execute_jump(jumpInfo)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if not self:game_is_running() then
		return
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if not self:game_is_running() then
		return
	end

	while lua_helper.type_compare(target.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState)
			and self:game_is_running() do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:onigirl_jump_tile_execute(target_pos, jump_tile_num, delay)
	self.is_knockback_block = true
	delay = lua_helper.get_or_default(delay, 0)
	local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
	local jump_tile = self.get_jumptile(jump_tile_num)

	self:jump_tile_activate(onigirl, jump_tile)

	if delay > 0 then
		while delay > 0 do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
			delay = delay - dt
			-- 게임이 멈추면 무조건 중단해야함.
			if not self:game_is_running() then
				return
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self:onigirl_move(target_pos)

	self.is_knockback_block = false
end
