function local_class:onigirl_rescue_jump()
	-- 성공하면 라나 위 경로대로 사인 곡선 그리면서 이동하여 바닥에 착지
	-- 라나 shake 중단
	-- 1.5초 간 이동
	-- X축으로 5칸, y축으로 3까지 올라갔다가 0으로 떨어짐
	-- 이동하는 동안 1080도 회전

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
	self.onigirl_rescue_jump_running = true
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
	local jump_goal_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_onigirl_rescue_pos_2')

	character_util.spine_rotate(onigirl, 0, 0)
	character_util.stop_shake(onigirl)
	character_util.spine_rotate(onigirl, 1080, 1)
	character_util.jump(onigirl, 3, 1)
	character_util.move_to(onigirl, jump_goal_pos, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 바닥에 떨어지면
	-- fx_hit, fx_lasthit 이펙트 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(onigirl.Position + vector(0, 0.02, 0))
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(onigirl.Position + vector(0, 0.02, 0))

	-- 카메라 shake(0.2, 0.5)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	-- Damage red pulse, damage squish
	onigirl.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
	onigirl.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

	-- (left, damaged, prostrate)
	scene_util.set_direction(onigirl, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(onigirl, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(onigirl, self, 'prostrate')

	-- 이후 0.5초 대기 후에 마리오 점프 한 뒤 파티원으로 가디언 뒤에 붙음
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(onigirl)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(onigirl, 'left')
	self.onigirl_rescue_jump_running = false
end

function local_class:onigirl_rescue_scene()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	self.section.can_player_knockback = false
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
	-- 라나에게 interact 시 이벤트
	-- 가디언 (right, attack, push)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'push')
	-- deviate local (vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(knight, vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- timescale 정지하는 좌측 슬라이드 QTE
	field_util.darken('qte', 0.3, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	qte_util.swipe('left', nil, 0, false, false)
	-- 성공할 때까지 대기
	-- 성공하면 가디언 애니메이션 hold_loop -> idle
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'hold_loop', next_anim = 'idle' })

	field_util.undarken('qte', 0)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	start_coroutine(self.onigirl_rescue_jump, self)

	-- 0.5초 대기 후 가디언 애니메이션과 이모션 제거하고 컨트롤 복구
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	while self.onigirl_rescue_jump_running do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_relate_event(onigirl, self.section.controller)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(onigirl, user_party)
	-- 라나 구했으니 플래그 설정
	self.section.is_onigirl_rescued = true
	self.section.can_player_knockback = true
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(onigirl, { key = 'qc_fall_guardian_s2_22' })
end

	end

function local_class:ball_update(dt, num, ball)
	if self.soccer_ball_info == nil or self.soccer_ball_info[num] == nil then
		return
	end

	local ball_info = self.soccer_ball_info[num]

	if ball_info.is_alive then
		local bound_size = ball_info.bound_size
		local position = ball.Position
		local bound = self:get_soccer_ball_bounds(position, bound_size)
		local move_speed = ball_info.speed * dt
		local target_pos = position + (ball_info.direction * move_speed)
		local distance = ball_info.distance
		local max_distance = self.soccer_ball_rot_distance

		if distance > max_distance then
			ball_info.distance = 0
			distance = 0
		end

		-- 축구공은 현재로써 그냥 자기 혼자 무작정 굴러가게 만든다.
		-- x축 구르기만 기능적으로 상정 되어있음.
		local rot_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(distance,
				self.soccer_ball_start_rotation,
				self.soccer_ball_end_rotation,
				max_distance)

		local rot = vector(self.soccer_ball_end_rotation - rot_x, 0, 0)

		ball.Position = target_pos
		self:set_soccer_ball_rotation(num, rot)
		ball_info.distance = distance + move_speed

		if self.section:is_fall_pos(ball.Position) then
			-- 낙사했음.
			ball_info.is_alive = false
			local bound_index = ball_info.bound_index
			self.section:unregister_bound_fo(bound_index)
			start_coroutine(self.fall_soccer_ball_event, self, num)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_soccer_ball_bounds(pos, size)
	local cur_size = lua_helper.get_or_default(size, 1)

	return {
		min = {
			x = pos.x - (-1 * cur_size),
			z = pos.z - (-1 * cur_size),
		},
		max = {
			x = pos.x + (1 * cur_size),
			z = pos.z + (1 * cur_size),
		}
	}
end

function local_class:fall_soccer_ball_event(num)
	local ball = self.get_soccer_ball(num)
	local ball_info = self.soccer_ball_info[num]
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1
	local fall_speed = 3
	local max_size = ball_info.bound_size

	ball_info.direction = vector(0, -1, 0)

	while time_passed < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self:get_time_scale()
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		local position = ball.Position
		local move_speed = fall_speed * dt
		local target_pos = position + (ball_info.direction * move_speed)
		local distance = ball_info.distance
		local max_distance = self.soccer_ball_rot_distance
		local cur_size = max_size * (1 - (time_passed / duration))

		if distance > max_distance then
			ball_info.distance = 0
			distance = 0
		end

		local rot_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(distance,
				self.soccer_ball_start_rotation,
				self.soccer_ball_end_rotation,
				max_distance)

		local rot = vector(self.soccer_ball_end_rotation - rot_x, 0, 0)

		ball.Position = target_pos
		self:set_soccer_ball_rotation(num, rot)
		ball_info.distance = distance + move_speed
		ball_info.cache.scale.localScale = vector(cur_size, cur_size, cur_size) * self.visual_size_scale_value

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	ball.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:execute_zone_event(zone_name)
	for i = 1, #self.soccer_ball_setting_list do
		local ball_setting = self.soccer_ball_setting_list[i]
		local ball_info = self.soccer_ball_info[i]
		local ball = self.get_soccer_ball(i)

		-- 같은 존이면 사용 해야 한다. 또한 ball_info가 유효하며 살아 있으면 안된다.
		if ball_setting.zone_name == zone_name and ball_info ~= nil and (not ball_info.is_alive) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true,
										 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default', parent = ball, max_distance = 15 })
			ball.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos(ball_setting.marker)
			ball_info.is_alive = true
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class
	end
}

-- 테이블이 비어있는지 검사

local function aabb(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

local function get_bound(fo)

	return bounds
end

		end
	end

	return -1
end

local function is_fo_in_screen(world_screen_size, fo_pos, args)
	local fo_position = lua_helper.get_or_default(fo_pos, user_party.Leader.Position)
	local bonus_dis = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'bonus_distance', 0)
	local center_pos = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'center_pos', stage_camera.LookAtPosition)

	if world_screen_size == nil then
		world_screen_size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size()
	end

	local size = world_screen_size * 0.5


	if bonus_dis ~= 0 then
		size.x = size.x + bonus_dis
		size.y = size.y + bonus_dis
	end

	local x_gap = math.abs(center_pos.x - fo_position.x)
	local y_gap = math.abs(center_pos.z - fo_position.z)

	if x_gap >= size.x or y_gap >= size.y then
		return false
	end

	return true

		cooldown_list[complete_list[i]] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:get_searching_bounds(num)
	local fan = self.get_windfan(num)
	return fan.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable().searching_bounds
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('MarioGimmickController')

local mario_gimmick_base = newclass('MarioGimmick')

local mushroom = newclass('MushroomGimmick', mario_gimmick_base)
local fire_flower = newclass('FireflowerGimmick', mario_gimmick_base)
local star = newclass('StarGimmick', mario_gimmick_base)

function local_class:init()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridMoveEndEvent), 'on_camera_grid_move_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	-- scene_util 버전
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	-- 데이터
	self.constants_data = nil

	-- 현재 액션
	self.current_action = nil

	-- gimmick 풀
	self.gimmick_pool = nil

	-- 모든 루틴 종료 플래그
	self.stage_ended = false

	-- 이펙트
	self.fx = {
		lasthit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		custom_sprite = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
		end,
		stomp = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_minotaur_buttbounce')
		end,
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end,
		destroy = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_slime_buttbounce')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	-- 인터랙트 가능한 상태인지
	self.interactable_state = true

	-- 기믹 변경중인지
	self.chainging_gimmick = false

	-- 빈 배틀액션 이름
	self.empty_battle_action_name = 'qc_mario_knight_manual'

	-- 데미지 입는 npc 테이블
	self.npc_hp_table = {}

	-- 기믹 적용 이벤트 오버라이드
	self.override_interact_func = nil

	-- 죽은 상태
	self.is_dead = false

	-- 죽는 상태 리셋을 위한 페이드 상태가 종료했는지
	self.end_dead_fade = true

	-- stage music clip을 이미 교체했는지
	self.set_stage_music_clip = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridMoveEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
end

function local_class:load_async()
	-- 데이터 가져오기
	self.constants_data = require('Quest/Main/QueenCastle/Mario/Gimmick/MarioGimmickConstants')

	-- 이펙트 로드
	self.fx:load_all()

	-- 기믹들 풀에 넣기
	self.gimmick_pool = {
		mushroom = mushroom(self),
		fire_flower = fire_flower(self),
		star = star(self)
	}

	-- 마리오 스테이지에서는 무적 처리
	character_util.set_immortal(get_party_leader(), true)

	-- 피격 npc들 hp 설정
	self:set_npc_hp()

	-- 기믹 루프 시작
	start_coroutine(self.gimmick_loop, self)
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.stage_ended = true
	if self.gimmick_pool ~= nil then
		for _,gimmick in pairs(self.gimmick_pool) do
			gimmick.stage_ended = true
		end
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	-- 현재 실행중인 기믹이 있는 상태면 touch event 전달
	if self.current_action ~= nil then
		self.current_action:on_touch_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.interactable_state then
		return false
	end

	for _,gimmick in pairs(self.gimmick_pool) do
		gimmick:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_move_end_event(e)
	-- 그리드 밖에 나가면 기믹 리셋
	for _,gimmick in pairs(self.gimmick_pool) do
		gimmick:reset_item(e)
	end
	return false
end

-- 데미지 입는 npc들 체크 후 처리
function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- 리더가 체력이 1이 되고 CharacterControllerScreenplayState가 아니라면 dead 이벤트 실행
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.HpBefore - e.Info:GetTotalDamage() <= 1 and
				not lua_helper.type_compare(get_party_leader().FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
				CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
			self:set_dead_event()
		end
	end

	if self.npc_hp_table[e.Info.target.Name] ~= nil and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_party_leader())  then

		if self.npc_hp_table[e.Info.target.Name] <= 1 or (e.Info.type & CS.Oak.DamageType.Death) == CS.Oak.DamageType.Death then
			if get_party_leader().Position.x > e.Info.target.Position.x then
				character_util.air_spin(e.Info.target, { offset = unity_class.vector3.left * 3 })
			else
				character_util.air_spin(e.Info.target, { offset = unity_class.vector3.right * 3 })
			end
			self.npc_hp_table[e.Info.target.Name] = nil
		else
			self.npc_hp_table[e.Info.target.Name] = self.npc_hp_table[e.Info.target.Name] - 1
		end

		return false
	end
	return false
end

-- 기믹 루프
function local_class:gimmick_loop()
	while not self.stage_ended do
		if self.current_action then
			self.current_action:update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.current_action then
		self.current_action:exit()
		self.current_action = nil
	end

	if self.gimmick_pool ~= nil then
		for _,gimmick in pairs(self.gimmick_pool) do
			gimmick:dispose()
			gimmick = nil
		end
		self.gimmick_pool = nil
	end
end

-- 기믹 활성화
function local_class:activate_gimmick(gimmick_key, item_key)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 변경할 기믹
	local gimmick = self.gimmick_pool[gimmick_key]

	self.chainging_gimmick = true

	-- 기믹 활성화 오버라이드 확인 및 실행
	local override_result = self:override_interact_routine(gimmick, item_key)
	if not override_result then
		self.chainging_gimmick = false
		return
	end

	-- 아이템 습득 연출
	gimmick:consume_item(item_key)

	-- 현재 상태에 맞는 변신 연출
	if not self.current_action then
		gimmick:from_normal_scene()
	else
		if self:is_mushroom_action() then
			gimmick:from_mushroom_scene()
		elseif self:is_fire_flower_action() then
			gimmick:from_fire_flower_scene()
		else
			gimmick:from_star_scene()
		end
	end

	self:set_stage_music()

	-- 기믹 상태 변경
	self:change_action(gimmick_key)

	self.chainging_gimmick = false

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 기믹 액션 활성화
function local_class:change_action(key)
	if self.current_action then
		self.current_action:exit()
	end
	self.current_action = self.gimmick_pool[key]
	self.current_action:enter()
end

-- 현재 기믹 상태 해제
function local_class:remove_action()
	if self.current_action then
		self.current_action:exit()
	end
	self.current_action = nil
end

-- 기믹 사운드 세팅
function local_class:set_stage_music()
	if not self.set_stage_music_clip then
		self.set_stage_music_clip = true
		music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'bgm_title_arcade', state = 'field' })
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	end
end

-- 기믹 인터랙트 이벤트 중 연출 오버라이드해서 사용자가 원하는대로 할 수 있도록
function local_class:override_interact(func, handler)
	self.override_interact_func = func
	self.override_interact_handler = handler
end

-- 인터랙트 오버라이드 취소
function local_class:cancel_override_interact()
	self.override_interact_func = nil
	self.override_interact_handler = nil
end

-- 인터랙트 오버라이드 루틴 true면 이후 기존 로직을 진행하고 false면 즉시 종료하라는 의미
function local_class:override_interact_routine(gimmick, item_key)
	if self.override_interact_func ~= nil then
		local continue = true
		if self.override_interact_handler ~= nil then
			continue = self.override_interact_func(self.override_interact_handler, gimmick, item_key)
		else
			continue = self.override_interact_func(gimmick, item_key)
		end
		return continue
	end
	return true
end

-- 현재 공격 가능한 상태인지 체크
function local_class:check_attackable()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	return not leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState or
		lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterNoActionState)) and
				lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState))
end

-- 버섯 기믹 상태인지
function local_class:is_mushroom_action()
	return mushroom:made(self.current_action)
end

-- 화염꽃 기믹 상태인지
function local_class:is_fire_flower_action()
	return fire_flower:made(self.current_action)
end

-- 별 기믹 상태인지
function local_class:is_star_action()
	return star:made(self.current_action)
end

-- 버섯 기믹 아이템 가져오기
function local_class:get_mushroom_item(key)
	return self.gimmick_pool['mushroom']:get_item(key)
end

-- 화염꽃 기믹 아이템 가져오기
function local_class:get_fire_flower_item(key)
	return self.gimmick_pool['fire_flower']:get_item(key)
end

-- 별 기믹 아이템 가져오기
function local_class:get_star_item(key)
	return self.gimmick_pool['star']:get_item(key)
end

-- 빈 배틀 액션 세팅 해주기
function local_class:set_empty_battle_action()
	yield_return_func(get_party_leader().CharacterBehaviour.RefreshBattleActionsWithClass,
			get_party_leader().CharacterBehaviour, self.empty_battle_action_name)
end

-- 배틀 액션 제거
function local_class:remove_battle_action()
	yield_return_func(get_party_leader().CharacterBehaviour.RefreshBattleActionsWithClass,
			get_party_leader().CharacterBehaviour, nil)
end

-- 죽은 상태인지 확인
function local_class:check_dead()
	return self.is_dead
end

-- 죽은 상태인지 확인
function local_class:ended_dead_fade()
	return self.end_dead_fade
end

-- 죽는 이벤트 처리
function local_class:set_dead_event()
	-- 별 기믹 상태에서는 죽지 않음
	if not self:is_star_action() then
		start_coroutine(self.dead_reset_scene, self)
	end
end

-- 죽는 이벤트
function local_class:dead_reset_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local leader_pos = leader.Position
	local height = leader.Position.y + 3
	local reset_table = self.constants_data['etc'].reset

	self.is_dead = true
	self.end_dead_fade = false

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState) then
	   -- 임시로 점프 스테이트 날려서 넉백 제거하기
	   local jumpInfo = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()
	   jumpInfo.jumper = leader
	   jumpInfo.jumpSource = leader
	   jumpInfo.jumpType = CS.Oak.JumpType.SlopeJump
	   jumpInfo.speed = 0
	   jumpInfo.direction = vector(0, 0, 0)
	   jumpInfo.jumpStartPos = leader.Position
	   jumpInfo.jumpTimeScale = 11
	   jumpInfo.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity

	   leader:OnEvent(CS.Oak.JumpStartEvent.Create(jumpInfo))
	   coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 리더가 HoldUpState일 경우 들고 있는 오브젝트 내려 놓도록
	local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
		if hold_target ~= nil then
			command_util.execute_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction),
					leader.Position, 4, false)
		end
	end

	character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, false)
	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'visible')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_active_state(user_party[i], 'visible')
	end

	-- 리셋 위치 가져오기
	-- 해당 존들안에 없으면 그 자리에서 부활
	local reset_pos = leader_pos
	local reset_dir = 'up'
	local contains_zone = false
	local battle_gates = nil
	local battle_id = 0
	local enemy_count = 0
	for i = 1, #reset_table do
		if zone_util.contains_fo(reset_table[i].zone, leader, false) then
			local marker = field:GetMarker(reset_table[i].marker)
			contains_zone = true
			reset_pos = marker.position
			reset_dir = marker.direction
			battle_gates = reset_table[i].battle_gates
			battle_id = reset_table[i].battle_id
			enemy_count = reset_table[i].enemy_count
		end
	end

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'get' })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_tipsy_01')
	-- 카메라 고정
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 0.4, { ignorecameragrids = true } )

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	local cur_speed = 8
	do
		local accel = 3
		local min_speed = 6
		while leader.Position.y < height do
			cur_speed = cur_speed - (unity_class.time.deltaTime * accel)
			if cur_speed < min_speed then
				cur_speed = min_speed
			end

			leader.Position = leader.Position + vector(0, (cur_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime), 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	do
		local accel = 5
		local max_speed = 11
		while screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(leader.Position, { bonus_distance = 6 }) do
			cur_speed = cur_speed + cur_speed + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * accel)
			if cur_speed > max_speed then
				cur_speed = max_speed
			end

			leader.Position = leader.Position +  vector(0, 0, -(cur_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime))

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_drown_02')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, true)

	self.end_dead_fade = true

	if contains_zone then
		-- 존이 있으니 배틀 게이트들 열어준다.
		if battle_gates ~= nil then
			for i = 1, #battle_gates do
				local index = battle_gates[i]
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('battlegate_' .. index))
			end
		end

		if enemy_count ~= nil then
			for i = 1, enemy_count do
				local enemy = get_character('battle_' .. battle_id .. '_' .. i)
				enemy:OnEvent(CS.Oak.ReturnToPatrolEvent.Instance)
			end
			stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()
		end
	end

	-- 파티 회복
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = member
		heal_info.target = member
		heal_info.heal = member.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

-- 공격 루틴
function mushroom:mushroom_attack_routine()
	local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(self.leader.Position):GetHeightAt(self.leader.Position)
	local leader_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.leader.Position, floor_height)
	local shadow_offset_origin = self.leader.SpineController.ShadowTransform.position

	self.controller.interactable_state = false

	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState) then
	   -- 임시로 점프 스테이트 날려서 넉백 제거하기
	   local jumpInfo = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()
	   jumpInfo.jumper = self.leader
	   jumpInfo.jumpSource = self.leader
	   jumpInfo.jumpType = CS.Oak.JumpType.SlopeJump
	   jumpInfo.speed = 0
	   jumpInfo.direction = vector(0, 0, 0)
	   jumpInfo.jumpStartPos = self.leader.Position
	   jumpInfo.jumpTimeScale = 11
	   jumpInfo.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity

	   self.leader:OnEvent(CS.Oak.JumpStartEvent.Create(jumpInfo))
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	if self.controller.chainging_gimmick or self.controller:check_dead() then
		self.controller.interactable_state = true
		return
	end

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	character_util.stop(self.leader)
	local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(self.leader)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state)

	state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
	message_system:SendSync(self.leader.FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_throw_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.leader, direction_util.to_side_dir(self.leader.Direction))
	character_util.set_emotion(self.leader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.leader, { name = 'get' })

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(self.data.jump_duration, function(progress)
		local cur_y = self.data.jump_height * progress
    	local cur_pos = leader_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)
    	self.leader.Position = cur_pos
    	self.leader.SpineController.ShadowTransform.position = shadow_offset_origin
	end)

	local roation_dir = self.leader.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left and 1 or -1
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.leader, 360 * roation_dir, self.data.jump_hold_time)
	character_util.set_anim(self.leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	wait_for_sec(self.data.jump_hold_time)

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(self.data.take_down_duration, function(progress)
		local cur_y = self.data.jump_height * (1 - progress)
    	local cur_pos = leader_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)
    	self.leader.Position = cur_pos
    	self.leader.SpineController.ShadowTransform.position = shadow_offset_origin
	end)
	character_util.set_position(self.leader, leader_pos)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_explosion_01')
	self.controller.fx.stomp():Instantiate(self.leader.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0))
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)

	character_util.set_anim(self.leader, { name = 'seat' })

	local obj_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.leader.Position, self.data.attack_radius)
	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]
		if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour) or
				lua_helper.type_compare(obj.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour) or
				(lua_helper.type_compare(obj, CS.Oak.Character) and not obj.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead and
				(obj.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
			damage_info.sender = self.leader
			damage_info.target = obj
			damage_info.damage = self.data.damage
			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	obj_list:Dispose()

	wait_for_sec(self.data.take_down_hold_time)

	character_util.spine_rotate(self.leader, 0, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leader)

	message_system:SendSync(self.leader, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)

	self.controller.interactable_state = true
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

-- 대쉬 공격 루틴
function mushroom:dash_routine()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) and
			self.leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState.Dashing then
		local dash_pos = self.leader.Position + (direction_util.to_vector3(self.leader.Direction) * 0.4)
		local obj_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(dash_pos, self.data.dash_radius)

		for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local obj = obj_list[i]

			if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour) or
				(lua_helper.type_compare(obj, CS.Oak.Character) and not obj.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead and
				(obj.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None and
					self.controller.npc_hp_table[obj.Name] ~= nil) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
				damage_info.sender = self.leader
				damage_info.target = obj
				damage_info.damage = 100

				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

				camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.2)
			end
		end
		obj_list:Dispose()
	end
end

			not self.controller:check_dead() and
			self.recent_attack_time + self.data.attack_cooltime < unity_class.time.time  then
		self.recent_attack_time = unity_class.time.time
		self.request_id = self.request_id + 1
		start_coroutine(self.flower_attack_routine, self, self.request_id)
	end
end

-- 불꽃 공격 루틴
function fire_flower:flower_attack_routine(request_id)
	self.current_fireball_num = self.current_fireball_num + 1

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_shot_01')

	character_util.set_emotion(self.leader, { name = 'attack'})
	character_util.remove_anim(self.leader)
	character_util.set_anim(self.leader, { name = 'sword_attack', remove_after = 0.25, scale = 2 })

	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	-- 현재 리퀘스트가 제일 최신이면 이모션을 꺼준다.
	if request_id == self.request_id then
		-- 죽은 상태면 무시
		if not self.controller:check_dead() then
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.leader)
		end
	end

	local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.leader.Direction)
	local leader_height = self.leader.Position.y
	local fireball = self:get_fireball()
	fireball.transform.localPosition = self.leader.Position + (dir * 0.5) + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

	local time_passed = 0
	local is_hit = false
	while not is_hit and not self.stage_ended and screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(fireball.transform.localPosition, { bonus_distance = 5 }) do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		fireball.transform.localPosition = fireball.transform.localPosition
				+ self.data.fireball_speed * dir * dt

		local obj_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(vector_util.get_x0z(fireball.transform.localPosition, leader_height), self.data.fireball_radius)
		for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local obj = obj_list[i]
			if ((obj.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle or
				lua_helper.type_compare(obj, CS.Oak.Character)) and
				not ((obj.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Cliff) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Cliff) and
				(obj.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None and
				not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(obj.CrashBehaviour) then

				is_hit = true
				break
			end
		end
		obj_list:Dispose()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	self.current_fireball_num = self.current_fireball_num - 1
	if is_hit then
		self:hit_fireball(fireball)
	else
		fireball.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end
end

-- 불꽃 피격 처리
function fire_flower:hit_fireball(fireball)
	local pos = fireball.transform.localPosition
	local obj_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.data.fireball_explosion_radius)

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]

		-- 불을 붙일 수 있으면 붙임
		if not lua_helper.type_compare(obj.CombustibleBehaviour, CS.Oak.NonCombustibleBehaviour) then
			command_util.execute_burn(self.leader, obj)
		end

		if lua_helper.type_compare(obj, CS.Oak.Character) and not obj.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead and
				(obj.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
			damage_info.sender = self.leader
			damage_info.target = obj
			damage_info.damage = self.data.damage

function star:init(controller)

	self.key = 'star'
	self.data = self.controller.constants_data[self.key]
	self.cycle_time = self.data.alpha_fade_cycle_time
	self.color_magitude = 0
	self.scene_state = false
	self.twinkle = nil
	self.twinkle_parent = nil

	self.sfx = nil
	-- 01_arcade_charge_01
	-- jump패드 끝나고 remove_emotion해주는 것 때문에 방어코드
	self.is_flying = false
	self.need_burning_emotion = false

	self:set_item()
end

function star:dispose()
	for _,item in pairs(self.item) do
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(item.item)
		item.fo = nil
	end
	self.item = nil

	self.super:dispose()
end

function star:enter()
	character_util.set_emotion(self.leader, { name = 'burning' })
	self.controller:remove_battle_action()
	self.leader.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	self.leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.show_attack_timer(self.leader, self.data.gimmick_duration)

	self.twinkle = self.controller.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(self.leader.Position)
	self.twinkle_parent = self.twinkle.transform.parent
	self.twinkle.transform.parent = self.leader.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform

	self.sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_arcade_charge_01', loop = true })
end

function star:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	self.sfx:FadeOut(0.5)
	self.sfx = nil

	self.leader.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.ManualCharacterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	self.leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.DefaultCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.leader)

	if self.twinkle ~= nil then
		self.twinkle.transform.parent = self.twinkle_parent
		self.twinkle:Dispose()
		self.twinkle = nil
	end
	self.twinkle_parent = nil

	character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.leader)

	character_util.remove_fade_color(self.leader, self.data.alpha_fade_key, self.cycle_time/2 * self.color_magitude)
	self.color_magitude = 0

	self.is_flying = false
	self.scene_state = false
	self.need_burning_emotion = false

	self.cur_emotion_count = 0
end

function star:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	-- 기믹 변경중이면 대기
	if self.controller.chainging_gimmick then
		return
	end
	self.color_magitude = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI *
			(self.time_passed % self.cycle_time)/self.cycle_time)

	character_util.add_fade_color(self.leader, self.data.alpha_fade_key, unity_class.color.white, self.color_magitude, 0)

	-- 공격
	self:attack()

	-- 연출 상태면 종료하지 않음
	if self.scene_state then
		return
	end

	-- 점프 패드 탑승 끝나고 이모션을 없애버려서 추가한 set_emotion
	if self.leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying then
		self.is_flying = true
	else
		-- 점프 상태 종료되면 1프레임 쉬고 이모션 변경
		if self.is_flying then
			self.is_flying = false
			self.need_burning_emotion = true
		elseif self.need_burning_emotion then
			self.need_burning_emotion = false
			character_util.set_emotion(self.leader, { name = 'burning' })
		end
	end

	-- 시간이 지났으면 종료
	if self.time_passed >= self.data.gimmick_duration then
		self.controller:remove_action()
		return
	end
end

function star:on_touch_event(e)
	return false
end

function star:on_interact_event(e)
	for key in pairs(self.item) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.item[key].fo) then
			start_coroutine(self.controller.activate_gimmick, self.controller, self.key, key)
		end
	end
end

function star:get_item(key)
	return self.item[key].item
end

function star:set_item()
	if self.data ~= nil then
		self.item = {}
		for i = 1, #self.data.item_key do
			local invisible_fo = get_field_object(self.data.item_key[i])
			self.item[self.data.item_key[i]] = { item = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{
						itemid = self.data.item_id,
						pos = invisible_fo.Position,
						notforinven = true,
						skip_text = true,
						lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
					}),
					fo = invisible_fo }
		end
	end
end

function star:reset_item()
	for _,item in pairs(self.item) do
		if item.item == nil then
			item.item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{
					itemid = self.data.item_id,
					pos = item.fo.Position,
					notforinven = true,
					skip_text = true,
					lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
				})
			item.fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		end
	end
end

function star:get_key()
	return self.key
end

function star:attack()
	local obj_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.leader.Position, self.data.attack_radius)
	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]

		if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.SpikeBehaviour) then
			self.controller.fx.destroy():Instantiate(obj.Position)
			obj.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
		end
		if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour) or
				lua_helper.type_compare(obj.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour) or
				(lua_helper.type_compare(obj, CS.Oak.Character) and not obj.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead and
				(obj.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None and
				self.controller.npc_hp_table[obj.Name] ~= nil) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
			damage_info.sender = self.leader
			damage_info.target = obj
			damage_info.damage = self.data.damage
			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
		end
	end
	obj_list:Dispose()
end

function mini_event:init(event_controller)

	--캐릭터

	end

	self.get_hero_ai = function()

	end

	self.get_fan = function(idx)
		return get_field_object('me1_wind_fan_' .. idx)
	end

	--event zone
	self.encounter_android_zone_name = 'me1_room_entrance'

	--스트링 키
	self.string_key = 'qc_sector_ds_me1_'

	--section state
	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		encounter_android = 2,
		rescue_android = 3,
	}
	self.current_state = self.section_state.none

	--패트롤 하고 있어야 하는지?
	self.android_patrol = false

	--머리가 패트롤 하는가?
	self.is_head_patrol = false
	--몸통이 패트롤 하는가?
	self.is_body_patrol = false

	self.is_fan_move = {
		false,
		false,
		false,
		false
	}

	self.fan_direction_org = {
		CS.Oak.Direction.Right,
		CS.Oak.Direction.Down,
		CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
		CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	}
	--어디서 안드로이드 머리가 멈췄나?
	self.head_only_android_stop_num = -1

	--이벤트 플래그. 미니이벤트 n은 1 << n
	self.event_flag = 1

	-- 이 이벤트에 지저된 안드로이드 NPC 수
	self.num_designated_androids = 1
end

function mini_event:enter()
	if not self.event_controller.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_event')

		self:init_designated_npcs_on_event_progressing()
	else
		self:init_designated_npcs_on_event_completed()
	end
end

function mini_event:init_designated_npcs_on_event_progressing()
	-- 안드로이드 세팅
	local head = self.get_head_only_android()
	local body = self.get_body_only_android()

	character_util.set_active_state(head, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(body, 'enabled')
	
	head.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	body.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_position(head, field_util.get_marker_pos('me1_head_only_start_pos'))
	character_util.set_position(body, field_util.get_marker_pos('me1_body_only_start_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(body, 'up')
end

function mini_event:init_designated_npcs_on_event_completed()
	local android = self.get_android()
	local android_offset = field_util.get_marker_pos('me_android_start_pos')
	android.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.set_position(android, android_offset)
	character_util.set_direction(android, 'up')
end

function mini_event:start()
	if self.event_controller.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then
		local android = self.get_android()
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(android, user_party, false)
	end
end

function mini_event:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
end

function mini_event:on_interact_event(e)
	local android = self.get_android()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, android) then
		--원래는 두가지 경우로 나뉘었지만, Right만 하는 것으로 정리함.
		sp_util.start_scene(self.success_rescue_android, self, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
	end

end
function mini_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.encounter_android_zone_name) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.encounter_android
		self:encounter_android()
	end
end

function mini_event:on_custom_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == 'wind_fan_start_rotation' then
		local sender = e.Sender
		for i = 4, 4 do
			local fan = self.get_fan(i)
			if fan == sender then
				self.is_fan_move[i] = true
			end
		end
	elseif e.Params[0] == 'wind_fan_end_rotation' then
		local sender = e.Sender
		for i = 4, 4 do
			local fan = self.get_fan(i)
			if fan == sender then
				if self.fan_direction_org[i] == fan.Direction then
					self.is_fan_move[i] = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function mini_event:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.event_controller = nil
end

function mini_event:dispose()
end

function mini_event:encounter_android()
	local head = self.get_head_only_android()
	local body = self.get_body_only_android()

	self.android_patrol = true
	head.Transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(head)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(body)
	start_coroutine(self.android_speech_loop, self)
	start_coroutine(self.head_only_android_patrol_loop, self)
	start_coroutine(self.body_only_android_patrol_loop, self)
end
function mini_event:setting_android()
	-- 안드로이드 세팅
	local head = self.get_head_only_android()
	local body = self.get_body_only_android()
	character_util.set_active_state(head, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(body, 'enabled')
	head.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	body.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_position(head, field_util.get_marker_pos('me1_head_only_start_pos'))
	character_util.set_position(body, field_util.get_marker_pos('me1_body_only_start_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(body, 'up')
end

function mini_event:android_speech_loop()
	local head = self.get_head_only_android()

	while self.android_patrol do
		--머리 대사(스킵 불가능) : 도와주십시오.
		--대사 끝나고 1초 대기.
		--다시 대사 출력.
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_02', parent = head })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(head, self.string_key .. 1, false)
		wait_for_sec(1.0)
	end
end

--머리가 선풍기에 날려다니는 중.
function mini_event:head_only_android_patrol_loop()
	local head = self.get_head_only_android()
	local head_marker_name = 'me1_head_only_pos_'
	local waypoint_list = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(waypoint_list, field_util.get_marker_pos(head_marker_name .. i))
	end

	self.is_head_patrol = true

	while self.is_head_patrol do
		--경로 길이 32, 거리 24의 4/3 이라 스피드 4
		for i = 1, 4 do
			wp_util.move_async(head, waypoint_list[i], 4.5, nil)
			--선풍기 정지하고, 정지 위치의 경로면 탈출
			if self.is_fan_move[i] then
				-- 정지 위치 저장. 몸이 멈출 때 사용.
				self.head_only_android_stop_num = i
				self.android_patrol = false
				self.is_head_patrol = false
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_head_01')
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

--몸은 머리랑 이동시간 동일하게 계속 따라서 사각형으로 도는 중. idle, walk로 날려다니는 중.
function mini_event:body_only_android_patrol_loop()
	local body = self.get_body_only_android()
	local body_marker_name = 'me1_body_only_pos_'
	--local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	local waypoint_list = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(waypoint_list, field_util.get_marker_pos(body_marker_name .. i))
	end

	self.is_body_patrol = true

	while self.is_body_patrol do
		--경로 길이 24, 거리 32의 3/4 이라 스피드 3
		for i = 1, 4 do
			wp_util.move_async(body, waypoint_list[i], 3.3, nil)
			
			--머리가 멈추고, 몸이 멈춘 위치의 경로면 탈출
			if self.is_head_patrol == false and i == self.head_only_android_stop_num then
				self.is_body_patrol = false
				break
			end
		end
	end

	--도는 것 종료하면,

	wp_util.move_async(body, {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('me1_body_only_end_pos_' .. self.head_only_android_stop_num),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('me1_head_only_pos_' .. self.head_only_android_stop_num) / 2.0 +
				field_util.get_marker_pos('me1_body_only_end_pos_' .. self.head_only_android_stop_num) / 2.0
	}, 3, nil)
	start_coroutine(self.body_hold_up_head, self)
end

function mini_event:body_hold_up_head()
	local body = self.get_body_only_android()
	local head = self.get_head_only_android()
	local android = self.get_android()
	local direction_str = direction_util.to_str(body.Direction)

	--hold_duration == 0.12
	body.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector_util.get_x0z(body.Hitbox.size, 0.1))
	character_util.set_direction(head, direction_str)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clang_01')
	command_util.execute_holdup(body, head, body.Position, nil, false)

	wait_for_sec(0.12)

	--안드로이드 교체(몸만, 머리만 비활성화, 안드로이드 1 활성화)
	character_util.set_active_state(head, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(body, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
	character_util.set_direction(android, direction_str)
	character_util.set_position(android, body.Position)
	character_util.set_position(head, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(body, vector(999, 0, 999))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(android, 0.05, 0.3)
	
	android.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	
	wait_for_sec(1.0)

	self.current_state = self.section_state.rescue_android

	start_coroutine(self.success_rescue_android_coroutine, self, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
end

--머리 만 있는 안드로이드 구출 성공시, (구출 위치 = direction)이 달라짐.
function mini_event:success_rescue_android_coroutine(direction)
	local android = self.get_android()
	local direction_str = direction_util.to_str(direction)

	local android_marker_name = 'me1_android_pos_' .. direction_str
	local android_pos = {
		vector(android.Position.x,0,field_util.get_marker_pos(android_marker_name).z),
		field_util.get_marker_pos(android_marker_name)
	}
	local opposite_str = ''


	if direction_str == 'left' then
		opposite_str = 'right'
	else
		opposite_str = 'left'
	end
	scene_util.set_direction(android, opposite_str, false)

	local align_duration = 2

	wp_util.move_async(android, android_pos, nil, align_duration)
	android.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour()
	character_util.add_listener(android,self.event_controller.quest_controller.cs_controller)
end

	--안드로이드(damaged, nod 고개 숙인 채 유지.) : 생각조차 해보지 못했습니다.
	local is_android_nodding = true

	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = false })
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(android, 'nod')
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.5)
		android.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
		is_android_nodding = false
	end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, nil, 'damaged',
			self.string_key .. '17_5')
	--안드로이드(idle, cross_arm) : 몇 시간 전, 마빈을 처음 본 순간부터 우리들은 도망치거나 숨기만 했습니다.
	while is_android_nodding do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	android.SpineController.TimeScale = 1

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, 'cross_arm', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. '17_6')

	-- 안드로이드(sleep_deep, idle) : 폐기될 지도 모른다는 두려움에 빠졌습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, nil, 'sleep_deep',
		'qc_sector_ds_me1_17_6_1')

	-- 안드로이드(attack, idle) : 대부분이 도망치거나 숨기만 했죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, nil, 'attack',
		'qc_sector_ds_me1_17_6_2')

	--안드로이드(idle, bomb_idle) : 개중에는 가끔 타도 마빈을 외치는 개체들도 있었지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. '17_7')
	--안드로이드(sleep_deep, idle) : 고작 몇 십분만에 전부 부서져 폐기되었습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, 'idle', 'sleep_deep',
			self.string_key .. '17_8')
	--카이(tired, cast) : 마빈님은… 잔인한 폭군 같군요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'cast', 'tired',
			self.string_key .. '17_9')
	--카이(attack, victory_get 1회) : 그러나 그 폭군을 쓰러뜨리는 용사님과 조력자, 카이!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'victory_get', 'attack',
			self.string_key .. '17_10')
	--카이(awesome, sing, jump 1회) : 정말 저스티스합니다!
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'sing', 'awesome',
			self.string_key .. '17_11')

	--안드로이드(idle, bomb_idle) : 당신들이 진심이라면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. '17_12')

	--안드로이드(idle, nod 1회) : 저도 당신을 돕겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, { name = 'nod', count = 1 }, 'idle',
			self.string_key .. '17_13')

	--안드로이드(attack, idle2, shake 유지) : 그 폭력 덩어리 인간을…
	character_util.shake(android, 0.05, 999999)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, 'idle2', 'attack',
			self.string_key .. '17_14')
	--안드로이드(attack, bomb_idle, jump 1회) : 마빈을 쓰러뜨리고 싶습니다!
	character_util.stop_shake(android)
	character_util.normal_jump(android, '01_player_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', 'attack',
			self.string_key .. '17_15')

	--가디언 선택지
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--원수!(노랑)
		{ 'qc_sector_ds_me1_choose_3_1', 'intellect' },
		--안드로이드의 힘을 보여준다!(초록)
		{ 'qc_sector_ds_me1_choose_3_2', 'mercy' },
		--죽음보다 더한 고통을!(빨강)
		{ 'qc_sector_ds_me1_choose_3_3', 'brutal' },
	})
	-- 케이든 여전히 안드로이드 바라보는 상태 유지.
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, direction_str, true)
	if choose_result == 1 then

		--가디언 attack, jingak 1회.
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(leader, 'jingak')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'jingak', loop = false, sfx_name = function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01', 0.5)
		end })
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		--안드로이드(sleep_deep, idle) : 이 감정이 인간들이 말하는 복수심… 이라는 거군요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, 'idle', 'sleep_deep',
				self.string_key .. 18)
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--안드로이드의 힘을 보여주자!(초록)
		--가디언 attack 좌측으로 2회, 우측으로 2회.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(leader, 'gauntlet_combo_attack2')
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, opposite_str, false)
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack2', loop = true })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

		scene_util.set_direction(leader, direction_str, false)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

		--안드로이드(attack, dagger_idle) : 마빈에게도 공포를 알려주고 싶습니다.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.normal_jump(android, '01_player_jump_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil, 'dagger_idle', 'attack',
				'qc_sector_ds_me1_18')
	else
		--죽음보다 더한 고통을!(빨강)
		--가디언 eyelight, dagger_idle 1초
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'eyelight')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'dagger_idle')
		wait_for_sec(1.0)

		--안드로이드(attack, victory_extra 3회) : 더한 고통을!
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(android, 'victory_extra')
		local victory_routine = true
		local speech_rotuine = true

		scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, 'attack')
		start_coroutine(function()
			scene_util.set_anim_async(android, self, { name = 'victory_extra', count = 3, sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
			victory_routine = false
		end)
		start_coroutine(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil,
					nil, nil,
					'qc_sector_ds_me1_18')
			speech_rotuine = false
		end)
		--victory_extra 3회 완료 + 대사 완료 해야 다음 대사 진행.
		while victory_routine or speech_rotuine do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 가디언, 케이든AI 정방향 바라 봄(임의 추가)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, direction_str, false)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, direction_str, false)

	--케이든AI(안드로이드 바라보며, attack, dagger_idle) : 이 안드로이드가 합류하면 승리확률은 대략 5.25%...
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, direction_str,
			'dagger_idle', 'attack',
			self.string_key .. 21)
	--케이든AI(smile, cast) : 용사님의 혜안 덕분에 승리 확률이 훨씬 더 높아졌네요!
	--가디언 표정 tired
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, direction_str,
			'cast', 'smile',
			self.string_key .. 22)

	--가디언 선택지
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--우리 편을 더 모으자.(초록)
		{ 'qc_sector_ds_me1_choose_4_1', 'mercy' },
		--50%는 되어야 한다.(노랑)
		{ 'qc_sector_ds_me1_choose_4_2', 'intellect' },
	})
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--우리 편을 더 모으자.(초록)
		--가디언 down, attack, release 2회
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
		--케이든AI up, idle, 느낌표 이모티콘
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up', false)
		character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, '01_small_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(hero_ai, nil, 'notice')
		--케이든AI(안드로이드 바라보며, tired, cross_arm) : 그렇군요… 다른 안드로이드들도 끌어들인다면…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, direction_str,
				'cross_arm', 'tired',
				self.string_key .. 23)
		--케이든AI(안드로이드 바라보며, attack, idle, jump 1회) : 승리 확률 50%도 가능할 겁니다!
		character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, '01_small_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, direction_str,
				'idle', 'attack',
				self.string_key .. 24)
	else
		--50%는 되어야 한다.(노랑)
		--가디언 down, attack, cast2 1초
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'cast2')
		wait_for_sec(1.0)
		--케이든AI up, idle, 느낌표 이모티콘
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up', false)
		character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, '01_small_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(hero_ai, nil, 'notice')
		--케이든AI(안드로이드 바라보며, tired, cross_arm) : 그렇군요… 다른 안드로이드들도 끌어들인다면…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, { dir = direction_str, sfx = false },
				'cross_arm', 'tired',
				self.string_key .. 23)
		--케이든AI(안드로이드 바라보며, attack, idle, jump 1회) : 불가능한 수치는 아닌 것 같습니다!
		character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, '01_player_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, direction_str,
				'idle', 'attack',
				self.string_key .. 25)
	end
	--케이든AI(up, release) : 이 신전에 있는 고장난 안드로이드들을 탐색해 보겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'up',
			'release', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 26)
	--케이든AI, (vr, left, idle, shake 지속) : 1… 4… 7…
	local clock_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_coop_ticking_01', loop = true })
	character_util.shake(hero_ai, 0.05, 999999)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, opposite_str,
			'idle', 'vr',
			self.string_key .. 27)
	--케이든AI, (vr, right, idle, shake 지속) : 8… 9… 12…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, direction_str,
			'idle', 'vr',
			self.string_key .. 28)
	clock_sfx:Stop()
	clock_sfx = nil
	
	--케이든AI(안드로이드 바라보며, eyelight, idle) : 탐색 완료하였습니다.
	character_util.stop_shake(hero_ai)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, direction_str,
			'idle', 'eyelight',
			self.string_key .. 29)
	--케이든AI(up, idle) : 이 신전에 있는 고장난 안드로이드는 총 12개.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'up',
			'idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 30)
	--케이든AI(up, bow_idle) : 승리 확률을 적어도 50% 이상 확보하려면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'up',
			'bow_idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 31)
	--케이든AI(attack, cast2) : 아마 안드로이드 8개 개체는 있어야 할 겁니다.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, direction_str, false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, direction_str,
			'cast2', 'attack',
			self.string_key .. 32)
	--케이든AI(up 안드로이드 바라보며, idle, release) :이 안드로이드가 있으니 앞으로 7개 안드로이드를 설득해야겠군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, direction_str,
			'release', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 33)
	--안드로이드(right, idle, idle) : 다른 개체들은 신전 안쪽으로 도망쳤을 겁니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 34)

	--안드로이드(idle, bomb_idle) : 대부분 겁에 질려 있겠지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. '34_1')
	--안드로이드(sleep_deep, idle) : 마빈을 쓰러뜨리는 것만이 유일한 방법이라는 걸 이해한다면…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'sleep_deep',
			self.string_key .. '34_2')
	--안드로이드(attack, bomb_idle) : 당신에게 합류할 겁니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'attack',
			self.string_key .. '34_3')

	--안드로이드(가디언 바라보며, idle, release 2회) : 신전 안쪽도 살펴볼 수 있도록 문을 열어드리죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 35)

	--안드로이드 문 앞으로 걸어간다. 안드로이드 위치 케이스에 따른 이동 동선 참고
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
	local android_pos_str = 'me1_android_pos_'
	local waypoint_list = {}
	--카메라도 1초에 걸쳐 도어 포커스.
	camera_util.move(field_util.get_marker_pos(android_pos_str .. 3), 1.0)
	--right 위치였으면 위(마커1, 마커2)를 경유해 지나간다.
	if direction_str == 'right' then

		waypoint_list = {
			field_util.get_marker_pos(android_pos_str .. 1),
			field_util.get_marker_pos(android_pos_str .. 2),
			field_util.get_marker_pos(android_pos_str .. 3)
		}

		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'up')
		wp_util.move_async(android, waypoint_list[1], 4, nil)
		wp_util.move_async(android, waypoint_list[2], 4, nil)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
		wp_util.move_async(android, waypoint_list[3], 4, nil)

	else
		waypoint_list = {
			field_util.get_marker_pos(android_pos_str .. 3)
		}

		wp_util.move_async(android, waypoint_list, 4, nil)
	end

	--안드로이드 문에 가까이 가서 left, idle, attack 1초.
	scene_util.set_direction(android, 'left', false)
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(android, 'attack')
	character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
	character_util.remove_anim(android)

	--문이 1초에 걸쳐 열린다.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('me1_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('me1_door_2', false))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--안드로이드(right, idle, bomb_idle) : 이제 신전 안쪽도 다 살펴볼 수 있을 겁니다.
	scene_util.set_direction(android, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android, self.string_key .. 36)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)

	--카이(greed, sing, jump 2회) : 오오! 저스티스 템플 최심부로 출발입니다! 추울발~!
	character_util.normal_double_jump(hero_ai, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, opposite_str,
			'sing', 'greed',
			self.string_key .. 37)

	--가디언 smile, victory_get 1회
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'victory_get')

	--안드로이드 파티에 팔로우 npc로 합류
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.0)
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(android, user_party, false)

	local quest_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('me1_finish_marker_pos')
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point('me1_finish_key', 337, true, quest_marker_pos)

	--클리어 처리. 비트연산
	self.event_controller.quest_controller:save_mini_event_cleared_state(self.event_flag)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

-- 물건에 숨어있는 안드로이드
-- 챕터: 16
-- 스테이지: queencastle_1_5
-- 기획서 링크: (https://bit.ly/407Zp1R)
local mini_event = newclass('AndroidMiniEvent2')

function mini_event:init(event_controller)
	self.event_controller = event_controller
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	--fieldobject
	--안드로이드가 들어있는 항아리
	self.get_android_pot = function()
		return get_field_object('me2_android_pot')
	end

	--character
	--안드로이드 2(여)
	self.get_android = function()
		return get_character('android_2')
	end

	--케이든 ai
	self.get_hero_ai = function()
		return get_character('hero_ai')
	end

	--fx
	self.get_fx_jump_smoke = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_Jump_small')
	end

	--zone name
	self.pot_available_zone = 'me2_room'
	self.fan_effect_zone = 'me2_fan_zone'
	self.pot_shaking_zone = 'me2_pot_shaking_zone'

	--event state
	self.event_state = {
		none = 1,
		pot_held = 2,
		pot_broken = 3,
	}
	self.current_state = self.event_state.none

	--스트링 키
	self.string_key = 'qc_sector_ds_me2_'

	--안드로이드 항아리가 몇번 땅에 닿았는지
	--해당 값을 항아리의 좌표 y를 받아와 0이 되었을 때 올라 가도록 판별 하기 때문에, 2층 등이 존재 하는 다른 경우에 소급 적용 하기 어려움
	self.num_pot_landed = 0

	--먼지 코루틴 진행중인가?
	self.small_smoke_flag = false

	--항아리가 존을 빠져 나간 경우
	self.is_pot_leave_zone = false

	--항아리가 들어진 상태인가?
	self.is_pot_hold = false

	--항아리가 던져진 상태인지 판별, wait_until_pot_landed 코루틴 탈출 판정용
	self.is_pot_throw = false

	--리더가 항아리를 든 상태로 존을 빠져나가 강제로 release된 상태인가?
	--TODO 해당 변수 필요 없을 확률 높음! start_scene에서 강제 throw때문에 on_throw_event 타는 거였으므로...
	self.is_pot_release = false

	--TODO section_state와 겹쳐서 안 쓸수도
	--항아리가 깨졌는가?
	self.is_pot_broken = false

	--zone_leave_event관련 scene을 보고 있는가?
	self.is_zone_leave_event = false

	--선풍기에 영향을 받고 있는가?
	self.is_effect_fan = false
	-- 선풍이 영향 이벤트 클리어 했는가 ?
	self.is_clear_fan_event = false
	--이벤트 플래그. 미니이벤트 n은 1 << n
	self.event_flag = 2

	self.is_check_brazier_routine = false

	self.is_pot_speech_check_brazier = false

	self.is_brazier_hold = false

	--윈드 팬 매니저 접근하기 위해 그대로 긁어 옴.
	self.wind_fan_manager = get_or_create_global_variable('Gimmick/WindFanManager')

	self.is_check_fan_routine = false

	-- 이 이벤트에 지저된 안드로이드 NPC 수
	self.num_designated_androids = 1

	-- 항아리가 떨리고 있는지
	self.is_pot_shaking = false
end

function mini_event:enter()
	if not self.event_controller.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then
		self:setting_on_enter()
	else
		self:setting_clear_on_enter()
	end
end

function mini_event:setting_on_enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_throw_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.get_fx_jump_smoke()
end

function mini_event:setting_clear_on_enter()
	self:setting_android_clear()
end

function mini_event:setting_android_clear()
	local android = self.get_android()
	local pot = self.get_android_pot()
	local android_offset = field_util.get_marker_pos('me_android_start_pos')
	character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(android, android_offset)
	character_util.set_direction(android, 'up')

	character_util.set_active_state(pot, 'disabled')
end

function mini_event:start()
	if self.event_controller.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then
		local android = self.get_android()
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(android, user_party, false)
	end
end

function mini_event:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function mini_event:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_android()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_android, self)
	end
end

function mini_event:on_throw_event(e)
	if self.current_state >= self.event_state.pot_broken then
		return
	end

	if self.is_zone_leave_event ~= false then
		return
	end

	if self.is_pot_release ~= false then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e.Target.CombustibleBehaviour, CS.Oak.BrazierCombustibleBehaviour) then
		self.is_brazier_hold = false
		return
	end

	local pot = self.get_android_pot()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, pot) then
		self.is_pot_throw = true
		self.is_pot_hold = false
		start_coroutine(self.wait_until_pot_landed, self, e.Target)
		return
	end
end

function mini_event:on_hold_up_event(e)
	---region Guard Clausures
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, e.Holder) then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state >= self.event_state.pot_broken then
		return
	end

	if self.is_zone_leave_event ~= false then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e.Target.CombustibleBehaviour, CS.Oak.BrazierCombustibleBehaviour) then
		self.is_brazier_hold = true
		return
	end
	---endregion

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.get_android_pot(), e.Target) then
		self.current_state = self.event_state.pot_held
		self.is_pot_throw = false
		self.is_pot_hold = true

		start_coroutine(self.speech_pot_on_hold, self)
		return
	end
end

function mini_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local pot = self.get_android_pot()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, pot, self.fan_effect_zone) then
		if self.current_state >= self.event_state.pot_broken then
			return
		end

		if self.is_clear_fan_event then
			return
		end

		self.is_effect_fan = true

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.pot_available_zone) then
		if self.is_pot_speech_check_brazier ~= false then
			return
		end

		start_coroutine(self.check_brazier, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.pot_shaking_zone) then
		if self.current_state >= self.event_state.pot_held then
			return
		end

		if self.is_pot_shaking then
			return
		end

		self.is_pot_shaking = true
		start_coroutine(self.pot_shaking_loop, self)
	end
end
function mini_event:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local pot = self.get_android_pot()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, pot, self.pot_available_zone) then
		if self.current_state == self.event_state.pot_broken then
			return
		end

		if self.is_zone_leave_event then
			return
		end

		self.is_zone_leave_event = true

		if self.is_pot_hold then
			self:start_scene_without_throwing(self.leave_zone_with_hold, self, pot)
		else
			sp_util.start_scene(self.leave_zone_with_throw, self, pot)
		end
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, pot) and
			e.Zone.Name == self.fan_effect_zone and
			self.current_state == self.event_state.none then
		self.is_effect_fan = false
		return
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, self.pot_available_zone) then
		self.is_check_brazier_routine = false
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, self.pot_shaking_zone) then
		self.is_pot_shaking = false
	end
end

function mini_event:exit()
	self:unsubscribe_using_events()

	self.event_controller = nil
end

function mini_event:unsubscribe_using_events()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function mini_event:dispose()
end

function mini_event:speech_pot_on_hold()
	local pot = self.get_android_pot()
	if self.num_pot_landed <= 3 then
		-- 그냥 항아리인 것 같습니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pot, { key = self.string_key .. 2, skip = false })
	else
		-- 제발 그만 하십시오, 휴먼.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pot, { key = self.string_key .. 3, skip = false })
	end
end

function mini_event:wait_until_pot_landed(pot)
	--throw이벤트 받아서, self.fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState.DidLandOnFloor while로 돌리는 방식 구현 예상
	--현재는 lua 단에서 접근이 불가능해 아래와 같이 구현.

	--해당 값을 항아리의 좌표 y를 받아와 0이 되었을 때 올라 가도록 판별 하기 때문에, 2층 등이 존재 하는 다른 경우에 소급 적용 하기 어려움
	while not (pot.Position.y <= 0) do
		if self.is_pot_throw == false then
			--아예 탈출
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--씬 진행중이면 진행하지 않는다.
	if self.is_zone_leave_event then
		return
	end

	-- 1번 던질 시 : 아… 아야… 저를 던지지 마십시오.
	-- 2번 던질 시 : 이대로는 부서질 겁니다, 휴먼.
	-- 4번 던질 시 : 마지막 기회입니다, 휴먼.
	local speech_key_table = {
		self.string_key .. 4,
		self.string_key .. 5
	}
	-- 1번 던질 시 : 03_dialogue_worker_03
	-- 2번 던질 시 : 01_bombard_range_01
	local speech_sfx_key_table = {
		'03_dialogue_worker_03',
		'01_bombard_range_01'
	}
	--speech_key_table[num_pot_landed]

	self.num_pot_landed = self.num_pot_landed + 1
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_01')

	if self.num_pot_landed <= 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(speech_sfx_key_table[self.num_pot_landed])
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pot, { key = speech_key_table[self.num_pot_landed], skip = false })
		if self.num_pot_landed < 2 then
			--땅에 닿는 순간 브레이커블 0.3초간 shake 한다.
			pot:Shake(0.05, 0.6)
		else
			--땅에 닿는 순간부터 브레이커블 계속 shake 한다.
			pot:Shake(0.05, 9999)
			--1초마다 작게 먼지 구름(FX_Common_Jump_small) 난다.
			self.small_smoke_flag = true
			start_coroutine(function(_)
				while self.small_smoke_flag do
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_dash_01')
					self.get_fx_jump_smoke():Instantiate(pot.Position)
					wait_for_sec(1)
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end
			end,self)
		end

		--정량적 시간 2초 이후에 선풍기 영향 받는지 확인
		wait_for_sec(2.0)

		if self.is_effect_fan and not self.is_pot_hold then
			-- 어… 어지럽습니다…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pot, { key = self.string_key .. 1, skip = false })
			self.is_clear_fan_event = true
		end
	else
		--항아리 총 5번 던지면 항아리 파괴
		self.small_smoke_flag = false
		self.is_pot_broken = true
		self.current_state = self.event_state.pot_broken
		self.is_check_brazier_routine = false
		start_coroutine(self.break_pot, self, pot)
	end
end

--들고 그리드 밖으로 나가려고 하면 연출.(그리드 밖으로 못나가게 처리 위함)
function mini_event:leave_zone_with_hold(pot)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--TODO 해당 변수 필요 없을 확률 높음! start_scene에서 강제 throw때문에 on_throw_event 타는 거였으므로...
	self.is_pot_release = true
	-- 브레이커블 고정위치 캐싱
	local pot_pos = pot.Position

	--가디언 surprise, idle
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	--가디언 + 브레이커블 1초간 shake.
	scene_util.shake(leader, 0.05, 1.0)
	pot:Shake(0.05, 1.0)
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	--좌우 존 범위 기준.

	-- 브레이커블 내려놓고, 그 위치에 고정
	character_util.release_hold_object(user_party.Leader, pot)
	pot.Position = pot_pos

	local direction = 'right'
	local dirction_num = 1
	if pot_pos.x > field_util.get_marker_pos('me2_cam_pos').x then
		direction = 'left'
		dirction_num = -1
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, direction)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_future_knight_hit_01')

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5
	local start_pos = pot.Position
	local end_pos = leader.Position
			+ vector(2 * dirction_num, 0, 0)
	local height = 2.0
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		pot.Position = cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	--브레이커블이 점프해서 바닥으로 내려온다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_projectile_01')

	--항아리 : 이 곳이 숨기 좋으니 다른 곳으로 들고가지 마십시오.
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pot, self.string_key .. 7)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	self.is_pot_release = false
	self.is_pot_hold = false
	self.is_zone_leave_event = false
end

--우 존 밖으로 던지면 연출(그리드 밖으로 못나가게 처리 위함)
function mini_event:leave_zone_with_throw(pot)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	--멈출 때 까지 2.0초 정량적으로 기다려 줌.
	wait_for_sec(2.0)

	--그럼에도 불구하고 안 멈춰 있다면, GetThrownEndEvent SendSync
	if self.is_pot_throw == true then
		message_system:SendSync(pot, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		self.is_pot_throw = false
	end

	local left_pos_x = field_util.get_marker_pos('me2_pot_align_pos_1').x
	local right_pos_x = field_util.get_marker_pos('me2_pot_align_pos_2').x
	local align_pos = left_pos_x
	if pot.Position.x > right_pos_x then
		align_pos = right_pos_x
	end

	local pot_jump_move_twice = function()
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = pot.Position
		local duration = 0.5
		--도착 지점의 절반 지점으로 이동
		local end_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(pot.Position, (align_pos + start_pos.x) / 2.0)
		local height = 1.0

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
		while time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
			pot.Position = cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_01')
		--도착지점으로 이동
		time_passed = 0
		start_pos = pot.Position
		end_pos = vector(align_pos, 0, start_pos.z)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
		while time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
			pot.Position = cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_01')
	end

	--아래 대사와 함께 항아리가 1초에 걸쳐 0.5초 점프하며 방으로 들어온다.
	start_coroutine(pot_jump_move_twice, self)

	--항아리 : (스킵 불가능 대사)이 곳이 숨기 좋으니 다른 곳으로 던지지 마십시오.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pot, self.string_key .. 8, false)

	--방 중앙까지 걸어들어오지는 않고, 방 안쪽으로만 들어오도록
	self.is_zone_leave_event = false
end

function mini_event:break_pot(pot)
	--브레이커블 총 5번 던지면 브레이커블이 부서지면서 안드로이드가 튀어나온다.
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local pot_pos = pot.Position
	local android = self.get_android()

	--pot shake 멈춤
	pot:CancelShake()

	message_system:SendSync(pot, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	-- 파괴하기 위해 DamagedBehaviour PotDamagedBehaviour로 변경
	pot.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour()

	--데미지를 주어 파괴
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
	damage_info.sender = pot
	damage_info.target = pot
	damage_info.damage = CS.Oak.DamageConstants.ObjectImpact
	damage_info.direction = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position - pot.Position).normalized

	command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
	--말하고 있는 안드로이드 컷!
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(pot)

	--작게 먼지 구름(FX_Common_Jump_small) 난다.
	self.get_fx_jump_smoke():Instantiate(pot_pos + vector(0, 0.1, -0.2))

	--안드로이드 중앙에 도열?
	character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(android, pot_pos, true)

	--튀어나올 때, 에어스핀하면서 방 중앙에 떨어진다.
	start_coroutine(self.airspin_android, self, android)

	character_util.add_listener(android, self.event_controller.quest_controller.cs_controller)
end

function mini_event:airspin_android(android)
	--튀어나올 때, 에어스핀하면서 방 중앙에 떨어진다.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(android, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.75
	local start_pos = android.Position
	local end_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('me2_android_pos')
	local height = 3.5
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		character_util.set_position(android, cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0), true)
		local cur_rot = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 360 * 4, progress)
		character_util.spine_rotate(android, cur_rot, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	character_util.spine_rotate(android, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(android, end_pos)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(android, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'confused' })
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(android, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
	self.get_fx_jump_smoke():Instantiate(android.Position + vector(0, 0.1, -0.2))

end

function mini_event:pot_shaking_loop()
	local pot = self.get_android_pot()

	local function pot_shaking_internal(pot)
		local pot_shaking_duration = 1
		while self.is_pot_shaking and self.current_state < self.event_state.pot_held do
			field_object_util.shake(pot, 0.04, pot_shaking_duration)
			-- 항아리 shake마다 적용 (01_earthquake_10)
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_10',
										 play_pos = pot.Position,
										 loop = false,
										 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })

			local s = unity_class.time.time
			while unity_class.time.time - s < pot_shaking_duration * 2 do
				if not self.is_pot_shaking or self.current_state >= self.event_state.pot_held then
					return
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end
	end

	pot_shaking_internal(pot)
	field_object_util.stop_shake(pot)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return mini_event
	end

function mini_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.me3_first_zone_name)
			and self.is_time_check then
		self.is_time_check = false
		start_coroutine(self.android_first_event, self)
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.me3_second_zone_name) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.android_second_event, self)
	end
end

	scene_util.set_anim(android_4, self, 'release')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_4, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = self.get_me3_string_name .. 1, skip = false })

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	end
end

function mini_event:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local left_fan = self.get_wind_fan(1)
	local right_fan = self.get_wind_fan(2)

	if not (lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, left_fan)
			or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, right_fan)) then
		return
	end

	local turned_fan = e.Sender
	local event_name = e:GetParamAt(0)

	if event_name == 'wind_fan_end_rotation' then
		if self.reset_flag then
			return
		end

		self.reset_flag = true
		sp_util.start_scene(self.reset_android, self, turned_fan)
		return
	end
end

function mini_event:reset_android(fan)
	-- 이벤트가 왜 계속 날라옴???
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	local android_3 = self.get_android(3)
	local android_4 = self.get_android(4)

	scene_util.set_emotion(android_3, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_4, self, 'surprise')

	character_util.normal_jump(android_3, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(android_4, '01_player_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion(android_4, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(android_4, self, 'attack')

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(android_4)
	scene_util.set_anim(android_4, self, 'cast')
	if fan then
		fan.FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable():reverse_rotate()
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	self.reset_flag = false
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function()
		return mini_event
	end
}
