function mini_event:drill_zone_event()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero_ai = user_party[1]
	local detective_android = self.get_android(8)
	local leader_pos = self.get_leader_pos(3)
	local hero_ai_pos = self.get_leader_pos(3) + vector(1, 0, 0)
	local detective_android_pos = self.get_drill_pos(1)
	local drill_pos_list = {}
	local stair_drill = self.get_stairs(3)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(drill_pos_list, self.get_drill_pos(i))
	end
	self.maze_clear_flag = true

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_drill_zone
	--1초에 걸쳐 일행 전원 정렬.
	start_coroutine(self.align_party, self, 3, 'left', 1)
	wp_util.move(leader, leader_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move(hero_ai, hero_ai_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move(detective_android, detective_android_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	--카메라 포커스는 1초에 걸쳐 형사 최종 정렬 위치로 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(detective_android_pos, 1.0, { end_target = detective_android })
	--형사 안드로이드(tired, cross_arm) : 흠…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective_android, self, nil,
		{ name ='cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = '01_coop_matching_01' }, 'tired', self.get_me9_string_name .. 47)
	--형사 안드로이드(idle, idle) : 막다른 길이군요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective_android, self, nil, 'idle', 'idle',
			self.get_me9_string_name .. 48)
	--형사 안드로이드(idle, bomb_idle) : 분명 어딘가 숨겨진 길이 있을텐데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective_android, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', 'idle',
			self.get_me9_string_name .. 49)
	--형사 안드로이드(idle, cross_arm) : 내가 만약 불량품 안드로이드라면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective_android, self, nil, 'cross_arm', 'idle',
			self.get_me9_string_name .. 50)
	--형사 안드로이드 sleep_deep, idle 1초
	scene_util.set_emotion(detective_android, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(detective_android, self, 'idle')
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(detective_android)
	--형사 안드로이드 sleep_deep, idle로 shake 0.3초
	scene_util.shake(detective_android, 0.05, 0.3, '01_coop_matching_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	--
	--형사 안드로이드 sleep_deep, drill 애니메이션으로 맵 이곳 저곳을 파고 다닌다.
	local anim_drill = function(android, direction, keep_anim)
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(android, 'drill')
		local opposite = 'right'
		local direction_vector = vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
		local direction_rotation = 30
		if direction == 'right' then
			opposite = 'left'
			direction_vector = vector(0.5, 0, 0)
			direction_rotation = -30
		end
		--left일 때는 z축 30도 회전
		--0.3초만에 회전
		--각 위치에서 2회씩 반복
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_atomic_saw_02')
		character_util.spine_rotate(android, direction_rotation, 0.3)
		scene_util.set_direction(android, direction, false)
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, { name = 'drill', sfx_name = function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_atomic_saw_02', 0.7)
		end })

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_01')
		self.get_fx_small_smoke():Instantiate(android.Position + direction_vector)

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_01')
		self.get_fx_small_smoke():Instantiate(android.Position + direction_vector)

		direction_vector = direction_vector * -1
		direction_rotation = direction_rotation * -1


		--right일 때는 z축 -30도 회전
		--0.3초만에 회전
		--각 위치에서 2회씩 반복
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_atomic_saw_02')
		character_util.spine_rotate(android, direction_rotation, 0.3)
		scene_util.set_direction(android, opposite, false)
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'drill')

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_01')
		self.get_fx_small_smoke():Instantiate(android.Position + direction_vector)

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_01')
		self.get_fx_small_smoke():Instantiate(android.Position + direction_vector)

		if keep_anim then
			return
		end

		character_util.spine_rotate(android, 0, 0)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
	end


	--이동하는 동안 카메라 포커스는 형사 안드로이드에게.
	wp_util.move_async(detective_android, {
		vector_util.get_0yz(drill_pos_list[2], drill_pos_list[1].x),
		drill_pos_list[2]
	}, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	anim_drill(detective_android, 'left', false)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wp_util.move_async(detective_android, {
		vector_util.get_xy0(drill_pos_list[3], drill_pos_list[2].z),
		drill_pos_list[3]
	}, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	anim_drill(detective_android, 'left', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 뭐 하는 거야?(초록)
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_sector_ds_me9_50_1', 'mercy', function()
			-- 가디언 smile, bomb_idle 1초
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bomb_idle')
			wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			-- 형사(계속 drill 하면서, 표정만 attack으로) : 불량품 안드로이드의 사고를 추적하는 중입니다!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_02')
			scene_util.set_emotion(detective_android, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(detective_android, 'qc_sector_ds_me9_50_2', true)
		end },
	})

	character_util.spine_rotate(detective_android, 0, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(detective_android)

	wp_util.move_async(detective_android, {
		vector_util.get_xy0(drill_pos_list[4] + vector(0.5,0,0), drill_pos_list[3].z),
		drill_pos_list[4]+ vector(0.5,0,0)
	}, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	anim_drill(detective_android, 'right', false)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_03')
	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(drill_pos_list[4])
	stair_drill.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(hero_ai)
	wait_for_sec(1.0)

	--3번 위치에서 drill 애니메이션 실행하면, fx_dead 이펙트와 함께 계단 exit가 생겨난다.

	--진행한다면 drill 애니메이션 요청 필요

	--가디언, 카이, surprise, idle,  jump 1회
	--형사 안드로이드 시작 위치로 돌아온다.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(detective_android, '[base]weapon1')
	wp_util.move_async(detective_android, {
		vector_util.get_xy0(drill_pos_list[1], drill_pos_list[4].z),
		drill_pos_list[1]
	}, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	--형사 안드로이드(right, attack, victory_get) : 불량품 안드로이드의 단순한 사고 따위… 별 거 아닙니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective_android, self, 'right', 'victory_get', 'attack',
			self.get_me9_string_name .. 51)
	--가디언 선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--비논리적인 사고라고 하지 않았어?(노랑)
		{ self.get_me9_string_name .. 52, 'intellect' },
		--불량품을 이해하는 너는…(보라)
		{ self.get_me9_string_name .. 53, 'forced' },

	})
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--비논리적인 사고라고 하지 않았어?(노랑)
		--가디언 tired, bomb_idle
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'bomb_idle', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01' })
		wait_for_sec(1.0)
		--형사 안드로이드(tired, idle) : attack, idle, jump 1회, question 이모티콘
		scene_util.set_emotion(detective_android, self, 'attack')
		character_util.normal_jump(detective_android, '01_small_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(detective_android, nil, 'notice')
		--형사 안드로이드 : 비논리적인 사고…에 적응했을 뿐입니다.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(detective_android, self, nil, 'idle', 'tired',

function mini_event:enter()

function mini_event:start()
	local function get_jerico_stair_by_idx(idx)
		return get_field_object('me9_stairs_' .. idx)
	end

 	if not self.event_controller.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(9)
		and self.event_controller.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(7) then

		get_jerico_stair_by_idx(2).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

function mini_event:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
end

function mini_event:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_android_by_idx(1)) then
		-- Guard Clausure
		if self.is_epilogue_playing then
			return
		end

		self.is_epilogue_playing = true

		local android = self.get_android_by_idx(1)

		if self.event_controller:is_every_events_cleared() then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.play_event_1_epilogue_scene_cleared_all_events, self, android)
			return
		end

		if self.has_event_1_android_interacted then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.play_event_1_epilogue_scene_again, self, android)
		else
			self.has_event_1_android_interacted= true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.play_event_1_epilogue_scene_first_time, self, android)
		end
	end

local controller = newclass('AndroidMiniEventController')

function controller:init(quest_controller)
	self.quest_controller = quest_controller

	local file_path_prefix = 'Quest/Main/QueenCastle/SectorDesertSlave/AndroidMiniEvents/'

	local script_file_names = {
		file_path_prefix .. 'AndroidMiniEvent1.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'AndroidMiniEvent2.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'AndroidMiniEvent3.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'AndroidMiniEvent4.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'AndroidMiniEvent5.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'AndroidMiniEvent6.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'AndroidMiniEvent7.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'AndroidMiniEvent8.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'AndroidMiniEvent9.lua',
	}

	self.has_been_initialized = false

	self.event_scripts = self:load_scripts(script_file_names)
	self.epilogue_script = get_or_create_global_table(file_path_prefix .. 'AndroidMiniEventEpilogue.lua')(self)
end

function controller:load_scripts(file_names)
	local scripts = {}

	for i = 1, #file_names do
		local script = get_or_create_global_table(file_names[i])
		if script ~= nil then
			table.insert(scripts, script(self))
		end
	end

	return scripts
end

function controller:enter()
	local is_sector_story_progressing = self:is_sector_story_progressing()

	if not self.has_been_initialized then
		for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
			local is_event_cleared
				= self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_scripts[i].event_flag)
		
			if (not is_sector_story_progressing and not is_event_cleared) or is_sector_story_progressing then
				lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'enter', self.event_scripts[i])
			end
		end
	end

	if not is_sector_story_progressing then
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.epilogue_script, 'enter', self.epilogue_script)
	end
end
	
function controller:start()
	local is_sector_story_progressing = self:is_sector_story_progressing()
	if not self.has_been_initialized then
		for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
			local is_event_cleared
				= self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_scripts[i].event_flag)
			
			if (not is_sector_story_progressing and not is_event_cleared) or is_sector_story_progressing then
					lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'start', self.event_scripts[i])
			end
		end
	end

	if not is_sector_story_progressing then
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.epilogue_script, 'start', self.epilogue_script)
	end

	self.has_been_initialized = true
end

function controller:exit()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		-- 좀 더 직관적인 Nullable Call 방식은 없을까???
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'exit', self.event_scripts[i])
	end

	lua_helper.call_nullable(self.epilogue_script, 'exit', self.epilogue_script)

	self.quest_controller = nil
end

function controller:dispose()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		-- 좀 더 직관적인 Nullable Call 방식은 없을까???
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'dispose', self.event_scripts[i])
	end

	lua_helper.call_nullable(self.epilogue_script, 'dispose', self.epilogue_script)
end

function controller:on_event(e)
	local is_sector_story_progressing = self:is_sector_story_progressing()

	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		local is_event_cleared = self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(i)
		if not is_event_cleared then
			lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'on_event', self.event_scripts[i], e)
		end
	end

	if not is_sector_story_progressing then
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.epilogue_script, 'on_event', self.epilogue_script, e)
	end
end

function controller:is_every_events_cleared()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if not self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(i) then
			return false
		end 
	end

	return true
end

function controller:get_uncleared_events()
	local event_list = {}
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if not self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(i) then
			table.insert(event_list, self.event_scripts[i])
		end 
	end

	return event_list
end

function controller:get_num_not_joiend_androids()
	local uncleared_events = self:get_uncleared_events()
	local count = 0
	for i = 1, #uncleared_events do
		count = count + uncleared_events[i].num_designated_androids
	end

	return count
end

function controller:is_sector_story_progressing()
	return self.quest_controller.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 3
end

function controller:teleport_to_aligned_pos(android)
	local teleport_fx_pool 
		= unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.quest_controller.effect_name_cache.android_teleport)

	teleport_fx_pool:Instantiate(android.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
end

function controller:set_androids_for_epilogue_event(androids, idx)
	for i = 1, #androids do
		self:teleport_to_aligned_pos(androids[i])
	end
	
	self.epilogue_script:set_anroid_for_epilogue_event(idx)
end

function controller:set_anroid_for_epilogue_event(android, idx)
	self:teleport_to_aligned_pos(android)
	self.epilogue_script:set_anroid_for_epilogue_event(idx)
end

function controller:set_cherico_androids_for_epilogue_event(detective, android_11, android_12)
	self:teleport_to_aligned_pos(detective)
	self:teleport_to_aligned_pos(android_11)	
	self:teleport_to_aligned_pos(android_12)

	self.epilogue_script:set_jerico_event_epilogue()
end

return {
	create = function()
		return controller
	end
}

function local_class:load_async(handler)
	self.handler = handler

	-- 캐릭터 동적 생성
	local optimized_npc_list_data = {}
	for android_name, data in pairs(self.base_data) do
		optimized_npc_list_data[android_name] = data.spine_name
	end
	self.optimized_npc_list = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(optimized_npc_list_data)

	for k, v in pairs(self.optimized_npc_list) do
		v.Name = k
	end

	self:setting_after_making_androids()
	self.get_custom_sprite()
	self.get_hit_effect()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	self.custom_atlas = nil
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)


	self.pooled_bullet = {}
	for i = 1, self.bullet_num do
		self.pooled_bullet[i] = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
		bullet_sprite.SortingLayer = 'Top Effects'
		bullet_sprite.SortingOrder = 2

		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'bullet'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.is_routine_running = false

	if self.behaviour_data ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.behaviour_data do
			local behaviour = self.behaviour_data[i]
			behaviour:dispose()
			behaviour = nil
		end

		self.behaviour_data = nil
	end

	if self.optimized_npc_list ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npc_list)
		self.optimized_npc_list = nil
	end

	if self.pooled_bullet ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.pooled_bullet do
			self.pooled_bullet[i]:Dispose()
		end
		self.pooled_bullet = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.special_death_android_container = nil

	self.base_data = nil
	self.data = nil
end

--region 세팅
function local_class:setting_after_making_androids()
	-- 생성된 캐릭터 설정
	for android_name, android in pairs(self.optimized_npc_list) do
		local data = self.base_data[android_name]
		data.anim_args['one_shot_sfx'] = false

		character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(android, data.dir)
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self.handler, data.anim_args)
		scene_util.set_emotion(android, self.handler, data.emo_args)
		android.Position = data.pos

		if android.Position.y >= 1 then
			android.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 0.8, 1))
		end

		if data.show_weapon == true then
			character_util.spine_set_attachment(android, '[base]weapon1', 'energy_rifle')
		end

		--아이언 티탄 미사일에 맞을 수 있도록 세팅
		android.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
		android.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		android.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy

		if data.special_death_state ~= nil then
			android.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.None

			if self.special_death_android_container == nil then
				self.special_death_android_container = {}
			end

			self.special_death_android_container[android_name] = {
				character = android,
				state = data.special_death_state
			}
		else
			android.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.AirSpin
		end
	end
end

function local_class:special_death_event(e)
	if self.special_death_android_container == nil then
		return
	end

	local target = e.Info.target
	local target_data = self.special_death_android_container[target.Name]

	if target_data == nil then
		return
	end

	if target_data.state == 0 then
		target_data.state = 1
		start_coroutine(self.fly_out_to_screen, self, target)
	end
end

function local_class:fly_out_to_screen(fo)
	local height = 14
	local dur = 3
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local end_pos = fo.Position + vector(9, 3, -6.5)
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_scale = 1
	local end_scale = 6

	local start_rotation = vector(0, 0, 0)
	local end_rotation = vector(0, 0, 330)

	character_util.set_active_shadow(fo, false)
	scene_util.set_anim(fo, self.handler, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	while self.is_routine_running do
		if self.handler.is_game_end ~= nil and self.handler.is_game_end == true then
			break
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(time_passed, 0, 1, dur)

		if progress > 0.8 and not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(fo.Position) then
			break
		end

		local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)
		fo.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_rotation, end_rotation, progress))
		fo.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'disabled')
end

function local_class:run_routine()
	self:behaviour_init()

	self.is_game_end = self.handler.game_end
	self.is_routine_running = true

	while not self.is_game_end and self.is_routine_running do
		for i = 1, #self.behaviour_data do
			local behaviour = self.behaviour_data[i]

			if not behaviour:get_is_routine_end() then
				if behaviour.ignore_screen_check then
					behaviour:execute_routine()
				elseif screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(behaviour.fo.Position) then
					behaviour:execute_routine()
				end
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:clean()
	self.is_routine_running = false

	if self.behaviour_data ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.behaviour_data do
			local behaviour = self.behaviour_data[i]
			behaviour:dispose()
			behaviour = nil
		end

		self.behaviour_data = nil
	end

	for _, npc in pairs(self.optimized_npc_list) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
	end
end

--region base_behaviour
--기본적인 행동 패턴으로 말하는 것만 할 수 있도록 한다.
--모든 패턴이 대사는 출력할 수 있으니까 여기에 넣도록 하겠음
function base_behaviour:init(controller, fo, talk_args, shake)
	--정보 캐싱
	self.fo = fo
	self.is_fo_dead = false
	self.controller = controller
	self.iron_teatans = controller.handler.iron_teatans
	self.behaviour_routine_state = controller.behaviour_routine_state

	self.ignore_screen_check = false

	--해당 패턴 자체의 진행도
	self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.not_started

	--대사 관련
	self.talk_key = lua_helper.get_value(talk_args, 'key', nil)
	self.talk_distance = lua_helper.get_value(talk_args, 'talk_distance', nil)
	self.talk_world_pos = lua_helper.get_value(talk_args, 'world_pos', nil)
	self.is_shout = lua_helper.get_value(talk_args, 'shout', false)
	self.bubble_direction = lua_helper.get_value(talk_args, 'bubble_direction', nil)
	self.talk_sfx = lua_helper.get_value(talk_args, 'talk_sfx', nil)
	self.lower_priority = lua_helper.get_value(talk_args, 'lower_priority', false)

	-- 말하는 것에 대한 진행도
	self.talk_state = controller.talk_state
	self.cur_talk_state = self.talk_key ~= nil and self.talk_state.none or self.talk_state.talk_end

	self.shake = shake
	if self.shake ~= nil and self.is_routine_running == true then
		character_util.shake(self.fo, 0.03, 99999)
	end
end

function base_behaviour:dispose()
	if self.fo ~= nil then
		if self.cur_talk_state == self.talk_state.talking then
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.fo)
			self.cur_talk_state = self.talk_state.talk_end
		end

		if self.shake ~= nil then
			character_util.stop_shake(self.fo)
		end
	end

	self.fo = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.iron_teatans = nil
end

function base_behaviour:get_is_routine_end()
	return self.cur_behaviour_routine_state == self.behaviour_routine_state.routine_finished
end

function base_behaviour:execute_routine()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.fo, util.cs_generator(self.just_talk, self))
end

function base_behaviour:just_talk()
	if self.cur_behaviour_routine_state == self.behaviour_routine_state.not_started then
		self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.on_routine

		if self.cur_talk_state < self.talk_state.talk_end then
			self:talk()
		else
			self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.routine_finished
		end
	end
end

function base_behaviour:talk(on_talk_routine)
	self.is_fo_dead = self.fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled')

	--말하는 대상이 죽었으면 스피치 버블을 지워야한다.
	if self.is_fo_dead then
		if self.cur_talk_state == self.talk_state.talking then
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.fo)
		end
	end

	if self.cur_talk_state == self.talk_state.none then
		if self.talk_distance == nil then
			self.cur_talk_state = self.talk_state.on_talk
		else
			--거리 체크 후 스피치버블을 출력
			local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.iron_teatans.Position)
			local fo_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position)
			local distance = (target_pos - fo_pos).magnitude

			if distance < self.talk_distance then
				self.cur_talk_state = self.talk_state.on_talk
			end
		end
	end

	if self.cur_talk_state == self.talk_state.on_talk then
		self.cur_talk_state = self.talk_state.talking

		if on_talk_routine ~= nil then
			on_talk_routine()
		end

		if self.talk_sfx ~= nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.talk_sfx)
		end

		if self.is_shout then
			scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(self.fo, self.talk_key, false,
					{ bubble_direction = self.bubble_direction, world_pos = self.talk_world_pos, lower_priority = self.lower_priority })
		else
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.fo, self.talk_key, false,
					{ bubble_direction = self.bubble_direction, world_pos = self.talk_world_pos, lower_priority = self.lower_priority })
		end

		self.cur_talk_state = self.talk_state.talk_end
	end
end

--region play_simple_action
function play_simple_action:init(controller, fo, talk_args, anim_args, emo_args, jump_count)
	self.super:init(controller, fo, talk_args)

	self.talk_args = talk_args

	self.anim_args = anim_args
	self.emo_args = emo_args

	self.jump_count = jump_count

	self.simple_action = function()
		if self.anim_args ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(self.fo, self.controller.handler, self.anim_args)
		end

		if self.emo_args ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(self.fo, self.controller.handler, self.emo_args)
		end

		if self.jump_count ~= nil then
			if self.jump_count == 1 then
				character_util.normal_jump(self.fo, true)
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
			elseif self.jump_count == 2 then
				character_util.normal_double_jump(self.fo, true)
			end
		end
	end
end

function play_simple_action:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function play_simple_action:execute_routine()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.fo, util.cs_generator(self.play_simple_action_routine, self))
end

function play_simple_action:simple_action()
	if self.anim_args ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_anim(self.fo, self.controller.handler, self.anim_args)
	end

	if self.emo_args ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.fo, self.controller.handler, self.emo_args)
	end

	if self.jump_count ~= nil then
		if self.jump_count == 1 then
			character_util.normal_jump(self.fo, true)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		elseif self.jump_count == 2 then
			character_util.normal_double_jump(self.fo, true)
		end
	end
end

function play_simple_action:play_simple_action_routine()
	if self.cur_behaviour_routine_state == self.behaviour_routine_state.not_started then
		if self.talk_args ~= nil then
			if self.cur_talk_state < self.talk_state.talk_end then
				self:talk(self.simple_action)
			else
				self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.routine_finished
			end
		else
			self.is_fo_dead = self.fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled')

			if self.fo ~= nil and not self.is_fo_dead then
				if self.talk_distance == nil then
					self.simple_action()
				else
					--거리 체크 후 스피치버블을 출력
					local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.iron_teatans.Position)
					local fo_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position)
					local distance = (target_pos - fo_pos).magnitude

					if distance < self.talk_distance then
						self.simple_action()
					end
				end
				self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.routine_finished
			end
		end
	end
end

--region shoot_behaviour
function shoot_behaviour:init(controller, fo, talk_args, wp_args)
 	self.super:init(controller, fo, talk_args)

	self.talk_args = talk_args

	self.speed = lua_helper.get_value(wp_args, 'speed', 6)
	self.wp = lua_helper.get_value(wp_args, 'relative_wp', nil)
	if self.wp ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.wp do
			self.wp[i] = self.wp[i] + self.fo.Position
		end
	end

	self.last_direction = lua_helper.get_value(wp_args, 'last_direction', nil)

	-- 무기 착용시키기
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(fo, '[base]weapon1', 'energy_rifle')
	scene_util.set_anim(fo, controller.handler, 'rifle_idle')

	self.pooled_bullet = self.controller.pooled_bullet
end

function shoot_behaviour:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function shoot_behaviour:execute_routine()
	if self.cur_behaviour_routine_state == self.behaviour_routine_state.not_started then
		self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.on_routine
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.fo, util.cs_generator(self.start_shooting, self))
	end
end

function shoot_behaviour:start_shooting()
	if self.wp == nil then
		self:shoot()
	else
		character_util.remove_anim(self.fo)
		wp_util.move_async(self.fo, self.wp, self.speed, nil, { run = true })

		if self.last_direction ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(self.fo, self.last_direction)
		end

		self:shoot()
	end
end

function shoot_behaviour:get_bullet()
	for i = 1, #self.pooled_bullet do
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		if bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition == vector(999, 0, 999) then
			return bullet_sprite
		end
	end
end

function shoot_behaviour:shoot()
	local is_dead = false
	local start_shooting = false

	local talked = false

	-- 죽지 않았다면 타겟을 향해 총을 발사.
	while true do
		-- 자신이 죽었는지 반영
		is_dead = self.fo == nil or self.fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') or
				(not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(self.fo.Position) and start_shooting) or
				self:get_is_routine_end()

		if is_dead then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		start_shooting = true

		if not talked and self.talk_args ~= nil then
			talked = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.fo, util.cs_generator(self.talk, self))
		end

		scene_util.set_anim_async(self.fo, self.controller.handler, { name = 'rifle_reload', count = 1 })

		local timer = 0
		local duration = 3;

		--CS.Debug.LogError('for time of ' .. duration .. ', move to v(' .. end_pos.x .. ', ' .. end_pos.y .. ', ' .. end_pos.z .. ')')

		while true do
			is_dead = self.fo == nil or self.fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') or
					(not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(self.fo.Position) and start_shooting) or
					self:get_is_routine_end()

			if is_dead then
				break
			end

			local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.iron_teatans.Bounds.center, 3)
			local fo_pos = self.fo.Bounds.center
			local dir = direction_util.to_str(vector_util.to_direction(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - fo_pos)))

			-- 여기서 총알 발사.
			scene_util.set_direction(self.fo, dir)
			scene_util.set_anim(self.fo, self.controller.handler, 'rifle_shoot')
			local start_pos = fo_pos + direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.fo.Direction) * 0.6
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			-- 프로젝타일 생성하기

			local bullet_sprite = self:get_bullet()
			if bullet_sprite ~= nil then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_03')
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.fo, util.cs_generator(self.create_projectile,
						self, bullet_sprite, start_pos, target_pos, 25))
			end

			wait_for_sec(0.4)
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime + 0.6
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.routine_finished
end

function shoot_behaviour:create_projectile(bullet_sprite, shoot_pos, target_pos, speed)
	local bullet_trans = bullet_sprite.transform

	bullet_trans.position = shoot_pos

	local diff = target_pos - shoot_pos
	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(diff)

	bullet_trans.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	--yield_return_func(self.bullet_move_to, self, bullet_sprite,
	--		bullet_sprite.localPosition, target_pos + diff * 0.3, -1, speed)

	local origin_pos = shoot_pos
	local end_pos = target_pos + diff * 0.5

	diff = end_pos - origin_pos;
	local timer = 0
	local duration = diff.magnitude / speed;
	local is_alive = true
	--CS.Debug.LogError('for time of ' .. duration .. ', move to v(' .. end_pos.x .. ', ' .. end_pos.y .. ', ' .. end_pos.z .. ')')

	while timer < duration and is_alive do
		if self.super:get_is_routine_end() then
			break
		end

		local player_pos = self.iron_teatans.Bounds.center
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(timer / duration)
		local currentPos = origin_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress
		bullet_trans.position = currentPos

		local player_rect_min = vector(player_pos.x - 1, 0, player_pos.z - 1)
		local player_rect_max = vector(player_pos.x + 1, 0, player_pos.z + 1)

		if player_rect_min.x < currentPos.x and player_rect_max.x > currentPos.x and player_rect_min.z < currentPos.z and player_rect_max.z > currentPos.z then
			is_alive = false
			-- fx hit 스폰
			self.controller.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(currentPos)
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	bullet_trans.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

--endregion

--region dash_behaviour
function dash_behaviour:init(controller, fo, talk_args, dash_args, group_flag)
	self.super:init(controller, fo, talk_args)

	self.ignore_screen_check = true

	self.start_move_dis = lua_helper.get_value(dash_args, 'start_move_dis', nil)
	self.speed = lua_helper.get_value(dash_args, 'speed', 6)
	self.wp = lua_helper.get_value(dash_args, 'relative_wp', nil)
	if self.wp ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.wp do
			self.wp[i] = self.wp[i] + self.fo.Position
		end
	end

	self.is_jump = lua_helper.get_value(dash_args, 'jump', false)
	self.jump_distance = lua_helper.get_value(dash_args, 'jump_distance', 7)
	self.jump_height = lua_helper.get_value(dash_args, 'jump_height', 3)

	self.group_flag_name = lua_helper.get_value(dash_args, 'group_flag_name', nil)
end

function dash_behaviour:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end
function dash_behaviour:execute_routine()
	self:dash_move()
end

function dash_behaviour:dash_move()
	local dash_routine = function(fo, target)
		local moving = true
		local should_jump = false

		character_util.remove_anim(fo)
		wp_util.move(fo, self.wp, self.speed, nil, { run = true, end_callback = function()
			moving = false
		end })

		if self.is_jump then
			while moving do
				local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Bounds.center)
				local fo_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position)
				local distance = (target_pos - fo_pos).magnitude

				if distance < self.jump_distance then
					character_util.stop(fo)
					moving = false

					should_jump = true
				end
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end

		if should_jump and not self.jump_started then
			self.jump_started = true
			scene_util.set_anim(fo, self.controller.handler, { name = 'get' })
			character_util.jump_move(fo, target.Bounds.center, self.speed, self.jump_height)
		end

		self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.routine_finished
	end

	if self.cur_behaviour_routine_state == self.behaviour_routine_state.not_started then
		if self.group_flag_name ~= nil then
			local group_flag = self.controller.group_flags[self.group_flag_name]

			if group_flag == false then
				local fo_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position)
				local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.iron_teatans.Bounds.center)
				local distance = (target_pos - fo_pos).magnitude

				if distance > self.start_move_dis then
					return
				end

				self.controller.group_flags[self.group_flag_name] = true
			end
		else
			local fo_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position)
			local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.iron_teatans.Bounds.center)
			local distance = (target_pos - fo_pos).magnitude

			if distance > self.start_move_dis then
				return
			end
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.fo, util.cs_generator(self.talk, self))

		self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.on_routine
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.fo, util.cs_generator(function()
			dash_routine(self.fo, self.iron_teatans)
			self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.routine_finished
		end))
	end
end

--endregion

--region retreat_behaviour
function retreat_behaviour:init(controller, fo, talk_args, wp_args, before_action_args, end_action_args)
	self.super:init(controller, fo, talk_args)

	self.speed = lua_helper.get_value(wp_args, 'speed', 6)
	self.wp = lua_helper.get_value(wp_args, 'relative_wp', nil)
	if self.wp ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.wp do
			self.wp[i] = self.wp[i] + self.fo.Position
		end
	end

	self.is_jump = lua_helper.get_value(before_action_args, 'jump', false)
	self.was_shake = lua_helper.get_value(before_action_args, 'shake', nil)

	self.anim_args = lua_helper.get_value(end_action_args, 'anim_args', nil)
	self.emo_args = lua_helper.get_value(end_action_args, 'emo_args', nil)
	self.last_direction = lua_helper.get_value(end_action_args, 'last_direction', nil)
	self.is_shake = lua_helper.get_value(end_action_args, 'shake', nil)
end

function retreat_behaviour:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function retreat_behaviour:execute_routine()
	self:retreat_move()
end

function retreat_behaviour:retreat_move()
	local move_before_action = function()
		if self.is_jump then
			character_util.normal_jump(self.fo, true)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end

		if self.was_shake then
			character_util.shake(self.fo, 0.03, 999)
		end
	end

	local move_end_action = function()
		if self.anim_args ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(self.fo, self.controller.handler, self.anim_args)
		end

		if self.emo_args ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(self.fo, self.controller.handler, self.emo_args)
		end

		if self.last_direction ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(self.fo, self.last_direction)
		end

		if self.is_shake then
			character_util.shake(self.fo, 0.03, 9999)
		end

		if self.talk_key ~= nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.fo, util.cs_generator(self.talk, self))
		end
	end

	if self.cur_behaviour_routine_state == self.behaviour_routine_state.not_started then
		self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.on_routine
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.fo, util.cs_generator(function()
			move_before_action()
			if self.was_shake then
				character_util.stop_shake(self.fo)
			end
			character_util.remove_anim(self.fo)
			wp_util.move_async(self.fo, self.wp, self.speed, nil, { run = true, end_callback = move_end_action })
			self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.routine_finished
		end))
	end
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local base_behaviour_path = 'Quest/Main/QueenCastle/SectorTeatanHero/AndroidArmy/AndroidArmyBaseBehaviour'
local base_behaviour = get_or_create_global_table(base_behaviour_path)

local local_class = newclass('AndroidArmyJustTalkBehaviour', base_behaviour)

function local_class:init(controller, fo, talk_key, talk_distance)
	self.super:init(controller, fo)

	self.talk_key = talk_key
	self.talk_distance = talk_distance
	self.talking = false
end

function local_class:run_routine()
	self.is_fo_dead = self.fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled')

	--말하는 대상이 죽었으면 스피치 버블을 지워야한다.
	if self.is_fo_dead then
		if self.talking then
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.fo)
		end
	end

	if self.cur_behaviour_routine_state == self.behaviour_routine_state.not_started then
		if self.talk_distance == nil then
			--거리 체크를 하지 않으면 화면 안에 보일 때 대사 출력
			if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(self.fo.Position) then
				self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.on_routine
			end
		else
			--거리 체크 후 스피치버블을 출력
			local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.iron_teatans.Position)
			local fo_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position)
			local distance = (target_pos - fo_pos).magnitude

			if distance < self.talk_distance then
				self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.on_routine
			end
		end
	elseif self.cur_behaviour_routine_state == self.behaviour_routine_state.on_routine then
		start_coroutine(function()
			self.talking = true
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.fo, self.talk_key, false)
			self.talking = false
			self.cur_behaviour_routine_state = self.behaviour_routine_state.routine_finished
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end


return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}
